00011 aṃśavastava niśākara nūnaṃ kalpitāstaruṇaketakakhaṇḍaiḥ |
00012 yena pāṇḍurataradyutayo naḥ kaṇṭakairiva tudanti śarīram ||
00021 aṃśukaṃ hṛtavatā tanubāhu svastikāpihitamugdhakucāgrā |
00022 bhinnaśaṅkhavalayaṃ pariṇetrā paryarambhi rabhasādaciroḍhā ||
00031 aṃśukamiva śītabhayātsaṃstyānatvacchalena himadhavalam |
00032 ambhobhirapi gṛhītaṃ paśyata śiśirasya māhātmyam ||
00041 aṃśukena jaghanaṃ tirodadhe ka cukena ca kucau mṛgīdṛśām |
00042 pīyamānamaniśaṃ priyekṣaṇaiḥ kṣāmatāmiva jagāma madhyamam ||
00051 aṃśupāṇibhiratīva pipāsuḥ padmajaṃ madhu bhṛśaṃ rasayitvā |
00052 kṣībatāmiva gataḥ kṣitimeṣyaṃllohitaṃ vapuruvāha pataṅgaḥ ||
00061 aṃśumānapi vipākapiśaṅgaṃ rūpamāpa parito divasānte |
00062 kaḥ paro'tra na vikāramupeyāddhvāntabhīmaparivellitamūrtiḥ ||
00071 aṃśo daṇḍasamaḥ pūrvaḥ prayāsasama uttamaḥ |
00072 vilopo vā yathālābhaṃ prakṣepasama eva vā ||
00081 aṃśo'pi duṣṭadiṣṭānāṃ pareṣāṃ syādvināśakṛt |
00082 bālaleśo'pi vyāghrāṇāṃ yatsyājjīvitahānaye ||
00091 aṃsāvavaṣṭabdhanatā samādhiḥ śirodharāyā rahitaprayāsaḥ |
00092 dhṛtā vikārāṃstyajatā mukhena prasādalakṣmīḥ śaśalāñchanasya ||
00101 aṃsālambitavāmakuṇḍaladharaṃ mandonnatabhrūlataṃ kiṃcitkuñcitakomalādharapuṭaṃ sāciprasārīkṣaṇam |
00102 alolāṅgulipallavairmuralikāmāpūrayantaṃ mudā mūle kalpatarostribhaṅgalalitaṃ dhyāye jaganmohanam ||
00111 aṃsāsaktakapolavaṃśavadanavyāsaktabimbādharadvandvodīritamandamandapavanprārabdhamugdhadhvaniḥ |
00112 īṣadvakrimalolahāranikaraḥ pratyekarokānananyañcaccañcadudañcadaṅgulicayastvāṃ pātu rādhādhavaḥ ||
00121 aṃsena karṇaṃ cibukena vakṣaḥ karadvayenākṣi tirodadhānām |
00122 saṃtāḍayāmāsa hariḥ sametya cakoranetrāṃ calukodakena ||
00131 aṃhaḥ saṃharadakhilaṃ sakṛdudayādeva sakalalokasya |
00132 taraṇiriva timirajaladhiṃ jayati jaganmaṅgalaṃ harernāma ||
00141 akaṇṭakā puṣpamahī veśayoṣidamātṛkā |
00142 mantrihīnā ca rājyaśrīrbhujyate viṭaceṭakaiḥ ||
00151 akaṇṭhasya kaṇṭhe kathaṃ puṣpamālā vinā nāsikāyāḥ kathaṃ dhūpagandhaḥ |
00152 akarṇasya karṇe kathaṃ gītanṛtyamapādasya pāde kathaṃ me praṇāmaḥ ||
00161 akaparddakasya viphalaṃ januriti jānīmahe maheśo'pi |
00162 śirasi kṛtena kaparddī bhavati jaṭājūṭakenāpi ||
00171 akaravamadhimauli pādapadmāvapanaya mānini mānitāmakāṇḍe |
00172 yadi pararamaṇīṃ gatastadātha stanayugaliṅgayugaṃ sprśāmi tanvi ||
00181 akaruṇa kātaramanasā darśitanīrā nirantarāleyam |
00182 tvāmanudhāvati vimukhaṃ gaṅgeva bhagīrathaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ ||
00191 akaruṇatvamakāraṇavigrahaḥ paradhanāpahṛtiḥ parayoṣitaḥ |
00192 svajanabandhujaneṣvasahiṣṇutā prakṛtisidhamidaṃ hi durātmanām ||
00201 akaruṇa mṛṣābhāśāsindho vimuñca mamāñcalaṃ tava paricitaḥ snehaḥ samyaṅmayetyabhidhāyinīm |
00202 aviralagaladvāṣpāṃ tanvīṃ nirastavibhūṣaṇāṃ ka iha bhavatīṃ bhadre nidre vinā vinivedayet ||
00211 akaroḥ kimu netraśoṇimānaṃ kimakārṣīḥ karapallavāvarodham |
00212 kalahaṃ kimadhāḥ krudhā rasajñe hitamarthaṃ na vidanti daivadaṣṭāḥ ||
00221 akarṇamakaroccheṣaṃ vidhirbrahmāṇḍabhaṅgadhīḥ |
00222 śrutvā rāmakathāṃ ramyāṃ śiraḥ kasya na kampate ||
00231 akarṇadhārāśugasaṃbhṛtāṅgatāṃ gatairaritreṇa vināsya vairibhiḥ |
00232 vidhāya yāvattaraṇerbhidāmaho nimajjya tīrṇaḥ samare bhavārṇavaḥ ||
00241 akartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapi |
00242 kartavyameva kartavyaṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapi ||
00251 akartavyeṣvasādhvīva tṛṣṇā prerayate janam |
00252 tameva sarvapāpebhyo lajjā māteva rakṣati ||
00261 akarmaṇāṃ vai bhūtānāṃ vṛttiḥ syānna hi kācana |
00262 tadevābhriprapadyeta na vihanyātkathaṃcana ||
00271 akarmaśīlaṃ ca mahāśanaṃ ca lokadviṣṭaṃ bahumāyaṃ nṛśaṃsam |
00272 adeśakālajñamaniṣṭaveṣametān gṛhe na prativāsayīta ||
00281 akalaṅkacandrakalayā kalitā sā bhāti vāruṇī taruṇī |
00282 bhālasthalīva śambhoḥ saṃdhyādhyānopaviṣṭasya ||
00291 akalaṅkāntike kāntiḥ keti kālaṅkalaṅkinaḥ |
00292 aruṇe taruṇe masyā dhāvaṃ kāmayate śaśī ||
00301 akalaṅkā pulakavatī sasnehā muktakañcukī śyāmā |
00302 patatu tavorasi dayitā khaṅgalatā vairiṇaḥ śirasi ||
00311 akalaṅko dṛḍhaḥ śuddhaḥ parivārī guṇānvitaḥ |
00312 sadvaṃśo hṛdayagrāhī khaṅgaḥ susadṛśastava ||
00321 akalitanijapararūpaḥ svakamapi doṣaṃ parasthitaṃ vetti |
00322 nāvāsthitastaṭasthānacalānapi vicalitānmanute ||
00331 akaliyugamakharvamatra hṛdyaṃ vyacaradapāpaghano yataḥ kuṭumbī |
00332 mama ruciriha lakṣmaṇāgrajena prabhavati śarmadaśāsyamardena ||
00341 akalilatapastejovīryaprathimni yaśonidhā vavitathamadadhmāte roṣānmunāvabhidhāvati |
00342 abhinavadhanurvidyādarpakṣamāya ca karmaṇe sphurati rabhasātpāṇiḥ pādopasaṃgrahaṇāya ca ||
00351 akalpaḥ svāṅgaceṣṭāyāṃ śakunta iva pañjare |
00352 anucchvasansmaran pūrvaṃ garbhe kiṃ nāma vindate ||
00361 akasmātprakriyā nṝṇāmakasmāccāpakarṣaṇam |
00362 śubhāśubhe mahattvaṃ ca prakartuṃ buddhilāghavāt ||
00371 akasmādapi yaḥ kaścidarthaṃ prāpnoti pūruṣaḥ |
00372 taṃ haṭheneti manyante sa hi yatno na kasyacit ||
00381 akasmādunmatta praharasi kimadhvakṣitiruhaṃ hradaṃ hastāghātairvidalasi kimutphullanalinam |
00382 tadā jānīmaste karivara balodgāramasamaṃ saṭāṃ suptasyāpi spṛśasi yadi pañcānanaśiśoḥ ||
00391 akasmādekasmin pathi sakhi mayā yāmunataṭaṃ vrajantyā dṛṣṭo'yaṃ navajaladharaśyāmalatanuḥ |
00392 sa dṛgbhaṅgyā kiṃ vākuruta na hi jāne tata idaṃ mano me vyālolaṃ kvacana gṛhakṛtye na lagate ||
00401 akasmādeva kupyanti prasīdantyanimittataḥ |
00402 śīlametadasādhūnāmabhraṃ pāriplavaṃ yathā ||
00411 akasmādeva tanvaṅgī jahāsa yadiyaṃ punaḥ |
00412 nūnaṃ prasūnabāṇo'syāṃ svārājyamadhitiṣṭhati ||
00421 akasmādeva te caṇḍi sphuritādharapallavam |
00422 mukhaṃ muktāruco dhatte gharmāmbhaḥkaṇamañjarīḥ ||
00431 akasmādeva yaḥ kopādabhīkṣṇaṃ bahu bhāṣate |
00432 tasmādudvijate lokaḥ sasphuliṅgādivānalāt ||
00441 akasmāddveṣṭi yo bhaktamājanmaparisevitam |
00442 na vyañjane ruciryasya tyājyo nṛpa ivāturaḥ ||
00451 akāṇḍakopino bharturanyāsakteśca yoṣitaḥ |
00452 praśāntiścetasaḥ kartuṃ brahmaṇāpi na śakyate ||
00461 akāṇḍadhrtamānasavyavasitotsavaiḥ sārasairakāṇdapaṭutāṇḍavairapi śikhaṇḍināṃ maṇḍalaiḥ |
00462 diśaḥ samavalokitāḥ sarasanirbharaprollasadbhavatpṛthuvarūthinīrajanibhūrajaḥśyāmalāḥ ||
00471 akāṇḍapātajātānāmastrāṇāṃ marmabhedinām |
00472 gāḍhaśokaprahārāṇāmacintaiva mahauṣadham ||
00481 akāṇḍe vakṣojaskhalitavasanavyāpṛtakaraṃ mṛṣā jṛmbhārambhonnamitabhujabandhonnatakucam |
00482 vṛthā yātāyātaiḥ kapaṭakalitānyonyahasitaṃ harantyetāścittānyahaha jagatāṃ vāravanitāḥ ||
00491 akāmasya kriyā kāciddṛśyate neha kaṛhicit |
00492 yadyaddhi kurute kiṃcittattatkāmasya ceṣṭitam ||
00501 akāmāṃ kāmayānasya śarīramupatapyate |
00502 icchantīṃ kāmayānasya prītirbhavati śobhanā ||
00511 akāmān kāmayati yaḥ kāmayānān paridviṣan |
00512 balavantaṃ ca yo dveṣṭi tamāhurmūḍhacetasam ||
00521 akāraṇaṃ rūpamakāraṇaṃ kulaṃ mahatsu nīceṣu ca karma śobhate |
00522 idaṃ hi rūpaṃ paribhutapūrvakaṃ tadeva bhūyo bahumānamāgatam ||
00531 akāraṇaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ tantrīśabdo'pyakāraṇam |
00532 akāraṇaṃ trayo vedāstaṇḍulāstatra kāraṇam ||
00541 akāraṇāviṣkṛtakopadāruṇātkhalādbhayaṃ kasya na nāma jāyate |
00542 viṣaṃ mahāheriva yasya durvacaḥ suduḥsahaṃ saṃnihitaṃ sadā mukhe ||
00551 akāraṇena viprebhyo yaḥ kupyati narādhipaḥ |
00552 krṣṇasarpaṃ sa gṛhṇāti śirasā baladaṛpitaḥ ||
00561 akāryakaraṇādbhītaḥ kāryāṇāṃ ca vivarjanāt |
00562 akāle mantrabhedācca yena mādyenna tatpibet ||
00571 akāryapratiṣedhaśca kāryāṇāṃ ca pravartanam |
00572 pradānaṃ ca pradeyānāmadeyānāmasaṃgrahaḥ ||
00581 akāryamasakṛtkṛtvā dṛśyante hyadhanā narāḥ |
00582 dhanayuktāstvadharmasthā dṛśyante cāpare janāḥ ||
00591 akāryāṇyapi paryāpya kṛtvāpiṃ vṛjinārjanam |
00592 vidhīyate hitaṃ yasya sa dehaḥ kasya susthiraḥ ||
00601 akārye tathyo vā bhavati vitathaḥ kāmamathavā tathāpyuccairdhāmnāṃ harati mahimānaṃ janaravaḥ |
00602 tulottīrṇasyāpi prakaṭanihatāśeṣatamaso ravestādṛktejo na hi bhavati kanyāṃ gata iti ||
00611 akālacaryā viṣamā ca goṣṭhī kumitrasevā na kadāpi kāryā |
00612 paśyāṇḍajaṃ padmavane prasuptaṃ dhanurvimuktena śareṇa bhinnam ||
00621 akālajaladendoḥ sā hṛdyā vadanacandrikā |
00622 nityaṃ kavicakorairyā pīyate na ca hīyate ||
00631 akālajaladaślokaiścitramātmakṛtairiva |
00632 jātaḥ kādambarīrāmo nāṭake pravaraḥ kaviḥ ||
00641 akālajaladacchannamālokya ravimaṇḍalam |
00642 cakravākayugaṃ rauti rajanībhayaśaṅkayā ||
00651 akālamṛtyuṃ parihṛtya jīvitaṃ dadāti yo dehasukhaṃ ca dehinām |
00652 natena dhātrāsti samaḥ kuto'dhiko na jīvitāddānamihātiricyate ||
00661 akālamṛtyurviśvāso viśvasan hi vipadyate |
00662 yasmin karoti viśvāsaṃ sa jīvatyaparo mṛtaḥ ||
00671 akālasahamatyalpaṃ mūrkhavyasanināyakam |
00672 aguptaṃ bhīruyodhaṃ ca durgavyasanamucyate ||
00681 akālasainyayuktastu hanyate kālayodhinā |
00682 kauśikena hatajyotirniśītha iva vāyasaḥ ||
00691 akāle kṛtyamārabdhaṃ kaṛtuṃ nārthāya kalpate |
00692 tadeva kāla ārabdhaṃ mahate'rthāya kalpate ||
00701 akāle garjite deve durdinaṃ vāthavā bhavet |
00702 pūrvakāṇḍahataṃ lakṣyamanadhyāyaṃ pracakṣate ||
00711 akiṃcanaḥ paripatan sukhamāsvādayiṣyasi |
00712 akiṃcanaḥ sukhaṃ śete samuttiṣṭhati caiva hi ||
00721 akiṃcanatvaṃ rājyaṃ ca tulayā samatolayat |
00722 akiṃcanatvamadhikaṃ rājyādapi jitātmanaḥ ||
00731 akiṃcanasya dāntasya śāntasya samacetasaḥ |
00732 mayā saṃtuṣṭamanasaḥ sarvāḥ sukhamayā diśaḥ ||
00741 akiṃcanasya śuddhasya upapannasya sarvaśaḥ |
00742 avekṣamāṇastrīṃllokānna tulyamupalakṣaye ||
00751 akiṃcanāśca dṛśyante puruṣāścirajīvinaḥ |
00752 samṛddhe ca kule jātā vinaśyanti pataṃgavat ||
00761 akiṃcitkāriṇāṃ dīnairākṛṣṭaguṇakarmaṇām |
00762 aghāya gatasattvānāṃ darśanasparśanādikam ||
00771 akīrtiṃ cāpi bhūtāni kathayiṣyanti te'vyayām |
00772 saṃbhāvitasya cākīrtirmaraṇādatiricyate ||
00781 akīrtiryasya gīyeta loke bhūtasya kasyacit |
00782 patatyevādhamāṃllokān yāvacchabdaḥ prakīrtyate ||
00791 akīrtirnindyate devaiḥ kīrtirlokeṣu pūjyate |
00792 kīrtyarthaṃ tu samārambhaḥ sarveṣāṃ sumahātmanām ||
00801 akīrteḥ kāraṇaṃ yoṣidyoṣidvairasya kāraṇam |
00802 saṃsārakāraṇaṃ yoṣidyoṣitaṃ varjayettataḥ ||
00811 akuṇṭhotkaṇṭhayā pūrṇamakaṇṭhaṃ kalakaṇṭhi mām |
00812 kambukaṇṭhyāḥ kṣaṇaṃ kaṇṭhe kuru kaṇṭhārtimuddhara ||
00821 akuberapurīvilokanaṃ na dharāsūnukaraṃ kadācana |
00822 atha tatpratikārahetave'damayantīpatilocanaṃ bhaja ||
00831 akurvanto'pi pāpāni śucayaḥ pāpasaṃśrayāt |
00832 parapāpairvinaśyanti matsyā nāgahrade yathā ||
00841 akulānāṃ kule bhāvaṃ kulīnānāṃ kulakṣayam |
00842 saṃyogaṃ viprayogaṃ ca paśyanti cirajīvinaḥ ||
00851 akulīnaḥ kulīnaśca maryādāṃ yo na laṅghayet |
00852 dharmāpekṣī mṛdurdāntaḥ sa kulīnaśatairvaraḥ ||
00861 akulīnastu puruṣaḥ prakṛtaḥ sādhusaṃkṣayāt |
00862 durlabhaiśvaryasaṃprāpto garvitaḥ śatrutāṃ vrajet ||
00871 akulīno'pi mūrkho'pi bhūpālaṃ yo'tra sevate |
00872 api saṃmānahīno'pi sa sarvatra prapūjyate ||
00881 akule patito rājā mūrkhaputro hi paṇḍitaḥ |
00882 nirdhanasya dhanaprāptistṛṇavanmanyate jagat ||
00891 akūpārādvāri pracurataramādāya jaladaḥ sa dānādhyakṣo'pi prakirati jalaṃ nādbhutamidam |
00892 sa megho dhanyo yatparikirati muktāphalatayā yadīyāsau kīrtirnaṭati nṛpanārīkucataṭe ||
00901 akūrcārambho'pi praticubukadeśaṃ karatalaṃ pratijñāyāṃ kurvan yuvatiṣu dṛśaṃ snigdhataralām |
00902 kumāro'haṃ kārātpariṣadi samānānagaṇayan bhujau vakṣaḥ paśyannavavayasi kāntiṃ vitanute ||
00911 akṛtakavalārambhairvaktrairbhayasthagitekṣaṇāḥ kimapi valitagrīvaṃ sthitvā muhurmṛgapaṅktayaḥ |
00912 gaganamasakṛtpaśyantyetāstathāśrughanairmukhairnipatati yathā śṛṅgāgrebhyo'kramaṃ nayanodakam ||
00921 akṛtajñamanāryaṃ ca dīrgharoṣamanārjavam |
00922 caturo viddhi cāṇḍālāñjātyā jāyeta pañcamaḥ ||
00931 akṛtatyāgamahimnāṃ mithyā kiṃ rājarājaśabdena |
00932 goptāraṃ na nidhīnāṃ mahayanti maheśvaraṃ vibudhāḥ ||
00941 akṛtadviṣadunnaticchidaḥ śritasaṃrakṣaṇavandhyakarmaṇaḥ |
00942 puruṣasya nirarthakaḥ karaḥ kila kaṇḍūyanamātrasārthakaḥ ||
00951 akṛtapremaiva varaṃ na punaḥ saṃjātavighaṭitapremā |
00952 uddhṛtanayanastāmyati yathā hi na tatheha jātāndhaḥ ||
00961 akṛta viśadadhāmno bimbasāraṃ gṛhītvā dayita yuvativaktraṃ lokadhātreti vidmaḥ |
00962 na hi na hi bhavadīyo moha evaiṣa mitra sitagaralanidhānaṃ tattvato niścinu tvam ||
00971 akṛtasyāgamo nāsti kṛte nāśo na vidyate |
00972 akasmādeva loko'yaṃ tṛṣṇe dāsīkṛtastvayā ||
00981 akṛtātmānamāsādya rājānamanaye ratam |
00982 samṛddhāni vinaśyanti rāṣṭrāṇi nagarāṇi ca ||
00991 akṛte'pyudyame puṃsāmanyajanmakṛtaṃ phalam |
00992 śubhāśubhaṃ samabhyeti vidhinā saṃniyojitam ||
01001 akṛteṣvevakāryeṣu mṛtyurvai saṃprakarṣati |
01002 yuvaiva dharmaśīlaḥ syādanimittaṃ hi jīvitam ||
01011 akṛtopadravaḥ kaścinmahānapi na pūjyate |
01012 pūjayanti narā nāgānna tārkṣyaṃ nāgaghātinam ||
01021 akṛtayaṃ naiva kṛtyaṃ syātprāṇatyāge'pyupasthite |
01022 na ca kṛtyaṃ parityājyameṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
01031 akṛtayaṃ manyate kṛtayamagamyaṃ manyate sugam |
01032 abhakṣyaṃ manyate bhakṣyaṃ strīvākyaprerito naraḥ ||
01041 akṛtrimapremarasā vilāsālasagāminī |
01042 asāre dagdhasaṃsāre sāraṃ sāraṅgalocanā ||
01051 akṛtrimavilāsāṅkamaśikṣitakalākramam |
01052 avibhāgāṅgasubhagaṃ babhūva surataṃ tayoḥ ||
01061 akṛtvā karma yo loke phalaṃ vindati viṣṭitaḥ |
01062 sa tu vaktavyatāṃ yāti dveṣyo bhavati prāyaśaḥ ||
01071 akṛtvā nijadeśasya rakṣāṃ yo vijigīṣate |
01072 sa nṛpaḥ paridhānena vṛtamauliḥ pumāniva ||
01081 akṛtvā parasaṃtāpamagatvā khalanamratām |
01082 anutsṛjya satāṃ vartma yatsvalpamapi tadbahu ||
01091 akṛtvā pauruṣaṃ yā śrīḥ kiṃ tayālasabhāgyayā |
01092 kuraṅgo'pi samaśnāti daivādupanataṃ tṛṇam ||
01101 akṛtvā mānuṣaṃ karma yo daivamanuvartate |
01102 vṛthā śrāmyati saṃprāpya patiṃ klībamivāṅganā ||
01111 akṛtvā helayā pādamuccairmūrdhasu vidviṣām |
01112 kathaṃkāramanālambā kīrtirdyāmadhirohati ||

07421 dhūmenāvriyate vahniryathādarśo malena ca |
07422 yatholbenāvṛto garbhastathā tenedamāvṛtam ||
07431 atha kokila kuru maunaṃ jaladharasamaye'pi picchilā bhūmiḥ |
07432 vikasati kuṭajakadambe vaktari bheke kutastavāvasaraḥ ||
07441 atha dhūkasvaro vāme yātrāyāṃ gacchataḥ śubhaḥ |
07442 dakṣiṇe mṛtaye kiṃcidduṣṭaṃ darśanamasya hi ||
07451 atha jagadavagāḍhaṃ vāsarāntāpacārāttimirapaṭalavṛddhāvapratīkārasattvam |
07452 śaśibhiṣaganupūrvaṃ śītahasto bhiṣajyannadhikaviśadavaktraḥ svairabhāvaṃ cakāra ||
07461 atha dīrghatamaṃ tamaḥ pravekṣyan sahasā rugṇarayaḥ sa saṃbhrameṇa |
07462 nipatantamivoṣṇaraśmimurvyāṃ valayībhūtataruṃ dharāṃ ca mene ||
07471 atha dehaṃ sthirīrktuṃ yogināṃ siddhimicchatām |
07472 kathyante śuddhakarmāṇi yaiḥ siddhiṃ prāpuruttamāḥ ||
07481 atha nagaradhṛtairamātyaratnaiḥ pathi samiyāya sa jāyayābhirāmaḥ |
07482 madhuriva kusumaśriyā sanāthaḥ kramamilitairalibhiḥ kutūhalotkaiḥ ||
07491 atha nabhasi nirīkṣya vyāptadikcakravālaṃ sajalajaladajālaṃ prāptahaṛṣaprakarṣaḥ |
07492 vihitavipulabarhāḍambaro nīlakaṇṭho madamṛdukalakaṇṭho nāṭyamaṅgīcakāra ||
07501 atha nayanasamutthaṃ jyotiratreriva dyauḥ surasaridiva tejo vahniniṣṭhyūtamaiśam |
07502 narapatikulabhūtyai garbhamādhatta rājñī gurubhirabhiniviṣṭaṃ lokapālānubhāvaiḥ ||
07511 atha nityamanityaṃ vā neha śocanti tadvidaḥ |
07512 nānyathā śakyate kartuṃ svabhāvaḥ śocatāmiti ||
07521 atha paṅktimatāmupeyivadbhiḥ sarasairvakrapathaśritairvacobhiḥ |
07522 kṣitibharturupāyanaṃ cakāra prathamaṃ tatparatasturaṅgamādyaiḥ ||
07531 atha pathikavadhūdahanaḥ śanakairudabhūnniśākarālokaḥ |
07532 kumudaprabodhadūto vyasanaguruścakravākīṇām ||
07541 atha prasannendumukhīn sitāmbarā samāyayāvutpalapatralocanā |
07542 sapaṅkajā śrīriva gāṃ niṣevituṃ sahaṃsabālavyajanā śaradvadhūḥ ||
07551 athabaddhajeṭe rāme sumantre gṛhamāgate |
07552 tyakto rājā sutatyāgādaviśvastairivāsubhiḥ ||
07561 atha bhadrāṇi bhūtāṇi hīnaśaktirahaṃ param |
07562 mudaṃ tadāpi kurvīta hānirdveṣaphalaṃ yataḥ ||
07571 atha manasijadigjyābhiśaṃsī jaladharadugdubhirātatāna śabdam |
07572 tadanu tadanujīvibhiḥ kadambaiḥ kavacitamunmadaṣaṭpadacchalena ||
07581 atha mantramimaṃ karne japeddaṃśaṃ spṛśettathā |
07582 ekaviṃśativāraṃ ca vṛścikakṣveḍaśāntaye ||
07591 atha manmathavāhinīparāgaḥ kimapi jyotirudasphuratpurastāt |
07592 timirasya jarā cakorakūraṃ kulaḍākelibanīdavānalārciḥ ||
07601 atha ratirabhasādalīkanidrā madhuravighūrṇitalocanotpalābhiḥ |
07602 śayanatalamaśiśriyan vadhūbhiḥ saha madamanmathamantharā yuvānaḥ ||
07611 atha rājñā daraḥ kāryo na tu kasyāṃ cidāpadi |
07612 api cetasi dīrṇaḥ syānnaiva varteta dīrṇavat ||
07621 arthatupakvātkalato'vaśoṣitādvikṛṣya bījaṃ payasā niṣicya |
07622 viśoṣitaṃ pañcadināni sarpiṣā viḍaṅgamiśreṇa ca dhūpayettataḥ ||
07631 atharvavidhitattvajñairbrāhmaṇairvijitendriyaiḥ |
07632 mantratantravidhānajñairdūrādunmūlayedripūn ||
07641 atharvāmnāyatattvajñastantrajñaḥ kratukarmaṭhaḥ dhanurvedasya vettā ca purodhā rājasaṃmataḥ ||
07651 atha lakṣmaṇānugatakāntavapurjaladhiṃ vilaṅghya śaśidāśarathiḥ |
07652 parivāritaḥ parita ṛkṣaganaistimiraugharākṣasakulaṃ bibhide ||
07661 athavā naśyati prajñā prājñasyāpi narasya hi |
07662 pratikūle gate daive vināśe samupasthite ||
07671 athavā procyate dhyānamanyadevātra yoginām |
07672 rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mukteḥ kāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ ca yat ||
07681 athavā bhavataḥ pravartanā na kathaṃ piṣṭamiyaṃ pinaṣṭi naḥ |
07682 svata eva satāṃ parārthatā grahaṇānāṃ hi yathā yathārthatā ||
07691 athavābhiniviṣṭabuddhiṣu vrajati vyarthakatāṃ subhāṣitam |
07692 ravirāgiṣu śītarociṣaḥ karajālaṃ kamalākaroṣviva ||
07701 athavā mama bhāgyaviplavādaśaniḥ kalpita eṣa vedhasā |
07702 yadanena tarurna pātitaḥ kṣipatā tadviḍapāśrayā latā ||
07711 athavā mūlasaṃsthānāmudghātaistu prabodhayet |
07712 suptāṃ kuṇḍalinīṃ śaktiṃ bisatantunibhākṛtim ||
07721 athavā mṛdu vastu hiṃsituṃ mṛdunaivārabhate prajāntakaḥ |
07722 himasekavipattiratra me nalīnī pūrvanidarśanaṃ matā ||
07731 atha vāsavasya vacanena ruciravadanastrilocanam |
07732 klāntirahitamabhirādhayituṃ vidhivattapāṃsi vidadhe dhanaṃjayaḥ ||
07741 atha saṃsārasaṃhāravāmanābandhavāsitaḥ |
07742 ajāyata vṛṣārūḍho bhairavo mahasāṃ nidhiḥ ||
07751 atha sa lalitayoṣidbhrūlatācāruśṛṅgaṃ rativalayapadāṅke cāpamāsajya kaṇṭhe |
07752 sahacaramadhuhastanyastucūtāṅkurāstraśśatamakhamupatasthe prāñjaliḥ puṣpadhanvā ||
07761 atha sa viṣayavyāvṛttātmā yathāvidhi sūnave nṛpatikakudaṃ dattvā yūne sitātapavāraṇam |
07762 munivanatarucchāyāṃ devyā tayā saha śiśriye galitavayasāmikṣvākūṇāmidaṃ hi kulavratam ||
07771 atha sāndrasāṃdhyakiraṇāruṇitaṃ harihetihūti mithunaṃ patatoḥ |
07772 pṛthagutpapāta virahārtidaladdhṛdayasrutāsṛganuliptamiva ||
07781 atha sāmānyaśṛṅgāre yuvatīnāṃ praśaṃsanam |
07782 strīpuṃsajātikathanaṃ tayoḥ saṃyogavarṇanam ||
07791 atha sphuranmīnavidhūtapaṅkajā vikaṅkatīraskhalitormisaṃhatiḥ |
07792 payo'vagāḍhuṃ kalahaṃsanādinī samājuhāveva vadhūḥ surāpagā ||
07801 atha svamādāya bhayena manthanācciratnaratnādhikamuccitaṃ cirāt |
07802 nilīya tasminnivasannapāṃnidhirvane taḍāko dadṛśo'vanībhujā ||
07811 atha svasthāya devāya nityāya hatapāpmane |
07812 tyaktakramavibhāgāya caitanyajyotiṣe namaḥ ||
07821 athāgatya bhuvaṃ rājñāṃ gatā vāhanatāṃ hayāḥ |
07822 teṣāṃ dharmārthakāmāṃśca sādhayantyupakāriṇaḥ ||
07831 athāṅgarājādavatārya cakṣuryāhīti janyāmavadatkumārī |
07832 nāsau na kāmyo na ca veda samyagdṛṣṭuṃ na sā bhinnarucirhi lokaḥ ||
07841 athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇāni hi vājinām |
07842 śubhāni varṇairāvartaistāni vidyādvicārataḥ ||
07851 athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi hayārohaṇamuttamam |
07852 yena vijñātamātreṇa revantaḥ priyatāṃ vrajet ||
07861 athātmanaḥ śabdaguṇaṃ guṇajñaḥ padaṃ vimānena vigāhamānaḥ |
07862 ratnākaraṃ vīkṣya mithaḥ sa jāyāṃ rāmābhidhāno harirityuvāca ||
07871 athānandakaraṃ vakṣye ṣaḍartūnāṃ ca varṇanam |
07872 yadrasāsvādamuditā vibhānti vibudhālayaḥ ||
07881 athānukramadvārāṇi viracyante'tra vāṅmaye |
07882 anyoktisūktamuktālīṃ samuddhṛtya śrutāmbudheḥ ||
07891 athāpi nāpasajjeta strīṣu straiṇeṣu cārthavit |
07892 viṣayendriyasaṃyogānmanaḥ kṣubhyati nānyathā ||
07901 athāpraśastāḥ kharatulyanādāḥ pradīptapucchāḥ kūnakhā vivarṇāḥ |
07902 nikṛttakarṇā dvipamastakāśca bhavanti ye vā sitatālujihvāḥ ||
07911 athāyatanasaṃnidhau bhagavato bhavānīpatermanoharamacīkhanadbhuvanabhūṣaṇaṃ bhūpatiḥ |
07912 vigāhanakutūhalottaralapaurasīmantinī payodharabharatruṭadvikaṭavīcimudraṃ saraḥ ||
07921 athāśuddhodbhavo grāmyanartaksyeva yo bhavet |
07922 kaitavasnehamāpanno bhavaḥ saṃkīrṇa ucyate ||
07931 athāśvānāṃ janmadeśān pravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ |
07932 uttamānāṃ ca madhyānāṃ hīnānāṃ yatra saṃbhavaḥ ||
07941 athāsasādāstamanindyatejā janasya dūrojjhitamṛtyubhīteḥ |
07942 utpattimadvastu vināśyavaśyaṃ yathāhamityevamivopadeṣṭum ||
07951 athetare sapta raghupravīrā jyeṣṭhaṃ purojanmatayā guṇaiśca cakruḥ kuśaṃ ratnaviśoṣabhājaṃ saubhrātrameṣāṃ hi kulānusāri ||
07961 athedaṃ rakṣobhiḥ kanakahariṇacchadmavidhinā tathā vṛttaṃ pāpairvyathayati yathā kṣālitamapi |
07962 janasthāne śūnye vikalakaraṇairāryacaritairapi grāvā rodityapi dalati vajrasya hṛdayam ||
07971 atheha kathyatesmābhiḥ karmanā yena bandhanam |
07972 chidyate sadupāyena śrutvā tatra pravartyatām ||
07981 athaitatpūrṇamabhyātmaṃ yacca netyanṛtaṃ vacaḥ |
07982 sarvaṃ netyanṛtaṃ brūyātsa duṣkīrtiḥ svasanmṛtaḥ ||
07991 atho gaṇapatiṃ vande mahāmodavidhāyinam |
07992 vidyādharagaṇairyasya pūjyate kaṇṭhagarjitam ||
08001 athoccakairjaraṭhakapotakaṃdharā tanūruhaprakaravipāṇḍuradyuti |
08002 balaiścalaccaraṇavidhūtamuccaraddhanāvalīrudacarata kṣamārajaḥ ||
08011 athocyate śvānarutasya sāraṃ sāraṃ samasteṣvapi śākuneṣu |
08012 vispaṣṭaceṣṭaṃ śubhalakṣaṇaṃ ca śubhāśubhaṃ prāktanakarmapākam ||
08021 athottarasyāṃ diśi khañjarīṭamālokya ko'pi smitamādadhānaḥ |
08022 kasyāścidāsye smitacārubhāsi sabhāvayāmāsa vilocanāni ||
08031 athodyayau bālasuhṛtsmarasya śayāmādhavaḥ śyāmalalakṣmabhaṅgyā |
08032 tārāvadhūlocanacumbanena līlāvilīnāñjanabindurinduḥ ||
08041 athopagūḍhe śaradā śaśāṅke prāvṛḍyayau śāntataḍitkaṭākṣā |
08042 kāsāṃ na saubhāgyaguṇo'ṅganānāṃ naṣṭaḥ paribhraṣṭpayodharāṇām ||
08051 adaḥ samitsaṃmukhavīrayauvata traṭadbhujākambumṛṇālahāriṇī |
08052 dviṣadgaṇastraiṇadṛgambunirjhare yaśomarālāvalirasya khelati ||
08061 adaṇḍanamadaṇḍyānāṃ daṇḍyānāṃ cāpi daṇḍanam |
08062 agrāhyāgrahaṇaṃ caiva grāhyāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ tathā ||
08071 adaṇḍyān daṇḍayan rājā daṇḍyāṃścaivāpyadaṇḍayan |
08072 ayaśo mahadāpnoti narakaṃ caiva gacchati ||
08081 adattaṃ nādatte kṛtasukṛtakāmaḥ kimapi yaḥ śubhaśreṇistasmin vasati kalahaṃsīva kamale |
08082 vipattasmāddūraṃ vrajati rajanīvāmbaramaṇervinītaṃ vidyeva tridivaśivalakṣmīrbhajati tam ||
08091 adattadoṣeṇa bhaveddaridro daridradoṣeṇa karoti pāpam |
08092 pāpādavaśyaṃ narakaṃ prayāti punardaridraḥ punareva pāpī ||
08101 adattabhuktamutsṛjya dhanaṃ sucirarakṣitam |
08102 mūṣakā iva gacchanti kadaryāḥ svakṣaye kṣayam ||
08111 adattānāmupādānaṃ hiṃsā caivāvidhānataḥ |
08112 paradāropasevā ca śārīraṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam ||
08121 adattetyāgatā lajjā datteti vyathitaṃ manaḥ |
08122 dharmasnehāntare nyastā duḥkhitāḥ khalu mātaraḥ ||
08131 adanaspṛhayā durīśvarāṇāṃ sadandvāri vitardimāśrayantām |
08132 apunarbhavasādhanaṃ śarīraṃ jarayāmo vayamoṃ namaḥ śivāya ||
08141 adabhramabhropalapaṭṭakeṣu ye śitīkriyante madanena patriṇaḥ |
08142 taḍillatā tannikaṣotthapāvaka sphuliṅgabhaṅgīṃ lalitāṅgi sevate ||
08151 adambhā hi rambhā vilakṣā ca lakṣmīrghṛtācī hriyā cīrasaṃcchāditāsyā |
08152 aho jāyate mandavarṇāpyaparṇā samākarṇya tasyā guṇasyaikadeśam ||
08161 adayaṃ gharṣa śilāyāṃ daha vā dāhena bhindhi lauhena |
08162 he hemakāra kanakaṃ ma māṃ guñjāphalaistulaya ||
08171 adaya daśasi kiṃ tvaṃ bimbabuddhyādharaṃ me bhava capala nirāśaḥ pakvajambūphalānām |
08172 iti dayitamavetya dvāradeśāptamanyā nigadati śukamuccaiḥ kāntadantakṣatauṣṭhī ||
08181 adarśanādāpatitaḥ punaścādarśanaṃ gataḥ |
08182 na tvāsau veda na tvaṃ taṃ kaḥ san kamanuśocasi ||
08191 adarśanādāpatitāḥ punaścādarśanaṃ gatāḥ |
08192 na te tava na teṣāṃ tvaṃ tatra kā paridevanā ||
08201 adarśane darśanamātrakāmā dṛṣṭau pariṣvaṅgarasaikalolā |
08202 āliṅgitāyāṃ punarāyatākṣyāmāśāsmahe vigrahayorabhedam ||
08211 adākṣiṇyādatīvogrāḥ pavanā iva durjanāḥ |
08212 gurūnapi pratikṣeptuṃ prayatante kṣamābhṛtaḥ ||
08221 adātā puruṣastyāgī dātā tyāgī ca nityaśaḥ |
08222 iti jñātvā svayaṃ buddhayā dhanaṃ dadyātpunaḥ punaḥ ||
08231 adātā puruṣasdhanaṃ saṃtyajya gacchati |
08232 dātāraṃ kṛpaṇaṃ manye mṛto'pyarthaṃ na muñcati ||
08241 adātāraṃ dātṛpravaramanayaṃ viśvavinayaṃ virūpaṃ rūpāḍhyaṃ vigatajayinaṃ viśvajayinam |
08242 akulyaṃ kulyaṃ tvāmahamavadamāśāparavaśātmṛṣāvādetyuktistvayi khalu mṛṣāvādini mayi ||
08251 adātā vaṃśadoṣeṇa karmadoṣāddaridratā |
08252 utmādo mātṛdoṣeṇa pitṛdoṣeṇa mūrkhatā ||
08261 adātṛmānasaṃ kvāpi na spṛśanti kavergiraḥ |
08262 duḥkhāyaivātivṛddhasya vilāsāstaruṇīkṛtāḥ ||
08271 adānamīṣaddānaṃ ca kiṃcitkopāya dardhiyām |
08272 saṃpūrṇadānaṃ prakṛtirvirāmo vairakāraṇam ||
08281 adāntasyāvinītasya vṛthāpaṇḍitamāninaḥ |
08282 na guṇāya bhavanti sma naṭasyevājitātmanaḥ ||
08291 adāhi yastena daśārdhabāṇaḥ purā purārernayanālayena |
08292 na nirdahaṃstaṃ bhavadakṣivāsī na vairaśuddheradhunādharmaṇaḥ ||
08301 adīpte'gnau hato homo hatā bhuktirasākṣikā |
08302 upajīvyā hatā kanyā svārthe pākakriyā hatā ||
08311 adīrghaṃ kālamāpannaḥ praśrayaṃ yuvateḥ smaraḥ |
08312 pragalbhyate manasyeva mughaṃ vapuṣi jāyate ||
08321 bibhetyaṅgārpaṇe vācchatyālikhyātāṃ ratiṃ priye |
08322 uktapratyuktasaṃmūḍhā saṃmukhaṃ na nirīkṣate ||
08331 ratacūtaphalotpākarasaiḥ kāntaṃ na dhinvatī |
08332 bālā nidāghalakṣmīva tāpayatyeva kevalam ||
08341 adīrghadarśibhiḥ krūrairmūḍhairindriyasāyakaiḥ |
08342 hamadbhiḥ kriyate karma rudadbhiranubhūyate ||
08351 adīrghasūtraḥ smṛtimān kutajño nītiśāstravit |
08352 dhīmānāyatidarśī ca mantrī rājñaḥ susaṃnidhiḥ ||
08361 adurgaviṣayaḥ kasya nāreḥ paribhavāspadam |
08362 adurgo'nāśrayo rājā potacyutamanuṣyavat ||
08371 adṛṣṭāpatitāṃ bhāryāṃ mūḍho yastu parityajet |
08372 saptajanmani sa strītvaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
08381 aduṣṭāpatitāṃ bhāryāṃ yauvane yaḥ parityajet |
08382 sa jīvanānte strītvaṃ ca vandhyatvaṃ ca samāpnuyāt ||
08391 adūragamanaṃ tīrthamadehadamanaṃ tapaḥ |
08392 anambhaḥsaṃbhavaṃ snānaṃ mātuścaraṇapaṅkajam ||
08401 adṛṣyanti purastena khelāḥ khañjanapaṅktayaḥ |
08402 asmayranta viniḥśvasya priyānayanavibhramāḥ ||
08411 adṛṣṭaguṇadoṣāṇāmadhṛtānāṃ ca karmaṇām |
08412 nāntareṇa kriyāṃ teṣāṃ phalmiṣṭaṃ pravartate ||
08421 adṛṣṭapūrvaḥ kaṇṭho'yaṃ kāntāyā bhuvantraye |
08422 yasmādviṇāninādasya samudbhūtirvibhāvyate ||
08431 adṛṣṭapūrvamasmābhiryadetaddṛśyate'dhunā |
08432 viṣaṃ viṣadharaiḥ pītaṃ mūrchitāḥ pathikāṅganāḥ ||
08441 adṛṣṭapūrvānādāya bhāvānapariśaṅkitān |
08442 iṣṭāniṣṭānmanuṣyāṇāmastaṃ gacchanti rātrayaḥ ||
08451 adṛṣṭapūrvā bahavaḥ sahāyāḥ sarve padasthasya bhavanti vaśyāḥ |
08452 arthādvihīnasya padacyutasya bhavanti kāle svajano'pi śatruḥ ||
08461 adṛṣṭamukhabhaṅgasya yuktamandhasya yācitum |
08462 aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ cakṣuṣmānapi yācate ||
08471 adṛṣṭavyāpāraṃ gatavati dinānāmadhipatau yaśaḥ śeṣībhūte śaśini gatadhāmni grahagaṇe |
08472 tathāndhaṃ saṃjātaṃ jagadupanate meghasamaye yathāmī gaṇyante tamasi paṭavaḥ kīṭamaṇayaḥ ||
08481 adṛṣṭe darśanotkaṇṭhā dṛṣṭe vicchedabhīrutā |
08482 tadṛṣṭena na dṛṣṭena bhatratā labhyate mukham ||
08491 adeśakālārthamanāyatikṣamaṃ yadapriyaṃ lāghavakāri cātmanaḥ |
08492 vicintya buddhyā muhurapyavaimyahaṃ na tadvaco hālahalaṃ hi tadviṣam ||
08501 adeśakāle yaddānamapātrebhyaśca dīyate |
08502 asatkṛtamavajñātaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛdam ||
08511 adeśastho hi ripuṇā svalpakenāpi hanyate |
08512 grāho'lpīyānapi jale jalendramapāi karṣati ||
08521 adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryurdaivataṃ cāpyadaivatam |
08522 lokapālān sṛjeyuśca lokānanyāṃstathā dvijaḥ ||
08531 adoṣāddoṣādvā tyajti vipine tāṃ yadi bhavānabhradraṃ bhadraṃ vā tribhuvanapate tvāṃ vadatu kaḥ |
08532 idaṃ krūraṃ me smarati hṛdayaṃ yatkila tayā tvadartha kāntāre kulatilaka nātmāpi gaṇitaḥ ||
08541 adbhiḥ śudhyanti vastrāṇi manaḥ satyena śudhyati |
08542 ahiṃsayā ca bhūtātmā buddhirjñānena śudhyati ||
08551 adbhirgātrāṇi śudhyanti manaḥ satyena śudhyati |
08552 vidyātapobhyāṃ bhūtātmā buddhirjñānena śudhyati ||
08561 adbhutastakrpāthodhiragādhī yasya vardhakaḥ |
08562 akṣapādo'tamaḥspṛṣṭastvakalaṅkaḥ kalānidhiḥ ||
08571 adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥkṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam |
08572 teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu sāmyati ||
08581 adyatano yoddhavye śakuno vihayāya yākrikavirudvaḥ |
08582 divasāntarite yuddhe kṣemaḥ prāsthānikaḥ śakunaḥ ||
08591 adya dhārā sadādhārā sadālambā sarasvatī |
08592 paṇḍitā maṇḍitāḥ sarve bhojarāje bhuvaṃ gate ||
08601 adya prabhṛtyavanatāṅgi tavāsmi dāsaḥ krītastapobhiriti vādini candramaulau |
08602 ahnāya sā niyamajaṃ klamamutsasarja kleśaḥ phalena hi punarnavatāṃ vidhatte ||
08611 adya bhomidinaṃ satyaṃ satyamaprastutaṃ tava |
08612 tathāpi dūti gantavyaṃ nārtaḥ kālamapekṣate ||
08621 adya me saphalamāyatanetre jīvitaṃ madanasaṃśrayabhāvam |
08622 āgatāsi bhavanaṃ mama yasmātsvāgataṃ tava varoru niṣīda ||
08631 adya yāvadapi yena nibaddhau na prabhū vicalituṃ balivindhyau |
08632 āsthitāvitathatāguṇapāśastvādṛśā sa viduṣā durapāsaḥ ||
08641 adya śītaṃ varivarti sarīsarti samīraṇaḥ |
08642 apatnīko marīmarti narīnarti kucoṣṇavān ||
08651 adya sa pravasatīti subhruvaḥ śrotrasīmani vijṛmbhite dhvanau |
08652 sadya eva nijapāṇigumphite puṣpadāmani mahoragabhramaḥ ||
08661 adya sundari kalindanandinī tīrakuñjabhuvi kelilampaṭaḥ |
08662 vādayanmuralikāṃ muhurmuhurmādhavo harati māmakaṃ manaḥ ||
08671 adya svargavadhūgaṇe guṇamaya tvatkīrtimindūjjavalāmuccairgāyati niṣkalaṅkimadaśāmādāsyate candramāḥ |
08672 gītākarṇanamodamuktayavasagrāsābhilāṣo vada svāminnaṅkamṛgaḥ kiyanti hi dinānyetasya vartiṣyate ||
08681 adya svāṃ jananīmakāraṇaruṣā prātaḥ sudūraṃ gatāṃ pratyānetumito gato gṛhapatiḥ kṣutvaiva madhyaṃdine |
08682 paṅgutvena śarīrajarjaratayā prāyaḥ sa lakṣyākṛtirdṛṣṭo'sau bhavatā na kiṃ pathika he sthitvā kṣaṇaṃ kathyatām ||
08691 adyāpi kokanadacārusarekhahastāṃ tāṃ śātakumbhakalaśastanacārugātrīm |
08692 bimbādharīṃ viṣamabāṇanipīḍitāṅgīṃ saṃcintaye dvyaṇukamadhyatanuprakāśām ||
08701 adyāpi kopavimukhīkṛtagantukāmā noktaṃ vacaḥ pratidadāti yadaiva vaktram |
08702 cumbāmi rodati bhṛśaṃ patito'smi pāde dāsastava priyatame bhaja māṃ smarāmi ||
08711 adyāpi cāṭuśatadurlalitocitārthaṃ tasyāḥ smarāmi surataklamavihvalāyāḥ |
08712 avyaktaniḥsvanitakātarakthyamāna saṃkīrṇavarṇarucitaṃ vacanaṃ priyāyāḥ ||
08721 adyāpi tatkanakakuṇḍalaghṛṣṭagaṇḍamāsyaṃ smarāmi viparītaratābhiyoge |
08722 āndolanaśramajalasphuṭasāndrabindu muktāphalaprakaravicchuritaṃ priyāyāḥ ||
08731 adyāpi tatkanakagaurakṛtāṅgarāgaṃ prasvedabinduvitataṃ vadnaṃ priyāyāḥ |
08732 ante smarāmi ratikhedavilolanetraṃ rāhūparāgaparimuktamivendubimbam ||
08741 adyāpi tatkanakareṇughanorudeśe nyastaṃ smarāmi nakharakṣatalakṣma tasyāḥ |
08742 ākṛṣṭahemarucirāmbarmutthitāyā lajjāvaśātkaradhṛtaṃ ca tato vrajantyāḥ ||
08751 adyāpi tatkamalareṇusugandhagandhi tatpremavāri makaradhvajapātakāri |
08752 prāpnomyahaṃ yadi punaḥ surataikatīrthaṃ prāṇāṃstyajāmi niyataṃ tadavāptihetoḥ ||
08761 adyāpi tatkṛtakacagrahamāgraheṇa dantairmayā daśanavāsasi khaṇḍyamāne |
08762 tasyā manāṅmukulitākṣamalakṣyamāṇa sītkāragarbhamasakṛdvadanaṃ smarāmi ||
08771 adyāpi tattaralatārakitākṣamāsyamālipracandanarasāhitaśobhamasyāḥ |
08772 kastūrikātilakatārakitābhirāma gaṇḍasthaladyuti muhurmanasā smarāmi ||
08781 adyāpi tatpraṇayabhaṅguradṛṣṭipātaṃ tasyāḥ smarāmi rativibhramagātrabhaṅgam |
08782 vastrāñcalaskhalanacārupayodharāntaṃ dantacchadaṃ daśanakhaṇḍanamaṇḍanaṃ ca ||
08791 adyāpi tatsapariveṣaśaśiprakāśamāsyaṃ smarāmi jaḍgātravivartaneṣu |
08792 tadveladujjvalakarāṅgulijālagumpha doḥ kandalīyugalakaṃ dayitaṃ priyāyāḥ ||
08801 adyāpi tatsuratakelinirastrayuddhaṃ bandhopabandhapatanotthitaśūnyahastam |
08792 dantauṣṭhapīḍananakhakṣataraktasiktaṃ tasyāḥ smarāmi ratibandhuraniṣṭhuratvam ||
08811 adyāpi tatsuratakelivimardakheda saṃjātagharmakaṇavisphuritaṃ priyāyāḥ |
08812 āpāṇḍuraṃ taralatāranimīlitākṣaṃ vaktraṃ smarāmi paripūrṇaniśākarābham ||
08821 adyāpi tadvadanapaṅkajagandhalubdha bhrāmyaddvirephacayacumbitagaṇḍayugmam |
08822 līlāvadhūtakarapallavakaṅkanānāṃ kvāṇo vimūrcchati manaḥ stutarāṃ madīyam ||
08831 adyāpi tadvikasitāmbujamadhyagauraṃ gorocanātilakabhāsuraphālarekham |
08832 īṣanmadālasavighūrṇitadṛṣṭipātaṃ tasyā mukhaṃ prati mano mama gacchatīdam ||
08841 adyāpi tannayanakajjalamujjvalāsyaṃ viśrāntakarṇayugalaṃ parihāsahetoḥ |
08842 paśye tavātmani navīnapayodharābhyāṃ kṣīṇaṃ vapuryadi vinaśyati no na doṣaḥ ||
08851 adyāpi tanmadanakārmukabhaṅgurabhru dantadyutiprakarakarburitādharoṣṭham |
08852 karṇāvasaktapulakojjvaladantapatraṃ tasyāḥ punaḥ punarapīha mukhaṃ smarāmi ||
08861 adyāpi tanmanasi saṃparivartate me rātrau mayi kṣutavati kṣitipālaputryā |
08862 jīveti maṅgalavacaḥ parihṛtya kopātkarṇe kṛtaṃ kanakapatramanālapantyā ||
08871 adyāpi tāṃ kanakakaṅkaṇabhūṣitāgra hastāṃ ca vaktrakamalena sunirjitendum |
08872 līlāvartīṃ suratakhedanimīlitākṣīṃ dhyāyāmi cetasi madākulalālasāṅgīm ||
08881 adyāpi tāṃ kanakakāntimadālasāṅgīṃ vrīḍotsukāṃ nipatitāmiva ceṣṭamānām |
08882 aṅgāṅgasaṅgaparicumbanajātamohāṃ tāṃ jīvanauṣadhimiva pramadhāṃ smarāmi ||
08891 adyāpi tāṃ kanakacampakadāmagaurīṃ phullāravindavadanāṃ tanuromarājīm |
08892 suptotthitāṃ madanavihvalasālasāṅgīṃ vidyāṃ pramādagalitāmiva cintayāmi ||
08901 adyāpi tāṃ kanakapatrasanāthakarṇāmuttuṅgakarkaśakucārpitatārahārām |
08902 kāñcīnipuñjitaviśālanitambabimbāmuddānanūpuraraṇaccaraṇāṃ smarāmi ||
08911 adyāpi tāṃ kaṭisamārpitavāmapāṇimākuñcitaikacaraṇāgraniruddhabhūmim |
08912 stambhāvalambitabhujāṃ pathi māṃ vrajantaṃ paśyāmi bandhuritakaṃdharamīkṣamāṇām ||
08921 adyāpi tāṃ kuṭilakuntalakeśapāśāmuntidratāmarasapatraviśālanetrām |
08922 uttuṅgapīvarapayodharakuṅmalāḍhyāṃ dhyāyāmi cetasi yathaiva gurūpadeśam ||
08931 adyāpi tāṃ kṣaṇaviyogaviṣopame yāṃ saṅge punarbahutarāmamṛtābhiṣekām |
08932 tāṃ jīvadhāraṇakarīṃ madanātapatrāmuddhṛttakeśanivahāṃ sudatīṃ smarāmi ||
08941 adyāpi tāṃ kṣititale varakāminīnāṃ sarvāṅgasundaratayā prathamaikarekhām |
08942 śṛṅgāranāṭakarasottamapānapātrīṃ kāntāṃ smarāmi kusumāyudhabāṇakhinnām ||
08951 adyāpi tāṃ gatinirākṛtarājahaṃsīṃ dhammillanirjitakalāpamayūkhabhāsām |
08952 mattaśriyā madacakoravilolanetrāṃ saṃcintayāmi kalakaṇṭjasamānakaṇṭhām ||
08961 adyāpi tāṃ gamanamityuditaṃ madīyaṃ śrutvaiva bhīruhariṇīmiva cañcalākṣīm |
08962 vācaḥ skhaladvigaladaśruhalākulākṣīṃ saṃcintayāmi guruśokavinamravaktrām ||
08971 adyāpi tāṃ galitabandhanakeśapāśāṃ srastasrajaṃ smitasudhāmadhurādharauṣṭhīm |
08972 pīnonnatastanayugoparicārucumbanmuktāvalīṃ rahasi loladṛśaṃ smarāmi ||
08981 adyāpi tāṃ cirayite mayi tannivāsaṃ rātrau samāgatavatīṃ parivartamānām |
08982 gatvā smitaṃ kimapi caṇcalitāṃ niṣaṇṇāṃ sakhyā samāgatavatīmadhikaṃ smarāmi ||
08991 adyāpi tāṃ jagati varṇayituṃ na kaścicchaknotyadṛṣṭasadṛśīṃ ca parigrahaṃ me |
08992 dṛṣṭaṃ dvayoḥ sadṛśayoḥ khalu yena rūpaṃ śakto bhavedyadi sa eva naro na cānyaḥ ||
09001 adyāpi tāṃ jaghanadarśanalālasena kṛṣṭaṃ mayā nivasanāṃcalamekapārśvāt |
09002 pūjya sthitāmapi tato muhurākṛṣantīṃ mandākṣasaṃkucitanūtnamukhīṃ smarāmi ||
09011 adyāpi tāṃ jhaṭiti vakritakandharāgrāṃ nikṣiptapāṇikamalāṃ ca nitambamimbe |
09012 vāsāṃsapārśvalasadulbaṇakeśapāśāṃ paśyāmi māṃ prati dṛśaṃ bahuśaḥ kṣipantīm ||
09021 adyāpi tāṃ dhavalaveśmani ratnadīpa mālāmayūkhapaṭalairdalitāndhakāre |
09022 prāptodyame rahasi saṃmukhadarśanārthaṃ lajjābhayārtanayanāmanucintayāmi ||
09031 adyāpi tāṃ nakhapadaṃ stanamaṇḍale yaddattaṃ mayāsyamadhupānavimohitena |
09032 udbhinnaromapulakairbahubhiḥ samantājjāgarti rakṣati vilokayati smarāmi ||
09041 adyāpi tāṃ na khalu vedmi kimīśapatnī śāpaṃ gatā surapateratha kṛṣṇalakṣmīḥ |
09042 dhatraiva kiṃ nu jagataḥ parimohanāya sā nirmitā yuvatiratnadidṛkṣayā vā ||
09051 adyāpi tāṃ navavayaḥśriyaminduvaktrāmuttuṅgapīvarapayodharabhārakhinnām |
09052 saṃpīḍya bāhuyugalena pibāmi vaktrāṃ pronmattavanmadhukaraḥ kamalaṃ yatheṣṭam ||
09061 adyāpi tāṃ nijavapuḥkṛśavedimadhyāmuttuṅgasaṃbhṛtasudhāstanakumbhayugmām |
09062 nānāvicitrakṛtamaṇḍanamṇḍitāṅgīṃ suptotthitāṃ niśi divā na hi vismarāmi ||
09071 adyāpi tāṃ nidhuvanaklamaniḥsahāṅgīmāpāṇḍugaṇḍapatitālakakuntalālīm |
09072 pracchannapāpakṛtamantarivāvahantīṃ kaṇṭhāvasaktamṛdubāhulatāṃ smarāmi ||
09081 adyāpi tāṃ nidhuvane madhupānaraktāṃ līlādharāṃ kṛśatanuṃ capalāyatākṣīm |
09082 kāśmīrapaṅkamṛganābhikṛtāṅgarāgāṃ karpūrapūgaparipūrṇamukhīṃ smarāmi ||
09091 adyāpi tāṃ nibhṛtavaktrakamāpatantaṃ māṃ dvāri vīkṣya sahasaiva miṣeṇa suptām |
09092 mandaṃ mayi spṛśati kaṇṭakitāṅgayaṣṭimutphullagallaphalakāṃ bahuśaḥ smarāmi ||
09101 adyāpi tāṃ nṛpatiśekhararājaputrīṃ saṃpūrṇayauvanamadālasaghūrṇanetrīm |
09102 gandharvayakṣasurakinnarnāgakanyāṃ svargādaho nipatitāmiva cintayāmi ||
09111 adyāpi tāṃpraṇayinīṃ mṛgaśāvakākṣīṃ pīyūṣapūrṇakucakumbhayugaṃ vahantīm |
09112 paśyāmyahaṃ yadi purnadivasāvasāne svargāpavarganararājasukhaṃ tyajāmi ||
09121 adyāpi tāṃ prathamato varasundarīṇāṃ snehaikapātraghaṭitāmavanīśaputrīm |
09122 haṃho janā mama viyogahutāśano'yaṃ soḍhuṃ na śakyata iti praticintayāmi ||
09131 adyāpi tāṃ prathamameva gataṃ virāgaṃ nirbhartsya roṣaparuṣairvacanairmuhurmām |
09132 āndolanena ca nitambasahāyavṛttyā samcintayāmi ratye sudatīmabhīkṣṇam ||
09141 adyāpi tāṃ prathamasaṃgamajātalajjāṃ bālāṃ rasena patite mayi mandapīṭhe |
09142 phūrkārakampitaśikhātaralapradīpaṃ karṇotpalena vinivārayatīṃ smarāmi ||
09151 adyāpi tāṃ bhujalatārpitakaṇṭhapāśāṃ vakṣaḥsthalaṃ mama pidhāya payodharābhyām |
09152 īṣannimīlitasalīlavilocanāntāṃ paśyāmi mṛgdhavadanāṃ vadanaṃ pibantīm ||
09161 adyāpi tāṃ madanamandiravaijayantīmantargṛhe vivasanāṃ dadhatīṃ niśānte |
09162 aṅgairanaṅgavisarairmama gāḍhmaṅgamāliṅgya keliśayane śayitāṃ smarāmi ||
09171 adyāpi tāṃ mama manaḥparitāpaśāntyai cakṣurviśuddhataṭinīmalasālasāṅgīm |
09172 śrīkhaṇḍakhaṇḍakhacitācitagātrayiṣṭaṃ tanvīṃ sadā hṛdayaharṣanidhiṃ smarāmi ||
09181 adyāpi tāṃ mayi kapāṭasamīpalīne manmārgadattadṛśamānanadattahastāṃ madgotracihnitapadaṃ mṛdukākalībhiḥ kiṃcittaraṅgamanasaṃ manasā smarāmi ||
09191  adyāpi tāṃ mayi kṛtāgasi dṛṣṭabhāvāṃ bhāṣāṃ lapatyapi muhurnigṛhītavācam |
09192 rāmāṃ viruddhaghanamanyusabāṣpakaṇṭhāṃ niḥśvāsaśuṣyadadharāṃ rudatīṃ smarāmi ||
09201 adyāpi tāṃ mayi gate cirakopayantīṃ yāntīṃ samāgatavatīṃ parivartamānām |
09202 ūrdhvasthitāṃ kimapi mañcatalaṃ niṣaṇṇāṃ śayyāṃ samāśratavatīmadhikaṃ smarāmi ||
09211 adyāpi tāṃ mayi dṛśaṃ tudatīṃ smarāmi smerāṃ smaradvarakarāṃ madhurāṃ sutārām |
09212 atyudbalāṃ suratalāṃ kuṭilāṃ suśīlāṃ niṣpandamandasamadapramadaprasādām ||
09221 adyāpi tāṃ mayi nimīlitacārunetre ko'yaṃ vadetyabhihitāṃ vadatīṃ sakhībhiḥ |
09222 mātarna vidya iti sasmitamullasantīmutphullagaṇḍaphalakāṃ nitarāṃ smarāmi ||
09231 adyāpi tāṃ masṛṇacandanapaṅkamiśra kastūrikāparimalotthavisarpigandām |
09232 anyonyacañcupuṭacumbanalagnapakṣma  yugmābhirāmanayanāṃ śayane smarāmi ||
09241 adyāpi tāṃ mukhagatairaruṇaiḥ karāgrairāpṛcchyamānamapi māṃ na vibhāṣayantīm |
09242 tadvāṣpapūritadṛśaṃ bahu niḥśvasantīṃ cintākulāṃ kimapi namramukhīṃ smarāmi ||
09251 adyāpi tāṃ punaḥ kamalāyatākṣīṃ paśyāmi pīvarapayodharabhārakhinnām |
09252 saṃpīḍya bāhuyugalena pibāmi vaktramunmattavanmadhukaraḥ kamalaṃ yatheṣṭam ||
09261 adyāpi tāṃ yadi punaḥ śravaṇāyatākṣīṃ paśyāmi dīrghavirahajvaritāṅgayaṣṭim |
09262 aṅgairahaṃ samupagūhma tato'tigāḍhaṃ nonmīlayāmi nayane na ca tāṃ tyajāmi ||
09271 adyāpi tāṃ rahasi darpaṇamīkṣamāṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā sphuṭaṃ pratinidhiṃ mayi pṛṣṭhalīne |
09272 paśyāmi vepathumatīṃ ca suvibhramāṃ ca lajjākulāṃ ca samudaṃ jitamanmathāṃ ca ||
09281 adyāpi tāṃ vidhṛtakajjalalolanetrāṃ pṛthvīṃ prabhūtakusumākulakeśapāśām |
09282 sindūrasaṃlulitamauktikadantakāntimābaddhahemakaṭakāṃ rahasi smarāmi ||
09291 adyāpi tāṃ vidhṛtakakajjalalolanetrāṃ pṛthvīṃ prabhūtakusumākulakeśapāśām |
09292 sindūrasaṃlulitamauktikadantakāntimābaddhahemakaṭakāṃ rahasi smarāmi ||
09301 adyāpi tāṃ virahavahri nipoḍitāṅgīṃ tanvīṃ kuraṅganayanāṃ surataikapātrīm |
09302 nānāvicitrakutamaṇḍanamāvahantīṃ tāṃ rājahaṃsagamanāṃ sudatīṃ smarāmi ||
09311 adyāpi tāṃ vihasītāṃ kācabhāranamrāṃ muktākalāpadhavalīkṛtakaṇṭhadeśām |
09312 tatkelimandaragirau kusumāyudhasya kāntāṃ smarāmi rucirojjvalapuṣpaketum ||
09321 adyāpi tāṃ śaśimukhīṃ navayauvanāḍhyāṃ pīnastanīṃ punarahaṃ yadi gaurakāntim |
09322 paśyāmi manmathaśarānalapīḍitāṅgīṃ gātrāṇi saṃprati karomi suśītalāni ||
09331 adyāpi tāṃ śikharacāruvalakṣadantairmukhyāni kundamukulāni jitāṃ ca sādhvīm |
09332 saṃcintayāmi satataṃ pravilolicittāṃ kāmeṣunīrajadṛśaṃ vanajāvataṃsām ||
09341 adyāpi tāṃ samapanītanitambavastrāṃ śyāmāṃ ca sādhvasarasākulavihvalāṅgīm |
09342 ekena pāṇikamalena pidhāya gṛhyamanyena nābhikuharaṃ dadhatīṃ smarāmi ||
09351 adyāpi tāṃ salalitaślathakeśapāśāmīṣatsamunmiṣitaghūrṇitavakranetrām |
09352 suptotthitāṃ vidadhatīṃ muhuraṅgabhaṅga paśyāmi daṣṭamadharaṃ bahuśaḥ spṛśantīm ||
09361 adyāpi tāṃ sunipuṇaṃ yatatā mayāpi dṛṣṭaṃ na yatsadṛśato vadanaṃ kadācit |
09362 saundaryanirjitarati dvijarājakānti kāntāmihātivimalatvamahāguṇena ||
09371 adyāpi tāṃ surataghūrṇanimīlitākṣīṃ srastāṅgayaṣṭagalitāṃśukakeśapāśām |
09372 śṛṅgāravāriruhakānanarāhahaṃsīṃ janmāntare'pi nidhane'pyanucintayāmi ||
09381 adyāpi tāṃ suratajāgaraghūrṇamāna tiryagvalattaralatārakdīrghanetrām |
09382 śṛṅgārasārakamalākararājahaṃsīṃ vrīḍāvinamravadanāmuṣasi smarāmi ||
09391 adyāpi tāṃ suratatāṇḍavasūtradhāraṃ durvāradarpajaghanaglapitāṅgayaṣṭim |
09392 aṅgaṃ rasaiḥ samupaguhya kaṭiṃ dadhānāṃ kiṃcinnimīlanayanāṃ manasā smarāmi ||
09401 adyāpi tāṃ suratatāṇḍavasūtradhārīṃ pūrṇendusundaramukhīṃ madavihvalāṅgīm |
09402 tanvīṃ viśālajaghanastanabhāranamrāṃ vyālolakuntalakalāpavatīṃ smarāmi ||
09411 adyāpi tāṃ suratalabdhayaśaḥpatākāṃ lambālakāṃ virahapāṇḍuragaṇḍabhittim |
09412 svapne'pi lolanayanāṃ kṣaṇadṛṣṭanaṣṭāṃ vidyāṃ pramādaguṇitāmiva saṃsmarāmi ||
09421 adyāpi tāṃ surabhinirbharadantabhājaṃ dhāvantamāsyakamalaṃ calacañcarīkam |
09422 kiṃciccalallalitakuñcitavāmanetrāṃ paśyāmi kelikamalena nivārayantīm ||
09431 adyāpi tāṃ suvadanāṃ valabhau niṣaṇṇāṃ tadgehasaṃnidhipade mayi dṛṣṭamātre |
09432 vītottarāṃ priyasakhīṣu kutasmarāsu lajjāvilāsahasitāṃ hṛdi cintayāmi ||
09441 adyāpi tāṃ suvadanāṃ stanabhāranabhrāṃ śyāmāṃ ca vāmanayanāṃ ramaṇīyagātrīm |
09442 nidrālasāmalakanirjitaṣaṭpadāliṃ saṃcintayāmi satataṃ smaravaijayantīm ||
09451 adyāpi tāṃ suśayitāṃ kṣaṇaviprabuddhāṃ nidrālasāṃ hṛdi vahāmi kṛtāṅgabhaṅgām |
09452 jṛmbhāvatīrṇamukhamārutagandhalabdha mughabhramadbhramaravibhramalolanetrām ||
09461 adyāpi tāṃ stimitavastramivāṅgalagnāṃ prauḍhapratāpamadanānalataptadehām |
09462 bālāmanāthaśaraṇāmanukampanīyāṃ prāṇādhikāṃ kṣaṇamahaṃ na hi vismarāmi ||
09471 adyāpi tāni smitamukhīṃ puruṣāyiteṣu lambālakākulakapolalatāṃ smarāmi |
09472 āndolanaśramajalākulavihvalāṅgīṃ śvāsottaraṃ ca nibhṛtaṃ ca muhurvadantīm ||
09481 adyāpi tāni parivartitakaṃdharāṇi kiṃcitkṣutatruṭitakañcukajālakāni |
09482 tasyā bhujāgraluladudvalakuntalāni citte sphuranti mama vakravilocanāni ||
09491 adyāpi tāni mama cetasi saṃsphuranti karṇāntasaṃgatakaṭākṣanirīkṣitāni |
09492 tasyāḥ smarajvarakarāṇi madālasāni līlāvilāsabahulāni vilocanāni ||
09501 adyāpi tāni mama cetasi saṃsphuranti bimboṣṭhadeśaparikīrṇaśucismatāni |
09511 adyāpi tāni mṛduvākyasubhāṣitāni tirthagvivarttinayanāntanirīkṣaṇāni līlālasāñcitagatāni śucismitāni tasyāḥ smarāmi madavibhramaceṣṭitāni ||
09521 adyāpi tāmanibhṛtakramamāgataṃ ca māṃ dvāri vīkṣya śayane nimiṣeṇa suptām |
09522 mandaṃ mayi spṛśati kaṇḍakitāṅgayaṣṭimutphullagaṇḍaphalakāṃ bahuśaḥ smarāmi ||
09531 adyāpi tāmanunayatyapi cāṭupūrvaṃ kopātprākṛtamukhīṃ mayi sāparādhe |
09532 āliṅgati prasabhamutpulakāṅgayaṣṭiṃ māmete duḥsahamivoktavatīṃ smarāmi ||
09541 adyāpi tāmanunayatyapi mayyasaktāṃ vyāvṛttya keliśayane śayitāṃ parācīm |
09542 nidrākulāmiva mamābhimukhībhavantīṃ prātarmadaṅganihitaikabhujāṃ smarāmi ||
09551 adyāpi tāmabhiviśālanitambabimbāṃ gambhīranābhikuharāṃ tanumadhyabhāgām |
09552 amlānakomalamṛṇālasamānabāhuṃ līlālasāñcitagatiṃ manasā smarāmi ||
09561 adyāpi tāmaruṇayatyaruṇentarikṣamāpṛcchamānamapi nāma vidhārayantīm |
09562 utthāpya niścaladṛśau mama niḥśvasantīṃ cintākulāṃ kimapi namramukhīṃ smarāmi ||
09571 adyāpi tāmalamasīlitacārunetrāṃ loladbhujāvalayajhaṃkṛtimāvahantīm |
09572 vellatkarorukucamunnamitasvakarṇe kaṇḍūyanaṃ vidadhatīṃ hṛdi cintayāmi ||
09581 adyāpi tāmavahitāṃ manasācalena saṃcintayāmi yuvatīṃ mama jīvitāśām |
09582 nānyopabhuktanavayauvanabhārasārāṃ janmāntare'pi mama saiva gatiryathā syāt ||
09591 adyāpi tāmavigaṇayya kṛtāparādhamāpādamūlapatitaṃ sahasā calantīm |
09592 vastrāñcalaṃ mama karānnijamākṣipantīṃ mā meti roṣaparuṣaṃ vadatīṃ smarāmi ||
09601 adyāpi tāmahamalajjitapūrvaghṛṣṭe śayyātale suśayitāṃ madanotsavāya |
09602 vīrṇāvatīṃ vikacacampakapuṣpanāsāṃ dhyāyāmi cetasi sadā nadatīṃ śubhāṅgīm ||
09611 adyāpi tāmita itaśca puraśca paścādantarbahiḥ parita eva paribhramantīm |
09612 paśyāmi phullakanakāmbujasaṃnibhen vaktreṇa tiryagapavartitalocanena ||
09621 adyāpi tāmupavane paricārayuktāṃ saṃcintayāmyupagatāṃ madanotsavāya |
09622 māṃ pārśvasaṃnihitalokabhayātsaśaṅkaṃ vyāvartitekṣaṇamanukṣaṇamīkṣamāṇām ||
09631 adyāpi tāmubhayapārśvagahāraramyāṃ vāsantikākusumabhāsittakañcukāṃ ca |
09632 rākābhirāmavidhumaṇḍalavalguvavatrāṃ lāvaṇyanirjjitarayāṃ satataṃ smarāmi ||
09641 adyāpi tāmurasijadvayamunnamayya madhye valitritayalakṣitaromarājim |
09642 dhyāyāmi vellitabhujāṃ vihitāṅgabhaṅgaṃ vyājena nābhikuharaṃ mama darśayantīm ||
09651 adyāpi tiṣṭhati dṛśoridamuttarīyaṃ dhartuṃ punaḥ stanataṭe galitaṃ pravṛttā |
09652 vācaṃ niśamya nayanaṃ nayanaṃ mameti kiṃcittadā yadkarotsmitamāyatākṣī ||
09661 adyāpi durnivāraṃ stutikanyā bhajati kaumāram |
09662 madbhyo na rocate sā'santo'pyasyai na rocante ||
09671 adyāpi dhāvati manaḥ kimahaṃ karomi sārdhaṃ sakhībhirapi vāsagṛhe sukānte |
09672 kāntāṅgasaṃgaparihāsavicitranṛtye krīḍābhirāma iti yātu madīyakālaḥ ||
09681 adyāpi na sphurati kesarabhāralakṣmīrna preṅkhati dhvanitamadraguhāntareṣu |
09682 mattāstathāpi kariṇo hariṇādhipasya paśyanti bhītamanasaḥ padavīṃ vaneṣu ||
09691 adyāpi nirmalaśaracchaśigaurakānti ceto munerapi haretkimutāsmadīyam |
09692 vaktraṃ sudhāmayamahaṃ yadi tatprapadye cumban pibāmyavirataṃ vyathate mano me ||
09701 adyāpi nānaṃ harakopavahnistvayi jvalatyaurva ivāmburāśau |
09702 tvamanyathā manmatha madvidhānāṃ bhasmāvaśeṣaḥ kathamevamuṣṇaḥ ||
09711 adyāpi rojjhati haraḥ kila kālakūṭaṃ kūrmo bibharti dharaṇīṃ puṣṭhabhāge |
09712 ambhonidhirvahati duḥsahavāḍavāgnimaṅgīkṛtaṃ sukṛtinaḥ paripālayanti ||
09721 adyāpi mārutavidhūtalatāvitānāṃ vīṇāvinodaracanāṃ mama jīviteśām |
09722 pañceṣurāṣṭrakamalāṃ śubhavedimadhyāṃ dhyāyāmi cetasi sartīṃ madanābhirāmām ||
09731 adyāpi me niśi divā hṛdayaṃ dunoti pūrṇendusundarasukhaṃ mama vallabhāyāḥ |
09732 lāvaṇyanirjitaratikṣatakāmadarpaṃ bhūyaḥ puraḥ pratipadaṃ na vilokyate yat ||
09741 adyāpi me varatanormadhurāṇi tasyā yānyarthavanti na ca yāni nirarthakāni |
09742 nidrānimīlitadṛśo madamantharāyāstānyakṣarāṇi hṛdaye kimapi dhvananti ||
09751 adyāpi ye na vihitā vipulāḥ prabandhā vidyotamānavibhavāḥ sukhayanti viśvam |
09752 so'yaṃ dviśuddhaguruvaṃśabhavaḥ prasiddho gopāladatta upameyapadaṃ kathaṃ syāt ||
09761 adyāpi vāsagṛhato mayi nīyamāne durvārabhīṣaṇakarairyamadūtakalpaiḥ |
09762 kiṃ kiṃ tayā bahuvidhaṃ na kṛtaṃ madarthe vaktuṃ na pāryata iti vyathate mano me ||
09771 adyāpi vismayakarī tridaśān vihāya buddhirbalāccalati me kimahaṃ karomi |
09772 jānannapi pratimuhūrtamihāntakāle kānteti vallabhatareti mameti dhīrā ||
09781 adyāpi śītadyutirātmabimbaṃ nirmāya nirmāya punarbhunakti |
09782 tasyā mukhenāyatalocanāyāḥ kartuṃ na śaktiḥ sadṛśaṃ priyāyāḥ ||
09791 adyāpi śravasī na kuṇḍalacale kelikvaṇatkaṅkaṇau bāhū nāpi na hārihāravalayāluṇṭhā ca kaṇṭhāvaniḥ |
09792 asyāḥ paśya tathāpi paṅkajadṛśo viśvaṃ priyaṃ bhāvukaṃ paśyāmaḥ sphuṭatāvibhūṣaṇakarābhogaṃ vapurvaibhavam ||
09801 adyāpi sā mama manastaṭinī sadāste romāñcavīcivilasadvipulasvabhāvā |
09802 kādambakeśararuciḥ kṣatavīkṣaṇaṃ māṃ gātraklamaṃ kathayatī priyarājahaṃsī ||
09811 adyāpi sundari tavānanacandrabimbaṃ bandīkṛtāmbujayugaṃ paricumbya cetaḥ |
09812 tvatsaṃgamodbhavasukhaṃ tanute tathāpi vairaṃ karoti karuṇāvikalo vivekaḥ ||
09821 adyāpi stanaśailadurgaviṣame sīmantinīnāṃ hṛdi sthātuṃ vāñchati māna eṣa dhigiti krodhādivālohitaḥ |
09822 udyaddūrataraprasāritakaraḥ karṣatyasau tatkṣaṇātphullatkairavakośaniḥsaradaliśreṇīkṛpāṇaṃ śaśī ||
09831 adyāpi hariharādibhiramarairapi tattvato na vijñātāḥ |
09832 bhramavibhramabahumohā veśyāḥ saṃsāramāyāśca ||
09841 adyāpi hi nṛśaṃsasya pituste divaso gataḥ |
09842 tamasā pihitaḥ panthā ehi putraka śevahe ||
09851 adyāpyaśokanavapallavaraktahastāṃ muktāphalapracayacumbitacūcukāgrām |
09852 antaḥsmitocchvasitapāṇḍuragaṇḍabhittiṃ tāṃ vallabhāmalasahaṃsagatiṃ smarāmi ||
09861 adyāpyahaṃ calitacārunimīlitākṣamāsyaṃ smarāmi satataṃ suratāvasāne |
09862 tatkālaniśvasitaniḥsṛtakāntikāntaṃ svedodabinduparidanturitaṃ priyāyāḥ ||
09871 adyāpyahaṃ varavadhūsuratopabhogaṃ jīvāmi nānyavidhinā kṣaṇamantareṇa |
09872 tadbhrātaro maraṇameva hi duḥkhaśāntyai vijñāpayāmi bhavatastvaritaṃ lunīdhvam ||
09881 adyāpyahaṃ vikacakundasamānadantaṃ tiryagvivartitaviśālavilocanāntam |
09882 tasyā mukhaṃ suvijitendu na vismarāmi codyaṃ kṛtajña iva sādhukṛtopakāram ||
09891 adyāpyahaṃ sarasamañjulabhṛṅganādamīṣatsmarollasitarāgasupāṇḍugaṇḍam |
09892 paśyāmi pūrṇaśaradindusamānakānti tasyā mukhaṃ vikacapaṅkajapātranetram ||
09901 adyāpyaho jagati sundaralakṣapūrṇe anyānyamuttamaguṇādhikasaṃprapanne |
09902 anyābhirapyupamituṃ na mayā ca śakyaṃ rūpaṃ tadīyamiti me hṛdaye vitarkaḥ ||
09911 adyāpyunmadayātudhānataruṇīcañcatkarāsphālana vyāvalgannṛkapālatālaraṇitairnṛtyatpiśācāṅganāḥ |
09912 udgāyanti yaśāṃsi yasya vitatairnādaiḥ pracaṇḍānila prakṣubhyatkarikumbhakūṭakuharavyaktai raṇakṣoṇayaḥ ||
09921 adyābhogini gāḍhamarmanivahe harmyāgravedījuṣāṃ sadyaścandanaśoṣiṇi stanataṭe saṅge kuraṅgīdṛśām |
09922 prāyaḥ praślathayanti puṣpadhanuṣaḥ puṣpākare niṣṭhite nirvedaṃ navamallikāsurabhayaḥ sāyaṃtanā vāyavaḥ ||
09931 adyāmbhaḥ paritaḥ patiṣyati bhuvastāpo'dya nirvāsyati kṣetreṣvadya yatiṣyate janapadaḥ sasyeṣu paryutsukaḥ |
09932 nartiṣyanti tavodaye'dya jalada vyālolapucchacchada cchatracchāditamaulayo diśi diśi krīḍālasāḥ kekinaḥ ||
09941 adyārabhya kaṭhorakārmukalatāvinyastahastāmbujastāvanna prakaṭīkaromi nayane śoṇe nimeṣodayān |
09942 yāvatsāyakakotipāṭitaripukṣmāpālamauliskhalanmallīmālyapatatparāgapaṭalairāmodinī medinī ||
09951 adyārabhya na hi priye punarahaṃ mānasya vā bhājanaṃ gṛhṇīyāṃ viṣarūpiṇaḥ śaṭhamaternāmāpi saṃkṣepataḥ |
09952 kiṃ tenaiva vinā śaśāṅkakiraṇaspaṣṭāṭṭahāsā niśā naiko vā divasaḥ payodamalino yāyānmama prāvṛṣi ||
09961 adyāśanaṃ śiśujanasya balena jātaṃ śvo vā kathaṃ nu bhaviteti vicintayantī |
09962 ityaśrupātamalinīkṛtagaṇḍadeśā neccheddaridragṛhiṇī rajanīvirāmam ||
09971 adyedaṃ śva idaṃ tathā parudidaṃ kṛtyaṃ parāri tvadaścetaścintayasītthameva satataṃ nirvyākulaṃ re kutaḥ |
09972 tatkālaṃ vilasanmanorathalatākāntāradāvānalo yasmin daṇḍadharaṃ smariṣyasi sakhe so'pyasti kaścitkṣaṇaḥ ||
09981 adyeśvarāścāraṇagāyanānāṃ sadaiva kalpadrumavatphalanti |
09982 sadbhyastu kiṃcidvacasaiva sāyaṃ dīpāya karpūramivārpayanti ||
09991 adyaike prātarapare vitate'hni tathā pare |
09992 yānti niḥsīmni saṃsāre kaḥ sthātā nanu śocati ||
10001  adyaiva kuru yacchreyo mā tvā kālo'tyagādayam |
10002 akṛteṣveva kāryeṣu mṛtyurvai saṃprakarṣati ||
10011 adyaiva kuru yacchreyo vṛddhaḥsan kiṃ kariṣyasi |
10012 svagātrāṇyapi bhārāya bhavanti hi viparyaye ||
10021 adyaiva yatpratipadudgatacandralekhā sakhyaṃ tvayā tanuriyaṃ gamitā varākyāḥ |
10022 kānte gate kusumasāyaka tatprabhāte bāṇāvalīṃ kathaya kutra vimokṣyasi tvam ||
10031 adyaiva śvaḥ paraśvastricaturadivasānantaraṃ sāyamahni prātaḥ prāhṇe parāhṇe kṣaṇamiha nivasa prasthito'bhyehi bhūyaḥ |
10032 itthaṃ rekātirekānaviditakapaṭaprakriyānarthisārthānatyarthaṃ vyarthayanti pratidivasamaho rājadhānyāṃ vadānyāḥ ||
10041 adyaiva hasitaṃ gītaṃ krīḍitaṃ yaiḥ śarīribhiḥ |
10042 adyaiva te na dṛśyante paśya kālasya ceṣṭitam ||
10051 adyotsaṅgavasadbhujaṃgakavalakleśādiveśācala prāleyaplavanecchayānusarati śrīkhaṇḍaśailānilaḥ |
10052 kiṃ ca snigdharasālamaulimukulānyālokya harṣodayādunmīlanti kuhūḥkuhūriti kalottālāḥ pikānāṃ giraḥ ||
10061 adyodyānagṛhāṅgaṇe sakhi mayā svapnena lākṣāruṇaḥ protkṣipto'yamaśokadohadavidhau pādaḥ kvaṇannūpuraḥ |
10062 tāvatkiṃ kathayāmi kelipaṭunā nirgatya kuñjodarādajñātopanatena tena sahasā mūrdhnaiva saṃbhāvitaḥ ||
10071 adyonmīlanmalayapavanoddhūtacūtāṃkurāgra grāsāsvādādadhikamadhurairuccaradbhirninādaiḥ |
10072 kvāpi kvāpi smarahutavahoddīpanāyādhvagānāṃ hotuṃ prāṇānṛcamiva pikaḥ sāmidhenīmadhīte ||
10081 adrākṣīdapanidrakorakabharavyānamravallīskhaladdhūlīdurdinasūditāmbaramasāvudyānamurvīpatiḥ |
10082 āsthānībhavanaṃ vasantanṛpaterdevasya cetobhuvaḥ satrāgāramanuttaraṃ madhulihāmekaṃ prapāmaṇḍapam ||
10091 adrākṣurye narendrā drupadatanubhuvaḥ keśapāśāvakṛṣṭiṃ cakrurvākārayan vā manasi kimaparaṃ ye'nvamanyanta mohāt |
10092 sarveṣāmeva teṣāṃ samaramakhabhuvi krodhavahṇau juhoti dvitrairhuṃkāramntrairabhijanasamidho madhyamaḥ pāṇḍaveyaḥ ||
10101 adriṣvañjanapuñjakānti jaladraprāyaṃ ca mūle diśāmūrdhvaṃ nīlavitānakalpabhavanau jambālalepopamam |
10102 tīre nīranidhestamālaviṭapicchāyāṃ ca sāyaṃ śanairudgacchatyabhisārikāpriyatamapremānukūlaṃ tamaḥ ||
10111 adreḥ kiṃ svidvahati pavanaḥ śṛṅgamityunmukhībhirdṛṣṭotsāhaścakitacakitaṃ mugdhasiddhāṅganābhiḥ |
10112 sthānādasmātsarasaniculādutpatodaṅmukhaḥ khaṃ diṅnāgānāṃ pathi pariharan sthūlahastāvalepān ||
10121 adrohaḥ śaucānāmacāpalaṃ vrataviśeṣaniyamānām |
10122 paiśunyamapriyāṇāṃ vṛtticchedo nṛśaṃsacaritānām ||
10131 adrohaḥ sarvabhūteṣu karmaṇā manasā girā |
10132 anugrahaśca dānaṃ ca satāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
10141 adrohasamayaṃ kṛtvā munīnāmagrato hariḥ |
10142 jaghāna namuciṃ paścādapāṃ phenena pārthiva ||
10151 adrohe samayaṃ kṛtvā ciccheda namuceḥ śiraḥ |
10152 śakraḥ sā hi matā tasya ripau vṛttiḥ sanātanī ||
10161 adrau jīrṇadarīṣu saṃkaṭasarittīreṣu nimnonnate ūḍhā yena vṛṣeṇa dhūrbalavatā yūnā dvitīyena yā |
10162 tāṃ vṛddho'pi kṛśo'pi durvaha dhuraṃ voḍhuṃ sa eva kṣamo rathyābhaḍḍalakaiḥ sametya bahubhirnākṛṣyate'nyairvṛṣaiḥ ||
10171 advitīyaṃ nijaṃ loke vilokya vahato mudam |
10172 pramadāvadanasyāyaṃ darpodreko na tu smitam ||
10181 advisaṃvīkṣaṇaṃ cakṣuradvisaṃmīlanaṃ manaḥ |
10182 advisaṃsparśanaḥ pāṇiradya me kiṃ kariṣyati ||
10191 adveṣapeśalaṃ kuryānmanaḥ kusumakomalam |
10192 babhūva dveṣadoṣeṇa devadānavasaṃkṣayaḥ ||
10201 advaitaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoranuguṇaṃ sarvāsvavasthāsu yadviśrāmo hṛdayasya yatra jarasā yasminnahāryo rasaḥ |
10202 kālenāvaraṇātyayātpariṇate yatsnehasāre sthitaṃ bhadraṃ tasya sumānuṣasya kathamapyekaṃ hi tatprāpyate ||
10211 advaitamekaṃ sukhamunnayantī vismārayantī jagadeva tanvi |
10212 muktāśritāmātmaruciṃ vadantī vedāntasiddhāntakatheva bhāsi ||
10221 advaitoktipaṭūn vaṭūnapi vayaṃ bālānnamaskurmahe ye tu dvandvavadāstadīyaśirasi nyasyāma vāmaṃ padam |
10222 siṃhaḥ svīyaśiśūnniveśya hṛdaye sāndrādarādāmṛśatyāveśena bhinatti saṃbhramapadaṃ mattebhakumbhasthalam ||
10231 advaidhamānasaṃyuktaṃ śūraṃ dhīraṃ vipaścitam |
10232 na śrīḥ saṃtyajate nityamādityamiva raśmayaḥ ||
10241 adhaḥ karoti yadratnaṃ mūrdhnā dhārayate tṛṇam |
10242 doṣastasyaiva jaladhe ratnaṃ ratnaṃ tṛṇaṃ tṛṇam ||
10251 adhaḥ kurvanprajāḥ sarvā bahudhā mahimolbaṇaḥ |

11361 adhunā madhukarapatinā gilito'pyapakāradaṃpatī yena |

26271 amlāno balavāñśūraśchāyevānugataḥ sadā |
26272 satyavādī mṛdurdāntaḥ sa rājavasatiṃ vaset ||
26281 ayaṃ kanakanirmitaḥ sakalabhūdharādunnataḥ sahasranayanāśrayaḥ sapadi labdhabhāgyodayaḥ |
26282 kucopari parisphurattaruṇicārucelāñcalaṃ manāgapi nivāraya tyajatu garvamurvīdharaḥ ||
26291 ayaṃ kāṇaḥ śukro viṣamacaraṇaḥ sūryatanayaḥ kṣatāṅgo'yaṃ rāhurvikalamahimā śītakiraṇaḥ |
26292 ajānānasteṣāmapi niyatakarmasvakaphalaṃ grahagrāmagrastā vayamiti jano'yaṃ pralapati ||
26301 ayaṃ kāmo nijāmo vā tvayā kimavadhāritam |
26302 iti dṛṣṭiriva praṣṭuṃ śrutiṃ śrayati subhruvām ||
26311 ayaṃ khalu mṛṇālinīnavavilāsavaihāsikastviṣāṃ vitapate patiḥ sapadi dṛśyamānā nijāḥ |
26312 stanau pulakayanti cotpaladṛśāṃ priyoraḥsthale viparyasitavṛttayo ghusṛṇapaṅkapatrāṅkurāḥ ||
26321 ayaṃ ca suratajvālaḥ kāmāgniḥ praṇayendhanaḥ |
26322 narāṇāṃ yatra hūyante yauvanāni dhanāni ca ||
26331 ayaṃ jyotsnājānistava vadanadūno'mbaraguhāṃ praviṣṭastatrāpi prasṛtamidamenaṃ dṛḍhatamaḥ |
26332 iti trāsodrekakramagalitasattvaḥ kṣayagadī vidhirdagdho dīnaṃ vyathayati nidānaṃ hi mṛdutā ||
26341 ayaṃ tasyā rathakṣobhādaṃsenāṃso nipīḍitaḥ |
26342 ekaḥ kṛtī śarīre'smiñśeṣamaṅgaṃ bhuvo bharaḥ ||
26351 ayaṃ tāvadbāṣpastruṭita iva muktāmaṇisaro visarpan dhārābhirluṭhati dharaṇīṃ jarjarakaṇaḥ |
26352 niruddho'pyāvegaḥ sphuradadharanāsāpuṭatayā pareṣāmunneyo bhavati ca bharādhmātahṛdayaḥ ||
26361 ayaṃ te vidrumacchāyo marumārga ivādharaḥ |
26362 karoti kasya no bāle pipāsākulitaṃ manaḥ ||
26371 ayaṃ trayāṇāṃ grāmāṇāṃ nidhānaṃ madhuradhvaniḥ |
26372 rekhātrayamitīvāsyāḥ sūtritaṃ kaṇṭhakandale ||
26381 ayaṃ daridro bhaviteti vaidhasīṃ lipiṃ lalāṭe'rthijanasya jāgratīm |
26382 mṛṣā na cakre'lpitakalpapādapaḥ praṇīya dāridryadaridratāṃ nalaḥ ||
26391 ayaṃ dūtārthasaṃkṣepaḥ pratyarthaniyatā giraḥ |
26392 prayojanaṃ kriyotpādi kiyacchakyeta bhāṣitum ||
26401 ayaṃ dūrabhrāntaḥ paṭutarapipāsākulamanāḥ kapole te mattadvipa nipatitaḥ ṣaṭpadayuvā |
26402 tvamapyetāṃ pīnaśravaṇadaradolāvyasanitāṃ vimuñca svācchandyādapanayatu tāvattṛṣamimām ||
26411 ayaṃ dvīpī priyāṃ leḍhi jihvāgreṇa punaḥ punaḥ |
26412 prītimāyāti ca tayā lihyamānaḥ svakāntayā ||
26421 ayaṃ dhārāvāhastaḍidiyamiyaṃ dagdhakarakā sa cāyaṃ nirghoṣaḥ sa ca ravavaśo bhekanicayaḥ |
26422 itīva pratyaṅgaprathitamadanāgniṃ kṛśatanurghanaśvāsotkṣepairjvalayati muhurmṛtyuvaśinī ||
26431 ayaṃ dhūrto māyāvinayamadhurādasya caritātsakhi pratyūṣi tvaṃ prakṛtisarale paśyasi na kim |
26432 kapole yallākṣārasabahalarāgapraṇayinīmimāṃ dhatte mudrāmanaticiravṛttāntapiśunām ||
26441 ayaṃ nijaḥ paro veti gaṇanā laghucetasām |
26442 udāracaritānāṃ tu vasudhaiva kuṭumbakam ||
26451 ayaṃ netrādatrerajani rajanīvallabha iti bhramaḥ ko'yaṃ prajñāparicayaparādhīnamanasām |
26452 sudhānāmādhāraḥ sa khalu ratibimbādharasudhā rasāsekasnigdhādajani nayanātpuṣpadhanuṣaḥ ||
26461 ayaṃ paṭaḥ sūtradaridratāṃ gato hyayaṃ paṭaśchidraśatairalaṃkṛtaḥ |
26462 ayaṃ paṭaḥ prāvarituṃ na śakyate hyayaṃ paṭaḥ saṃvṛta eva śobhate ||
26471 ayaṃ paṭo me pituraṅgabhūṣaṇaṃ pitāmahādyairupabhuktayauvanaḥ |
26472 alaṃkariṣyatyatha putrapautrakānmayādhunā puṣpavadeva dhāryate ||
26481 ayaṃ padmāsanāsīnaścakravāko virājate |
26482 yugādau bhagavān vedhā vinirmitsuriva prajāḥ ||
26491 ayaṃ pīnastanābhogasaubhāgyavibhavocitaḥ |
26492 draviṇopārjanasyaiva kālaḥ kuvalayekṣaṇe ||
26501 ayaṃ puraḥ pārvaṇaśarvarīśaḥ kiṃ darpaṇo'yaṃ rajanīramaṇyāḥ |
26502 yatastadīyaṃ pratibimbamasmin saṃlakṣyate lāñchanakaitavena ||
26511 ayaṃ prabhurayaṃ bhṛtya iti yā jagataḥ sthitiḥ |
26512 phalaṃ vijayate tatra śrīprasādāprasādayoḥ ||
26521 ayaṃ bandhuḥ paraścāyaṃ mamāyamayamanyataḥ |
26522 iti brahmanna jānāmi tena jīvāmyanāmayaḥ ||
26531 ayaṃ mandadyutirbhāsvānastaṃ prati yiyāsati |
26532 udayaḥ patanāyeti śrīmato bodhayannarān ||
26541 ayaṃ mama dahatyaṅgamambhojadalasaṃstaraḥ |
26542 hutāśanapratinidhirdāhātmā nanu yujyate ||
26551 ayaṃ mārtaṇḍaḥ kiṃ sa khalu turagaiḥ saptabhiritaḥ kṛśānuḥ kiṃ sarvāḥ prasarati diśo naiṣa niyatam |
26552 kṛtāntaḥ kiṃ sākṣānmahiṣavahano'sāviti ciraṃ samālokyājau tvāṃ vidadhati vikalpān pratibhaṭāḥ ||
26561 ayaṃ mukhasaroruhabhramaravibhramaḥ subhruvāṃ kucasthalakuraṅgakaḥ pṛthunitambalīlāśikhī |
26562 na yauvanamadodayaścarati cārukānticchaṭā kulatrivalikūlinīpulinarājahaṃsaściram ||
26571 ayaṃ mṛgaḥ samāyāti mṛgātsiṃhaḥ palāyate |
26572 tato vegātpalāyasva tvaritaistvaritaiḥ padaiḥ ||
26581 ayaṃ meghavyūhe balini paripanthinyapasṛte śarajjanyāḥ svairaṃ hasitamiva harṣādaviratam |
26582 payaḥpūrabhraṃśakramajanitasopānasikate nadītīre dhīraṃ carati viśadaḥ khañjanagaṇaḥ ||
26591 ayaṃ me vāggumpho viśadapadavaidagdhyamadhuraḥ sphuradbandho vandhyaḥ parahṛdi kṛtārthaḥ kavihṛdi |
26592 kaṭākṣo vāmākṣyā daradalitanetrāntagalitaḥ kumāre niḥsāraḥ sa tu kimapi yūnaḥ sukhayati ||
26601 ayaṃ ratnākaro'mbhodhirityasevi dhanāśayā |
26602 dhanaṃ dūre'stu vadanamapūri kṣāravāribhiḥ ||
26611 ayaṃ rasālaḥ sukṛtaikasālaḥ pravālamālollasadālavālaḥ |
26612 mudaḥ pradātā bhavitā kathaṃ me varāṅganetyaśrumukhī śuśoca ||
26621 ayaṃ revākuñjaḥ kusumaśarasevāsamucitaḥ samīro'yaṃ velāvanavidaladelāparimalaḥ |
26622 iyaṃ prāvṛḍdhanyā navajaladavinyāsacaturā smarādhīnaṃ cetaḥ sakhi kimapi kartuṃ mṛgayate ||
26631 ayaṃ lolanmuktāvalikiraṇamālāparikaraḥ sphuṭasyendorlakṣmīṃ kṣapayitumalaṃ manmathasuhṛt |
26632 viśālaḥ śyāmāyāḥ skhalitaghananīlāṃśukavṛtiḥ stanābhogaḥ snihyanmasṛṇaghusṛṇālepasubhagaḥ ||
26641 ayaṃ vahati dhātāraṃ yadvā devīṃ sarasvatīm |
26642 pakṣadvayamapi sthāne rājahaṃsasya nirmalam ||
26651 ayaṃ vārāmeko nilaya iti ratnākara iti śrito'smābhistṛṣṇātaralitamanobhirjalanidhiḥ |
26652 ka evaṃ jānīte nijakarapuṭīkoṭaragataṃ kṣaṇādenaṃ tāmyattimimakaramāpāsyati muniḥ ||
26661 ayaṃ vipāko vada kasya yūnaḥ kalyāṇi kalyāṇaparaṃparāṇām |
26662 yadakṣikoṇasravadacchadhārā hārāvatāro guṇamantareṇa ||
26671 ayaṃ śūnyo grāmaḥ surasadanametannu patitaṃ puraḥ śuṣkā vāpī tarurayamitaḥ śīrṇaviṭapaḥ |
26672 vayaṃ caite pānthāḥ parikṛśadaśābhāgyagatayaḥ samānaḥ saṃyogaḥ kaṭurapi mano me ramayati ||
26681 ayaṃ sa kālaḥ saṃprāpto dhārttarāṣṭropajīvinām |
26682 niveṣṭavyaṃ mayā tatra prāṇānaparirakṣatā ||
26691 ayaṃ sa te tiṣṭhati saṃgamotsuko viśaṅkase bhīru yato'vadhīraṇām |
26692 labheta vā prārthayitā na vā śriyaṃ śriyo durāpaḥ kathamīpsito bhavet ||
26701 ayaṃ sa bhuvanatrayaprathitasaṃyamaḥ śaṃkaro bibharti vapuṣādhunā virahakātaraḥ kāminīm |
26702 anena kila nirjitā vayamiti priyāyāḥ karaṃ kareṇa paritāḍayan jayati jātahāsaḥ smaraḥ ||
26711 ayaṃ sa raśanotkarṣī pīnastanavimardanaḥ |
26712 nābhyūrujaghanasparśī nīvīvisraṃsanaḥ karaḥ ||
26721 ayaṃ sarvāṇi śāstrāṇi hṛdi jñeṣu ca vakṣyati |
26722 sāmarthyakṛdamitrāṇāṃ mitrāṇāṃ ca nṛpātmajaḥ ||
26731 ayaṃ senottaṃsaḥ karakṛtakṛpāṇo raṇabhuvi dviṣadbhūmīpālāḥ kimapasarata prāṇakṛpaṇāḥ |
26732 kimabhyarthyaḥ pṛthvīdharakuharavāso'dya bhavatāṃ na kiṃ hṛdyā vidyādharanagaranīlotpaladṛśaḥ ||
26741 ayaṃ snigdhaśyāmo ya iha viharatyambujavane vinidre vyāguñjanmadhupa iti taṃ jalpatu janaḥ |
26742 ahaṃ śaṅke paṅkeruhakuharavāsavyasaninīṃ śriyaṃ bhṛṅgacchadmā muraripurupeto ramayitum ||
26751 ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ svata eva yatpara śramāpanodapravaṇaṃ mahātmanām |
26752 sudhāṃśureṣa svayamarkakarkaśa prabhābhitaptāmavati kṣitiṃ kila ||
26761 ayaṃ svārthaḥ parārtho'yamityevaṃ vā na kalpayet | vibudhā naiva manyante svaṃ paraṃ vā pṛthakpṛthak | niyuñjīta parasyārthe protsaheta svakarmaṇi || ayaṃ hi tīvreṇa jaganti tejasā
26772 pratāpya bhāsāṃ patirastamāgataḥ |
26772 pratāpamātropanatā vibhūtayaściraṃ na tiṣṭhanti paropatāpinām ||
26781 ayaṃ hi dehino deho dravyajñānakriyātmakaḥ |
26782 dehino vividhakleśasaṃtāpakṛdudāhṛtaḥ ||
26791 ayaṃ hi prathamo rāgaḥ samastajanarañjane |
26792 yasya nāsti dvitīyo'pi sa kathaṃ pañcamo bhavet ||
26801 ayaḥpiṇḍa ivottapte khalānāṃ hṛdaye kṣaṇāt |
26802 patitā api nekṣyante guṇāstoyakanā iva ||
26811 ayathāvihitānāṃ yanmanojñatāsaṃpādau na staḥ |
26812 kathayāmyatastarūṇāṃ ropavidhānaṃ yathoddiṣṭam ||
26821 ayane viṣuve caiva ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca |
26822 candrasūryoparāge ca dattamakṣayamaśnute ||
26831 ayamakṣuṇṇakāntaśrīradharo hariṇīdṛśaḥ |
26832 pravālapadmarāgāderupari pratigarjati ||
26841 ayamaṅkurabhāva eva tāvatkucayoḥ karṣati lokalocanāni |
26842 itaretarapīḍanīmavasthāṃ gatayoḥ śrīranayoḥ kathaṃ bhavitrī ||
26851 ayamatijaraṭhāḥ prakāmagurvīralaghuvilambipayodharoparuddhāḥ |
26852 satatamasumatāmagamyarūpāḥ pariṇatadikkarikāstaṭīrbibharti ||
26861 ayamaparalatāyāḥ sādaraṃ hanta pītvā madhu mama makarandaṃ pātumāyāti bhṛṅgaḥ |
26862 iti manasi viṣādaṃ mallike mā kuru tvaṃ bata vada madhupānāṃ mānase ko vivekaḥ ||
26871 ayamapi kharayoṣitkarṇakāṣāyamīṣadvisṛmaratimirorṇājarjaropāntamarciḥ |
26872 madakalakalaviṅkīkākunāndīkarebhyaḥ kṣitiruhaśikharebhyo bhānumānuccinoti ||
26881 ayamapi puruhūtapreyasīmūrdhni pūrṇaḥ kalaśa iva sudhāṃśuḥ sādhurullālasīti |
26882 madanavijayayātrākālavijñāpānāya sphurati jaladhimadhye tāmrapātrīva bhānuḥ ||
26891 ayamabhinavameghaśyāmalottuṅgasānurmadamukharamayūrīmuktasaṃsaktakekaḥ |
26892 śakuniśabalanīḍānokahasnigdhavarṣmā vitarati bṛhadaśmā parvataḥ prītimakṣṇoḥ ||
26901 ayamamṛtanidhānaṃ nāyako'pyoṣadhīnāmamṛtamayaśarīraḥ kāntiyukto'pi candraḥ |
26902 bhavati vigataraśmirmaṇḍalaṃ prāpya bhānoḥ parasadananiviṣṭaḥ ko laghutvaṃ na yāti ||
26911 ayamamṛtanidhānaṃ nāyako'pyoṣadhīnāṃ śatabhiṣaganuyātaḥ śaṃbhumūrdhāvataṃsaḥ |
26912 virahayati na cainaṃ rājayakṣmā śaśāṅkaṃ hatavidhiparipākaḥ kena vā laṅghanīyaḥ ||
26921 ayamayamasāvākarṇyārātpratidvipaḍiṇḍimaṃ madakaluṣite netre mārjannudastakarārgalaḥ |
26922 agaṇitasṛṇiḥ krodhastabdhāyataśrutipallavaḥ praviśati nṛpasyāntaḥkakṣāṃ javādarimudgaraḥ ||
26931 ayamayogivadhūvadhapātakairmramimavāpya divaḥ khalu pātyate |
26932 śitiniśādṛṣadi sphuṭadutpatatkaṇagaṇādhikatārakitāmbaraḥ ||
26941 ayamaravivarebhyaścātakairniṣpatadbhirharibhiracirabhāsāṃ tejasā cānuliptaiḥ |
26942 gatamupari ghanānāṃ vārigarbhodarāṇāṃ piśunayati rathastaṃ śīkaraklinnanemiḥ ||
26951 ayamalaghuvisārisphārijihvākalāpo jvalati yadi na madhye vāḍavo havyavāhaḥ |
26952 muhurupacitasāro vāribhirnimnagānāṃ tribhuvanamapi kiṃ na plāvayatyamburāśiḥ ||
26961 ayamavasaraḥ saraste salilairupakartumarthināmaniśam |
26962 idamapi ca sulabhamambho bhavati purā jaladharābhyudaye ||
26971 ayamavasara upakṛtaye prakṛticalā yāvadasti saṃpadiyam |
26972 vipadi sadābhyudayinyāṃ punarupakartuṃ kuto'vasaraḥ ||
26981 ayamavicāritacārutayā saṃsāro bhāti ramaṇīyaḥ |
26982 atra punaḥ paramārthadṛśāṃ na kimapi sāramaṇīyaḥ ||
26991 ayamasau gaganāṅgaṇadīpakastaralakālabhujaṃgaśikhāmaṇiḥ |
26992 kṣaṇaviḍambitavāḍavavigrahaḥ patati vārinidhau vidhuro raviḥ ||
27001 ayamasau bhagavānuta pāṇḍavaḥ sthitamavāṅmuninā śaśimaulinā |
27002 samadhirūḍhamajena nu jiṣṇunā sviditi vegavaśānmumuhe gaṇaiḥ ||
27011 ayamaho rajanīcarakesarī giridarīśayanātsahasotthitaḥ |
27012 timiravāraṇakumbhavidāraṇocchvalitaraktabharairiva lohitaḥ ||
27021 ayamātmā svayaṃ sākṣādguṇaratnamahārṇavaḥ |
27022 sarvajñaḥ sarvadṛksārvaḥ parameṣṭhī nirañjanaḥ ||
27031 ayamāndolitaprauḍhacandanadrumapallavaḥ |
27032 utpādayati sarvasya prītiṃ malayamārutaḥ ||
27041 ayamālohitacchāyo madena mukhacandramāḥ |
27042 saṃnaddhodayarāgasya candrasya pratigarjati ||
27051 ayamiha mugdho madhupaḥ parihṛtasahakāramañjarīpuñjaḥ |
27052 asaralamarasamasāraṃ śākhoṭakaviṭapamanusarati ||
27061 ayamudayati kokīśokaśalyairmayūkhaiḥ śatamakhapuranārīnetragaṇḍūṣapeyaḥ |
27062 udayagirimṛgendrodgārabhinnāṅkaraṅku śravaṇarudhiradhārāpāṭalaḥ pārvaṇenduḥ ||
27071 ayamudayati candraścandrikādhautaviśvaḥ pariṇatavimalimni vyomni karpūragauraḥ |
27072 ṛjurajataśalākāspardhibhiryasya pādairjagadamalamṛṇālīpañjarasthaṃ vibhāti ||
27081 ayamudayati candro vāridherambugarbhādamṛtakaṇakarālairaṃśubhirdīpyamānaḥ |
27082 bhujagaśayanavakṣoharmyadeśe lalantyā vadanamiva yadṛcchottānitaṃ viśvamātuḥ ||
27091 ayamudayati mudrābhañjanaḥ padminīnāmudayagirivanālībālamandārapuṣpam |
27092 virahavidhurakokadvandvabandhurvibhindan kupitakapikapolakroḍatāmrastamāṃsi ||
27101 ayamudayamahīdhradhāturāgairaruṇakarāruṇitāmbarābhirāmaḥ |
27102 vitarasi na dṛśau kṛśāṅgi tārāmiva divi vanditumindurabhyupaiti ||
27111 ayamudayamahībhṛnmūrdhni pāṇiṃ gṛhītvā divasapatirahauṣīdindupādān havīṃṣi |
27112 aruṇakiraṇavahnau kanyakā pauruhūtī haridapi kimakārṣīttārakālājahomam ||
27121 ayamudito himaraśmirvanitāvadanasya kīdṛśaḥ sadṛśaḥ |
27122 nīlādikopalambhaḥ sphurati pratyakṣataḥ kasya ||
27131 ayamupagatakṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇasārākṣipātairyamakṛ(vikasi?)tanavanīlāmbhojavaktraścakāsti |
27132 jalayuvatikucānuprāsitottuṅgakumbha sthalamadakalagarjannīranāgastaṭākaḥ ||
27141 ayamuṣasi vinidradrāviḍītuṅgapīna stanaparisarasāndrasvedabindūpamardī |
27142 srutamalayajavṛkṣakṣīrasaurabhyasabhyo vahati sakhi bhujaṅgībhuktaśeṣaḥ samīraḥ ||
27151 ayamekapade tayā viyogaḥ priyayā copanataḥ suduḥsaho me |
27152 nava vāridharodayādahobhirbhavitavyaṃ ca nirātapatvaramyaiḥ ||
27161 ayameko'hameketi jñānaṃ tatsaṃgame na me |
27162 rāga evādhikastatra haridrācūrṇayoriva ||
27171 ayameva paro dharmo hyayameva paraṃ tapaḥ |
27172 patiśuśrūṣaṇaṃ yatra tatstrīṇāṃ svargahetukam ||
27181 ayaśaḥ prāpyate yena yena cādhogatirbhavet |
27182 svārthācca bhraśyate yena tatkarma na samācaret ||
27191 ayaśasyamanāyuṣyaṃ paradārābhimarśanam |
27192 arthakṣayakaraṃ ghoraṃ pāpasya ca punarbhavam ||
27201 ayaśobhidurāloke kopadhāmaraṇādṛte |
27202 ayaśobhidurā loke kopadhā maraṇādṛte ||
27211 ayaścaṇakacarvaṇaṃ phaṇiphaṇāmaṇeḥ karṣaṇaṃ kareṇa giritolanaṃ jalanidheḥ padā laṅghanam |
27212 prasuptaharibodhanaṃ niśitakhaṅgasaṃsparśanaṃ kadācidakhilaṃ bhavenna ca śaṭhāddhanasyārjanam ||
27221 ayastu kākatuṇḍena carma ārāmukhena hi |
27222 mṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ caiva vidhyetsūcīmukhena hi ||
27231 ayācataḥ sīdataśca sarvopāyairnimantraya |
27232 ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmo'yācate yatpradīyate ||
27241 ayācitaḥ sukhaṃ datte yācitaśca na yacchati |
27242 sarvasvaṃ cāpi harate vidhiruccṛṅkhalo nṛṇām ||
27251 ayācitāraṃ nahi devadevamadriḥ sutāṃ grāhayituṃ śaśāka |
27252 abhyarthanābhaṅgabhayena sādhurmādhyasthamiṣṭe'pyavalambate'rthe ||
27261 ayācito mayā labdho matpreṣitaḥ punargataḥ |
27262 yatrāgatastatra gatastatra kā parivedanā ||
27271 ayācyaṃ caiva yācante'bhojyān vyāhārayanti ca |
27272 utkocairvañcanābhiśca kāryāṇi ghnanti cāsyati ||
27281 ayājyayājanaiścaiva nāstikyena ca karmaṇām |

27321 ayi kuraṅgi tapovanavibhramādupagatāsi kirātapurīmimām |

27341 ayi kulanicūlamūlocchedanaduḥśīlavīcivācāle |

27391 ayi cakorakuṭumbini kātare tiraya pakṣapuṭena kuṭumbakam |

27401 ayi cātaka cañcupuṭātskhalayati jaladodabindumanilaścet |
27402 dvija eva bhāgyahīno jīvanadātā kṛtī jaladaḥ ||
27411 ayi citta vittaleśe sahajapremṇā kiyannu lubdhamasi |
27412 na tathāpi tadviyogaḥ kevalamāste śivenāpi ||
27421 ayi cetovihaga tvaṃ viṣayāraṇye bhramannasi śrāntaḥ |

27431 ayi jalada yadi na dāsyasi katicittvaṃ cātakāya jalakaṇikāḥ |

27441 ayi tyaktāsi kastūri pāmaraiḥ paṅkaśaṅkayā |
27442 alaṃ khedena bhūpālāḥ kiṃ na santi mahītale ||
27451 ayi dayite tava vadanaṃ pāyaṃ pāyaṃ manobhavo garjan |
27452 smitamavalambya tamisrāsvapi hatakān hanta no hanti ||
27461 ayi daladaravinda syandamānaṃ marandaṃ tava kimapi lihanto mañju guñjantu bhṛṅgāḥ |
27462 diśi diśi nirapekṣastāvakīnaṃ vivṛṇvan parimalamayamanyo bāndhavo gandhavāhaḥ ||
27471 ayi dīnadayārdranātha he mathurānātha kadāvalokyase |
27472 hṛdayaṃ tvadalokakātaraṃ dayita bhrāmyati kiṃ karomyaham ||
27481 ayi durjanagarjitena kiṃ sarale namramukhī viṣīdasi tvam |
27482 paripanthini devakīsute parivādo'pi tapobhirunnataiḥ ||
27491 ayi duṣkṛtakena kena vatse halikadvāri lavaṅgi puṣpitāsi |
27492 stabakāstava pāṃsubhiḥ parītāḥ paritaḥ prāṅgaṇasīmni yalluṭhanti ||
27501 ayi dūti sakhī tvameva me madano hanti śitaiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ |
27502 dayitaṃ tamupānayāśu tatsuśako jīvitanirgamo'nyathā ||
27511 ayi nandatanūja kiṃkaraṃ patitaṃ māṃ viṣame bhavāmbudhau |
27512 kṛpayā tava pādapaṅkaja sthitadhūlīsadṛśaṃ vibhāvaya ||
27521 ayi pataṅgi lavaṅgalatāvane piba madhūni vidhūya madhuvratān |
27522 iha vane ca vanecarasaṃkule na ca satāmasātāṃ ca nirūpaṇam ||
27531 ayi parāri parunmalayānilā vavuramī jagureva ca kokilāḥ |
27532 kalamalotkalitaṃ tu na me manaḥ sakhi babhūva vṛthaiva yathaiṣamaḥ ||
27541 ayi pibata cakorāḥ kṛtsnamunnāmikaṇṭha kramasaralitacañcaccañcavaścandrikāmbhaḥ |
27542 virahavidhuritānāṃ jīvitatrāṇahetorbhavati hariṇalakṣmā ye na tejodaridraḥ ||
27551 ayi bata guru garvaṃ mā sma kastūri yāsīrakhilaparimalānāṃ maulinā saurabheṇa |
27552 girigahanaguhāyāṃ līnamatyantadīnaṃ svajanakamamunaiva prāṇahīnaṃ karoṣi ||
27561 ayi makarandasyandini padmini manye tavaiva subhagatvam |
27562 puṣpavatīmapi bhavatīṃ tyajati na vṛddhaḥ śucirhaṃsaḥ ||
27571 ayi madana na dagdhastvaṃ kimīśena kopātkimuta rativiyoge nānvabhūrmūrkha duḥkham |
27572 aviditaparapīḍo yena māmutpalākṣī rahitamahitapātraiḥ patrivarṣairdunoṣi ||
27581 ayi manmathacūtamañjari śravaṇāyatalocane priye |
27582 apahṛtya manaḥ kva yāsi me kimarājakamatra vartate ||
27591 ayi mamaiṣa cakoraśiśurmunervrajati sindhupibasya na śiṣyatām |
27592 aśitumabdhimadhītavato'sya ca śaśikarāḥ pibataḥ kati śīkarāḥ ||
27601 ayi malayaja mahimāyaṃ kasya girāmastu viṣayaste |
27602 udgirato yadgaralaṃ phaṇinaḥ puṣṇāsi parimalodgāraiḥ ||
27611 ayi mālati saurabhasāravinirjitasaṃvikasatkamalānilaye |
27612 madhupānavidhau madhupasya punarbhuvane bhavatīmahamākalaye ||
27621 ayi mṛgākṣi tavādharapallave dayitadantapadaṃ na bhavatyadaḥ |
27622 bhuvanamohanamantrapadāṅkitaṃ kimuta yantramidaṃ smarayoginaḥ ||
27631 ayi roṣamurīkaroṣi no cetkimapi tvāṃ prati vāridhe vadāmaḥ |
27632 jaladena tavārthinā vimuktānyapi toyāni mahānna hā jahāsi ||
27641 ayi laṅghitamaryāda smara smara harānalam |
27642 dagdhaṃ dagdhumayuktaṃ te janaṃ virahakātaram ||
27651 ayi varoru hatasmaradīpike yadi gatāsi madīkṣaṇagocarāt |
27652 asamasāyakasāyakakīlitā vada gamiṣyasi me hṛdayātkatham ||
27661 ayi vijahīhi dṛḍhopagūhanaṃ tyaja navasaṃgamabhīru vallabham |
27662 aruṇakarodgama eṣa vartate varatanu saṃpravadanti kukkuṭāḥ ||
27671 ayi vidhuṃ paripṛccha guroḥ kutaḥ sphuṭamaśikṣyata dāhavadānyatā |
27672 glapitaśaṃbhugalādgaralāttvayā kimudadhau jaḍa vā vaḍavānalāt ||
27681 ayi śākunika kṛto'ñjaliritare na katīha jīvanopāyāḥ |
27682 hatvā śukān kimetadvipinamasārasvataṃ kuruṣe ||
27691 ayi saṃprati dehi darśanaṃ smara paryutsuka eṣa mādhavaḥ |
27692 dayitāsvanavasthitaṃ nṛṇāṃ na khalu prema calaṃ suhṛjjane ||
27701 ayi saṃprasīda pārvati śivo'pi tava pādayornipatito'ham |
27702 śiva iti kathaṃ hi jalpasi sarudhiragajacarmasaṃvītaḥ ||
27711 āyi sakhi kuru kṣipraṃ rambhādalaiḥ śiśirānilaṃ sahacari tanau satkarpūraṃ drutaṃ parilepaya |
27712 sarasabisinīpatraistalpaṃ priye parikalpaya sphuṭamiti vibho tasyā gehe bhavanti kiloktayaḥ ||
27721 ayi sakhi niśā kiṃ vā ghasraḥ śaśī kimu bhāskaraḥ sphurati purataḥ kāmaḥ kiṃ vā mamāsti sa vallabhaḥ |
27722 pratipalamiti prāṇādhīśa priyā virahāturā kathayati muhurmandaṃ mandaṃ sakhīṃ savidhasthitām ||
27731 ayi sakhi paridoṣo jāyate cumbane kiṃ kimu kucaparirambhe kiṃ rate brūhi tathyam |
27732 itinigadati nāthe dīpamālokayantī hari hari hariṇākṣī hrīsamudre nimagnā ||
27741 ayi sakhi mama prāṇādhīśo gato viṣayāntaraṃ kusumaviśikhastasmāduccairdunoti tanuṃ śaraiḥ |
27742 laghu kuru tathā yatnaṃ yena smarādhinivāraṇe paṭutaramatestasyāśu syādihāgamanaṃ tataḥ ||
27751 ayi sakhi śastaḥ sakhivatpatiriti kiṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi |
27752 śasto'tisakhivadupapatirityāli kathaṃ tvayāpi nābodhi ||
27761 ayi sarasija sāyaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ tvadīyaṃ bhramara upagato'yaṃ cūtamālāṃ vihāya |
27762 anupamamadhulobhāddūrataḥ sāṃprataṃ tadidamanucitametanmudraṇaṃ yanmukhasya ||
27771 ayi sarale tāvadimā upadeśagiro viśanti karṇāntaḥ |
27772 yāvannāntarbhūtaṃ taccetasi māmakaṃ cetaḥ ||
27781 ayi sutanuśarīre talpamāruhya tūrṇaṃ viracaya mama kaṇṭhe bandhanaṃ bāhuvallyā |
27782 itinigadati nāthe dīpamālokayantī hari hari hariṇākṣī hrīsamudre nimagnā ||
27791 ayi sundari tava vadanaṃ nityaṃ pūrṇaṃ sudhānidhirmatvā |
27792 hanta patatyupariṣṭānmadhye'mbudhi nityamevāsau ||
27801 ayi sundari saṃprati paśya puraścaramācalamastakameti raviḥ |
27802 samupaiti tamaḥpaṭalījaṭilā rajanī kuru kāmakalāḥ sakalāḥ ||
27811 ayi svayūthyairaśanikṣatopamaṃ mamādya vṛttāntamimaṃ batoditā |
27812 mukhāni lolākṣi diśāmasaṃśayaṃ daśāpi śūnyāni vilokayiṣyasi ||
27821 ayi hastagataiḥ prāṇairamībhiḥ kandukairiva |
27822 aparyantarasaṃ mugdhe kiyatkrīḍitumicchasi ||
27831 ayi hāralate saṃhara harahuṃkṛtidagdhadehasaṃkṣobham |
27832 sadbhāvajānuraktirnahi ramyā paṇyanārīṇām ||
27841 ayi hṛdaya dayāṃ mayi kuru kuraṅganayanāṃ vinā badhāna dhṛtim |
27842 ṭasaditi jhaṭiti sphuṭa vā sphuṭamidamuktaṃ gatirnānyā ||
27851 ayuktaṃ bahu bhāṣante yatra kutrāpi śerate |
27852 nagnā vikṣipya gātrāṇi sajjarā iva madyapāḥ ||
27861 ayuktaṃ yuktaṃ vā yadabhihitamajñena vibhunā stuyādetannityaṃ jaḍamapi guruṃ tasya vinuyāt |
27862 vivatsurnaiḥspṛhyaṃ kathamapi sabhāyāmabhinayetsvakāryaṃ saṃtuṣṭe kṣitibhṛti rahasyeva kathayet ||

27872 amṛtaṃ rāhave mṛtyurviṣaṃ śaṃkarabhūṣaṇam ||
27881 ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naikṛtiko'lasaḥ |
27882 viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate ||
27891 ayuktacāraṃ durdarśamasvādhīnaṃ narādhipam |

27901 ayuktarūpaṃ kimataḥparaṃ bhavettrinetravakṣaḥ sulabhaṃ tavāpi yat |
27902 stanadvaye'smin haricandanāspade padaṃ citābhasmarajaḥ kariṣyati ||
27911 ayutaṃ niyutaṃ vāpi pradiśantu prākṛtāya bhogāya |
27912 krīṇanti na bilvadalaiḥ kaivalyaṃ paccaṣairmūḍhāḥ ||
27921 ayudhyamānasyotpādya brāhmaṇasyāsṛgaṅgataḥ |
27922 duḥkhaṃ sumahadāpnoti pretyāprājñatayā naraḥ ||
27931 aye kīraśreṇīparivṛḍha vṛthā vāsaraśataṃ tarorasya skandhe gamayati phalāśārabhasataḥ |
27932 yadā puṣpārambhe mukhamalinimā kiṃśukatarostadaivābhijñātaṃ phaliparicayo durlabha itaḥ ||

27952 aho netradvandvaṃ vilasati vilaṅghya śrutipathaṃ kathaṃ na trailokyaṃ jayati madanaḥ smeravadanaḥ ||
27961 aye kelīgṛhastambha kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ tvayā |
27962 paryaṅke vallabhaṃ tyaktvā tvāmāliṅgati māninī ||
27971 aye ko jānīte nijapuruṣasaṅgo hi na tathā yathā cetaḥ strīṇāṃ parapuruṣasaṅgo ramayate |
27972 api svairaṃ bhuktā divasamakhilaṃ vāsarakṛtā karasparśādindormukulayati netrāṇi nalinī ||
27981 aye ko'yaṃ vṛddho gṛhaparivṛḍhaḥ kiṃ tava pitā na me bhartā kiṃtu vyapagatadṛganyacca badhiraḥ |
27982 huhuṃ śrānto'dyāhaṃ śiśayiṣurihaivāpavarake kva yāminyāṃ yāmi svapimi nanu nirdaṃśamaśake ||
27991 aye jaladhinandinīnayananīrajālambana jvalajjvalanajitvarajvarabharatvarābhaṅguram |
27992 prabhātajalajonnamadgarimagarvasarvaṃkaṣairjagattritayarocanaiḥ śiśirayāśu māṃ locanaiḥ ||
28001 aye tāla vrīḍāṃ vraja gurutayā bhāti na bhavān phale na cchāyā no kaṭhinaparivāro hi bhavataḥ |
28002 iyaṃ dhanyā dhanyā saralakadalī sundaradalā parātmānaṃ manye sukhayati phalenāmṛtavatā ||
28011 aye diṣṭyā naṣṭo mama gṛhapiśācīparicayaḥ parāvṛttaṃ mohātsphurati ca manāgbrahmaṇi manaḥ |
28012 vikāro'pyakṣāṇāṃ galita iva nirbhāti viṣayāttathāpi kṣetrajñaḥ spṛhayati vanāya prati muhuḥ ||
28021 aye dūrabhrāntaṃ viṣayaviṣamāraṇyavipathe paribhrāntaṃ ceto mama vidhuritaṃ svairamadhunā |

28031 aye nīlagrīva kva kathaya sakhe te'dya munayaḥ paraṃ toṣaṃ yeṣāṃ tava varavilāso vitanute |

28041 aye nṛpatimaṇḍalīmukuṭaratna yuṣmadbhujā mahoṣmatatisaṃjuṣā bata bhavatpratāpārciṣā |
