28051 aye pāthovāha sthagaya kakubho'nyāstata itastyajaitāṃ sīmānaṃ vasati munirasyāṃ kalaśabhūḥ |
28052 udañcatkope'smin sa jaladhirapi sthāsyati na te yataḥ pāyaṃ pāyaṃ salilamiha śauryaṃ prathayasi ||
28061 aye madhupa mā kṛthā bata vṛthā manodīnatāṃ tuṣārasamaye latāśataniṣevaṇavyākulaḥ |
28062 iyaṃ purata eva te sarasapuṣpamāsodaye rasālanavamañjarī madhujharī jarījṛmbhate ||
28071 aye mamodāsitameva jihvayā dvaye'pi tasminnanatiprayojane |
28072 garau giraḥ pallavanārthalāghave mitaṃ ca sāraṃ ca vaco hi vāgmitā ||
28081 aye mātardṛṣṭvā mukhamamṛtabhānubhramavaśātkacacchadmā rāhurvasati kimu tṛṣṇātaralitaḥ |
28082 kimevaṃ kandarpāntakataruṇi sindūrasaraṇicchalādbhoktuṃ bhūyo bahiriva rasajñāṃ kalayati ||
28091 aye mātastātaḥ kva gata iti yadvairiśiśunā darīgehe līnā nibhṛtamiha pṛṣṭā svajananī |
28092 kareṇāsyaṃ tasya drutamatha niruddhyāśrubhṛtayā viniḥśvasya sphāraṃ śiva śiva dṛśaivottarayati ||
28101 aye muktāratna prasara bahiruddyotaya gṛhānapi kṣoṇīndrāṇāṃ kuru phalavataḥ svānapi guṇān |
28102 kimatraivātmānaṃ jarayasi mudhā śuktikuhare mahāgambhīro'yaṃ jaladhiriha kastvāṃ gaṇayati ||
28111 aye yadi samīhase parapurāvarodhaṃ prabho tadākalaya madvacaḥ kimapi darpanārāyaṇa |
28112 pratīpanṛpanāgarīnayananīrakallolinī samuttaraṇacāturīṃ turagarājimadhyāpaya ||
28121 aye lājā uccaiḥ pathi vacanamākarṇya gṛhiṇī śiśoḥ karṇau yatnātsupihitavatī dīnavadanā |
28122 mayi kṣīṇopāye yadakṛta dṛśāvaśrubahule tadantaḥśalyaṃ me tvamasi punaruddhartumucitaḥ ||
28131 aye vāpīhaṃsā nijavasatisaṃkocapiśunaṃ kurudhvaṃ mā ceto viyati calato vīkṣya vihagān |
28132 amī te sāraṅgā bhuvanamahanīyavratabhṛtāṃ nirīhāṇāṃyeṣāṃ tṛṇamiva bhavantyambunidhayaḥ ||
28141 aye vārāṃ rāśe katipayapayobinduvibhavairamībhirmā garvaṃ vaha niravalepā hi kṛtinaḥ |
28142 na kiṃ lopāmudrāsahacarakarakroḍakuhare bhavān dṛṣṭaḥ kaṣṭaṃ pracalajalajantuvyatikaraḥ ||
28151 aye vārāṃ rāśe kuliśakarakopapratibhayādayaṃ pakṣapremṇā giripatisutastvāmupagataḥ |
28152 tvadantarvāstavyo yadi punarayaṃ vāḍavaśikhī pradīptaḥ pratyaṅgaṃ glapayati tataḥ ko'sya śaraṇam ||
28161 aye sudhākairaviṇi vyadhāyi mudhā sudhādhāmani bandhubhāvaḥ |
28162 janāpavādaḥ paritaḥ prayātaḥ samāgamo hanta na jātu jātaḥ ||
28171 aye'stamayate śaśī nahi kṛśībhavatyāgraho vinaśyati tamo haṭhaṃ kimaṇumapyapāste manaḥ |
28172 sakhi prakaṭito'ruṇo na karuṇodayaste manākprayāti khalu yāminī na vimanīkṛthā nāyakam ||
28181 aye svargaḥ svargaḥ katidivasamārgaḥ pravasatāṃ purastuṅgau syātāṃ yadi na kucakumbhau mṛgadṛśaḥ |
28182 ayācaṃ pātheyaṃ sulabha[mubhayaṃ] mūlaphalayoḥ payaḥ sthāne sthāne pathi pathi ca viśrāmataravaḥ ||
28191 aye helāvelātulitakulaśaile jalanidhau kuto vārāmoghaṃ bata jalada moghaṃ vitarasi |
28192 samantāduttālajvaladanalakīlākavalana klamopetānetānupacara payobhirviṭapinaḥ ||
28201 ayogajāmanvabhavaṃ na vedanāṃ hitāya me'bhūdiyamunmadiṣṇutā |
28202 udeti doṣādapi doṣalāghavaṃ kṛśatvamajñānavaśādivainasaḥ ||
28211 ayogyavastubharaṇātbhajedyogyo'pi duṣṭatām |
28212 rakṣaṇāyendradattāsiṃ vahan vyādho'bhavanmuniḥ ||
28221 ayodhyāmaṭavībhūtāṃ pitrā bhrātrā ca varjitām |
28222 pipāsārto'nudhāvāmi kṣīṇatoyāṃ nadīmiva ||
28231 ayyayi sāhasakāriṇi kiṃ tava caṅkramaṇena |
28232 ṭasaditi bhaṅgamavāpsyasi kucayugabhārabhareṇa ||

38132 nirvāṇabāṇadīpaṃ jagadidamadyoti ratnena ||
38141 astaṃ gatavati savitari pāyasapiṇḍaṃ sudhākaraṃ prācī |
38142 vyaracayadambarakuśabhuvi carati kalaṅkastadantare kākaḥ ||
38151 astaṃ gatavati savitari bhartari madhupaṃ niveśya kośānte |
38152 kamalinyo'pi ramante kimatra citraṃ mṛgākṣīṇām ||
38161 astaṃgate divānāthe nalinī madhupacchalāt |
38162 gilanti svavināśāya guṭikāṃ kālakūṭajām ||
38171 astaṃgate nijaripāvapi kumbhayonau saṃkocamāpa jaladhirna tu mādyati sma |
38172 gambhīratāguṇacamatkṛtaviṣṭapānāṃ śatrukṣaye'pi mahatāmucitaṃ hyadaḥ syāt ||
38181 astaṃgate bhāsvati nāndhakārān śanaiścaro hanti vidhau budhaśca |
38182 piturguṇairna pratibhāti putro guṇānvito yaḥ sa guṇena bhāti ||
38191 astaṃgato'yamaravindavanaikabandhurbhāsvānna laṅghayati ko'pi vidhipraṇītam |
38192 he cakra dhairyamavalambya vimuñca śokaṃ dhīrāstaranti vipadaṃ na tu dīnacittāḥ ||
38201 astaṃ bhāsvati lokalocanakalāloke gate bhartari strīlokocitamācaranti sukṛtaṃ vahnau vilīya tviṣaḥ |
38202 apyetāstu cikīrṣayeva tapasāṃ tārākṣamālā diśo manye khañjanakaṇṭhakomalatamaḥkṛṣṇājinaṃ bibhrati ||
38211 astaṃ muktirupaitu yatra na tanūsādhyā harerbhaktayastannaḥ saṃsṛtiredhatāṃ niravadhiryasyāḥ prasādodayāt |
38212 mūrdhni śrīpuruṣottamapraṇatayaḥ śrīrāmanāmānane hṛddeśe yadunandanasya jaladaśyāmābhirāmākṛtiḥ ||
38221 astaṃ yatāpi kila mastakavartināsāvastācalo'himarucā rucimapyalambhi |
38222 prāyaḥ paropakṛtaye kṛtino'nepekṣya svārthaṃ vipatkavalitā api bhāvayanti ||
38231 astaṃ yātastimirapaṭalīdattabhaṅgaḥ pataṃgaḥ prāpto naivodayagiriśiromūlameṇāvacūlaḥ |
38232 tatte kālaṃ katipalamayaṃ bhāti khadyotapota dyotaṃ dyotaṃ punarapi punardyotatāṃ ko vilambaḥ ||
38241 astaṃ śaśī yāti śaśāṅkavadane mānaṃ vimuñcādhunā kiṃ mānena mudhā natabhru gaganādbhraśyantyamūstārakāḥ |
38242 itthaṃ tvāmanuśikṣayan kṣititalādunnamya pādaṃ śanaiḥ kṣīṇāṃ vīkṣya niśāṃ nisargasubhagaṃ gāyatyasau kukkuṭaḥ ||
38251 astagrastagabhastimatkaratatinyaṅnītacañcūpuṭī pāṭīrādrimatho himācalamadhaḥ prakṣipya pakṣadvayam |
38252 paścādunnatapucchapuñjamudayatprācīprakāśacchalādaṇḍaṃ maṇḍalamaindavaṃ janayati vyaktaṃ bakoṭīviyat ||
38261 astapratyupakāragandhamakṛtasvaprārthanāpekṣama pyambhobhirbhuvamārdrayanti jaladā jīvantyamī jantavaḥ |
38262 daivajñaḥ punarasti vṛṣṭiriti vāgekā mayokteti yadviśvaṃ krītamivādhigacchati tadevāghūrṇate marmaṇi ||
38271 astabdhaḥ pūjayenmānyān gurūn sevedamāyayā |
38272 arceddevānnadambhena śriyamicchedakutsitām ||
38281 astabdhatāmacāpalyaṃ vairāṇāṃ cāpyakartṛtām |
38282 pratyakṣato vijānīyādbhadratāṃ kṣudratāmapi ||
38291 astabdhamaklībamadīrghasūtraṃ sānukrośaṃ ślakṣṇamahāryamanyaiḥ |
38292 arogajātīyamudāravākyaṃ dūtaṃ vadantyaṣṭaguṇopapannam ||
38301 astamastakaparyastasamastārkāṃśusaṃstarā |
38302 pīnastanasthitātāmrakamravastreva vāruṇī ||
38311 astamitaviṣayasaṅgā mukulitanayanotpalā mṛduśvasitā |
38312 dhyāyati kimapyalakṣyaṃ nityaṃ yogābhiyukteva ||
38321 astamīyuṣi niśākare satī rāgato'tividhurā kumudvatī |
38322 ṣaṭpadaṃ garalamagrahīnmukhe saṃmukhe'pi khagaśabdavāritā ||
38331 astavyastamitastataḥ pathi patanmadyaṃ mahādudvaman hastābhyāṃ mukhamakṣikāḥ pariṇudan gālīrgadan gadgadan |
38332 uttālaiḥ śiśubhirbhṛśaṃ valayito bībhatsamūrtirmahānmatto dakṣiṇataḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṣipa dṛśaṃ matto'yamāgacchati ||
38341 astavyastasamīrakampitatayā dṛṣṭestiraskāriṇīṃ hastenālakavallarīmakuṭilāmānīya karṇāntikam |
38342 udvīkṣya priyamārgamadhvagavadhūrastaṃ gate bhāsvati chinnāśā svaniveśameti śanakaiḥ svapnekṣaṇāśaṃsinī ||
38351 astavyastān kramatatagatīn patrimālātaraṅgān veṇīdaṇḍāniva dhṛtavatī muktasaṃdhyāṅgarāgā |
38352 dhvāntamlānāṃśukaparicayacchannalāvaṇyaśocyā dyauḥ pratyagradyumaṇivirahādvāntamakṣṇorna yāti ||
38361 astādripārśvamupajagmuṣi tigmabhāsi jānīta śītakiraṇo'bhyudito na veti |
38362 cārā ivātha rajanītimiraprayuktāśceruściraṃ caraṇabhūmiṣu cañcarīkāḥ ||
38371 astādriśirovinihita ravimaṇḍalasarasayāvaghaṭṭāṅkam |
38372 nayatīva kālakaulaḥ kvāpi nabhaḥsairibhaṃ siddhyai ||
38381 astābhimukhe sūrye udite saṃpūrṇamaṇḍale candre |
38382 gamanaṃ budhasya lagne uditāstamite ca ketau ||
38391 astāvalambiravibimbatayodayādri cūḍonmiṣatsakalacandratayā ca sāyam |
38392 saṃdhyāpranṛttaharahastagṛhītakāṃsya tāladvayeva samalakṣyata nākalakṣmīḥ ||
38401 astāvilarūkṣākṣyo mūṣakanayanāśca na śubhadā gāvaḥ |
38402 pracalaccipiṭaviṣāṇā karaṭāḥ kharasadṛśavarṇāśca ||
38411 asti kāraṇamavyaktaṃ sarvavyāpi parāparam |
38412 sāṃnidhyādapi durgrāhyaṃ viśvamūrtyopalakṣitam ||
38421 asti ko'pi timirastanaṃdhayaḥ kiṃcidañcitapadaṃ sa gāyati |
38422 yanmanāgapi niśamya kā vadhūrnāvadhūtahṛdayopajāyate ||
38431 asti grīvā śiro nāsti dvau bhujau karavarjitau |
38432 sītāharaṇasāmarthyo na rāmo na ca rāvaṇaḥ ||
38441 asti jalaṃ jalarāśau kṣāraṃ tatkiṃ vidhīyate tena |
38442 laghurapi varaṃ sa kūpo yatrākaṇṭhaṃ janaḥ pibati ||
38451 asti putro vaśe yasya bhṛtyo bhāryā tathaiva ca |
38452 abhāve sati saṃtoṣaḥ svargastho'sau mahītale ||
38461 asti bhayamasti kautukamasti ca mandākṣamasti cotkaṇṭhā |
38462 bālānāṃ praṇayijane bhāvaḥ ko'pyeṣa naikarasaḥ ||
38471 asti yadyapi sarvatra nīraṃ nīrajarājitam |
38472 modate na tu haṃsasya mānasaṃ mānasaṃ vinā ||
38481 asti śrīstanapatrabhaṅgamakarīmudrāṅkitoraḥsthalo devaḥ sarvajagatpatirmadhuvadhūvaktrābjacandrodayaḥ |
38482 krīḍākroḍatanornavenduviśade daṃṣṭrāṅkure yasya bhūrbhāti sma pralayābdhipalvalatalotkhātaikamustākṛtiḥ ||
38491 asti svarṇamayo'drirasti viṣayaḥ kṣuttṛḍbharāvarjitaḥ santi kṣīraghṛtākarā jaladhayaḥ santi drumāḥ kāmadāḥ |
38492 kiṃ nastaccaritādbhutaśravaṇataḥ sādhyaṃ kṣudhā tāmyatāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yatsavidhe vidhehi sumate tatraiva sarvaṃ śramam ||
38501 asti svāduphalaṃ kimasti kimathāghrātuṃ kṣamaḥ korakastadviśrāmyatu nāma bhoktumucitaṃ patraṃ kimastyantataḥ |
38502 sevyo hanta yadīdṛśo'pi manujairvṛkṣādhamaḥ pippalo duḥsvātantryamidaṃ vidheḥ kathaya tatkasyāgrato rudyatām ||
38511 astītyeva kṛṣiṃ kuryātasti nāstīti vāṇijam |
38512 nāstītyeva ṛṇaṃ dadyātnāhamasmīti sāhasam ||
38521 astu tāvadagastyena jahnormahimanihnavaḥ |
38522 kā kathā tasya bālasya viśvagrāse'pyatṛpyataḥ ||
38531 astu svastyayanāya digdhanapate kailāsaśailāśraya śrīkaṇṭhābharaṇenduvibhramadivānaktaṃbhramatkaumudī |
38532 yatrālaṃ nalakūbarābhisaraṇārambhāya rambhāsphuratpāṇḍimnaiva tanostanoti virahavyagrāpi veśagraham ||
38541 aste śivā paścimāyāṃ paracakrabhayāya sā |
38542 śubhā kuberadiśyaste grāmāntaḥ śūnyakāriṇī ||
38551 astokavismayamapasmṛtapūrvavṛttamudbhūtanūtanabhayajvarajarjaraṃ naḥ |
38552 ekakṣaṇatruṭitasaṃghaṭitapramohamānandaśokaśabalatvamupaiti cetaḥ ||
38561 astodayācalavilambiravīndubimba vyājātkṣaṇaṃ śravaṇayornihitāravindā |
38562 tārācchalena kusumāni samutkṣipantī saṃdhyeyamāgatavatī pramadeva kācit ||
38571 astodayādrigatamarkaśaśāṅkabimbamahno'tivārdhakadaśāmavalambitasya |
38572 tārākṣarāṇi paṭhituṃ tapanīyaśaila nāsāvasaktamupanetramivābabhāse ||
38581 astopadhānavinihita ravibimbaśironikuñcitadigaṅgaḥ |
38582 vaste'ndhakārakambalamambaraśayane dinādhvanyaḥ ||
38591 astyatraiva kilārṇave tadamṛtaṃ tatraiva hālāhalaḥ santyasminmalaye paṭīrataravastatraiva vātāśanāḥ |
38592 yadyadvastvabhijātamasti savidhe tattaddurāpaṃ nṛṇāṃ prāptavyaṃ rasanāñcale karatale bhāle ca vedhā nyadhāt ||
38601 astyadyāpi catuḥsamudraparikhāparyantamurvītalaṃ vartante'pi ca tatra tatra rasikā goṣṭhīṣu saktā nṛpāḥ |
38602 ekastatra nirādaro bhavati cedanyo bhavetsādaro vāgdevī vadanāmbuje vasati cetko nāma dīno janaḥ ||
38611 astyapratisamādheyaṃ stanadvandvasya dūṣaṇam |
38612 sphuṭatāṃ kañcukānāṃ yannāyātyāvaraṇīyatām ||
38621 astyuttarasyāṃ diśi devatātmā himālayo nāma nagādhirājaḥ |
38622 pūrvāparau toyanidhī vagāhya sthitaḥ pṛthivyā iva mānadaṇḍaḥ ||
38631 astyekaṃ bhuvanaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kṣamadhve yatra vīkṣitum |
38632 viṣayāṃścitravidyāyāścitrāṇāṃ calatāṃ tathā ||
38641 nāṭakākhyāyikānāṃ ca śakyān sarvavidhānapi |
38642 sphuraṇā jāyate prāyastata eva kalākṛtām ||
38651 astyeva bhūbhṛtāṃ mūrdhni divi vā dyotate'mbudaḥ |
38652 marudbhirbhajyamāno'pi sa kimeti rasātalam ||
38661 astyevoddāmadāvānalavikalataraṃ kānanaṃ yatra tatra prauḍhottāpābhibhūtaṃ jagadapi sakalaṃ nirjalā eva nadyaḥ |
38662 kiṃ re nirlajja garjaṃ kalayasi bahuśastarjayan pānthabālāḥ parjanya tvāmamī kiṃ kvacidapi gaṇayantyambudatvena lokāḥ ||
38671 astraṃ vimucya sakalaṃ prathamaprayoge bhūyo'pi hantumabalāṃ vihitodyamasya |
38672 puṣpāyudhasya vapureva tadīyamekaṃ lakṣyaṃ ca hanta śaradhiśca tadā babhūva ||
38681 astraṃ strī vāmano martyaḥ paśurebhyo'thavetaraḥ |
38682 vidhiyogādbhavetkāmaṃ pauruṣaṃ na parityajet ||
38691 astrajvālāvalīḍhapratibalajaladherantaraurvāyamāṇe senānāthe sthite'sminmama pitari gurau sarvadhanvīśvarāṇām |
38692 karṇālaṃ saṃbhrameṇa vraja kṛpa samaraṃ muñca hārdikyaśaṅkāṃ tāte cāpadvitīye vahati raṇadhuraṃ ko bhayasyāvakāśaḥ ||
38701 astraprayogakhuralīkalahe gaṇānāṃ sainyairvṛto'pi jita eva mayā kumāraḥ |
38702 etāvatāpi parirabhya kṛtaprasādaḥ prādādimaṃ priyaguṇo bhagavān gururme ||
38711 astravyastaśirastraśastrakaṣaṇaiḥ kṛttottamāṅge kṣaṇaṃ vyūḍhāsṛksariti svanatpraharaṇe varmodvamadvāhnini |
38712 āhūyājimukhe sa kosalapatirbhagne pradhāne bale ekenaiva rumaṇvatā śaraśatairmattadvipastho hataḥ ||
38721 astrāṇi plavagādhipena vihitāḥ paulastyavakṣaḥsthalī saṃghaṭṭānaladattadāvavipadaḥ sīdanti bhūmīruhāḥ |
38722 utpāṭya prahitaśca śailaśikharo laṅkendrahastāvalī niṣpiṣṭo nijakuñjanirjharajalairjambālapiṇḍāyate ||
38731 astrāmāsa tṛṇaṃ priyādruhi tṛṇāmāsa smarārerdhanurdārāmāsa muneḥ śilāpi nṛvarāmāsa svayaṃ pādukā |
38732 kulyāmāsa mahārṇavo'pi kapayo yodhāṃbabhūvustadā paulastyo maśakībabhūva bhagavaṃstvaṃ mānuṣāmāsithāḥ ||
38741 astraughaprasareṇa rāvaṇirasau yaṃ duryaśobhāginaṃ cakre gautamaśāpayantritabhujasthemānamākhaṇḍalam |
38742 kacchāvartakulīratāṃ gamayatā vīra tvayā rāvaṇaṃ tatsaṃmṛṣṭamaho viśalyakaraṇī jāgarti satputratā ||
38751 astvakṣaragrahavidhirjanuṣāṃ sahasrairāpātato bhavatu vāpi tato'rthabodhaḥ |
38752 durvādikalpitavikalpataraṅgasāndrān duṣpūrvapakṣajaladhīn kathamuttareyuḥ ||
38761 asthānagāmibhiralaṃkaraṇairupetā bhūyaḥ padaskhalananihnutiraprasannā |
38762 vāṇīva kāpi kukaverjanahasyamānā drāṅnirgatā nijagṛhādvanitā madāndhā ||
38771 asthānābhiniveśitā ratipateraucityabhaṅgo ratervaiyarthyaṃ navayauvanasya kimapi premṇaḥ kalaṅkāṅkuraḥ |
38772 saubhāgyasya vimānanā viguṇatā saundaryasāraśriyaḥ śṛṅgārasya viḍambanā kimaparaṃ veśyāratāḍambaraḥ ||
38781 asthānābhiniveśī prāyo jaḍa eva bhavati no vidvān |
38782 bālādanyaḥ ko'mbhasi jighṛkṣatīndoḥ sphuradbimbam ||
38791 asthāne gamitā layaṃ hatadhiyāṃ vāgdevatā kalpate dhikkārāya parābhavāya mahate tāpāya pāpāya vā |
38792 sthāne tu vyayitā satāṃ prabhavati prakhyātaye bhūtaye cetonirvṛtaye paropakṛtaye prānte śivāvāptaye ||
38801 asthāne janasaṃkaṭe mayi manākkāñcīṃ samāskandati vyālole raśanāṃśuke vigalite nīte ca nābheradhaḥ |
38802 dhanyo'yaṃ sa karaḥ kuraṅgakadṛśā tasminnavasthāntare kampātaṅkakaraṃbitāṅgalatayā yasyāvakāśaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
38811 asthāne tāḍito vājī bahūn doṣānavāpnuyāt |
38812 tāvadbhavanti te doṣā yāvajjīvatyasau hayaḥ ||
38821 asthāne'bhiniviṣṭānmūrkhānasthāna eva saṃtuṣṭān |
38822 anuvartante dhīrāḥ pitara iva krīḍato bālān ||
38831 asthāne hyapi ca sthāne satataṃ cānugāmini |
38832 kruddho daṇḍān praṇayati vividhāṃstejasā vṛtaḥ ||
38841 asthikṣodavatīva kundamukulaiḥ phullaiḥ palāśadrumaiḥ sāṅgāraprakareva dhūmakaluṣevotpātibhiḥ ṣaṭpadaiḥ |
38842 raktākṣadyutibhiḥ saśeṣadahanālāteva puṃskokilairdṛṣṭā prāṇasamāciteva pathikairārādvanāntasthalī ||
38851 asthi nāsti śiro nāsti bāhurasti niraṅguliḥ |
38852 nāsti pādadvayaṃ gāḍhamaṅgamāliṅgati svayam ||
38861 asthiraṃ jīvitaṃ loke yauvanaṃ dhanamasthiram |
38862 asthiraṃ putradārādi dharmaḥ kīrtirdvayaṃ sthiram ||
38871 asthiraḥ kulasaṃbandhaḥ sadā vidyā vivādinī |
38872 mado mohāya mithyaiva muhūrtanidhanaṃ dhanam ||
38881 asthiramanekarāgaṃ guṇarahitaṃ nityavakraduṣprāpam |
38882 prāvṛṣi surendracāpaṃ vibhāvyate yuvaticittamiva ||
38891 asthireṇa śarīreṇa sthiraṃ karma samācaret |
38892 avaśyameva yāsyanti prāṇāḥ prāghūrṇakā iva ||
38901 asthivaddadhivaccaiva śaṅkhavadbakavattathā |
38902 rājaṃstava yaśo bhāti punaḥ saṃnyāsidantavat ||
38911 asthiṣvarthāḥ sukhaṃ māṃse tvaci bhogāḥ striyo'kṣiṣu |
38912 gatau yānaṃ svare cājñā sarvaṃ sattve pratiṣṭhitam ||
38921 asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam |
38922 carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhi pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ ||
38931 jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam |
38932 rajasvalamanityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsamimaṃ tyajet ||
38941 nadīkūlaṃ yathā vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ vā śakuniryathā |
38942 tathā tyajannimaṃ dehaṃ kṛcchrādgrāhādvimucyate ||
38951 asthīni majjā śuklaṃ ca pituraṃśāstrayo matāḥ |
38952 raktaṃ romāṇi palalamaṃśā māturamī matā ||
38961 asthīnyasthīnyajinamajinaṃ bhasma bhasmendurindurgaṅgā gaṅgoraga uraga ityākulāḥ saṃbhrameṇa |
38962 bhūṣāveṣopakaraṇagaṇaprāpaṇavyāpṛtānāṃ nṛttārambhapraṇayini śive pāntu vāco gaṇānām ||
38971 asnātāśī malaṃ bhuṅkte ajapī pūyabhakṣaṇam |
38972 ahutāśī viṣaṃ bhuṅkte adātā viṣamaśnute ||
38981 aspṛśyasaṃgatimiha pravidhāya soḍhā daṇḍāhatīḥ paṭaha bandhamapi prapadya |
38982 doṣaṃ prakāśayasi yatpratirathyameva lokasya tadvimukhatāṃ prakaṭīkaroṣi ||
38991 aspṛśyo'stu malīmaso'stvaniyatāhāro'stvato'pyudbhaṭairdoṣairastu paraḥśataiḥ parivṛtaḥ kākastataḥ kā kṣatiḥ |
38992 bhuṅkte bhojyamupasthitaṃ samupahūyaiva svayaṃ bāndhavān yaḥ sīdan kṣudhayā vicintaya tato dhanyaśca puṇyaśca kaḥ ||
39001 aspṛṣṭe rāhubhītyāhani niśi ca same kalmaṣacchāyayone hāsatrāsādvidūre samupacitavibhāvaibhave hṛdyagandhe |
39002 pāthodācchādahīne dharaṇitalagatādurlabhe sarvalokā hlādaṃ cāpyādadhāne sumukhi tava mukhaupamyaleśaḥ sudhāṃśau ||
39011 asmatpūrvaiḥ surapatihṛtaṃ draṣṭukāmaisturaṅgaṃ bhittvā kṣoṇīmagaṇitabalaiḥ sāgaro vardhitātmā |
39012 satkārārthaṃ tava yadi girīnādiśedguptapakṣā na śrānto'pi praṇayamucitaṃ naiva bandhorvihanyāḥ ||
39021 asmatprayāṇasamaye kuru maṅgalāni kiṃ rodiṣi priyatame vada kāraṇaṃ me |
39022 bhoḥ prāṇanātha virahānalatīvratāpa dhūmena vāri galitaṃ mama locanānām ||
39031 asmadīśvaraviśvāsapramāṇena prabhoḥ kṛpā |
39032 vidhātuṃ prabhavetkāryaṃ sāhāyyaṃ ca tathaiva naḥ ||
39041 asmadripūṇāmanilāśanānāṃ datto nivāsaḥ khalu candanena |
39042 itīva roṣādvyajanasya vāyurvyaśoṣayaccandanamaṅgasaṃstham ||
39051 asmadvairī śaśabhṛdamunā jīyate hyandhakāraḥ sāraṅgākṣyā mukhamanugataḥ keśapāśacchalena |
39052 taṃ saṃśrutya pragalitamahāḥ śītaraśmistadaiva prāptaḥ sevāghaṭanavidhaye mālatīdāmabhaṅgyā ||
39061 asmākaṃ jalajīvināṃ jalamidaṃ sadvājirājivrajaiḥ pātavyaṃ pararaktaraktamanasāṃ tṛptiḥ patīnāṃ kṣayaḥ |
39062 matvaivaṃ kila rājarāja nṛpate tvajjaitrayātrotsave matsī roditi makṣikā ca hasati dhyāyanti vairistriyaḥ ||
39071 asmākaṃ paramandirasya caritaṃ yadyapyavācyaṃ bhavetsvāmī tvaṃ kathayāmi tena bhavataḥ kiṃcitpriyādūṣaṇam |
39072 śrīmadrāma nṛpa tvayā raṇamukhe pāṇigrahaḥ sādaraṃ yasyāḥ sāsilatā parasya hṛdaye dṛṣṭā luṭhantī mayā ||
39081 asmākaṃ bata maṇḍale prathamataḥ patyā karaḥ pātyate kāñcīkuntalamadhyadeśaviṣayān saṃtyajya bhūriśriyaḥ |
39082 ityālokya kucau payoruhadṛśāṃ jātau sunīlānanau no nīco'pi parābhavaṃ viṣahate kiṃ tādṛśāvunnatau ||
39091 asmākaṃ vadarīcakraṃ badarī ca tavāṅgaṇe |
39092 vādarāyaṇasambandhādyūyaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ vayam ||
39101 asmākaṃ vratametadeva yadayaṃ kuñjodare jāgaraḥ śuśrūṣā madanasya vaktramadhubhiḥ saṃtarpaṇīyo'tithiḥ |
39102 nistriṃśāḥ śataśaḥ patantu śirasaśchedo'thavā jāyatāmātmīyaṃ kulavartma putri na manāgullaṅghanīyaṃ tvayā ||
39111 asmākaṃ sakhi vāsasī na rucire graiveyakaṃ nojjvalaṃ no vakrā gatiruddhataṃ na hasitaṃ naivāsti kaścinmadaḥ |
39112 kintvanye'pi janā vadanti subhago'pyasyāḥ priyo nānyato dṛṣṭiṃ nikṣipatīti viśvamiyatā manyāmahe duḥsthitam ||
39121 asmākamaṅgamaṅgaṃ paṇyopanataṃ mahādhananidhānam |
39122 dāsīsutāḥ kimete svādanti viṭāḥ prasaṅgena ||
39131 asmākamadhyāsitametadantastāvadbhavatyā hṛdayaṃ cirāya |
39132 bahistvayālaṃkriyātamidānī muro muraṃ vidviṣataḥ śriyeva ||
39141 asmākamātmabhūrbhūtvā hantāsmāneva haṃsi yat |
39142 re re kandarpa tannityamanaṅgatvaṃ sadāstu te ||
39151 asmākamekapada eva marudvikīrṇa jīmūtajālarasitānukṛtirninādaḥ |
39152 gambhīramaṅgalamṛdaṅgasahasrajanmā śabdāntaragrahaṇaśaktimapākaroti ||
39161 asmātparaṃ bata yathāśruti saṃbhṛtāni ko naḥ kule nivapanāni niyacchatīti |
39162 nūnaṃ prasūtivikalena mayā prasiktaṃ dhautāśruśeṣamudakaṃ pitaraḥ pibanti ||
39171 asmādṛśāṃ nūnamapuṇyabhājāṃ na svopayogī na paropayogī |
39172 sannapyasadrūpatayaiva vedyo dāridryamudro guṇaratnakoṣaḥ ||
39181 asmānavehi kalamānalamāhatānāṃ yeṣāṃ pracaṇḍamusalairavadātataiva |
39182 snehaṃ vimucya sahasā khalatāṃ prayānti ye svalpapīḍanavaśānna vayaṃ tilāste ||
39191 asmānmā bhaja kālakūṭabhagini svapne'pi padmālaye vyādhībhūya kadarthayanti bahuśo mātarvikārā ime |
39192 yaccakṣurna nirīkṣatecchaviṣayaṃ naivaṃ śṛṇoti śrutiḥ prāṇā eva varaṃ prayānti na punarniryānti vāco bahiḥ ||
39201 asmān vicitravapuṣaścirapṛṣṭhalagnān ko vā vimuñcati sakhe yadi vā vimuñca |
39202 hā hanta kekivara hāniriyaṃ tavaiva bhūpālamūrdhani punarbhavitā sthitirnaḥ ||
39211 asmān sādhu vicintya saṃyamadhanānuccaiḥ kulaṃ cātmanastvayyasyāḥ kathamapyabāndhavakṛtāṃ snehapravṛttiṃ ca tām |
39212 sāmānyapratipattipūrvakamiyaṃ dāreṣu dṛśyā tvayā bhāgyāyattamataḥparaṃ na khalu tadvācyaṃ vadhūbandhubhiḥ ||
39221 asmābhiḥ kalitaṃ purā na bhavatī bhuktā nṛbhiḥ kairapi prauḍhā mānavaśālinīti calitaṃ cetaḥ sakāmaṃ tvayi |
39222 dhiktvāṃ saṃprati sadbhujaṅgajanatāsaṃśleṣamātanvatī gamyā sarvajanasya vāravanitevotkṣepaṇīyāsi naḥ ||
39231 asmābhiḥ smayalolamauliphalakairmuktāvisārādhipaṃ vedoddhāraparaḥ karastava paraṃ dānāmbupūtaḥ stutaḥ |
39232 kintu kṣmātilaka kṣamasva kavibhiḥ kiṃ nāma nālokyate dṛṣṭaḥ spaṣṭataraṃ tavāpi nibhṛtaḥ pāṇau sa vaisāriṇaḥ ||
39241 asmābhiścaturamburāśiraśanāvacchedinīṃ medinīṃ bhrāmyadbhirna sa ko'pi nistuṣaguṇo dṛṣṭo viśiṣṭo janaḥ |
39242 yasyāgre cirasaṃcitāni hṛdaye duḥkhāni saukhyāni vā saṃjalpya kṣaṇamekamardhamathavā niḥśvasya viśrāmyate ||
39251 asmāllokādūrdhvamamuṣya cādho mahattamastiṣṭhati hyandhakāram |
39252 tadvai mahāmohanamindriyāṇāṃ budhyasva mā tvāṃ pralabheta rājan ||
39261 asmiṃścandramasi prasannamahasi vyākoṣakundatviṣi prācīnaṃ khamupeyuṣi tvayi manāgdūraṃ gate preyasi |
39262 śvāsaḥ kairavakorakīyati mukhaṃ tasyāḥ sarojīyati kṣīrodīyati manmatho dṛgapi ca drākcandrakāntīyati ||
39271 asmiṃste śirasi tadā kānte vaidūryasphaṭikasuvarṇāḍhye |
39272 śobhāṃ svāṃ na vahati tāṃ baddhā suśliṣṭā kuvalayamāleyam ||
39281 asmiñjagati mahatyapi kimapi na tadvastu vedhasā vihitam |
39282 animittavatsalāyā bhavati yato māturupakāraḥ ||
39291 asmiñjaḍe jagati ko nu bṛhatpramāṇa karṇaḥ karī nanu bhavedduritasya pātram |
39292 ityāgataṃ tamapi yo'linamunmamātha mātaṅga eva kimataḥparamucyate'sau ||
39301 asmiñjarāmaraṇamṛtyumahātaraṅga miśrodadhau mahati saṃparivartamānaḥ |
39302 puṇyaplavena sukṛtena narāstarantaḥ saṃprāpya tīramabhayaṃ sukhamāpnuvanti ||
39311 asmin kaḥ prabhavedyogo hyasaṃdhārye'mitātmani |
39312 laṅghane kaḥ samarthaḥ syādṛte devaṃ maheśvaram ||
39321 asmin karīndrakaranirgalitāravinda kandānukāriṇi ciraṃ rucicakravāle |
39322 kasmai phalāya kulaṭākulakoṭihomaṃ haṃho mṛgāṅka kuruṣe karuṇāmapāsya ||
39331 asmin kāle tu yadyuktaṃ tadidānīṃ vidhīyatām |
39332 gataṃ tu nānuśocanti gataṃ tu gatameva hi ||
39341 asmin kuñje vināpi pracalati pavanaṃ vartate ko'pi nūnaṃ paśyāmaḥ kiṃ na gatvetyanusarati gaṇe bhītabhīte'rbhakāṇām |
39342 tasmin rādhāsakho vaḥ sukhayatu vilasan krīḍayā kaiṭabhārirvyātanvāno mṛgāriprabalavuraghurārāvaraudroccanādān ||
39351 asmin kuṭilakalloladolāvikṣobhite'mbhasi |
39352 hāsyahetuḥ kathaṃ setuḥ sikatāmuṣṭibhirbhavet ||
39361 asmin kelivane sugandhapavane krīḍatpuraṃdhrījane guñjadbhṛṅgakule viśālabakule kūjatpikīsaṃkule |
39362 unmīlannavapāṭalāparimale mallīprasūnākule yadyekāpi na mālatī vikasitā tatkiṃ na ramyo madhuḥ ||
39371 asmin digvijayodyate patirayaṃ me stāditi dhyāyati kampaṃ sāttvikabhāvañcati ripukṣoṇīndradārā dharā |
39372 asyaivābhimukhaṃ nipatya samare yāsyadbhirūrdhvaṃ nijaḥ panthā bhāsvati dṛśyate bilamayaḥ pratyarthibhiḥ pārthivaiḥ ||
39381 asminnaktamaharvivekavikale kālādhame nīradaiḥ saṃnaddhairabhito niruddhagaganābhogāsu digbhittiṣu |
39382 bhānorna prasarantu nāma kiraṇāḥ kiṃ tvasya tejasvinaḥ sattāmātraparigraheṇa vikasantyadyāpi padmākarāḥ ||
39391 asminnagṛhyata pinākabhṛtā salīlamābaddhavepathuradhīravilocanāyāḥ |
39392 vinyastamaṅgalamahauṣadhirīśvarāyāḥ srastoragapratisareṇa kareṇa pāṇiḥ ||
39401 asminnabhyudite jagattrayadiśāmullāsahetau diśāmāsyamlānihare sudhārasanidhau deve niśāsvāmini |
39402 vaktraṃ mudritamambujanma bhavatā cetkiṃ tataḥ śāśvataṃ naitasyeśvaramaulimaṇḍanamaṇergāyanti viśve yaśaḥ ||
39411 asminna nirguṇaṃ gotre apatyamupajāyate |
39412 ākare padmarāgāṇāṃ janma kācamaṇeḥ kutaḥ ||
39421 asminnambhodavṛndadhvanijanitaruṣi prekṣamāṇe'ntarikṣaṃ mā kāka vyākulo bhūstaruśirasi śavakravyaleśānaśāna |
39422 dhatte mattebhakumbhavyatikarakarajagrāmavajrāgrajāgradgrāsavyāsaktamuktādhavalitakavalo na spṛhāmatra siṃhaḥ ||
39431 asminnīṣadvalitavitatastokavicchinnabhugnaḥ kiṃcillīlopacitavibhavaḥ puñjitaścotthitaśca |
39432 dhūmodgārastaruṇamahiṣaskandhanīlo davāgneḥ svairaṃ sarpan sṛjati gagane gatvarān patrabhaṅgān ||
39441 asmin parasparadveṣaparuṣe puruṣāyuṣe |
39442 kevalaṃ madhurā vāṇī dadātyānīya sauhṛdam ||
39451 asmin prakīrṇapaṭavāsakṛtāndhakāre dṛṣṭo manāṅmaṇivibhūṣaṇaraśmijālaiḥ |
39452 pātālamudyataphaṇākṛtiśṛṅgako'yaṃ māmadya saṃsmarayatīva bhujaṅgalokaḥ ||
39461 asmin prakṛtimanojñe lagnā prāyeṇa mānmathī dṛṣṭiḥ |
39462 sundari yato bhavatyāḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣīyate madhyaḥ ||
39471 asmin bhūvalaye janasya mahimā bhāgyena saṃjāyate no tatrāsti hi kāraṇaṃ prayatatā naivātha kaścidguṇaḥ |
39472 kākāyāśucibhojine hi vitaratyuccaistu loko baliṃ muktāhāraparāyaṇāya śucaye no hanta haṃsāya yat ||
39481 asminmarau kimaparaṃ vacasāmavācyaṃ mā muñca pāntha muhurāśritavatsalo bhūḥ |
39482 etattvayā jalalavāmiṣalālasena dṛṣṭaṃ jvalatparikaraṃ sikatāvitānam ||
39491 asminmahatyanavadhau kila kālacakre dhanyāstu ye katipaye śukayogimukhyāḥ |
39492 līnāstvadaṅghriyugale pariśuddhasattvāstānātmanastava nakhānavadhārayāmaḥ ||
39501 asminmahāmohamaye kaṭāhe sūryāgninā rātridinendhanena |
39502 māsartudarvīparighaṭṭanena bhūtāni kālaḥ pacatīti vārtā ||
39511 asmin varṣamahe na vartata idaṃ yatkāmadevotsave stheyaṃ putri nirannayā tadadhunā kiṃcinmukhe dīyatām |
39512 ityukte jaratījanena kathamapyadhvanyavadhvā tataḥ paryaste'hani kalpitaśca kavalo dhautaśca dhārāśrubhiḥ ||
39521 asmin vasante na narāḥ sahante vadhūviyogaṃ ca balāsarogam |
39522 kuraṅganābhidravalepabhābhirbhajantu dṛptāḥ pramadāḥ praliptāḥ ||
39531 asmin sakhe nanu maṇitvamahāsubhikṣe cintāmaṇe tvamupalo bhava mā maṇirbhūḥ |
39532 adyedṛśā hi maṇayaḥ prabhavanti loke yeṣāṃ tṛṇagrahaṇakauśalameva bhūṣā ||
39541 asmin sthite vipadabhūditi saṃcintya varjyate |
39542 mūḍhaiḥ parivṛḍhairāpatsevako maṅgalecchubhiḥ ||
39551 asmi vīrajananīti jananyāmasmi vīraramaṇīti ramaṇyām |
39552 saṃmadaṃ vyadadhadutsukacetāstāratūryataralaścalito'nyaḥ ||
39561 asmi vīratanayā varavīra preyasī ca kuru vīrasavitrīm |
39562 adya hṛdyasamarairiti mātā kācidāha tilakākṣatapūrvam ||
39571 asmai karaṃ pravitarantu nṛpā na kasmādasyaiva tatra yadabhūtpratibhūḥ kṛpāṇaḥ |
39572 daivādyadā pravitaranti na te tadaiva nedaṃkṛpā nijakṛpāṇakaragrahāya ||
39581 asya kṣoṇipateḥ parārdhaparayā lakṣīkṛtāḥ saṃkhyayā prajñācakṣuravekṣyamāṇatimiraprakhyāḥ kilākīrttayaḥ |
39582 gīyante svaramaṣṭamaṃ kalayatā jātena vandhyodarānmūkānāṃ prakareṇa kūrmaramaṇīdugdhodadheḥ rodhasi ||
39591 asyatyuccaiḥ śakalitavapuścandano nātmagandhaṃ nekṣuryantrairapi madhuratāṃ pīḍyamāno jahāti |
39592 yadvatsvarṇaṃ na calati hitaṃ chinnaghṛṣṭopataptaṃ tadvatsādhuḥ kujananihato'pyanyathātvaṃ na yāti ||
39601 asya dagdhodarasyārthe kiṃ na kurvanti paṇḍitāḥ |
39602 vānarīmiva vāgdevīṃ nartayanti gṛhe gṛhe ||
39611 asya pracaṇḍabhujadaṇḍabhavaḥ kṛśānuścaṇḍāṃśucaṇḍakarajitsumahāpratāpaḥ |
39612 pratyarthibhūpatipalāśavanaṃ vidahya prauḍhāsu dikṣu bahudāhamurīkaroti ||
39621 asya prayāṇeṣu samagraśakteragresarairvājibhirutthitāni |
39622 kurvanti sāmantaśikhāmaṇīnāṃ prabhāprarohāstamayaṃ rajāṃsi ||
39631 asya śrībhojarājasya dvayameva sudurlabham |
39632 śatrūṇāṃ śṛṅkhalairlohaṃ tāmraṃ śāsanapatrakaiḥ ||
39641 asya snigdhasya varṇasya vipattirdāruṇā katham |
39642 idaṃ ca mukhamādhuryaṃ kathaṃ dūṣitamagninā ||
39651 asyāṃ netrapathaṃ manye gatāyāṃ lolacakṣuṣi |
39652 bhavanti pañcabāṇasya svabāṇā eva vairiṇaḥ ||
39661 asyāṃ prāvṛṣi cātakairjalakaṇā labdhā na cetkiṃ tato bhāviprāvṛṣi dāsyate dviguṇamityabhra tvayā gamyate |
39662 ete'dyaiva layaṃ vrajanti pṛthukairetatkulīno na cedekaḥ prāṇiti tāvataiva kṛtamastyatraiva naḥ saṃśayaḥ ||
39671 asyāṃ munīnāmapi mohamūhe bhṛgurmahān yatkucaśailaśīlī |
39672 nānāradāhlādi mukhaṃ śritorurvyāso mahābhāratasargayogyaḥ ||
39681 asyāṃ vapurvyūhavidhānavidyāṃ kiṃ dyotayāmāsa navāṃ sa kāmaḥ |
39682 pratyaṅgasaṅgasphuṭalabdhabhūmā lāvaṇyasīmā yadimāmupāste ||
39691 asyāṃ sakhe badhiralokanivāsabhūmau kiṃ kūjitena khalu kokila komalena |
39692 ete hi daivahatakāstadabhinnavarṇaṃ tvāṃ kākameva kalayanti kalānabhijñāḥ ||
39701 asyāḥ kacānāṃ śikhinaśca kiṃnu vidhiṃ kalāpau vimateragātām |
39702 tenāyamebhiḥ kimapūji puṣpairabhartsi dattvā sa kimardhacandram ||
39711 asyāḥ kararuhakhaṇḍita kāṇḍapaṭaprakaṭanirgatā dṛṣṭiḥ |
39712 paṭavigalitaniṣkaluṣā svadate pīyūṣadhāreva ||
39721 asyāḥ karaspardhanagardhanarddhirbālatvamāpatkhalu pallavo yaḥ |
39722 bhūyo'pi nāmādharasāmyagarvaṃ kurvan kathaṃ vāstu na sa pravālaḥ ||
39731 asyāḥ karṇāvataṃsena jitaṃ sarvaṃ vibhūṣaṇam |
39732 tathaiva śobhate'tyarthamasyāḥ śravaṇakuṇḍalam ||
39741 asyāḥ kāntasya rūpasya savaupamyātiśāyinaḥ |
39742 ekaiva gacchetsādṛśyaṃ svacchāyā darpaṇāśritā ||
39751 asyāḥ kāmanivāsaramyabhavanaṃ vaktraṃ vilokyādarānniścityeva sudhākaraṃ priyatamaṃ bhūmīgataṃ śobhanam |
39752 nāsāmauktikakaitavena rucirā tārāpi sā rohiṇī manye tadvirahāsahiṣṇuhṛdayā tatsaṃnidhiṃ sevate ||
39761 asyāḥ kuśeśayadṛśaḥ śaśiśubhraśubhraṃ nāsāgravarti navamauktikamācakāsti |
39762 kailāsamānasasarovararājahaṃsyā niḥkṣiptamaṇḍamiva jāgrati puṇḍarīke ||
39771 asyāḥ khalu granthinibaddhakeśa mallīkadambapratibimbaveṣāt |
39772 smarapraśastī rajatākṣareyaṃ pṛṣṭhasthalīhāṭakapaṭṭikāyām ||
39781 asyāḥ padau cārutayā mahantāvapekṣya saukṣmyāllavabhāvabhājaḥ |
39782 jātā pravālasya mahīruhāṇāṃ jānīmahe pallavaśabdalabdhiḥ ||
39791 asyāḥ pāṭalapāṇijāṅkitamuro nidrākaṣāye dṛśau nirdhauto'dharaśoṇimā vilulitasrastasrajo mūrdhajāḥ |
39792 kāñcīdāma daraślathāñcalamiti prātarnikhātairdṛśorebhiḥ kāmaśaraistadadbhutamabhūdyanme manaḥ kīlitam ||
39801 asyāḥ pīṭhopaviṣṭāyā abhyaṅgaṃ vitanotyasau |
39802 lasacchroṇi caladveṇi naṭadgurupayodharam ||
39811 asyāḥ pīnastanavyāpte hṛdaye'smāsu nirdaye |
39812 avakāśalavo'pyasti nātra kutra bibhartu naḥ ||
39821 asyāḥ saṃyamavān kaco madhukarairabhyarthyamāno muhurbhṛṅgīgopanajābhiśāpamacirādunmārṣṭukāmo nijam |
39822 sīmantena kareṇa komalarucā sindūrabinducchalādātaptāyasapiṇḍamaṇḍalamasāvādātumākāṅkṣati ||
39831 asyāḥ sa cārurmadhureva kāruḥ śvāsaṃ vitene malayānilena |
39832 amūni sūnairvidadhe'ṅgakāni cakāra vācaṃ pikapañcamena ||
39841 asyāḥ sapakṣaikavidhoḥ kacaughaḥ sthāne mukhasyopari vāsamāpa |
39842 pakṣasthatāvadbahucandrako'pi kalāpināṃ yena jitaḥ kalāpaḥ ||
39851 asyāḥ sargavidhau prajāpatirabhūccandro nu kāntaprabhaḥ śṛṅgāraikarasaḥ svayaṃ nu madano māso nu puṣpākaraḥ |
39852 vedābhyāsajaḍaḥ kathaṃ nu viṣayavyāvṛttakautūhalo nirmātuṃ prabhavenmanoharamidaṃ rūpaṃ purāṇo muniḥ ||
39861 asyāḥ sargavidhau prajāpatiraho candro na saṃbhāvyate no devaḥ kusumāyudho na ca madhurdūre viriñcaḥ prabhuḥ |
39862 etanme matamutthiteyamamṛtātkācitsvayaṃ sindhunā yā manthācalaloḍitena haraye dattvā śriyaṃ rakṣitā ||
39871 asyāḥ sugandhinavakuṅkumapaṅkadatto mugdhaścakāsti tilako madirekṣaṇāyāḥ |
39872 āviṣṭarāgamabhirāmamukhāravinda niṣyandalagnamiva me hṛdayaṃ dvitīyam ||
39881 asyāḥ svedāmbubinducyutatilakatayā vyaktavaktrendukāntervāraṃvāreṇa vegaprahaṇanagaṇanākelivācālitāyāḥ |
39882 tatpātotpātatālakramanamitadṛśastāṇḍavottālatālī lālityāllobhitāḥ smaḥ pratipadamamunā kandukakrīḍitena ||
39891 asyāṅke kaṣapaṭṭabhāsicapalā śrīḥ svarṇarekhāyate dhārāsāraghanaṃ sudarśanamadaścakraṃ jagatpaśyati |
39892 prodañcadvanamālamañjanarucā dehena pītāmbaraṃ dūronnītaśikhaṇḍamaṇḍalamidaṃ rūpaṃ harerambudaḥ ||
39901 asyā dhāmasarovare bhujabise vaktrāravinde bhramannetrabhrūbhramare suyauvanajale kastūrikāpaṅkile |
39902 vakṣojapratikumbhikumbhadalanakrodhādupetya drutaṃ magnaścittamataṃgajaḥ kathamasāvutthāya niryāsyati ||
39911 asyānanasya bhavataḥ khalu koṭireṣā kaṇṭārikā yadi bhavedaviśīrṇaparṇā |
39912 yogyā kva te karabha kalpatarorlatāyāste pallavā vimalavidrumabhaṅgabhājaḥ ||
39921 asyābhyāsādgranthavaryasya śiṣyaḥ sarvajñaḥ syādvisphuraccārubuddhiḥ |
39922 arthaṃ kāmaṃ vetti dharmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ niḥsaṃdehaṃ śīlituṃ paṇḍito'pi ||
39931 asyā manoharākārakabarībhāratarjitāḥ |
39932 lajjayeva vane vāsaṃ cakruścamarabarhiṇaḥ ||
39941 asyāmapūrva iva ko'pi kalaṅkariktaścandro'paraḥ kimuta tanmakaradhvajena |
39942 romāvalīguṇamilatkucamandareṇa nirmathya nābhijaladhiṃ dhruvamuddhṛtaḥ syāt ||
39951 asyā mukhaṃ himarucirnanu yadvidhātrā saṃpūrya sarvamavaśeṣatayātra muktaḥ |
39952 āśyānatāmupagato'sya rucā cakāsti nāsāgramauktikamiṣādamṛtasya binduḥ ||
39961 asyā mukhaśrīpratibimbameva jalācca tātānmukurācca mitrāt |
39962 abhyarthya dhattaḥ khalu padmacandrau vibhūṣaṇaṃ yācitakaṃ kadācit ||
39971 asyā mukhasyāstu na pūrṇamāsyaṃ pūrṇasya jitvā mahimā himāṃśum |
39972 bhrūlakṣmakhaṇḍaṃ dadhadardhamindurbhālastṛtīyaḥ khalu yasya bhāgaḥ ||
39981 asyā mukhena lokānāṃ hṛtapaṅkajakāntinā |
39982 niśāsu nāśitā nidrā kumudānāmivendunā ||
39991 asyā mukhenaiva vijitya nitya spardhī milatkuṅkumaroṣabhāsā |
39992 prasahya candraḥ khalu nahyamānaḥ syādeva tiṣṭhatpariveṣapāśaḥ ||
40001 asyā mukhendāvadharaḥ sudhābhūrbimbasya yuktaḥ pratibimba eṣaḥ |
40002 tasyāthavā śrīrdrumabhāji deśe saṃbhāvyamānāsya tu vidrume sā ||
40011 asyāmoṣadhayo jvalantu dadhatu jyotīṃṣi kīṭā api pronmīlantu bhujaṅgamaulimaṇayaḥ krīḍantu dīpāṅkurāḥ |
40012 praṣṭavyāḥ khalu yūyameva yadi ko'pyastaṃ gate bhāsvati prauḍḥdhvāntapayodhimagnajagatīhastāvalambakṣamaḥ ||
40021 asyā yadaṣṭādaśa saṃvibhajya vidyāḥ śrutī dadhraturardhamardham |
40022 karṇāntarutkīrṇagabhīrarekhaḥ kiṃ tasya saṃkhyaiva navā navāṅkaḥ ||
40031 asyā yadāsyena purastiraśca tiraskṛtaṃ śītarucāndhakāram |
40032 sphuṭasphuradbhaṅgikacacchalena tadeva paścādidamasti baddham ||
40041 asyāriprakaraḥ śaraśca nṛpateḥ saṃkhye patantāvubhau sītkāraṃ ca na saṃmukhau racayataḥ kampaṃ ca na prāpnutaḥ |
40042 tadyuktaṃ na punarnivṛttirubhayorjāgarti yanmuktayorekastatra bhinatti mitramaparaścāmitramityadbhutam ||
40051 asyā lalāṭe racitā sakhībhirvibhāvyate candanapatralekhā |
40052 āpāṇḍurakṣāmakapolabhittāvanaṅgabāṇavraṇapaṭṭikeva ||
40061 asyā vapuṣi tāruṇyaṃ śaiśavaṃ vā kṛtāspadam |
40062 jātiḥ kāpālikasyeva na kenāpyavadhāryate ||
40071 asyā vapuṣi tulāyāṃ śaiśavaguñjāṃ ca yauvanaṃ hema |
40072 tulayati kutukini kāme na namati madhyānmanaḥsūcī ||
40081 asyāścedalakāvalī kṛtamaliśreṇībhireṇīdṛśaḥ saundaryaṃ yadi cakṣuṣostaralayoḥ kiṃ manmathasyāyudhaiḥ |
40082 kā prītiḥ kanakāravindamukule pīnau stanau cedato manye kācidiyaṃ manobhavakṛtā māyā jaganmohinī ||
40091 asyāścedgatisaukumāryamadhunā haṃsasya garvairalaṃ saṃlāpo yadi dhāryatāṃ parabhṛtairvācaṃyamatvavratam |
40092 aṅgānāmakaṭhoratā yadi dṛṣatprāyaiva sā mālatī kāntiścetkamalā kimatra bahunā kāṣāyamālambatām ||
40101 asyāsirbhujagaḥ svakośasuṣirākṛṣṭaḥ sphuratkṛṣṇimā kamponmīladarālalīlavalanasteṣāṃ bhiye bhūbhujām |
40102 saṃgrāmeṣu nijāṅgulīmayamahāsiddhauṣadhīvīrudhaḥ parvāsye viniveśya jāṅgulikatā yairnāma nālambitā ||
40111 asyāstanimā madhye prathimā kucayordṛśośca cāñcalyam |
40112 ūrvoḥ krameṇa vṛtto nnāhaśca tulyatāṃ dadhati ||
40121 asyāstanusyandanasaṃsmito vai sa mīnaketurjagatīṃ vijetum |
40122 sakuṅkumālekhamiṣeṇa vīro vyamocayaccārutarāṃ patākām ||
40131 asyāstanau virahatāṇḍavaraṅgabhūmau svedodabindukusumāñjalimāvikīrya |
40132 nāndīṃ papāṭha pṛthuvepathuvepamāna kāñcīlatākalaravaiḥ smarasūtradhāraḥ ||
40141 asyāstuṅgamiva stanadvayamidaṃ nimneva nābhiḥ sthitā dṛśyante viṣamonnatāśca valayo bhittau samāyāmapi |
40142 aṅge ca pratibhāti mārdavamidaṃ snigdhasvabhāvaściraṃ premṇā manmukhacandramīkṣata iva smereva vaktīti ca ||
40151 asyāstrāṇamaho viyogaduritādasmāsu kṛtvā kṛtī svairaṃ gacchasi tattu kiṃ vimṛśasi trāsāvahaṃ hanta naḥ |
40152 vācāleṣu dineṣu kokilarutairutpañcamaprakramaiḥ sajyotsnāsu ca yāminīṣvaśaraṇāḥ kiṃ nāma kurmo vayam ||
40161 asyaikasyāpi kāyasya sahajā asthikhaṇḍakāḥ |
40162 pṛthakpṛthaggamiṣyanti kimutānyaḥ priyo janaḥ ||
40171 asyaiva rambhoru tāvananasya dṛśaiva saṃjīvitamanmathasya |
40172 vanaṃ vidhātā nanu nīrajānāṃ nīrājanārthaṃ kimu nirmimīte ||
40181 asyaiva sargāya bhavatkarasya sarojasṛṣṭirmama hastalekhaḥ |
40182 ityāha dhātā hariṇekṣaṇāyāṃ kiṃ hastalekhīkṛtayā tayāsyām ||
40191 asyodarasya pratitulyaśobhaṃ nāstīti dhātrā bhuvanatraye'pi |
40192 saṃkhyānarekhā iva saṃprayuktāstisro virejurvalayaḥ sudatyāḥ ||
40201 asyorvīramaṇasya pārvaṇavidhudvairājyasajjaṃ yaśaḥ sarvāṅgojjvalaśarvaparvatasitaśrīgarvanirvāsi yat |
40202 tatkambupratibimbitaṃ kimu śaratparjanyarājiśriyaḥ paryāyaḥ kimu dugdhasindhupayasāṃ sarvānuvādaḥ kimu ||
40211 asraṃ locanakoṇa eva kṛpaṇadravyāyate sarvadā kaṇṭhe kākuvacaḥ prasuptakamalakroḍasthabhṛṅgāyate |
40212 hā rāvo hṛdaye viyogikulajākāmābhilāṣāyate vaidehīvirahajvaro raghupaterāpākatāpāyate ||
40221 asramajasraṃ moktuṃ dhiṅnaḥ karṇāyate nayane |
40222 draṣṭavyaṃ paridṛṣṭaṃ tatkaiśoraṃ vrajastrībhiḥ ||
40231 asrasrotastaraṅgabhramiṣu taralitā māṃsapaṅke luṭhantaḥ sthūlāsthigranthibhaṅgairdhavalabisalatāgrāsamākalpayantaḥ |
40232 māyāsiṃhasya śaureḥ sphuradaruṇahṛdambhojasaṃśleṣabhājaḥ pāyāsurdaityavakṣaḥsthalakuharasarorājahaṃsā nakhā vaḥ ||
40241 asrākṣīnnavanīlanīrajadalopāntātisūkṣmāyata tvaṅmātrāntaritāmiṣaṃ yadi vapurnaitatprajānāṃ patiḥ |
40242 pratyagrakṣaradasravisrapiśitagrāsagrahaṃ gṛhṇato gṛdhradhvāṅkṣavṛkāṃstanau nipatataḥ ko vā kathaṃ vārayet ||
40251 asvatantrāḥ striyaḥ kāryāḥ puruṣaiḥ svairdivāniśam |
40252 viṣayeṣu ca sajjantyaḥ saṃsthāpya hyātmano vaśe ||
40261 asvādhyāyaḥ pikānāṃ madanamakhasamārambhaṇasyādhimāso nidrāyā janmalagnaṃ kimapi madhulihāṃ ko'pi durbhikṣakālaḥ |
40262 ṛṣṭiryātrotsukānāṃ malayajamarutāṃ pānthakāntākṛtāntaḥ prāleyonmūlamūlaṃ samajani samayaḥ kaścidautpātiko'yam ||
40271 ahaṃkāra kvāpi vraja vṛjina he mā tvamiha bhūrabhūmirdarpāṇāmahamapasara tvaṃ piśuna he |
40272 are krodha sthānāntaramanusarānanyamanasāṃ trilokīnātho naḥ sphurati hṛdi devo harirasau ||
40281 ahaṃkāro dhiyaṃ brūte mainaṃ suptaṃ prabodhaya |
40282 utthite paramānande na tvaṃ nāhaṃ na vai jagat ||
40291 ahaṃ kimambā kimabhīṣṭatāpade taveti māturdhuri tātapṛcchayā |
40292 pralobhyatulyaṃ pravadantamarbhakaṃ mudā hasañjighrati mūrdhni puṇyabhāk ||
40301 ahaṃkṛteḥ paricchedānavidyāmacitiṃ tathā |
40302 jahi yenopalabdhiste kāpi syānnistulādbhutā ||
40311 ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca rājendra lokanāthāvubhāvapi |
40312 bahuvrīhirahaṃ rājan ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo bhavān ||
40321 ahaṃ ca devanandī ca kuśāgrīyadhiyāvubhau |
40322 naiva śabdāmbudheḥ pāraṃ kimanye jaḍabuddhayaḥ ||
40331 ahaṃ tanīyānatikomalaśca stanadvayaṃ voḍhumalaṃ na tāvat |
40332 itīva tatsaṃvahanārthamasyā valitrayaṃ puṣyati madhyabhāgaḥ ||
40341 ahaṃ tāvanmahārāje pitṛtvaṃ nopalakṣaye |
40342 bhrātā bhartā ca bandhuśca pitā ca mama rāghavaḥ ||
40351 ahaṃ tenāhūtā kimapi kathayāmīti vijane samīpe cāsīnā saralahṛdayatvādavahitā |
40352 tataḥ karṇopānte kimapi vadatāghrāya vadanaṃ gṛhītvā dhammillaṃ mama sakhi nipīto'dhararasaḥ ||
40361 ahaṃ na cetsyāṃ mayi duṣṭabhāvanāmime vrajeyurna nirāśrayā janāḥ |
40362 tadenasā yojayataḥ parān svayaṃ mamaiva yuktā khalu nanvapatrapā ||
40371 ahaṃ nayanajaṃ vāri niroḍhumapi na kṣamaḥ |
40372 rāmaḥ sītāviyogārto babandha saritāṃ patim ||
40381 ahaṃ naśyāmi mānena mānena kalahaṃ kṛthāḥ |
40382 virodhametya kāntena kānte na paritapyate ||
40391 ahaṃbhāvātyayo jātu sukaro na kathaṃcana |
40392 cetanāyāmahambhāvo bhautikyāṃ vijitaḥ sakṛt |
40393 ādhyātmikyāṃ punaścaiṣa sphītaḥ sphurati no'grataḥ ||
40401 ahaṃ mametyeva bhavasya bījaṃ na me na cāhaṃ bhavabījaśāntiḥ |
40402 bīje pranaṣṭe kuta eva janma nirindhano vahnirupaiti śāntim ||
40411 ahaṃ mahānasāyātaḥ kalpito narakastava |
40412 mayā māṃsādikaṃ bhuktaṃ bhīmaṃ jānīhi māṃ baka ||
40421 ahaṃyuvaravarṇinījanamadāyatodavrata sphuraccaturapañcamasvarajitānyapakṣivrajaḥ |
40422 rasālataruṇā kṛtāmasamatulyatāmātmano vihantumiha kokilaḥ phalinamanyamudvīkṣate ||
40431 ahaṃ rathāṅganāmeva priyā sahacarīva me |
40432 ananujñātasaṃparkā dhāriṇī rajanīva nau ||
40441 ahaṃ vo rakṣitetyuktvā yo na rakṣati bhūmipaḥ |
40442 sa saṃhatya nihantavyaḥ śveva sonmāda āturaḥ ||
40451 ahaṃ sadā prāṇasamaṃ mahībhujāmayaṃ tu māṃ vetti nṛpastṛṇopamam |
40452 itīva karṇeṣu suvarṇamarthināṃ svakhedamākhyātumabhūtkṛtāspadam ||
40461 ahaṃ hi saṃmato rājño ya evaṃ manyate kudhīḥ |
40462 balīvardaḥ sa vijñeyo viṣāṇaparivarjitaḥ ||
40471 ahanyahani boddhavyaṃ kimadya sukṛtaṃ kṛtam |
40472 dattaṃ vā dāpitaṃ vāpi vāksāhyamapi vākkṛtam ||
40481 ahanyahani bhūtāni gacchanti caramālayam |
40482 śeṣāḥ sthāvaramicchanti kimāścaryamataḥparam ||
40491 ahanyahani bhūtāni sṛjatyeva prajāpatiḥ |
40492 adyāpi na sṛjatyekaṃ yo'rthinaṃ nāvamanyate ||
40501 ahanyahani yācantaṃ ko'vamanyedguruṃ yathā |
40502 mārjanaṃ darpaṇasyeva yaḥ karoti dine dine ||
40511 ahanyahanyātmana eva tāvajjñātuṃ pramādaskhalitaṃ na śakyam |
40512 prajāsu kaḥ kena pathā prayātītyaśeṣato veditumasti śaktiḥ ||
40521 ahamapi pare'pi kavayastathāpi mahadantaraṃ parijñeyam |
40522 aikyaṃ ralayoryadyapi tatkiṃ karabhāyate kalabhaḥ ||
40531 ahamasmi nīlakaṇṭhastava khalu tuṣyāmi śabdamātreṇa |
40532 nāhaṃ jaladhara bhavataścātaka iva jīvanaṃ yāce ||
40541 ahamahamikābaddhotsāhaṃ ratotsavaśaṃsini prasarati muhuḥ prauḍhastrīṇāṃ kathāmṛtadurdine |
40542 kalitapulakā sadyaḥ stokodgatastanakorake valayati śanairbālā vakṣaḥsthale taralāṃ dṛśam ||
40551 ahamiva dinalakṣmīḥ proṣitaprāṇanāthā tvamiva pathika panthā muktapānthānubandhaḥ |
40552 ayamapi paradeśaḥ so'pi yatrāsi gantā madanamadhuramūrte kiṃ vṛthā satvaro'si ||
40561 ahamiva śūnyamaraṇyaṃ vayamiva tanutāṃ gatāni toyāni |
40562 asmākamivocchvāsā divasā dīrghāśca taptāśca ||
40571 ahamiha kṛtavidyo veditā satkalānāṃ dhanapatirahameko rūpalāvaṇyayuktaḥ |
40572 iti kṛtagurugarvaḥ khidyate kiṃ jano'yaṃ katipayadinamadhye sarvametanna kiṃcit ||
40581 ahamiha sthitavatyapi tāvakī tvamapi tatra vasannapi māmakaḥ |
40582 na tanusaṃgatamārya susaṃgataṃ hṛdayasaṃgatameva susaṃgatam ||
40591 ahameko na me kaścinnāhamanyasya kasyacit |
40592 na taṃ paśyāmi yasyāhaṃ na hi so'sti na yo mama ||
40601 ahametya pataṅgavartmanā punaraṅkāśrayaṇī bhavāmi te |
40602 caturaiḥ surakāminījanaiḥ priya yāvanna vilobhyase divi ||
40611 ahameva guruḥ sudāruṇānāmiti hālāhala tāta mā sma dṛpyaḥ |
40612 nanu santi bhavādṛśāni bhūyo bhuvane'smin vacanāni durjanānām ||
40621 ahameva balī na cāpara iti buddhiḥ pralayaṃkarī nṛṇām |
40622 nahi santi mahītale kati prabalairye vijitā baloddhatāḥ ||
40631 ahameva mato mahīpateriti sarvaḥ prakṛtiṣvacintayat |
40632 udadheriva nimnagāśateṣvabhavannāsya vimānanā kvacit ||
40641 aharan kasyaciddravyaṃ yo naraḥ sukhamāvaset |
40642 sarvataḥ śaṅkitaḥ steno mṛgogrāmamivāgataḥ ||
40651 aharniśaṃ jāgaraṇodyato janaḥ śramaṃ vidhatte viṣayecchayā yathā |
40652 tapaḥśramaṃ cetkurute tathā kṣaṇaṃ kimaśnute'nantasukhaṃ na pāvanam ||
40661 aharniśā veti ratāya pṛcchati kramoṣṇaśītānnakarārpaṇādviṭe |
40662 hriyā vidagdhā kila tanniṣedhinī nyadhatta saṃdhyāmadhure'dhare'ṅgulim ||
40671 ahalyākelikāle'bhūtkandarpāṇāṃ śatadvayam |
40672 tatpañcabāṇabhinnākṣaḥ sahasrākṣo'ndhatāṃ gataḥ ||
40681 ahastāni sahastānāmapadāni catuṣpadām |
40682 phalgūni tatra mahatāṃ jīvo jīvasya jīvanam ||
40691 ahaha karmakarīyati bhūpatiṃ narapatīyati karmakaraṃ naraḥ |
40692 jalanidhīyati kūpamapāṃ nidhiṃ gatajalīyati madyamadākulaḥ ||
40701 ahaha kimadhunā mudhaiva badhnāsyanucitakāriṇi karṇadantapatram |
40702 nanu tava caṭulabhru karṇapālirbhuvanavilocanakālasārapāśaḥ ||
40711 ahaha gṛhī kva nu kuśalī baddhaḥ saṃsārasāgare kṣiptaḥ |
40712 kathamapi labhate potaṃ tenāpi nimajjati nitāntam ||
40721 ahaha caṇḍa samīraṇa dāruṇaṃ kimidamācaritaṃ caritaṃ tvayā |
40722 yadiha cātakacañcupuṭodare patati vāri tadeva nivāritam ||
40731 ahaha nayane mithyādṛgvatsadīkṣaṇavarjite śravaṇayugalaṃ duṣputro vā śrṇoti na bhāṣitam |
40732 skhalati caraṇadvandvaṃ mārge madākulalokavadvapuṣi jarasā jīrṇe varṇo vyapaiti kalatravat ||
40741 ahaha sahajamohā dehagehaprapañce navaratamatimagnā kāminīvigrahāptiḥ |
40742 tadahamiha vihartuṃ saṃtatāmodamugdhā svahitamahitakṛtyaṃ hanta nāntaḥ smarāmi ||
40751 ahānyastamayāntāni udayāntā ca śarvarī |
40752 sukhasyāntaḥ sadā duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyāntaḥ sadā sukham ||
40761 ahāpayannṛpaḥ kālaṃ bhṛtyānāmanuvartinām |
40762 karmaṇāmānurūpyeṇa vṛttiṃ samanukalpayet ||
40771 ahāryaḥ sarvamadhyasthaḥ kāñcanadyutimudvahan |
40772 satpradakṣiṇayogyatvamupayāti mahonnataḥ ||
40781 ahāryeṇa kadāpyanyairasaṃhāryeṇa kenacit |
40782 titikṣākavacenaiva sarvaṃ jayati saṃvṛtaḥ ||
40791 ahiṃ nṛpaṃ ca śārdūlaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca bālakaṃ tathā |
40792 paraśvānaṃ ca mūrkhaṃ ca sapta suptānna bodhayet ||
40801 ahiṃsayaiva bhūtānāṃ kāryaṃ śreyo'muśāsanam |
40802 vākcaiva madhurā ślakṣṇā prayojyā dharmamicchatā ||
40811 ahiṃsā dhāma dharmasya duḥkhasyāyatanaṃ spṛhā |
40812 saṅgatyāgaḥ padaṃ mukteryogābhyāsaḥ padaṃ śucaḥ ||
40821 ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ ahiṃsā paramā gatiḥ |
40822 ahiṃsā paramā prītistvahiṃsā paramaṃ padam ||
40831 ahiṃsā paramo dharmastathāhiṃsā paro damaḥ |
40832 ahiṃsā paramaṃ dānamahiṃsā paramaṃ tapaḥ ||
40841 ahiṃsā paramo yajñastathāhiṃsā paraṃ balam |
40842 ahiṃsā paramaṃ mitramahiṃsā paramaṃ sukham |
40843 ahiṃsā paramaṃ satyamahiṃsā paramaṃ śrutam ||
40851 ahiṃsā paramo dharmo hyahiṃsaiva paraṃ tapaḥ |
40852 ahiṃsā paramaṃ dānamityāhurmunayaḥ sadā ||
40861 ahiṃsāpūrvako dharmo yasmātsarvahite rataḥ |
40862 yūkāmatkuṇadaṃśādīṃstasmāttānapi rakṣayet ||

46881 ādarśāya śaśāṅkamaṇḍalamidaṃ harmyāya hemācalaṃ dīpāya dyumaṇiṃ mahīmiva kathaṃ no bhikṣave dattavān |
46882 ditsāpallavitapramodasalilavyākīrṇanetrāmbujo jānīmo bhṛgunandanastadakhilaṃ na prāyaśo dṛṣṭavān ||
46891 ādātavyaṃ na dātavyaṃ priyaṃ brūyannirarthakam |
46892 āśāṃ kālavatīṃ kuryātkālaṃ vighnena yojayet ||
46901 ādātuṃ sakṛdīkṣite'pi kusume hastāgramālohitaṃ lākṣārañjanavārtayāpi sahasā raktaṃ talaṃ pādayoḥ |
46902 aṅgānāmanulepanasmaraṇamapyatyantakhedāvahaṃ hantādhīradṛśaḥ kimanyadalakāmodo'pi bhārāyate ||
46911 ādānaṃ caiva tūṇīrātsaṃdhānaṃ karṣaṇaṃ tathā |
46912 kṣepaṇaṃ ca tvarāyukto bāṇasya kurute tu yaḥ |
46913 nityābhyāsavaśāttasya śīghrasaṃdhānatā bhavet ||
46921 ādānapānalepaiḥ kāścidgaralopatāpahāriṇyaḥ |
46922 sadasi sthitaiva siddhau ṣadhivallī kāpi jīvayati ||
46931 ādānamapriyakaraṃ dānaṃ ca priyakārakam |
46932 abhīpsitānāmarthānāṃ kāle yuktaṃ praśasyate ||
46941 ādāya karamāḍhyebhyaḥ kīkaṭeṣvapi varṣasi |
46942 prapīya vāri sindhubhyaḥ sthaleṣviva ghanāghanaḥ ||
46951 ādāya cāpamacalaṃ kṛtvāhīnaṃ guṇaṃ viṣamadṛṣṭiḥ |
46952 yaścitramacyutaśaro lakṣyamabhāṅkṣīnnamastasmai ||
46961 ādāya daṇḍaṃ sakalāsu dikṣu yo'yaṃ paribhrāmyati bhānubhikṣuḥ |
46962 abdhau nimajjanniva tāpaso'yaṃ saṃdhyābhrakāṣāyamadhatta sāyam ||
46971 ādāya dhanamanalpaṃ dadānayā subhaga tāvakaṃ vāsaḥ |
46972 mugdhā rajakagṛhiṇyā kṛtā dinaiḥ katipayairniḥsvā ||
46981 ādāya patraṃ tvaritaṃ yadi śvā dūrvāṃ navāṃ vā navagomayaṃ vā |
46982 prayāti yātuḥ paratastadānīṃ rājaprasādaṃ niyataṃ bravīti ||
46991 ādāya pratipakṣakīrtinivahān brahmāṇḍamūṣāntare nirvighnaṃ dhamatā nitāntamuditaiḥ svaireva tejo'gnibhiḥ |
46992 tattādṛkpuṭapākaśodhitamiva prāptaṃ guṇotkarṣiṇāṃ piṇḍasthaṃ ca mahattaraṃ ca bhavatā niḥkṣāratāraṃ yaśaḥ ||
47001 ādāya māṃsamakhilaṃ stanavarjamaṅgānmāṃ muñca vāgurika yāmi kuru prasādam |
47002 sīdanti śaṣpakavalagrahaṇānabhijñā manmārgavīkṣaṇaparāḥ śiśavo madīyāḥ ||
47011 ādāya vakulagandhānandhīkurvan pade pade bhramarān |
47012 ayameti mandamandaṃ kāverīvāripāvanaḥ pavanaḥ ||
47021 ādāya vāri paritaḥ saritāṃ mukhebhyaḥ kiṃ tāvadarjitamanena durarṇavena |
47022 kṣārīkṛtaṃ ca vaḍavādahane hutaṃ ca pātālakukṣikuhare viniveśitaṃ ca ||
47031 ādāya vāri yata eva jahāti bhūyastatraiva yaḥ sa jaladaḥ prathamo jaḍānām |
47032 vāntaṃ pratīpsati tadeva tadeva yastu srotaḥpatiḥ sa nirapatrapasārthavāhaḥ ||
47041 ādāya viprasvamapi nāśayedrājyaghātinaḥ |
47042 ādāyāsthi dadhīcestu śakro daityān jaghāna hi ||
47051 ādāyādāya muktāstadanu śikhidhiyādāya māṇikyavargaṃ dhūmabhrāntiṃ vahantyaḥ svavadanakamalāmodalubdhālivṛnde |
47052 paktuṃ bhillyaḥ pravṛttāḥ sarabhasamasakṛdyaddviṣatpattaneṣu brūmaḥ kiṃ kīrtipūraṃ dhavalitavasudhaṃ mallaśāhasya tasya ||
47061 ādāyāmṛtapūrṇamarkacaṣakaṃ śoṇāravindaprabhe pāṇāvindravadhūrvilokya ca punastasminnabhaḥśyāmikām |
47062 cikṣepopari kopataḥ parijane'saṃśodhya dattā sudhetyenaṃ taṃ śaśinaṃ praśaṃsati janastatpāṇimuktārjunam ||
47071 ādāvaghaṭitaṃ kāryaṃ madhye sughaṭitaṃ mama |
47072 bhūyo vighaṭitaṃ bhūyo bhūyādghaṭayituṃ prabhuḥ ||
47081 ādāvaṅkuritaṃ punaḥ pratipadaṃ patrāvṛtaṃ tvāṃ mudā saurabhyasphuritaprasūnakalitaṃ dṛṣṭvātha hṛṣṭo'smyaham |
47082 kiṃ brūmaḥ phalite tvayi drutataraṃ hā hanta kimpāka he bhūyo vyākulayanti kaṇṭakabharāḥ sarvatra tatkiṃ bruve ||
47091 ādāvañjanapuñjaliptavapuṣāṃ śvāsānilollāsita protsarpadvirahānalena ca tataḥ saṃtāpitānāṃ dṛśām |
47092 saṃpratyeva niṣekamaśrupayasā devasya cetobhuvo bhallīnāmiva pānakarma kurute kāmaṃ kuraṅgekṣaṇā ||
47101 ādāvapyupacāracāṭuvinayālaṃkāraśobhānvitaṃ madhye cāpi vicitravākyakusumairabhyarcitaṃ niṣphalaiḥ |
47102 paiśunyāvinayāvamānamalinaṃ bībhatsamante ca yaddūre vo'stvakulīnasaṃgatamasaddharmārthamutpāditam ||
47111 ādāvādipitāmahasya niyamavyāpārapātre jalaṃ paścātpannagaśāyino bhagavataḥ pādodakaṃ pāvanam |
47112 bhūyaḥ śambhujaṭāvibhūṣaṇamaṇirjahnormaharṣeriyaṃ kanyā kalmaṣanāśinī bhagavatī bhāgīrathī dṛśyate ||
47121 ādāvāyuḥ parīkṣeta paścāllakṣaṇamuttamam |
47122 āyurhīnanarāṇāṃ ca lakṣaṇaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||
47131 ādāvutsṛjya kāryāṇi paścācca prārthayanti ye |
47132 te loke hāsyatāṃ yānti palāṇḍuharaṇādiva ||
47141 ādāveva gajendramaulivilasaddaṇḍā patākāvalī paścādvāraṇarājadhoraṇiratiproddāmayodhāśritā |
47142 uddaṇḍadhvajalāñchitāpyatha ghanībhūtā rathānāṃ tatistatpaścātturagāvalī vijayate yodhaiḥ samaṃ sarvataḥ ||
47151 ādāveva manuṣyeṇa vartitavyaṃ yathā kṣamam |
47152 yathā nātītamarthaṃ vai paścāttāpena yujyate ||
47161 ādikavī caturāsyau kamalajavalmīkajau vande |
47162 lokaślokavidhātroryayorbhidā leśamātreṇa ||
47171 āditāmajananāya dehināmantatāṃ ca dadhate'napāyine |
47172 bibhrate bhuvamadhaḥ sadātha ca brahmaṇo'pyupari tiṣṭhate namaḥ ||
47181 āditālo jayantaḥ syācchṛṅgārarasasaṃyutaḥ |
47182 rudrasaṃkhyākṣarapadairāyurvṛddhikaraḥ paraḥ |
47183 eka eva laghuryasminnāditālaḥ sa kathyate ||
47191 ādityacandrahariśaṃkaravāsavādyāḥ śaktā na jetumatiduḥkhakarāṇi yāni |
47192 tānīndriyāṇi balavanti sudurjayāni ye nirjayanti bhuvane balinasta eke ||
47201 ādityacandrāvanijajñajīvaḥ śukrārkaputrā api rāhuketū |
47202 kurvantu nityaṃ dhanadhānyasauṣṭhyaṃ dīrghāyurārogyaśubhānyamī vaḥ ||
47211 ādityacandrāvanilānalau ca dyaurbhūmirāpo hṛdayaṃ yamaśca |
47212 ahaśca rātriśca ubhe ca sandhye dharmaśca jānāti narasya vṛttam ||
47221 ādityasya gatāgatairaharahaḥ saṃkṣīyate jīvitaṃ vyāpārairbahukāryabhāragurubhiḥ kālo na vijñāyate |
47222 dṛṣṭvā janmajarāvipattimaraṇaṃ trāsaśca notpadyate pītvā mohamayīṃ pramādamadirāmunmattabhūtaṃ jagat ||
47231 ādityasya namaskāraṃ ye kurvanti dine dine |
47232 janmāntarasahasreṣu dāridryaṃ nopajāyate ||
47241 ādityasyodayo gānaṃ tāmbūlaṃ bhāratīkathā |
47242 iṣṭā bhāryā sumitraṃ ca apūrvāṇi dine dine ||
47251 ādityāḥ kiṃ daśaite pralayabhayakṛtaḥ svīkṛtākāśadeśāḥ kiṃ volkāmaṇḍalāni tribhuvanadahanāyodyatānīti bhītaiḥ |
47252 pāyāsurnārasiṃhaṃ vapuramaragaṇairbibhrataḥ śārṅgapāṇerdṛṣṭā dṛptāsurorastaladaraṇagaladraktaraktā nakhā vaḥ ||
47261 ādityādapi nityadīptamamṛtaprasyandi candrādapi trailokyābharaṇaṃ maṇerapi tamaḥkāṣaṃ hutāśādapi |
47262 viśvāloki vilocanādapi parabrahmasvarūpādapi svāntānandanamastu dhāma jagatastoṣāya sārasvatam ||
47271 ādityādigrahāḥ sarve nakṣatrāṇi ca rāśayaḥ |
47272 āyuḥ kurvantu te nityaṃ yasyaiṣā janmapatrikā ||
47281 ādityādyā grahāḥ sarve yathā tuṣyanti dānataḥ |
47282 sarvasve'pi na tuṣyeta jāmātā daśamo grahaḥ ||
4728 1 ādityāya tamaḥ sṛṣṭaṃ meghāya grīṣmaśoṣaṇam |
4728 2 mārgaśramastu vṛkṣāya duḥkhinastūpakāriṇe ||
47291 ādityo'yaṃ sthito mūḍhāḥ snehaṃ kuruta mā bhayam |
47292 bahurūpo muhūrtaśca jīvetāpi kadācana ||
47301 ādimatsyaḥ sa jayatādyaḥ śvāsocchvāsitairjalaiḥ |
47302 gagane vidadhe'mbhodhiṃ gaganaṃ ca mahodadhau ||
47311 ādimadhyanidhaneṣu sauhṛdaṃ sajjane bhavati netare jane |
47312 chedatāpananigharṣatāḍanairnānyabhāvamupayāti kāñcanam ||
47321 ādimadhyāntarahitaṃ daśāhīnaṃ purātanam |
47322 advitīyamahaṃ vande madvastrasadṛśaṃ harim ||
47331 ādimadhyāvasāne ca naiva gacchati vikriyām |
47332 ata eva kulīnānāṃ nṛpāḥ kurvanti saṃgraham ||
47341 ādirājayaśobimbamādarśaṃ prāpya vāṅmayam |
47342 teṣāmasaṃnidhāne'pi na svayaṃ paśya naśyati ||
47351 ādīptavahnisadṛśairmarutāvadhūtaiḥ sarvatra kiṃśukavanaiḥ kusumāvanamraiḥ |
47352 sadyo vasantasamayena samāgateyaṃ raktāṃśukā navavadhūriva bhāti bhūmiḥ ||
47361 ādīrgheṇa calena vakragatinā tejasvinā yoginā nīlābjadyutināhinā varamahaṃ dṛśyo na taccakṣuṣā |
47362 daṣṭe santi cikitsakā diśi diśi prāyeṇa dharmārthino mugdhākṣīkṣaṇavīkṣitasya nahi me vaidyo na cāpyauṣadham ||
47371 ādūrātpratipānthamāhitadṛśaḥ pratyāśayonmīlati dhvānte svāntamaharvyaye'pi na parāvṛttaṃ kuraṅgīdṛśaḥ |
47372 tasyā niḥsahabāhuvallivigaladdhammillavadbhaṅgura grīvaṃ dīrghamajīvavatpriyasakhīvargeṇa nītaṃ vapuḥ ||
47381 ādṛtakupitabhavānī kṛtakaramālādibandhanavyasanaḥ |
47382 kelikalākalahādau devo vaḥ śaṃkaraḥ pāyāt ||
47391 ādṛtā nakhapadaiḥ parirambhāścumbitāni ghanadantanipātaiḥ |
47392 saukumāryaguṇasaṃbhṛtakīrtirvāma eva surateṣvapi kāmaḥ ||
47401 ā dṛṣṭiprasarātpriyasya padavīmudvīkṣya nirviṇṇayā viśrānteṣu pathiṣvahaḥpariṇatau dhvānte samutsarpati |
47402 gatvaikaṃ saśucā gṛhaṃ prati padaṃ pānthastriyāsmin kṣaṇe mā bhūdāgata ityamandavalitagrīvaṃ punarvīkṣitam ||
47411 ādeyasya pradeyasya kartavyasya ca karmaṇaḥ |
47412 kṣipramakriyamāṇasya kālaḥ pibati tadrasam ||
47421 ādehadāhaṃ kusumāyudhasya vidhāya saundaryakathādaridram |
47422 tvadaṅgaśilpātpunarīśvareṇa cireṇa jāne jagadanvakampi ||
47431 ādau kulaṃ parīkṣeta tato vidyāṃ tato vayaḥ |
47432 śīlaṃ dhanaṃ tato rūpaṃ deśaṃ paścātvivāhayet ||
47441 ādau gṛhītapāṇiḥ paścādārūḍhajaghanakaṭibhāgā |
47442 nakhamukhalālanasukhadā sā kiṃ rāmāsti naiva bhoḥ pāmā ||
47451 ādau citte tataḥ kāye satāṃ saṃjāyate jarā |
47452 asatāṃ ca punaḥ kāye naiva citte kadācana ||
47461 ādau chāyātidīrghāpi prācyāmalpatarā tataḥ |
47462 tathā maitryasatāmādau dīrghāpyalpatarā bhavet ||
47471 ādau taddhitakṛtsnehaṃ kāryaṃ snehamanantaram |
47472 kṛtvā sadharmavādaṃ ca madhyasthaḥ sādhayeddhitam ||
47481 ādau tanvyo bṛhanmadhyā vistāriṇyaḥ pade pade |
47482 yāyinyo na nivartante satāṃ maitryaḥ saritsamāḥ ||
47491 ādau tāto varaṃ paśyettato vittaṃ tataḥ kulam |
47492 yadi kaścidvare doṣaḥ kiṃ dhanena kulena kim ||
47501 ādau tāvadvyāpārasthā yamavaruṇadhanadasadṛśā bhavantyatigarvitā mānonmattā darpotsiktāḥ paribhavaharaṇaniratā bhavantyatidāruṇāḥ |
47502 bhraṣṭāstebhyo vyāpārebhyo hatinigaḍaniyatacaraṇāstathā laguḍārditā lambaiḥ kūrcairdīnairvaktrairmunaya iva śamadamaratā bhavantyatibhadrakāḥ ||
47511 ādau tu mandamandāni madhye samarasāni ca |
47512 ante snehāyamānāni saṃgatānyuttamaiḥ saha ||
47521 ādau tu ramaṇīyāni madhye tu virasāni ca |
47522 ante vairāyamāṇāni saṃgatāni khalaiḥ saha ||
47531 ādau darśayati natiṃ yāntī yāntī samunnatiṃ dhatte |
47532 anukūlāpi varāhī cireṇa tucchaṃ phalaṃ dhatte ||
47541 ādau dharme pramāṇaṃ vividhavidhibhidāśeṣatāṃ ca prayuktiṃ paurvāparyādhikārau tadanu bahuvidhaṃ cātideśaṃ tathoham |
47542 bādhaṃ tantraṃ prasaṅgaṃ nayamanayaśataiḥ samyagālocayadbhyo bhinnā mīmāṃsakebhyo vidadhati bhuvi ke sādaraṃ vedarakṣām ||
47551 ādau namaskṛtiḥ paścādāśaṃsāvacanāni ca |
47552 subhāṣitapraśaṃsā ca kavikāvyastutistataḥ ||
47561 ādau namrastatahstabdhaḥ kāryakāle ca niṣṭhuraḥ |
47562 kṛte kārye punarnamraḥ śiśnatulyo vaṇigjanaḥ ||
47571 ādau namrāḥ punarvakrāḥ svīyakāryeṣu tatparāḥ |
47572 kāryānte ca punarvakrāḥ kāṇvāstu prāṇaghātakāḥ ||
47581 ādau na vāpraṇayināṃ praṇayo vidheyo datto'thavā pratidinaṃ paripoṣaṇīyaḥ |
47582 utkṣipya yatkṣipati tatprakaroti lajjāṃ bhūmau sthitasya patanādbhayameva nāsti ||
47591 ādau necchati nojjhati smarakathāṃ vrīḍāvimiśrālasā madhye hrīparivarjitābhyuparame lajjāvinamrānanā |
47592 bhāvairnaikavidhaiḥ karotyabhinayaṃ bhūyaśca yā sādarā buddhvā puṃprakṛtiṃ yānucarati glānetaraiśceṣṭitaiḥ ||
47601 ādau patravicitritaḥ punarasau mugdhaprasūnāṅkitaḥ paścātsnigdhaphalodgame ghanarasaiḥ sikto mayā sarvataḥ |
47602 dānonmattadurantavāraṇakaṭīsaṃghaṭṭanaiḥ kevalaṃ so'yaṃ ghūrṇita eva daivavaśato mākandabhūmīruhaḥ ||
47611 ādau premakaṣāyitā haramukhavyāpāralolā śanairvrīḍābhāravidhūrṇitā mukulitā dhūmodgamavyājataḥ |
47612 patyuḥ saṃmilitā dṛśā sarabhasavyāvartanavyākulā pārvatyāḥ pariṇītimaṅgalavidhau dṛṣṭiḥ śivāyāstu vaḥ ||
47621 ādau budhyeta paṇitaḥ paṇamānaśca kāraṇam |
47622 tato vitarkyobhayato mataḥ śreyastato vrajet ||
47631 ādau majjanacīrahāratilakaṃ netrāñjanaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ nāsāmauktikamālatīvikaraṇaṃ jhaṃkārakaṃ nūpuram |
47632 aṅge candanacarcitaṃ maṇigaṇaḥ kṣudrāvalirghaṇṭikā tāmbūlaṃ karakaṅkaṇaṃ caturatā śṛṅgārakāḥ ṣoḍaśa ||
47641 ādau mātā guroḥ patnī brahmaṇī rājapatnikā |
47642 dhenurdhātrī tathā pṛthvī saptaitā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ ||
47651 ādau mānaparigraheṇa guruṇā dūraṃ samāropitā paścāttāpabhareṇa tānavakṛtā nītā paraṃ lāghavam |
47652 utsaṅgāntaravartināmanugamātsaṃpīḍitā gāmimāṃ sarvāṅgapraṇayapriyāmiva tarucchāyā samālambate ||
47661 ādau yādonivāsoktiḥ pārāvāravaroktayaḥ |
47662 kṣīranīranidheruktirnadyuktirjāhnavyuktayaḥ ||
47671 ādau raktaṃ punā raktaṃ madhya ujjvalabhāsvaram |
47672 durnirīkṣyaprabhāvaṃ taṃ dṛśyaṃ draṣṭāramāśraye ||
47681 ādau rājetyadhīrākṣi pārthivaḥ ko'pi gīyate |
47682 sanātanaśca naivāsau rājā nāpi sanātanaḥ ||
47691 ādau rūpavināśinī kṛśakarī kāmasya vidhvaṃsinī prajñāmāndyakarī tapaḥkṣayakarī dharmasya nirmūlinī |
47692 putrabhrātṛkalatrabhedanakarī lajjāṅkuracchedinī sā māṃ pīḍati sarvadoṣajananī prāṇāpahantrī kṣudhā ||
47701 ādau rūpavināśinī kṛśakarī kāmāṅkuracchedinī putrāmitrakalatrabhedanakarī garvāṅkuracchedinī |
47702 kāmaṃ mandakarī tapaḥkṣayakarī dharmasya nirmūlanī sā māṃ saṃprati sarvarogajananī prāṇāpahantrī kṣudhā ||
47711 ādau lajjayati kṛtaṃ madhye paribhavati riktamavasāne |
47712 khalasaṃgatasya kathayata yadi susthitamasti kiṃcidapi ||
47721 ādau varaṃ nirdhanatvaṃ dhanikatvamanantaram |
47722 tathādau pādagamanaṃ yānagatvamanantaram |
47723 sukhāya kalpate nityaṃ duḥkhāya viparītakam ||
47731 ādau vitatya caraṇau vinamayya kaṇṭhamutthāpya vaktramabhihatya muhuśca vatsāḥ |
47732 mātrā vivartitamukhaṃ mukhalihyamāna paścārdhasusthamanasaḥ stanamutpibanti ||
47741 ādau vismayanistaraṅgamanu ca preṅkholitaṃ sādhvasairvrīḍānamramatha kṣaṇaṃ pravikasattāraṃ didṛkṣārasaiḥ |
47742 ākṛṣṭaṃ sahajābhijātyakalanātpremṇā purahpreritaṃ cakṣurbhūri kathaṃkathaṃcidagamatpreyāṃsameṇīdṛśaḥ ||
47751 ādau veśyā punardāsī paścādbhavati kuṭṭinī |
47752 sarvopāyaparikṣīṇā vṛddhā nārī pativratā ||
47761 ādau hālāhalahutabhujā dattahastāvalambo bālye śaṃbhorniṭilamahasā baddhamaitrīnirūḍhaḥ |
47762 prauḍho rāhorapi mukhaviṣeṇāntaraṅgīkṛto yaḥ so'yaṃ candrastapati kiraṇairmāmiti prāptametam ||

48001 ādhārajanmabhūtāni hṛtkaṇṭhastālunāsike |

48091 ā dhūmādvinivartante suhṛdo bāndhavaiḥ saha |

48101 ādhoraṇāṅkuśabhayātkarikumbhayugmaṃ jātaṃ payodharayugaṃ hṛdaye'ṅganānām |

49741 ābaddhakṛtrimasaṭājaṭilāṃsabhittirāropito yadi padaṃ mṛgavairiṇaḥ śvā |

49811 ābālyaṃ patireṣa me jagadidaṃ jānāti tattvaṃ punarbhūmadhye samupāgatā tadapi te vikhyāyate yaḥ patiḥ |

49821 ā bālyaṃ bhavatā samīra katidhā sārdhaṃ mṛṇālīdalaṃ bhuktaṃ kelikathāmṛtairapi tathā nītaṃ rahaḥ sādaram |
49822 cittāndolanalālanairmṛgadṛśāṃ vakṣaḥsthalāsphālanairbhūyaḥ saprati māṃ vinā tava mano rantuṃ kathaṃ modate ||
49831 ā bālyādapi yo vidāritamadonmattebhakumbhasthalī sthālīmadhyakavoṣṇaraktarasavanmuktāpulākapriyaḥ |
49832 hastastasya kathaṃ prasarpatu puraḥ kṛcchre'pyavasthāntare gartāvartavivartamānaśaśakaprāṇāpahāre hareḥ ||
49841 ā bālyāddevabālāḥ suravarasadane kiṃnarīgīyamānaṃ yannāmākarṇya karṇe'maraguruvacanodgītagāthānibaddham |
49842 dānaudāryāḍhyaśauryādvayavimalaguṇaṃ sarvabhogaikasāraṃ bhartāraṃ kāmayantyo hariharagṛhiṇīpādamārādhayanti ||
49851 ābālyādhigamānmayaiva gamitaḥ koṭiṃ parāmunnaterasmatsaṃkathayaiva pārthivasutaḥ saṃpratyasau lajjate |
49852 itthaṃ khinna ivātmajena yaśasā dattāvalambo'mbudheryātastīratapovanāni bhavato vṛddho guṇānāṃ gaṇaḥ ||
49861 ābāhūdgatamaṇḍalāgrarucayaḥ saṃnaddhavakṣaḥsthalāḥ soṣmāṇo vraṇino vipakṣahṛdayapronmāthinaḥ karkaśāḥ |
49862 utsṛṣṭāmbaradṛṣṭavigrahabharā yasya smarāgresarā mārā māravadhūstanāśca na dadhuḥ kṣobhaṃ sa vo'vyājjinaḥ ||
49871 ābrahmakīṭāntamidaṃ nibaddhaṃ puṃstrīprayogena jagatsamastam |
49872 vrīḍātra kā yatra caturmukhatvamīśo'pi lobhādgamito yuvatyāḥ ||
49881 ābhaṅgurāgrabahuguṇa dīrghāsvādapradā priyādṛṣṭiḥ |
49882 karṣati mano madīyaṃ hradamīnaṃ baḍiśarajjuriva ||
49891 ābharaṇasyābharaṇaṃ prasādhanavidheḥ prasādhanaviśeṣaḥ |
49892 upamānasyāpi sakhe pratyupamānaṃ vapustasyāḥ ||
49901 ābhāti candrarahitā na kadāpi rātriścandro'pi rātrirahito gatakāntireva |
49902 kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yadanayoḥ pratimāsameko jāto nirantaratayā parirambhayogaḥ ||
49911 ābhāti dhūsarataraṃ timiraṃ purastādantaḥsphuradviralatārakabhārametat |
49912 dagdhuṃ viyogivipinaṃ sitaraśmivahnerdhūmo jvaliṣyata ivānugatasphuliṅgaḥ ||
49921 ābhāti bālikeyaṃ pāṇisparśena pulakitāvayavā |
49922 abhinavavasantasaṅgādāvirmukuleva bālacūtalatā ||
49931 ābhāti romarājiścaladalikulakomalā viśālākṣyāḥ |
49932 nābhīvivarāntargata madanānaladhūmalekheva ||
49941 ābhāti śobhātiśayaprapañcādeṇīdṛśo'syā ramaṇīyaśobhā |
49942 veṇī lasatkuntaladhoraṇīnāṃ śreṇīva kiṃ cāruharinmaṇīnām ||
49951 ābhātyetaddvicandraṃ viyadapi nikhilaṃ hantinastu tridantā gaṅgāpūraścaturdhā pravilasati lasatpañcadantaḥ karīndraḥ |
49952 ṣaḍvaktraḥ (saptavaktraḥ) pariṇamati tathā ṣaṅguṇāḥ saptasaṃkhyāḥ śaṅke tvatkīrtimūrtyā navamiva jagadālakṣyate kṣoṇipāla ||
49961 ābhicārikahomaistu mantraiḥ ṣaṭkarmasādhakaḥ |
49962 yantralekhanakairugrairupāṃśujapanādibhiḥ ||
49971 ābhimukhyadaśāmātrādādarśa iva sajjanaḥ |
49972 śīghraṃ raktamaraktaṃ vā gṛhṇāti svaprasādataḥ ||
49981 ābhīradārakamudañcitakiṃkiṇīkamātāmrapāṇicaraṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇam |
49982 mañjīramañjumaruṇādharamambujākṣamadvaitacinmayamanādimanantamīḍe ||
49991 ābhīranāryāḥ karamādadhāno  na śaṅkase mādhava kiṃ bravīṣi |
49992 pallīpatirballavavallabhāyāḥ  karagrahe kiṃ vidadhīta śaṅkām ||
50001 ābhīrādigiraḥ kāvyeṣvaprabhraṃśa iti smṛtāḥ |
50002 śāstreṣu saṃskṛtādanyadapabhraṃśatayoditam ||
50011 ābhugnāṅgulipallavau kacabhare vyāpārayantī karau  bandhotkarṣanibaddhamānasatayā śūnyāṃ dadhānā dṛśam |
50012 bāhūtkṣepasamunnate stanataṭeparyastacīnāṃśukā  hrīsaṅkocitabāhumūlasubhagaṃ badhnāti jūṭiṃ vadhūḥ ||
50021 ābhujyendradiśaṃ kuberakakubhaṃ svāśliṣya gāḍhaṃ karair ācumbyāmbujinīṃ samaṃ kumudinīmullāsya tāṃ dakṣiṇām |

50031 ābhogaḥ stanayormahatyatimahānmuktāsrajaṃ bhāsuro  māhātmyāvahitaprabhūtasumanobāṇo'pi te'ntaḥ sthitaḥ |
50032 bhālaṃ svacchavirocanaṃ balirasāvapyāsta evodare  romṇāṃ vikriyayā yuvatvabhavayā vindhyāvalī vartate ||
50041 ābhogabhūṣaṇavatī kucakumbhasaṃpad antarvikāramadhurāṇi vilokitāni |
50042 aṅgānyanaṅgapiśunāni kulāṅganānāṃ  dhīrātmanāmapi manaḥ paritāpayanti ||
50051 ābhogaścaikakhaṇḍaḥ syāddvitīyaṃ coccakhaṇḍakam |
50052 tulyanāmāṅkitaṃ caitaditi madhyamalakṣaṇam ||
50061 ābhoginaḥ kimapi samprati vāsarānte  saṃpannaśālikhalapallavitopaśalyāḥ |

50071 ābhoginetraparivartanavibhrameṇa  mūrtyā nitambavalanākulatāṃ vahantyā |

50142 aṅge cūtaprasavasurabhirdakṣiṇo māruto me  sāndrasparśaḥ karatala iva vyāpṛto mādhavena ||

50152 satataṃ śuciveṣaścetyetaddambhasya jīvitam ||

50171 āmantraṇā surabhiṇā marutā kṛtādau  dattaṃ phalaṃ ca purataḥ kaṭukaṇṭakākhyam |

50182 patyutsāhayutā nāryaḥ ahaṃ kṛṣṇa raṇotsavaḥ ||
50191 āmantrya tena deva tvāṃ tadvaiyarthyaṃ samarthaye |

50201 āmanthinīkalaśa eṣa sadugdhasindhur vetraṃ ca vāsukirayaṃ girireṣa manthaḥ |
50202 saṃpratyupoḍhamadamantharabāhudaṇḍa  kaṇḍūyanāvasara eva surāsurāṇām ||
50211 āmayārtiriputrāsa kṣudādau dṛṣṭavaikṛtān |
50212 labdhodayā hrībhayena kṣmāpā ghnantyanuyāyinaḥ ||
50221 ā maraṇādapi virutaṃ  kurvāṇāḥ spardhayā saha mayūraiḥ |

50231 āmardayati pāṇibhyāṃ kānte kamalakorake |

50251 āmarṣānmadanaḥ sadyo dīptaścetasi jāyate |

50261 āmāśayastho hatvāgniṃ sāmo mārgān pidhāpayan |
50262 vidadhāti jvaraṃ doṣastasmāllaṅghanamācaret ||
50271 āmīlannavanīlanīrajatulāmālambate locanaṃ  śaithilyaṃ navamallikāsahacarairaṅgairapi svīkṛtam |
50272 ālāpādadharaḥ sphuratkalayati preṅkhatpravālopamām  ānandaprabhavāśca bāṣpakaṇikā muktāśriyaṃ bibhrati ||

50282 mithunairmitho'vadhāritam  arcitamidameva kāmanirvahaṇam ||
50291 āmīlitālasavivartitatārakākṣīm  utkaṇṭhabandhanadaraślathabāhuvallīm |
50292 prasvedavārikaṇikācitagaṇḍabimbāṃ  saṃsmṛtya tāmaniśameti na śāntimantaḥ ||
50301 āmuktaṃ hṛdi mauktikaṃ mṛgadṛśāṃ bhillai radopyādade  luṇṭākaiḥ karaṭe'valuṇṭhi piśitaṃ raktaṃ na naktaṃcaraiḥ |
50302 he pārīndra karīndrakumbhadalane bhūto bhavānagraṇīḥ  anyatraiva phalopadhānamakhilaṃ haste yaśaste param ||
50311 āmuktapuṣpasurabhīkṛtakeśapāśā  muktālatāprahasitastanabhārakhinnāḥ |

50331 āmūlaṃ kvaciduddhṛtā kvacidapi cchinnā sthalī barhiṣām  ānamrā kusumoccayācca sadayākṛṣṭāgraśākhā latā |
50332 ete pūrvavilūnavalkalatayā rūḍhavraṇāḥ śākhinaḥ  sadyacchedamamī vahanti samidhāṃ prasyandinaḥ pādapāḥ ||
50341 āmūlakaṇṭakitakomalabāhunālam  ārdrāṅgulīdalamanaṅganidāghataptaḥ |
50342 asyāḥ kareṇa karamākalayāmi kāntam  āraktapaṅkajamiva dviradaḥ sarasyāḥ ||
50351 ā mūlato valitakuntalacārucūḍa  cūrṇālakaprakaralāñchitabhālabhāgaḥ |
50352 kakṣāniveśaniviḍīkṛtanīvireṣa  veṣaściraṃ jayati kuntalakāminīnām ||

50362 kurvantyaśokā hṛdayaṃ saśokaṃ  nirīkṣyamāṇā navayauvanānām ||
50371 āmūlāgraṃ sakalabhuvanaślāghyasaurabhyalīlā  khelaḥ kālāgarutaruvara kvāsti dhanyastvadanyaḥ |

50381 āmūlāgranibaddhakaṇṭakatanurnirgandhapuṣpodgamaś chāyā na śramahāriṇī na ca phalaṃ kṣutkṣāmasaṃtarpaṇam |
50382 burbūradruma sādhusaṅgarahitastattāvadāstāmaho  anyeṣāmapi śākhināṃ phalavatāṃ guptyai vṛtirjāyase ||
5038 1 ā mūlādratnasānormalayavalayitādā ca kūlātpayodher yāvantaḥ santi kāvyapraṇayanapaṭavaste viśaṅkaṃ vadantu |

50402 manorathāsaktiparasya cittaṃ  na jāyate vai paramārthasaṅgi ||
50411 āmṛdgantastama iva saraḥsīmni saṃbhūya paṅkaṃ  tārāsārthairiva patiśucā phenakaiḥ śliṣṭapādāḥ |
50412 bhrāntyādaṣṭasphuṭabisalatācuñcubhiścañcu cakraiś cakrā bandīkṛtavirahakṛccandralekhā ivaite ||
