50422 pakṣmotkṣepavyatikarahato yacca bāṣpastadete  bhāvāścaṇḍi truṭitahṛdayaṃ manyumāvadeyanti ||
50431 āmṛśadbhirabhito valivīcīr lolamānavitatāṅgulihastaiḥ
50432 subhruvāmanubhavātpratipede  muṣṭimeyamiti madhyamabhīṣṭaiḥ ||
50441 āmṛśya stanamaṇḍalaṃ pratimuhuḥ saṃcumbya gaṇḍasthalīṃ  grīvāṃ pratyavalambya saṃbhramabalairāhanyamānaḥ karaiḥ |
50442 suptasyādrinadīnikuñjagahane mattaḥ payodānilaiḥ  karṇānte maśakaḥ kimapyarivadhūsārthasya te jalpati ||
50451 āmerumalayamurvī  valayamalaṅkṛtya kīrtikarpūraiḥ |
50452 maṅgalamāpnuhi nityaṃ  guṇamaya jaya jīva yāvadādityam ||
5045 1 āmodaṃ kumudākareṣu vipadaṃ padmeṣu kālānalaṃ  pañceṣorviśikheṣu sāndraśiśirakṣāraṃ śaśigrāvasu |
5045 2 mlāniṃ mānavatīmukheṣu vinayaṃ cetaḥsu vāmabhruvāṃ  vṛddhiṃ vārdhiṣu nikṣipannudayate devastamīkāmukaḥ ||
50461 āmodavāsitacalādharapallaveṣu  nidrākaṣāyitavipāṭalalocaneṣu |
50462 vyāmṛṣṭapatratilakeṣu vilāsinīnāṃ  śobhāṃ babandha vadaneṣu madāvaśeṣaḥ ||
50471 āmodāhṛtabhṛṅgapakṣapavanapreṅkhadrajaḥpiñjare  padma śrīrvasatīti nādbhutamidaṃ ramyaṃ prakṛtyaiva tat |
50472 taccitraṃ yadarātikaṇṭharudhirapraklinnatīkṣṇasphurad dhāre'sau bhavataściraṃ nivasati strītve'pi hṛṣṭā satī ||
50481 āmodinā samadhunā paridhūsareṇa  savyākulabhramavatā patatā purastāt |
50482 āyāsitāsmi sakhi tena divāvasāne  mattena kiṃ praṇayinā na hi kesareṇa ||
50491 āmodīni sumedurāṇi ca mṛdusvādūni ca kṣmāruhām  udyāneṣu vaneṣu labdhajanuṣāṃ santītareṣāmapi |
50492 kiṃtu śrīphalatā tavaiva jayinī mālūra diṅmaṇḍale  yasyaitāni phalāni yauvanavatīvakṣojalakṣmīgṛhāḥ ||
50501 āmodena kadambakandalabhuvā limpannaśeṣaṃ nabhaḥ  prītisphītamayūravṛndanaṭanaprastāvanāpaṇḍitaḥ |
50502 ambhodaprathamodabinduracanānirmṛṣṭagharmaḥ śanair vāyurvāti bhayaṃkaraḥ pravasatāṃ meghaṃkarāḍambaraḥ ||
50511 āmodairmaruto mṛgāḥ kisalayollāsaistvacā tāpasāḥ  puṣpaiḥ ṣaṭcaraṇāḥ phalaiḥ śakunayo gharmārditāśchāyayā |
50512 skandhairgandhagajāstvayaiva vihitāḥ sarve kṛtārthāstatas tvaṃ viśvopakṛtikṣamo'si bhavatā bhagnāpado'nye drumāḥ ||
50521 āmodaiste diśi diśi gatairdūramākṛṣyamāṇāḥ  sākṣāllakṣmīṃ tava malayaja draṣṭumabhyāgatāḥ smaḥ |
50522 kiṃ paśyāmaḥ subhaga bhavataḥ krīḍati kroḍa eva  vyālastubhyaṃ bhavatu kuśalaṃ muñca naḥ sādhayāmaḥ ||
50531 āmnāyānāmāhāntyā vāggītīrītīḥ prītīrbhītīḥ |
50532 bhogo rogo modo moho dhyeye dhyecche deśe kṣeme ||
50541 āmnāyābhyasanānyaraṇyaruditaṃ kṛcchravratānyanvahaṃ  medaśchedapadāni pūrtavidhayaḥ sarve hutaṃ bhasmani |
50542 tīrthānāmavagāhanāni ca gajasnānaṃ vinā yatpada  dvandvāmbhoruhasaṃstutiṃ vijayate devaḥ sa nārāyaṇaḥ ||
50551 amnāye smṛtitantre ca lokācāre ca sūribhiḥ |
50552 śarīrārdhaṃ smṛtā jāyā puṇyāpuṇyaphale samā ||
50561 āmraṃ chittvā kuṭhāreṇa nimbaṃ paricarettu yaḥ |
50562 yaścainaṃ payasā siñcennaivāsya madhuro bhavet ||
50571 āmra yadyapi gatā divasāste  puṣpasaurabhaphalapracurā ye |
50572 hanta saṃprati tathāpi janānāṃ  chāyayaiva dalayasyatitāpam ||
50581 āmrāḥ kiṃ phalabhāranamraśiraso ramyāḥ kimūṣmacchidaḥ  sacchāyāḥ kadalīdrumāḥ surabhayaḥ kiṃ puṣpitāścampakāḥ |
50582 etāstā niravagrahograkarabhollīḍhārdharūḍhāḥ punaḥ  śamyo bhrāmyasi mūḍha nirmaruti kiṃ mithyaiva martuṃ marau ||
50591 āmrāṅkuro'yamaruṇa  śyāmalarucirasthinirgataḥ sutanu |
50592 navakamaṭhakarparapuṭān  mūrdhevordhvaṃ gataḥ sphurati ||
50601 āmrīmañjulamañjarīvaraśaraḥ satkiṃśukaṃ yaddhanur jyā yasyālikulaṃ kalaṅkarahitaṃ chatraṃ sitāṃśuḥ sitam |
50602 mattebho malayānilaḥ parabhṛto yadvandino lokajit so'yaṃ vo vitarītarītu vitanurbhadraṃ vasantānvitaḥ ||
50611 āmre pallavite sthitvā kokilā madhurasvaram |
50612 cukūja kāmināṃ cittamākarṣantīva dūtikā ||
50621 āmraiḥ kṣemaṃ bhallā  takairbhayaṃ pīlubhistathārogyam |
50622 khadiraśamībhyāṃ durbhi  kṣamarjunaiḥ śobhanā vṛṣṭiḥ ||
50631 āmlena tāmraśuddhiḥ syācchuddhiḥ kāṃsyasyabhasmanā |
50632 saṃśuddhī rajasā nāryāstaṭinyā vegataḥ śuciḥ ||
50641 āyaṃ paśyan vyayaṃ kuryātāyādalpataraṃ vyayam |
50642 āyābhāve vyayaṃ kurvan kubero'pi vinaśyati ||
50651 āyatāgrasitaraśminibaddhaṃ  lāñchanacchavimaṣīrasadigdham |
50652 candrakaitavamarutpaṭacakraṃ  krīḍayotsṛjati kiṃ smarabālaḥ ||
50661 āyatāṅgulirabhūdatiriktaḥ  subhruvāṃ kraśimaśālini madhye |
50662 śroṇiṣu priyakaraḥ pṛthulāsu  sparśamāpa sakalena talena ||
50671 āyatiṃ sarvakāryāṇāṃ tadātvaṃ ca vicārayet |
50672 atītānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ guṇadoṣau ca tattvataḥ ||
50681 āyatīmiva vidhvastāmājñāṃ pratihatāmiva |
50682 dīptāmiva diśaṃ kāle pūjāmapahatāmiva ||
50691 āyatyāṃ guṇadoṣajñastadātve kṣipraniścayaḥ |
50692 atīte kāryaśeṣajñaḥ śatrubhirnābhibhūyate ||
50701 āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca yatsyādāsvādapeśalam |
50702 tadeva tasya kurvīta na lokadviṣṭamācaret ||
50711 āyatyāṃ pratikārajñastadātve dṛḍhaniścayaḥ |
50712 atīte kāryaśeṣajño naro'rthairna prahīyate ||
50721 āyatyā ca jayedāśāmarthaṃ saṅgavivarjanāt |
50722 anityatvena ca snehaṃ kṣudhaṃ yogena paṇḍitaḥ ||
50731 āyadvāreṣu sarveṣu kuryādāptān parīkṣitān |
50732 ādadīta dhanaṃ taistu bhāsvānusrairivodakam ||
50741 āyavyayaṃ sadānuṣṇaṃ chedanaṃ saṃśayasya ca |
50742 aniśaṃ tasya ca jñānaṃ mantriṇāṃ trividhaṃ phalam ||
50751 āyavyaye'nnasaṃskāre gṛhopaskārarakṣaṇe |
50752 śauce'gnikārye saṃyojyāḥ rakṣā strīṇāmiyaṃ smṛtā ||
5075 1 āyavyayau yasya ca saṃvibhaktau  channaśca cāro nibhṛtaśca mantraḥ |
5075 2 na cāpriyaṃ mantriṣu yo bravīti  sā sāgarāntāṃ pṛthivīṃ praśāsti ||
50761 āyastā kalahaṃ pureva kurute na sraṃsane vāsaso  bhugnabhrūratikhaṇḍyamānamadharaṃ dhatte na keśagrahe |
50762 aṅgānyarpayati svayaṃ bhavati no vāmā haṭhāliṅgane  tanvyā śikṣita eṣa saṃprati punaḥ kopaprakāro'paraḥ ||
50771 āyasya tāvadapi karma karotu kaścit tenāpi mātaradhikaṃ kimihānubhāvyam |
50772 āste sukhaṃ ya iha bhāratavarṣasīmany āste sa kiṃcidita uttarato'pasṛtya ||
50781 āyasya turyabhāgena vyayakarma pravartayan |
50782 anyūnatailadīpo'pi ciraṃ bhadrāṇi paśyati ||
50791 āyāccaturthabhāgena vyayakarma pravartayet |
50792 prabhūtatailadīpo hi ciraṃ bhadrāṇi paśyati ||
50801 āyātaṃ māmaparicitayā velayā mandiraṃ te  coro daṇḍyastvamiti madhuraṃ vyāharantyā bhavatyā |
50802 mande dīpe madhulavamucāṃ mālayā mallikānāṃ  baddhaṃ ceto dṛḍhataramidaṃ bāhubandhacchalena ||
50811 āyātaṃ sakhi dayitaṃ cirātpravāsāt kṣāmāṅgaṃ tava virahānalena taptam |
50812 sadyo'muṃ nijamṛdulāṅgasaṅgadānāt saṃtṛptiṃ naya bhava saṃmukhī kimevam ||
50821 āyātaḥ kumudeśvaro vijayate sarveśvaro māruto  bhṛṅgaḥ sphūrjati bhairavo na nikaṭaṃ prāṇeśvaro muñcati |
50822 ete siddharasāḥ prasūnaviśikho vaidyo'navadyotsavo  mānavyādhirayaṃ kṛśodari kathaṃ tvaccetasi sthāsyati ||
50831 āyātaste samīpaṃ tava guṇavimalān paṇḍito vādakartā  kāvye bhavye hi revābhavavigatarase rugyuge rogahartā |
50832 nāhaṃ jāne cikitsāṃ sakalaguṇanidhe durdaridratvaroge  śrīmadrājārjunendraprabalamapi yate kalpitā sā cikitsā ||
50841 āyātāḥ sakhi varṣā  varṣādapi yāsu vāsaro dīrghaḥ |
50842 diśi diśi nīrataraṅgo  nīrataraṅgo mamāpi hṛdayeśaḥ ||
50851 āyātā jaladāvalī sarabhasaṃ vidyutsamāliṅgitā  śailānāṃ paritaḥ saśabdamahibhukśreṇī narīnṛtyati |
50852 evaṃ satyapi hanta saṃprati patirdeśāntaraṃ prasthitas tadduḥkhaṃ vinivedyatāṃ sakhi kathaṃ kasyādhunāgre mayā ||
50861 āyātā madhuyāminī yadi punarnāyāta eva prabhuḥ  prāṇā yāntu vibhāvasau yadi punarjanmagrahaṃ prārthaye |
50862 vyādhaḥ kokilabandhane vidhuparidhvaṃse ca rāhugrahaḥ  kandarpe haranetradīdhitirahaṃ prāṇeśvare manmathaḥ ||
50871 āyātā madhurajanī  madhurajanīgītihṛdyeyam |
50872 aṅkuritaḥ smaraviṭapī  smara viṭa pīnastanīmabalām ||
50881 āyātā rajanī bhaviṣyati mahāviśleṣadāvānalo  nodvegaḥ sahasā kṛśāṅgi manasā kāryo rathāṅgāhvayaḥ |
50882 itthaṃ bāṣpaniruddhagadgadatayā saṃbhāṣya kokīṃ ciraṃ  cintāpūrṇamanā vinodavimukho haṃho vidhiṃ nindati ||
50891 āyātā ratināyakasya vipinaṃ śrīrādhikābhyāgato  daivādeva hariśca tatra caturaśceṭo'pi tatrāgamat |
50892 śīghraṃ parvatakandarodaragataṃ lāsyaṃ śikhīnāṃ puraḥ  paṃśyāmīti hariṃ nigadya śanakairgehaṃ samabhyāgamat ||
50901 āyātāsi vimuñca vepathubharaṃ dṛṣṭāsi kiṃ kenacin  nīlaṃ colamamuṃ vimuñca haratu svedaṃ niśīthānilaḥ |
50902 ityantarbhayasannakaṇṭhamasakṛdyāmīti talpātithir trasyantī parirabhyate sukṛtinā svairaṃ navasvairiṇī ||
50911 āyāti phullakusumaḥ kusumāgamo'yam  eṣā śaśāṅkatilakā śaradāgateti |
50912 bāḍhaṃ prahṛṣyati jano na punarmamaitad āyuḥprahīṇamiti yāti manoviṣādam ||
50921 āyāti yāti khedaṃ  karoti madhu harati madhukarīvānyā |
50922 adhidevatā tvameva  śrīriva kamalasya mama manasaḥ ||
50931 āyāti yāti punareva jalaṃ prayāti  padmāṅkurāṇi vidhunoti dhunoti pakṣau |
50932 unmattavadbhramati kūjati mandamandaṃ  kāntāviyogavidhuro niśi cakravākaḥ ||
50941 āyāti śriyamañjasā nayanayorambhoruhapreyasī  saṃnāhaḥ stanayorayaṃ kalayate saṃbhogayogyāṃ daśām |
50942 vaidagdhyena sahāsikāṃ vitanute vācāmiyaṃ prakriyā  mugdhāyāḥ punaraindavīṃ na sahate mukhyāmabhikhyāṃ mukham ||
50951 āyāti skhalitaiḥ pādairmukhavaivarṇyasaṃyutaḥ |
50952 lalāṭasvedabhāgbhūrigadgadaṃ bhāṣate vacaḥ ||
50961 kampamānamadho'vekṣī pāpaṃ prāptaḥ sadā naraḥ |
50962 tasmādyatnātparijñeyaścihnairetairvicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
50971 āyāti hṛṣṭo'bhimukho yadi śvā  krīḍāṃ prakurvan viluthaṃstathāgre |
50972 śīghraṃ tadānīṃ dhruvamadhvagānāṃ  bhavetprabhūto dhanadhānyalābhaḥ ||
50981 āyātu yātu khedaṃ  karotu madhu haratu cāpyanyā |
50982 adhidevatā tvameva  śrīriva kamalasya mama manasaḥ ||
50991 āyāte ca tirohito yadi punardṛṣṭo'nyakārye rato  vāci smeramukho viṣaṇṇavadanaḥ svakleśavāde muhuḥ |
50992 antarveśmani vāsamicchati bhṛśaṃ vyādhīti yo bhāṣate  bhṛtyānāmaparādhakīrtanaparastanmandiraṃ na vrajet ||
51001 āyāte dayite manorathaśatairnītvā kathaṃciddinaṃ  gatvā vāsagṛhaṃ jaḍe parijane dīrghāṃ kathāṃ kurvati |
51002 daṣṭāsmītyabhidhāya satvarapadaṃ vyādhūya cīnāṃśukaṃ  tanvaṅgyā ratikātareṇa manasā nītaḥ pradīpaḥ śamam ||
51011 āyāte dayite marusthalabhuvāmullaṅghya durlaṅghyatāṃ  gehinyā paritoṣabāṣpataralāmāsajya dṛṣṭiṃ mukhe |
51012 datvā pīluśamīkarīrakavalān svenāñcalenādarād āmṛṣṭaṃ karabhasya keśarasaṭābhārābalagnaṃ rajaḥ ||
51021 āyāte rabhasādyadi priyatame pratyudgatā no ciraṃ  no vā maṇḍalitonnatastanataṭaṃ gāḍhaṃ samāliṅgitaḥ |
51022 āśliṣya svabhujāvalambamathavā premārdrayā no girā  saṃbhāvyābhihito hatāsi sarale svaireva duśceṣṭitaiḥ ||
51031 āyāte'rthini gotrabhidyabhimate karṇo'mucatkuṇḍalaṃ  kāmāstraṃ kila bhūrilocanayugaṃ tasmin samāsajjatām |
51032 nanvetatkurunāyakasya hṛdayaṃ tasmātsamādhīyatāṃ  saṃbhūtastapaso'tra yo ratiraso māpārthato hīyatām ||
51041 āyāte śrutigocaraṃ priyatamaprasthānakāle puras talpāntaḥsthitayā tadānanamalaṃ dṛṣṭvā ciraṃ mugdhayā |
51042 socchvāsaṃ dṛḍhamanyunirbharagaladbāṣpāmbudhautaṃ tayā  svaṃ vaktraṃ viniveśya bhartṛhṛdaye niḥśabdakaṃ rudyate ||
51051 āyātaiva niśā niśāpatikaraiḥ kīrṇaṃ diśāmantaraṃ  bhāminyo bhavaneṣu bhūṣaṇagaṇairaṅgānyalaṃkurvate |
51052 mugdhe mānamapākaroṣi na manāgadyāpi roṣeṇa te  hā hā bālamṛṇālato'pyatitarāṃ tanvī tanustāmyati ||
51061 āyātaiva niśā mano mṛgadṛśāmunnidramātanvatī  māno me kathameṣa saṃprati nirātaṅkaṃ hṛdi sthāsyati |
51062 ūhāpohamimaṃ sarojanayanā yāvadvidhattetarāṃ  tāvatkāmanṛpātapatrasuṣamaṃ bimbaṃ babhāse vidhoḥ ||
51071 āyāto dayitastaveti sahasā na śraddadhe bhāṣitaṃ  sadyaḥ saṃmukhatāṃ gate'pi sumukhī bhrāntiṃ nijāṃ manyate |
51072 kaṇṭhāśleṣibhuje'pi śūnyahṛdayā svapnāntaraṃ śaṅkate  pratyāvṛttimiyaṃ priyasya kiyatā pratyetu śātodarī ||
51081 āyāto bhavataḥ piteti sahasā māturniśamyoditaṃ  dhūlīdhūsarito vihāya śiśubhiḥ krīḍārasān prastutān |
51082 dūrātsmeramukhaḥ prasārya lalitaṃ bāhudvayaṃ bālako  nādhanyasya puraḥ sameti parayā prītyā raṭadghargharam ||
51091 āyāto vanamālī  gṛhapatirāli samāyātaḥ |
51092 smara sakhi pāṇinisūtraṃ  vipratiṣedhe paraṃ kāryam ||
51101 āyāttribhāgataḥ kuryādvyayaṃ dharmaparo naraḥ |
51102 etadeva hi pāṇḍityaṃ yadāyādalpako vyayaḥ ||
51111 āyāntaṃ guṇinaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣyedādriyeta ca |
51112 guṇino hyādṛtā bhūyaśceṣṭante tasya saṃpade ||
51121 āyāntaṃ svapatiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhakṣayantī sadākhilam |
51122 parityaktā nijaiḥ putrairbāndhavaiḥ svajanaistathā ||
51131 āyāntamālokya hariṃ pratolyām  ālyāḥ purastādanurāgamekā |
51132 romāñcakampādibhirucyamānaṃ  bhāmā jugūha praṇamantyathainam ||
51141 āyānti tvaritaṃ gabhīrasaritāṃ kūleṣu bhūmīruhāṃ  mūleṣu vyathitā nidāghapathikāḥ kṛtyaṃ tadeṣāṃ param |
51142 yatpuṣpairadhivāsanaṃ nibiḍayā yacchāyayā pālanaṃ  yanmandairupavījanaṃ ca pavanaiḥ kṛtyaṃ tadurvīruhām ||
51151 āyānti yatra nivasanti cirāya ceṣṭaṃ  niryānti caivamamitāḥ sarito yato'mī |
51152 devairhṛteṣu bahuleṣu maṇiṣvapībhyo  yaḥ pūrvavatsa jayatādamṛtaikabhūmiḥ ||
51161 āyānti yānti satataṃ  nīraṃ śiśiraṃ kharaṃ na gaṇayanti |
51162 vidmo na hanta divasāḥ  kasya kimete kariṣyanti ||
51171 āyāntyagre nanu tanubhavā uttamarṇā iveme  śayyālagnāḥ phaṇabhṛta ivābhānti dārā idānīm |
51172 kārāgehapratimamadhunā mandiraṃ dṛśyate me  tatra sthātuṃ prasajati mano na kṣaṇaṃ na kṣaṇārdham ||
51181 āyāntyāṃ nijayuvatau vanātsaśaṅkaṃ  barhāṇāmaparaśikhaṇḍinīṃ bhareṇa |
51182 ālokya vyavadadhataṃ puro mayūraṃ  kāminyaḥ śradadhuranārjavaṃ nareṣu ||
51191 āyāntyā divasaśriyaḥ padatalasparśānubhāvādiva  vyomāśokatarornavīnakalikāgucchaḥ samujjṛmbhate |
51192 ātanvannavataṃsavibhramamasāvāśākuraṅgīdṛśām  unmīlattaruṇaprabhākarakarastomaḥ samudbhāsate ||
51201 āyāminostadakṣṇor añjanarekhāvidhiṃ vitanvantyāḥ |
51202 pāṇiḥ prasādhikāyāḥ  prāpadapāṅgaṃ cireṇa viśramya ||
51211 āyāsaḥ parahiṃsā  vaitaṃsikasārameya tava sāraḥ |
51212 tvāmapasārya vibhājyaḥ  kuraṅga eṣo'dhunaivānyaiḥ ||
51221 āyāsaśatalabhyasya prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasaḥ |
51222 gatirekaiva vittasya dānaṃ śeṣā vipattayaḥ ||
51231 āyāsaśokabhayaduḥkhamupaiti martyo  mānena sarvajananinditaveṣarūpaḥ |
51232 vidyādayādamayamādiguṇāṃśca hanti  jñātveti garvavaśameti na śuddhabuddhiḥ ||
51241 āyāsaślathabāhuvalliradhikasmerai . .  lolāpāṅgakapolapāliralikastomārdhaluptālakā |
51242 nyasyantī madayatyanāvṛta iva pracchādanāyāñcalaṃ  mugdhā svedanipītasūkṣmasicayavyaktastanī vakṣasi ||
51251 āyāsādalaghutarastanaiḥ svanadbhiḥ  śrāntānāmavikacalocanāravindaiḥ |
51252 abhyambhaḥ kathamapi yoṣitāṃ samūhais tairurvīnihitacalatpadaṃ pracele ||
51261 āyāsānavicintayannagaṇayallābhaṃ tataḥ kiṃcidapy ambho muñcati kīrtimātraśaraṇo dhārādharaḥ sarvataḥ |
51262 tadyatnādupayujya vardhayatu vā dāturyaśaḥ śāśvataṃ  mauḍhyādetadupekṣya nāśayatu vā lokaḥ pramāṇaṃ tataḥ ||
51271 āyāsya bahubhirdugdhāṃ pītāṃ vatsena sadgavīm |
51272 suśikṣito'pi gopālaḥ prayatnena duhīta kim ||
51281 āyāsyasi kadā kānte madantakamayi prabhe |
51282 iti prṣṭenduvadanācchādayadvāsasā mukham ||
51291 āyāsyasyavadhāvaparyavasite gatveti saṃbhāvyate  saṃprāpte tvayi yāni tānyapi sukhānyadyāparokṣāṇi naḥ |
51292 kiṃtvajñātaviyogavedanamidaṃ sadyastvayi prasthite  cetaḥ kiṃ nu karīṣyatītyaviditaṃ samyaṅna niścīyate ||

52172 pratikartumivordhvakaraḥ  sthitaḥ purastānniśānāthaḥ ||
52181 āruhyākrīdaśailasya candrakāntasthalīmimām |
52182 nṛtyatyeṣa lasaccārucandrakāntaḥ śikhāvalaḥ ||
52191 ārūḍhaḥ patita iti svasaṃbhavo'pi  svacchānāṃ pariharaṇīyatāmupaiti |
52192 karṇebhyaścyutamasitotpalaṃ vadhūnāṃ  vīcībhistaṭamanu yannirāsurāpaḥ ||
52201 ārūḍhakṣitipālabhālavigalatsvedāmbusekoddhatā  bherījhāṃkṛticāpaṭaṃkṛticamatkārollasanmānasā |
52202 kṣubhyatkṣoṇitalaṃsphuratkhurapuṭaṃ cañcaccalatkeśaraṃ  mandabhrāntavilocana pratidiśaṃ nṛtyanti vājivrajāḥ ||
52211 ārūḍhaveṇutaruṇādharavibhrameṇa  mādhuryaśālivadanāmbujamudvahantī |
52212 ālokyatāṃ kimanayā vanadevatā vaḥ  kaiśorake vayasi kāpi ca kāntiyaṣṭiḥ ||
52221 ārūḍhasya citāṃ kṛtānumaraṇodyogapriyāliṅganaṃ  puṇḍrekṣudravapānamulbaṇamahāmohapraluptasmṛte ḥ |
52222 vītāsoravataṃsamālyavalayāmodaśca yādṛgbhaved bhāvānāṃ subhagaḥ svabhāvamahimā niścetasastādṛśaḥ ||
52231 ārūḍhasvāmiko'śvaḥ syādvittacintitasiddhaye |
52232 sarveṣāṃ suratakrīḍā dṛṣṭādau bhogalabdhaye ||
52241 ārūḍhāntarayauvanasya parito goṣṭhīranubhrāmyatas tattattāsu manogataṃ sunibhṛtaṃ saṃvyācikīrṣorhareḥ |
52242 vegāducchalitāsphuṭākṣaradaśāgarbhāstrapāgauravāt pratyañco valitā bhavantu bhavatāṃ kṛtyāya vāgūrmayaḥ ||
52251 ārūḍho malayāniladvipavaraṃ yukto vilāsānugaiḥ  pītaḥ puṣpavilocanairnavalatāpaurāṅganānāṃ gaṇaiḥ |
52252 abhrāmyadvanapattane madhumahīpālaḥ sphuratkokilā  līlālāpamiladbhramadbhramarikājhāṃkārabherīravaiḥ ||
52261 ārūḍho vāsayaṣṭiṃ gṛhavalabhitale duṣṭamārjārakeṇa  krūrāsyaṃ grasyamānaḥ sakṛdapi śanakairyadvicukrośa kīraḥ |
52262 gaṅgeti svāminīṃ svāmayamamarapaterlabdhavānāsanārdhaṃ  yastu traisrotasāmbhaḥ spṛśati mṛśati vā tatkathāṃ ke vidantu ||
52271 ārogyaṃ ciramaśvinī narapate toṣaṃ śivaḥ keśavaḥ  kalyāṇaṃ tava sarvadā śaśiravī proddīpanaṃ devatāḥ |
52272 brahmādyāḥ sakalāḥ subhadramavanaṃ gauryādayo mātaraḥ  kurvāte kurute karoti kurutaḥ kurvanti kurvantu ca ||
52281 ārogyaṃ paramānandaḥ sukhamutsāha eva ca |
52282 aiśvaryaṃ priyasaṃbhogaṃ vinā sarvaṃ nirarthakam ||
52291 ārogyaṃ bhāskarādicchecśriyamicchedhutāśanāt |
52292 jñānaṃ maheśvarādicchenmokṣamicchejjanārdanāt ||
52301 ārogyaṃ bhāskarādiccheddhanamicchedhutāśanāt |
52302 maheśvarājjñānamicchenmuktimicchejjanārdanāt ||
52311 ārogyaṃ vidvattā  sajjanamaitrī mahākule janma |
52312 svādhīnatā ca puṃsāṃ  mahadaiśvaryaṃ vināpyarthaiḥ ||
52321 ārogyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ  dhanāḍhyatā nāyakatvamānandaḥ |
52322 kṛtapuṇyasya syādiha  sadā jayo vāñchitāvāptiḥ ||
52331 ārogyabuddhivinayodyamaśāstrarāgāḥ  pañcāntarāḥ paṭhanasiddhiguṇā bhavanti |
52332 ācāryapustakanivāsasahāyakarṇā  bāhyāstu pañca paṭhanaṃ parivardhayanti ||
52341 ārogyamānṛṇyamavipravāsaḥ  sadbhirmanuṣyaiḥ saha saṃprayogaḥ |
52342 svapratyayā vṛttirabhītavāsaḥ  ṣaḍjīvalokasya sukhāni rājan ||
52351 ārogyalakṣmīrupayāti pitta  jvarāturaṃ reṇukaṣāyabhājam |
52352 mā tvaṃ yathā ratnakale smarārtā  kṛtaprakopapraśamā sakhībhiḥ ||
52361 āroḍhuṃ varamaupavāhyamapahartuṃ sundarī kanyakā  bhoktuṃ bhogamupasthitaṃ sukhamalaṃkartuṃ ca ratnaistanum |
52362 sannahyantyamṛtāndhaso hi śamite yenaiva hālāhale  sa svāmī mama daivataṃ taditaro nāmnāpi na mnāyate ||
52371 āropayasi mudhā kiṃ  nāhamabhijñā kila tvadaṅkasya |
52372 divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ  sthitveti na yuktamabhidhātum ||
52381 āropitaḥ pṛthunitambataṭe taruṇyā  kaṇṭhe ca bāhulatayā niviḍaṃ gṛhītaḥ |
52382 uttuṅgapīnakucanirbharapīḍito'yaṃ  kumbhaḥ karīṣadahanasya phalāni bhuṅkte ||
52391 āropitā api prājyā guṇā lokeṣu pūjitaiḥ |
52392 pūjayantīha dṛṣṭāntaḥ pratimā dyuḥsadāṃ nanu ||
52401 āropitā śilāyām  aśmeva tvaṃ bhaveti mantreṇa |
52402 magnāpi pariṇayāpadi  jāramukhaṃ vīkṣya hasitaiva ||
52411 āropyate'śmā śailāgraṃ yathā yatnena bhūyasā |
52412 nipātyate sukhenādhastathātmā guṇadoṣayoḥ ||
52421 ārohaṇaṃ govṛṣakuñjarāṇāṃ  prāsādaśailāgravanaspatīnām |
52422 viṣṭhānulepo rudhiraṃ mṛtaṃ ca  svapneṣvagamyāgamanaṃ ca dhanyam ||
52431 ārohaṇāya tava sajja ivāsti tatra  sopānaśobhivapuraśmavalicchaṭābhiḥ |
52432 bhogīndraveṣṭaśataghṛṣṭikṛtābhirabdhi  kṣubdhācalaḥ kanakaketakagotragātri ||
52441 ārohatu giriśikharaṃ  samudramullaṅghya yātu pātālam |
52442 vidhilikhitākṣaramālaṃ  phalati kapālaṃ na bhūpālaḥ ||
52451 ārohatyavanīruhaḥ praviśati śvabhraṃ nagaiḥ spardhate  khaṃ vyāledhi viceṣṭate kṣititale kuñjodare līya |
52452 antarbhrāmyati koṭarasya virasatyālambate vīrudhaḥ  kiṃ tadyanna karoti mārutavaśaṃ yātahkṛśānurvane ||
52461 ārohanti sukhāsanānyapaṭavo nāgān hayāṃstajjuṣas tāmbūlādyupabhuñjate naṭaviṭāḥ khādanti hastyādayaḥ |
52462 prāsāde caṭakādayo'pi nivasantyete na pātraṃ stuteḥ  sa stutyo bhuvane prayacchati kṛtī lokāya yahkāmitām ||
52471 ārohavallībhirivāmbudhārā  rājībhirābhūmivilambinībhiḥ |
52472 saṃlakṣyate vyoma vaṭadrumābham  ambhodharaśyāmadalaprakāśam ||
52481 ārjavaṃ cānṛśaṃsyaṃ ca damaścendriyanigrahaḥ |
52482 eṣa sādhāraṇo dharmaścāturvarṇye'bravīnmanuḥ ||
52491 ārjavaṃ pratipadyasva putreṣu satataṃ vibho |
52492 iha kīrtiṃ parāṃ prāpya pretya svargamavāpsyasi ||
52501 ārjavatvaṃ caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ dharmameva hi |
52502 madhuratvaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ ṣaṣṭhameva varānane ||
52511 ārjavamamalakarāṇāṃ  vinayo vararatnamukuṭānām |
52512 dyūtaṃ durvyasanānāṃ  strījitatā marutaṭīpiśācānām ||
52521 ārjavena dhṛtā dīkṣā yā no daivaṃ paraṃ prati |
52522 atyantamānuṣīyābhyaḥ pīḍābhyastadvimocanam ||
52531 ārjavena naraṃ yuktamārjavātsavypatrapam |
52532 aśaktimantaṃ manyanto dharṣayanti kubuddhayaḥ ||
52541 ārtatrāṇaparāyaṇena kariṇā dāhādimūleti yad vākyaṃ cakradhareṇa nakramukhato hākārarorīkṛtam |
52542 yaḥ stambhe karatāḍanadhvanirabhūtkarṇe surasyāpyaho  hā kṛṣṇeti yadakṣayaṃ sa bhagavān pāyādapāyājjagat ||
52551 ārtaduḥkhyaparitrāṇadurgatādi yathākramam |
52552 pātramāhurdayālūnāmalābhe guṇavāniti ||
52561 ārtadrutasvarajñā  vibhinnadīnaprabhinnalaghuraudrāḥ |
52562 nindyāḥ śubhāstu śabdāḥ  pramuditaparipūrṇadṛḍhaśāntāḥ ||
52571 ārtasya me praṇamato jagadantarātman  paśyanna paśyasi vibho na śṛṇoṣi śṛṇvan |
52572 durdaivakumbhajanuṣā nanu sāṃprataṃ me  pītastadīyakaruṇāvaruṇālayo'pi ||
52581 ārtā devānnamasyanti tapaḥ kurvanti rogiṇaḥ |
52582 nirdhanā dānamicchanti vṛddhā nārī pativratā ||
52591 ārtānāmārtisaṃbandhaṃ prītiviśrāmakāraṇam |
52592 kena ratnamidaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ mitramityakṣaradvayam ||
52601 ārtānāmiha jantūnāmārticchedaṃ karoti yaḥ |
52602 śaṅkhacakragadāhīno dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||
52611 ārtārte mudite hṛṣṭā proṣite malinā kṛśā |
52612 mṛte mriyeta yā patyau sā strī jñeyā pativratā ||
52621 ārteṣu dīyate dānaṃ śūnyaliṅgasya pūjanam |
52622 anāthapretasaṃskāramaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||
52631 ārteṣu vipreṣu dayānvitaśca  yacchraddhayā svalpamupaiti dānam |
52632 anantapāraṃ samupaiti rājan  yaddīyate tanna labheddvijebhyaḥ ||
52641 ārto matsadṛśo nānyastvatto nānyaḥ kṛpāparaḥ |
52642 tulya evāvayoryogaḥ kathaṃ nātha na pāsi mām ||
52651 ārto vā yadi vā trastaḥ pareṣāṃ śaraṇāgataḥ |
52652 ariḥ prāṇān parityajya rakṣitavyaḥ kṛtātmanā ||
52661 ārdrakīkasamukhaḥ purataśced dṛśyate bhavati tacchubhadaḥ śvā |
52662 carma śuṣkamathavāsthi viśuṣkaṃ  bibhradeṣa maraṇaṃ vidadhāti ||
52671 ārdramapi stanajaghanān  nirasya sutanu tvayaitadunmuktam |
52672 khasthamavāptumiva tvāṃ  tapanāṃśūnaṃśukaṃ pibati ||
52681 ārdrāṃ kaṇṭhe mukhābjasrajamavanamayatyambikā jānulambāṃ  sthāne kṛtvendulekhāṃ nibiḍayati jaṭāḥ pannagendreṇa nandī |
52682 kālaḥ kṛttiṃ nibadhnātyupanayati kare kālarātriḥ kapālaṃ  śaṃbhornṛtyāvatāre pariṣaditi pṛthagvyāpṛtā vaḥ punātu ||
52691 ārdrālaktakamasyāś caraṇaṃ mukhamārutena vījayitum |
52692 pratipannaḥ prathamataraḥ  saṃprati sevāvakāśo me ||
52701 āryakarmaṇi rajyante bhūtikarmāṇi kurvate |
52702 hitaṃ ca nābhyasūyanti paṇḍitā bharatarṣabha ||
52711 āryajananinditānāṃ  pāpaikarasaprakāśanārīṇām |
52712 etāvāneva guṇo  yadabhīṣṭasamāgamo nirāvaraṇaḥ ||
52721 āryajuṣṭamidaṃ vṛttamiti vijñāya śāśvatam |
52722 santaḥ parārthaṃ kurvāṇā nāvekṣante pratikriyām ||
52731 āryatā puruṣajñānaṃ śauryaṃ karuṇaveditā |
52732 sthaulalakṣyaṃ ca satatamudāsīnaguṇodayaḥ ||
52741 āryatvaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ dharmameva hi |
52742 ṣaṣṭhaṃ satītvaṃ dṛḍhatā saptamaṃ sāhaso'ṣṭamam ||
52751 āryadeśakularūpabalāyur buddhibandhuramavāpya naratvam |
52752 dharmakarma na karoti jaḍo yaḥ  potamujjhati payodhigataḥ saḥ ||
52761 āryaputra pitā mātā bhrātā putrastathā snuṣā |
52762 svāni puṇyāni bhuñjānāḥ svaṃ svaṃ bhāgyamupāsate ||
52763 bharturbhāgyaṃ tu bhāryaikā prāpnoti puruṣarṣabha ||
52771 āryānaṅga mahāvrataṃ vidadhatā vindhyānilaiḥ pāraṇāṃ  kṛtvā sāṅgamakāri kena muralākūle kaṭhoraṃ tapaḥ |
52772 yenāsyā ratikhedameduramṛduśvāsādhivāsaspṛśaḥ  pīyante'dharasīdhavo vihasitajyotsnopadaṃśaṃ rahaḥ ||
52781 āryā mukhe tu capalā  tathāpi caryā na me yataḥ sā tu |
52782 dakṣā gṛhakṛtyeṣu ta  thā duḥkhe bhavati duḥkhārtā ||
52791 ārye karmaṇi yuñjānaḥ pāpe vā punarīśvaraḥ |
52792 vyāpya bhūtāni carate na cāyamiti lakṣyate ||
52801 āryeṇa sukaraṃ hyāhuryāryakarma dhanaṃjaya |
52802 anāryakarma tvāryeṇa suduṣkarataraṃ bhuvi ||
52811 ālakṣya dantamukulānanimittahāsair avyaktavarṇaramaṇīyavacaḥ pravṛttīn |
52812 aṅkāśrayapraṇayinastanayān vahanto  dhanyāstadaṅgarajasā malinībhavanti ||
52821 ā laṅkānāthanārīstanataralapayovīcimudrātsamudrād ā svargaṅgātaraṅgāvaliviralaśilādustarāduttarādreḥ |
52822 ā prākśailāsurastrīsuratagativido magnabhāsvanmṛgāṅkād ā ca prācetasābdherbhavatu mama puraḥ ko'pi yadyasti vīraḥ ||
52831 ālapati pikavadhūriva  paśyati hariṇīva calati haṃsīva |
52832 sphurati taḍillatikeva  svadate tuhināṃśulekheva ||
52841 ālapa yathā yathecchasi  yuktaṃ tava kitava kimapavārayasi |
52842 strījātilāñchanamasau  jīvitaraṅkā sakhī subhaga ||
52851 ālambihemaraśanāhstanasaktahārāḥ  kandarpadarpaśithilīkṛtagātrayaṣṭyaḥ |
52852 māse madhau madhurakokilabhṛṅganādair nāryo haranti hṛdayaṃ prasabhaṃ narāṇām ||
52861 ālambe jagadālambe herambacaraṇāmbuje |
52862 śuṣyanti yadrajaḥ sparśātsadyaḥ pratyūhavārdhayaḥ ||
52871 ālambyāṅgaṇavāṭikāparisare svecchānatāṃ śākhikāṃ  keyūrībhavadalpaśeṣavalayā bālā samastaṃ dinam |
52872 sā daivopahṛtasya mūḍhamanaso bhagnāvadheradya me  panthānaṃ vivṛtāśruṇā vadanakenālokya kiṃ vakṣyati ||
52881 ālambhyāṅgaṇavāpikāparisare cūtadrume mañjarīṃ  sarpatsāndraparāgalampaṭaraṇadbhṛṅgāṅganāśobhinīm |
52882 manye svāṃ tanumuttarīyaśakalenācchādya bālā sphurat kaṇṭhadhvānanirodhakampitakucaśvāsodgamā roditi ||
52891 ālavāle sthitaṃ toyaṃ śoṣaṃ na bhajate yadā |
52892 ajīrṇaṃ tadvijānīyānna deyaṃ tādṛśe jalam ||
52901 ālasyaṃ kuru pāpakarmaṇi bhava krūraḥ krudhastāḍane  naiṣṭhuryaṃ bhaja lobhamohaviṣaye nidrāṃ samādhau hareḥ |
52902 jāḍyaṃ gaccha parāpavādakathane drohaṃ vidhehi smare  doṣā eva guṇatvamevamakhilā yāsyanti cetastava ||
52911 ālasyaṃ prathamaṃ paścādvyādhipīḍā prajāyate |
52912 pramādaḥ saṃśayasthāne cittasyehānavasthitiḥ ||
52921 ālasyaṃ madamohau ca cāpalaṃ goṣṭhireva ca |
52922 stabdhatā cābhimānitvaṃ tathātyāgitvameva ca |
52923 ete vai sapta doṣāstu sadā vidyārthināṃ matāḥ ||
52931 ālasyaṃ yadi na bhavejjagatyanarthaḥ  ko na syādbahudhanako bahuśruto vā |
52932 ālasyādiyamavaniḥ sasāgarāntā  saṃpūrṇā narapaśubhiśca nirdhanaiśca ||
52941 ālasyaṃ strīsevā  sarogatā janmabhūmivātsalyam |
52942 saṃtoṣo bhīrutvaṃ  ṣaḍvyāghātā mahattvasya ||
52951 ālasyaṃ sthiratāmupaiti bhajate cāpalyamudyogitāṃ  mūkatvaṃ mitabhāṣitāṃ vitanute maugdhyaṃ bhavedārjavam |
52952 pātrāpātravicārabhāvaviraho yacchatyudārātmatāṃ  mātarlakṣmi tava prasādavaśato doṣā api syurguṇāḥ ||
52961 ālasyaṃ harati prajñāṃ dhanamāyuryaśo balam |
52962 yasminnāste tadālasyaṃ sarvadoṣākarastu saḥ ||
52971 ālasyaṃ hi manuṣyāṇāṃ śarīrastho mahān ripuḥ |
52972 nāstyudyamasamo bandhuḥ kṛtvā yaṃ nāvasīdati ||
52981 ālasyamapi pārīndraṃ pratipadya vijṛmbhate |
52982 hatabhāgaṃ prayatno'pi pratihanyata eva hā ||
52991 ālasyātsusahāyo'pi na gacchatyudayaṃ janaḥ |
52992 hastāgrāsphālito bhūmau toyārdra iva kandukaḥ ||
53001 ālasyena hatā vidyā parahastagatāḥ striyaḥ |
53002 alpabījaṃ hataṃ kṣetraṃ hataṃ sainyamanāyakam ||
53011 ālānaṃ jayakuñjarasya dṛṣadāṃ seturvipadvāridheḥ  pūrvādriḥ karavālacaṇḍamahaso līlopadhānaṃ śriyaḥ |
53012 saṃgrāmāmṛtasāgarapramathanakrīḍāvidhau mandaro  rājan rājati vīravairivanitāvaidhavyadaste bhujaḥ ||
53021 ālānatvaruṣevaitā dantibhirvṛkṣapaṅktayaḥ |
53022 sphuratkaṭakaṭārāvaṃ pātyante kṛtacitkṛtaiḥ ||
53031 ālānamunmūlya sukhābhidhānaṃ  tāruṇyanāge gamanodyate'smin |
53032 palāyite kāmigaṇe'ṅganānāṃ  vimardabhītyeva kucāḥ patanti ||
53041 ālāne gṛhyate hastī vājī valgāsu gṛhyate |
53042 hṛdaye gṛhyate nārī yadīdaṃ nāsti gamyatām ||
53051 ālāpaṃ kalakaṇṭhikā na kurute kīrā na dhīradhvaniṃ  vyāhāraṃ kalayanti komalagiraḥ kūjanti no barhiṇaḥ |
53052 nīrāḍambaradurdināmbaratale dūre dvirephadhvaniḥ  kākāḥ kevalameva keṅkṛtaravaiḥ kurvanti karṇajvaram ||
53061 ālāpaḥ smitakaumudīsahacaro dṛṣṭiḥ praharṣojjvalā  bhrūrnṛtyādhvaradīkṣitā caraṇayornyāsaḥ same bhaṅguraḥ |
53062 veśeṣu kṣaṇikaspṛhā madavidherbandho na vādāśrayas tanvyā naikavikārabhūrmadhumadaprāyo madaḥ sphūrjati ||
53071 ālāpamālinikarasya niśamya bhītā  mugdhā vilokya vadanaṃ mukuraṃ jahāti |
53072 mandaṃ na niśvasiti manmathavedanārtā  kīrendu māruta bhayātkimu manna bhūpa ||
53081 ālāpayatyakāryāṇi kiṃcidākhyāti vā svayam |
53082 yā na prayāti śayanaṃ sāpyanutpannasaspṛhā ||
53091 ālāpādgātrasaṃsparśātsaṃsargātsahabhojanāt |
53092 āsanācśayanādyānātpāpaṃ saṃkramate nṛṇām ||
53101 ālāpān bhrūvilāso viralayati lasadbāhuvikṣiptiyātaṃ  nīvigranthiṃ prathimnā pratanayati manāṅmadhyanimno nitambaḥ |
53102 utpuṣyatpārśvamūrcchatkucaśikharamuro nūnamantaḥsmareṇa  spṛṣṭā kodaṇḍakoṭyā hariṇaśiśudṛśo dṛśyateyauvanaśrīḥ ||
53111 ālāpairmadhuraiśca kāścidaparānālokitaiḥ sasmitair anyān vibhramakalpanābhiritarānaṅgairanaṅgojjvalaiḥ |
53112 ācāraiścaturaiḥ parānabhinavairanyān bhruvaḥ kampanair itthaṃ kāścana rañjayanti sudṛśo manye manastvanyathā ||
53121 āli kapālini jaṭile  patyāvatyāgrahaistavālamiti |
53122 haragatamiti duḥsahamapi  muhurapi mukharānnigādayati gaurī ||

54912 antaścetasi saṃsthitāpi hṛdayaṃ bhūyo viśatyeva me  rūḍhapremasamāgamāpi navatāṃ dhatte priyā pratyaham ||
54921 āśliṣṭā rabhasādvilīyata ivākrāntāpyanaṅgena yā  yasyāḥ kṛtrimacaṇḍavastukaraṇākūteṣu khinnaṃ manaḥ |
54922 ko'yaṃ kāhamiti pravṛttasuratā jānāti yā nāntaraṃ  rantuḥ sā ramaṇī sa eva ramaṇaḥ śeṣau tu jāyāpatī ||
54931 āśliṣya vā pādaratāṃ pinaṣṭu mām  adarśanānmarmahatāṃ karotu vā |
54932 yathā tathā vā vidadhātu nāgaro  matprāṇanāthastu sa eva nāparaḥ ||
54941 āśleṣacumbanaratotsavakautukāni  krīḍādurodarapaṇaḥ pratibhūranaṅgaḥ |
54942 bhogaḥ sa yadyapi jaye ca parājaye ca  yūnormanastadapi vāñchati jetumeva ||
54951 āśleṣaśeṣā ratiraṅganānām  āmodaśeṣā kucakuṅkumaśrīḥ |
54952 tūṇīraśeṣaḥ kusumāyudho'pi  prabhātaśeṣā rajanī babhūva ||
54961 āśleṣādanu cumbanādanu nakhollekhādanu svāntaja  prodbodhādanu saṃbhramādanu ratārambhādanu prītayoḥ |
54962 anyārthaṃ gatayorbhramānmilitayoḥ saṃbhāṣaṇairjānator dampatyoriha ko na ko na tamasi vrīḍāvimiśro rasaḥ ||
54971 āśleṣādharabimbacumbanasukhālāpasmitānyāsatāṃ  dūre tāvadidaṃ mitho na sulabhaṃ jātaṃ mukhālokanam |
54972 itthaṃ vyarthakṛtaikadehaghaṭanāvinyāsayorāvayoḥ  keyaṃ prītividambanetyavatu vaḥ smero'rdhanārīśvaraḥ ||
54981 āśleṣeṇa payodharapraṇayinīṃ pratyādiśantyā dṛśaṃ  dṛṣṭvā cādharabaddhatṛṣṇamadharaṃ nirbhartsayantyā mukham |
54982 ūrvorgāḍhanipīḍanena jaghane pāṇiṃ ca ruddhvānayā  patyuḥ prema na khaṇḍitaṃ nipuṇayā māno'pi naivojjhitaḥ ||
54991 āśleṣe prathamaṃ kramādapahṛte hṛdye'dharasyārpaṇe  kelidyūtavidhau paṇaṃ priyatame kāntāṃ punaḥ pṛcchati |
54992 antargūḍhavigāḍhasaṃbhramarasasphārībhavadgaṇḍayā  tūṣṇīṃ śārivisāraṇāya nihitaḥ svedāmbugarbhaḥ karaḥ ||
55001 āśleṣe sarvadā patyuḥ satṛṣṇevāntarātmanā |
55002 ardhanārīśvaratanau gaurīvṛttaṃ samīhate ||
55011 saṃbhogāyogyakāleṣu sārdhaṃ kāntena kāminī |
55012 vāpīsaudhe gṛhodyāne yātrāsaṅgena tiṣṭhati ||
55021 anyacchāyāvaloke'pi parālāpe manāgapi |
55022 patye kruddhyatyanarthādau svayaṃ cāpi nimajjati ||
55031 aparopagamārambhamunnāṭayati vallabham |
55032 daridrajaratīvārtā śiśire sāyamātapam ||
55041 patyuḥ śayyāparāvṛttiṃ viyogamiva manyate |
55042 devāgāraprayāṇaṃ ca pravāsamiva paśyati ||
55051 atisnehasya nisyandādatipremṇaḥ pravṛttibhiḥ |
55052 chāyevānucaretkāntaṃ yāntaṃ tiṣṭhantamaṅganā ||
55061 āśleṣe sundarīṇāṃ sthitavati sahasā sarvasaṃtṛptihetau  vyarthaḥ pīyūṣamāptuṃ jalanidhimathane yatna ityākalayya |
55062 tasmādete viraktā jagati sumanaso yatsamastāstadaddhā  svargasthānāmivaiṣāṃ na kathamitarathā lāghavaṃ syātpratītam ||
55071 āśvapehi mama sīdhubhājanād yāvadagradaśanairna dṛśyase |
55072 candra maddaśanamaṇḍalāṅkitaḥ  khaṃ na yāsyasi hi rohiṇībhayāt ||
55081 āśvasihi mahābāho prāṇināṃ sarvamāpadaḥ |
55082 spṛśantyanilavalloke kṣaṇena pratiyānti ca ||
55091 āśvāsayati kāko'pi duḥkhitāṃ pathikāṅganām |
55092 tvaṃ candrāmṛtajanmāpi dahasīti kimucyatām ||
55101 āśvāsayeccāpi paraṃ sāntvadharmārthavṛttibhiḥ |
55102 athāsya praharetkāle yadā vicalite pathi ||
55111 āśvāsasnehabhaktīnāmekamāyatanaṃ mahat |
55112 prakṛṣṭasyeva dharmasya prasādo mūrtisundaraḥ ||
55121 āśvāsitasya mama nāma sutopalabdhyā  sadyastvayā saha kṛśodari viprayogaḥ |
55122 vyāvartitātaparujaḥ prathamābhravṛṣṭyā  vṛkṣasya vaidyuta ivāgnirupasthito'yam ||
55131 āśvāsya parvatakulaṃ tapanoṣṇataptam  uddāmadāvavidhurāṇi ca kānanāni |
55132 nānānadīnadaśatāni ca pūrayitvā  rikto'si yajjalada saiva tavottamaśrīḥ ||
55141 āśvine kṛṣṇapakṣe ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhaumo'tha rohiṇī |
55142 vyatīpātastadā ṣaṣṭhī kapilānantapuṇyadā ||
55151 āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣe  bhānordivase śirīṣavṛkṣasya |
55152 mūlaṃ jalena piṣṭvā  pibenna bhīstasya sarpotthā ||
55161 āṣāḍhī kārttikī māghī vacā śuṇṭhī harītakī |
55162 gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena puṇyā śleṣmaharānṛṇī ||
55171 āṣāḍhe śaśakā dṛṣṭā sthānāsthane subhikṣadāḥ |
55172 catuṣpadādināśāya tallabdhyai śaśadarśanam ||
55181 āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi bījāvapanaropaṇe |
55182 grīṣmādanyatra vallīnāṃ kecidicchanti ropaṇam ||
55191 ā saṃpravṛddherapi vṛddhikāmaḥ  samena saṃdhānamihopagacchet |
55192 apakvayorvā ghaṭayoravaśyam  anyo'nyabhedī samasaṃnipātaḥ ||
55201 āsaṃsāraṃ tribhuvanamidaṃ cinvatāṃ tāta tādṛṅ naivāsmākaṃ nayanapadavīṃ śrotravartmāgato vā |
55202 yo'yaṃ dhatte viṣayakariṇīgāḍharūḍhābhibhāna  kṣībasyāntaḥkaraṇakariṇaḥ saṃyamālānalīlām ||
55211 āsaktāḥ pratikoṭaraṃ viṣadharā bhānoḥ karā mūrdhani  jvālājālakarāladāvadahanaḥ pratyaṅgamāliṅgati |
55212 sarvānandanacārucandanataroretasya jīvātave  re jīmūta vimuñca vāri bahuśo yuṣmadyaśo jṛmbhatām ||
55221 āsajya svayameva cumbanavidhiṃ yācñā vināliṅganaṃ  talpānte jaghanena vepathumatā paryarpitaṃ jānunoḥ |
55222 krodhotkampamamarṣayatyanunayatyasyāḥ smarakrīḍayā  prauḍhaikābhiratiḥ priyasya hṛdayaṃ helābalātkarṣati ||
55231 āsate śatamadhikṣiti bhūpās toyarāśirasi te khalu kūpāḥ |
55232 kiṃ grahā divi na jāgrati te te  bhāskarasya katamastulayāste ||
55241 āsatyalokamakhilaṃ bhuvanaṃ jaleṣu  nirmajjayetprakupito jaladhirjavena |
55242 kiṃtu svamantayitumudyatamaurvamagnim  antarvasantamapi hantumasau na śaktaḥ ||
55251 ā satyalokādā bhūmeḥ svairacārakṛtaśramāḥ |
55252 tenurindukarāḥ svedaṃ drutanīhārabhūmikam ||
55261 āsanaṃ caiva yānaṃ ca saṃdhāya ca vigṛhya ca |
55262 kāryaṃ vīkṣya prayuñjīta dvaidhaṃ saṃśrayameva ca ||
55271 āsanaṃ prāṇasaṃrodhaḥ pratyāhāraśca dhāraṇā |
55272 dhyānaṃ samādhiretāni yogāṅgāni smṛtāni ṣaṭ ||
55281 āsanaṃ prāṇasaṃrodho dhyānaṃ caiva samādhikaḥ |
55282 etaccaṭuṣṭayaṃ viddhi sarvayogeṣu saṃmatam ||
55291 āsanācśayanādyānātsaṃgateścāpi bhojanāt |
55292 kṛte saṃcarate pāpaṃ tailabindurivāmbhasi ||
55301 āsanādekaśayyāyāṃ saṃbhāṣātsahabhojanāt |
55302 puṃsāṃ saṃkramate pāpaṃ ghaṭādghaṭamivodakam ||
55311 āsanāvasathau śayyāmanuvrajyāmupāsanam |
55312 uttameṣūttamaṃ kuryādhīne hīnaṃ same samam ||
55321 āsanāśanaśayyābhiradbhirmūlaphalena vā |
55322 nāsya kaścidvasedgehe śaktito'narcito'tithiḥ ||
55331 āsane pādamāropya yo bhuṅkte sa dvijādhamaḥ |
55332 mukhena dhamate cānnaṃ tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇam ||
55341 āsane lālayedbālāṃ taruṇīṃ śayane tathā |
55342 utsaṅge patirūḍhāṃ ca lālanaṃ trividhaṃ viduḥ ||
55351 āsane śayane yāne pānabhojanavastuṣu |
55352 dṛṣṭvāntaraṃ pramatteṣu praharantyarayo'riṣu ||
55361 āsane śayane yāne bhāvā lakṣyā viśeṣataḥ |
55362 puruṣāṇāṃ praduṣṭānāṃ svabhāvo valavattaraḥ ||
55371 āsan kṣīṇāni yāvanti cātakāśrūṇi te'mbuda |
55372 tāvanto'pi tvayodāra na muktā jalabindavaḥ ||
55381 āsannataratāmeti mṛtyurjantordine dine |
55382 āghātaṃ nīyamānasya vadhyasyeva pade pade ||
55391 āsannanāśaṃ salilaṃ taṭāke  kūpādikānāmatiyatnalabhyam |
55392 nadi tvamagryāsi jalāśrayāṇāṃ  yasyāṃ yugasthāyi sulambhamambhaḥ ||
55401 āsannamārgamatilaṅghya natena mūrdhnā  paścātprasaṅgavalitena mukhena yāntyā |
55402 āropitāḥ katipaye mayi paṅkajākṣyā  sākūtahāsamanatiprakaṭāḥ kaṭākṣāḥ ||
55411 āsannamitrāgamasūcyamāna  samāgame vāsaravallabhasya |
55412 niryānti dīpā iva rātribhogyāḥ  paśya prabhāte gaṇikāgṛhebhyaḥ ||
55421 āsannameva nṛpatirbhajate manuṣyaṃ  vidyāvihīnamakulīnamasaṃstutaṃ vā |
55422 prāyeṇa bhūmipatayaḥ pramadā latāśca  yaḥ pārśvato vasati taṃ pariveṣṭayanti ||
55431 āsannayauvanastvaṃ  duhiturme yauvanaṃ tvayā prāyaḥ |
55432 kṣapitamalakṣyaṃ strīṇāṃ  galati hi sahasaiva tāruṇyam ||
55441 āsannasevāṃ nṛpateḥ krīḍāśastrāhipāvakaiḥ |
55442 kauśalenātimahatā vinītaḥ sānurudhyate (?) ||
55451 āsannāḥ kaṇṭakino  ripubhayadāḥ kṣīriṇo'rthanāśāya |
55452 phalinaḥ prajākṣayakarā  dārūṇyapi varjayetteṣām ||
55461 āsannān purato bhogān darśayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
55462 chāgo haritamuṣṭyeva dūraṃ nīto'smi tṛṣṇayā ||
55471 āsannābhrajalasya dāvavigame vidyudbhayaṃ śākhino  nakrāsyādgalataśca majjanamayī śaṅkā bhavedvāridhau |
55472 bhoktavyasya vidhiḥ śubhasya rabhasātsvādutvaniṣpattaye  jantoḥ saṃtanute nirākṛtabhiyo bhītyantarotpādanam ||
55481 āsannāmavalambya kesaralatāmekena puṣpojjvalāṃ  savyaṃ niḥsahayā nitambaphalake kṛtvā karāmbhoruham |
55482 āmīlannayanāntavāntasalilaṃ ślāghyasya nindyasya vā  kasyedaṃ dṛḍhasauhṛdaṃ pratidinaṃ dīnaṃ tvayā smaryate ||
55491 āsannāmavalambya kesaralatāmekena puṣpojjvalāṃ  savyaṃ niḥsahayā nitambaphalake kṛtvā karāmbhoruham |
55492 udgrīvaṃ vada durdine'dya caraṇāvunnamya mārgastvayā  bālodbhrāntamṛgekṣaṇe sukṛtinaḥ kasyāyamālokyate ||
55501 āsannāya sudūrāya suptāya prakaṭātmane |
55502 sulabhāyātidurgāya namaścitrāya śaṃbhave ||
55511 āsanne phalamāsannaṃ dūrage dūragaṃ phalam |
55512 miśraṃ tu miśre śakune phalamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||
55521 āsanno madhurāgataṃ vanabhuvaḥ sāmrājyamityadbhutāḥ  śrūyante gira eṣa tattvamiha na jñātuṃ vidhātuḥ kṣamaḥ |
55522 yatparṇaistruṭitaṃ tadapyuparataṃ puṣpodgamaiḥ śākhināṃ  yadglānaṃ viṭapairidaṃ punariha pratyakṣamālakṣyate ||
55531 āsanno valmīko  dakṣiṇapārśve vibhītasya |
55532 adhyardhe bhavati śirā  puruṣe jñeyā diśi prācyām ||
55541 āsan yāvanti yācñāsu cātakāśrūṇi cāmbuda |
55542 tāvanto'pi tvayā megha na muktā vāribindavaḥ ||
55551 ā saptateryasya vivāhapaṅktir vicchidyate nūnamapaṇḍito'sau |
55552 jīvanti tāḥ kartanakuṭṭanābhyāṃ  gobhyaḥ kimukṣā yavasaṃ dadāti ||
55561 āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ hanti śiro'bhyaṅge caturdaśī |
55562 māṃsāśane pañcadaśī kāmadharme tathāṣṭamī ||
55571 ā samantāccaturdikṣu sannikṛṣṭāśca ye nṛpāḥ |
55572 tatparāstatparā ye'nye kramādhīnabalārayaḥ ||
55581 āsamastākṣivikṣepasamarpitamanobhuvām |
55582 manmathoddīpanaṃ tāsāṃ viṭavṛttaṃ vidhāsyate ||
55591 ā sargātprativāsaraṃ rasaśatairyā bodhitā poṣitā  kalpāntāvasare'tha saiva pṛthivī svaireva dagdhā karaiḥ |
55592 kṛtvetthaṃ kimapi svakarma niyateḥ pūrvāparopaplutaṃ  kaṣṭaṃ so'pi dināntavītakiraṇastigmāṃśurastaṃ gataḥ ||
55601 āsavaratiratibahubhuk kaṭvamlāśī ca karmaṭhaḥ piśunaḥ |
55602 sthūlaḥ kṛśo'tidīrghaḥ  kharvo vā kṛṣṇapīto vā ||
55611 āsasāda munirātmanastataḥ  śiṣyavargaparikalpitārhaṇam |
55612 baddhapallavapuṭāñjalidrumaṃ  darśanonmukhamṛgaṃ tapovanam ||
55621 āsāṃ jalāsphālanatatparāṇāṃ  muktāphalaspardhiṣu śīkareṣu |
55622 payodharotsarpiṣu śīryamāṇaḥ  saṃlakṣyate na cchiduro'pi hāraḥ ||
55631 āsāṃ vratamatīvākṣṇoryatpuraḥ parisarpaṇam |
55632 saha yātaṃ manastatra tyaktvā bhūyo nivartanam ||
55641 āsāditaprakaṭanirmalacandrahāsaḥ  prāptaḥ śaratsamaya eṣa viśuddhakāntaḥ |
55642 utkhāya gāḍhatamasaṃ ghanakālamugraṃ  rāmo daśāsyamiva saṃbhṛtabandhujīvaḥ ||
55651 āsāditavyo'sti karālakeśaḥ  sakhedayārhaḥ samayo'pakārī |
55652 taduttamaślokakathānubandhas tāvadyathā syātprayate tathāham ||
55661 āsāditasya tamasā niyaterniyogād ākāṅkṣataḥ punarapakramaṇena kālam |
55662 patyustviṣāmiha mahauṣadhayaḥ kalatra  sthānaṃ parairanabhibhūtamamūrvahanti ||
55671 āsādya kṛṣṇapakṣān  atrasataḥ sarvadā'bhīkān |
55672 parayātmani ratacittān  vibhāvya tatkarma kurvataḥ kva bhayam ||
55681 āsādyate kathaṃ vā  śauryāśrayaṇena gauravadhvaṃsaḥ |
55682 tattatra dattacittaś cittajasaṃtāpabhājanaṃ na janaḥ ||
55691 āsādya dakṣiṇāṃ diśam  avilambaṃ tyajati cottarāṃ taraṇiḥ |
55692 puruṣaṃ haranti kāntāḥ  prāyeṇa hi dakṣiṇā eva ||
55701 āsādya bhaṅgamanayā  dyūte vihitābhirucitakelipaṇe |
55702 niḥsārayatākṣāniti  kapaṭaruṣotsāritāḥ sakhyaḥ ||
55711 āsādya mandarāgo'pi bhujaṅgenātisaṃgatim |
55712 tadbhogāttu bhraman kaṣṭaṃ prāpnoti viṣamantataḥ ||
55721 āsādya somabhuvamāsvahi yatra nityaṃ  maṅktuṃ pralobhayati saikatamaṃśukābham |
55722 tattatra nirvahati saṃprati nityakṛtyam  etasya vismṛtagṛhasya parānubhūtyā ||
55731 āsādyāpi mahodadhiṃ na vitṛṣo jāto jalairvāḍavo  meghaṃ prāpya na cātako'pi caraṇau bhānuṃ na lebhe'ruṇaḥ |
55732 candraḥ śaṃkaraśekhare'pi nivasan pakṣakṣaye kṣīyate  prāyaḥ sajjanasaṃgato'pi labhate daivānurūpaṃ phalam ||
55741 āsādyāmravanīmimāṃ prati navāmāsvādya tanmañjarīṃ  maivaṃ pañcamamañca nandanavanabhrāntyā tayā kokila |
55742 eṣā vāyasamaṇḍalī ghanaśiraḥśūlāhativyākulā  kudhvānairbadhirīkariṣyati vṛthā śrotrāṇi satpatriṇām ||
55751 āsāmupari dadyācca pānīyasya vicakṣaṇaḥ |
55752 evaṃ yāmadvayaṃ kuryāttatastvāsāṃ na dāpayet ||
55761 āsāyaṃ salilabhare  savitāramupāsya sādaraṃ tapasā |
55762 adhunābjena manāktava  mānini tulanā mukhasyāptā ||
55771 āsārāntamṛdupravṛttamaruto meghopaliptāmbarā  vidyutpātamuhūrtadṛṣṭakakubhaḥ suptendutārāgrahāḥ |
55772 dhārāklinnakadambasaṃbhṛtasurāmododvahāḥ proṣitair niḥsaṃpātavisāridarduraravā nītāḥ kathaṃ rātrayaḥ ||
55781 āsāreṇa na harmyataḥ priyatamairyātuṃ bahiḥ śakyate  śītotkampanimittamāyatadṛśā gāḍhaṃ samāliṅgyate |
55782 jālaiḥ śīkaraśītalāśca maruto ratyantakhedacchido  dhanyānāṃ bata durdinaṃ sudinatāṃ yāti priyāsaṃgame ||
55791 āsāroparame pragāḍhatimirāḥ kirmīrayantyo niśāḥ  pānthastrīmanasāṃ smarānalakaṇāsantānaśaṅkāspṛśaḥ |
55792 piṣṭānāṃ prasabhaṃ ghanāghanaghaṭāsaṃghaṭṭato vidyutāṃ  cūrṇābhāḥ paritaḥ patanti taralāḥ khadyotakaśreṇayaḥ ||
55801 āsitāni hasitāni kṛtāni  prekṣitāni gaditāni gatāni |
55802 prāyaśo'nukurute lalitāṅgī  nartakīva caturaṃ dayitasya ||
55811 āsitvā vijane vimuktaviṣayāsaṅgaṃ mano niścalaṃ  kṛtvā hṛjjalajāntare priyatamārūpaṃ paraṃ daivatam |
55812 dhyātvā hāralatāmayākṣavalayaṃ hastena dhṛtvā mayā  tatsāyujyaphalāptaye pratidinaṃ tannāma saṃjapyate ||
55821 āsiṣye sukhito gṛhīti vihito mohena dāragrahas tatsaṅgātsutadāsabāndhavasuhṛtsaṃbandhināmudbhavaḥ |
55822 tannirvāhakadarthanāparibhavānaucityacintājuṣaḥ  kiṃ saukhyaṃ katamā gṛhasthitirato'nartho mayā svīkṛtaḥ ||
55831 āsījjanaḥ kṛtaghnaḥ  kriyamāṇaghnaśca sāṃprataṃ jātaḥ |
55832 iti me manasi vitarko  bhavitā lokaḥ kathaṃ bhavitā ||
55841 āsītā maraṇātkṣāntā niyatā brahmacāriṇī |
55842 yo dharma ekapatnīnāṃ kāṅkṣantī tamanuttamam ||
55851 āsītkalpamudanvadambuni ciraṃ bheje ca bhālānalaṃ  bhargasya pratimāsakarmahutabhukkuṇḍe'pyahauṣīdvapuḥ |
55852 tīvraireva tapobhirindurakaroditthaṃ januryāpanaṃ  kiṃ kuryādvidhuro na vāñchati vidhistallāñchanaproñchanam ||
55861 āsīttāmramayaṃ śarīramadhunā sauvarṇavarṇaṃ gataṃ  muktāhāralatāśrubindunivahairniḥsvasya me kalpitā |
55862 svalpaṃ svalpamanalpakalpamadhunā dīrghaṃ vayaḥ kalpitaṃ  svāmin duḥkha bhavatprasādavaśataḥ kiṃ kiṃ na labdhaṃ mayā ||
55871 āsītpūrvaṃ vimalajaladhau maṇḍanaṃ bhūpatīnāṃ  nārīṇāṃ ca prabalamukuṭe kāñcanena prasaṅgāt |
55872 tantrībaddhaḥ kathamidamaho kācakhaṇḍena sārdhaṃ  bhillīkaṇṭhe marakatamaṇe kāmavasthāṃ gato'si ||
55881 āsītsatyayuge balistadanu ca tretāyuge bhārgavo  rāmaḥ satyaparākramo'tha bhagavān dharmastathā dvāpare |
55882 dātā ko'pi na cāsti saṃprati kalau jīvanti kenārthinaś cetyevaṃ kṛtaniścayena vidhinā vyāpāriṇo nirmitāḥ ||
55891 āsīdañjanamatreti paśyāmi tava locane |
55892 bhāvibhūṣaṇasaṃbhārāṃ sākṣātkurve tavākṛtim ||
55901 āsīdadabhraśaradabhramiṣādyaśaste  nāke bhramannṛpa yadabhramukāntaśubhram |
55902 tatpuṣpavarṣaṇamivāpsarasāṃ dyuloke  vyāpnotyamādiva bhuvaṃ tuhinacchalena ||
55911 āsīdāsīmabhūmīvalayamalayajālepanepathyakīrti ḥ  saptākūpārapārīsadanajanaghanodgītacāpapratāpaḥ |
55912 vīrādasmātparaḥ kaḥ padayugayugapatpātibhūpātibhūyaś cūḍāratnoḍupatnīkaraparicaraṇāmandanandannakhenduḥ ||
55921 āsīduptaṃ yadetadraṇabhuvi bhavatā vairimātaṅgakumbhān  muktābījaṃ tadetattrijagati janayāmāsa kīrtidrumaṃ te |
55922 śeṣo mūlaṃ prakāṇḍaṃ himagirirudadhirdugdhapūrālavālaṃ  jyotsnā śākhāpratānaḥ kusumamuḍucayo yasya candraḥ phalaṃ ca ||
55931 āsīdeva yadārdraḥ  kimapi tadā kimayamāhato'pyāha |
55932 niṣṭhurabhāvādadhunā  kaṭūni sakhi raṭati paṭaha iva ||
55941 āsīdgaṅgādharastasya bhrātā gaṅgādharopamaḥ |
55942 ekān babandha yo vyālānmumocaikān yadṛcchayā ||
55951 āsīdgaṅgānvayāyakṣitipatitilako rājarājakṣitīśaḥ  kṣmāpālaprauḍhamauliprakaramaṇiruciprasphuratpādapīṭhaḥ |
55952 yo'rātikṣatracakrakrathanakarabhujāpālitāśeṣapṛthvī  cakraścakrāyudhābho'dadhadurasi ramāṃ vāci vācāmadhīśaḥ ||
55961 āsīdyastava putrakastricaturaiḥ patrāṅkurairāvṛto  meghonmuktajalaikajīvanavidhiḥ sanmārgalabdhāspadaḥ |
55962 so'yaṃ saṃprati vāsaraiḥ katipayairadhvanyapuṇyoccayaiḥ  saṃpannaḥ phalanamrapallavataticchāyopaliptāvaniḥ ||
55971 āsīdvaraḥ kaṇṭakitaprakoṣṭhaḥ  svinnāṅguliḥ saṃvavṛte kumārī |
55972 tasmin dvaye tatkṣaṇamātmavṛttiḥ  samaṃ vibhakteva manobhavena ||
55981 āsīnaḥ śayitaḥ sthitaḥ pracalitaḥ svapnāyito jāgṛtaḥ  paśyanmīlitalocano vyavaharanmaunaṃ prapanno'thavā |
55982 tāṃ premākulavīkṣitāṃ smitamukhīṃ savrīḍamandāgamāṃ  śliṣyantīṃ praṇayārdramugdhalapitāṃ paśyāmi naktaṃdivam ||
55991 āsīnaḥ sukhamāpaṇe yadi vaṇikśraddhālubhiḥ prārthitaḥ  kiṃcicśaṃsati pañcakaṃ śatakamityetanna tasyādbhutam |
55992 āpātālavighūrṇitāmbhasi calatyautpātike mārute  majjantyāmapi nāvi muñcati na yastāmeva mūlyasthitim ||
56001 asīnaḥ svāminaḥ pārśve tanmukhekṣī kṛtāñjaliḥ |
56002 svabhāvaṃ cāsya vijñāya dakṣaḥ kāryāṇi sādhayet ||
56011 āsīnā taṭabhuvi sasmitena bhartrā  rambhorūravatarituṃ sarasyanicchuḥ |
56012 dhunvānā karayugamīkṣituṃ vilāsāñ śītāluḥ salilagatena sicyate sma ||
56021 āsīne pūṣṇi tūṣṇīṃ vyasanini śaśini vyomni kṛṣṇe satṛṣṇe  daityendre jātanidre dravati maghavati klāntakāntau kṛtānte |
56022 abrahmaṇyaṃ bruvāṇe kamalapuṭakuṭīśrotriye śāntyupāye  pāyādvaḥ kālakūṭaṃ jhaṭiti kavalayaṃllīlayā nīlakaṇṭhaḥ ||
56031 āsīne lālayedbālāṃ taruṇīṃ śayane tathā |
56032 utthite'pyadhirūḍhāṃ ca lālanaṃ trividhaṃ viduḥ ||
56041 āsīnaiḥ svaṃ vimānaṃ kṛtaparivṛtibhiḥ sundarīsaṃgataistair devaiḥ siddhaiśca yakṣairanimiṣanayanairdṛśyamānaḥ satṛṣṇam |
56042 madhyemaghye payodairmurajasadṛśatāṃ bodhayadbhiḥ sumanda  mambhaḥ saṃpātya puṣpairiva nanu mahitastāṇḍavaḥ śreyase stāt ||
56051 āsīnnātha pitāmahī tava mahī mātā tato'nantaraṃ  saṃpratyeva hi sāmburāśiraśanā jāyā jayodbhūtaye |
56052 pūrṇe varṣaśate bhaviṣyati punaḥ saivānavadyā snuṣā  yuktaṃ nāma samastaśāstraviduṣāṃ lokeśvarāṇāmidam ||
56061 āsīnme manasi hṛtā na sā mṛtā sā  yā dṛṣṭervrajati na gocaraṃ priyā me |
56062 jyotsnā hi sphuṭadhavalāpi kaumudīndor andhānāṃ bahalatamomalīmasaiva ||
56071 āsīmā kālikā yasya kṣudrāṅgaṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtam |
56072 kṣudravajrakanāmānaṃ prāha nāgārjuno muniḥ ||
56081 āsīmāntānnivartante suhṛdaḥ saha bandhubhiḥ |
56082 sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vāpi gacchantamanugacchati ||
56091 āsīstvaṃ niśirājaraktahṛdayetīrṣyālunā vajriṇā  prātaḥ śaṅkitayeva divyapadavīṃ gatvātmanaḥ śuddhaye |
56092 aurvottāpitavārdhitāpakatalādādāya mukto bahiḥ  prācyāsau divi taptamāṣaka iva pradyotano dyotate ||
56101 āsuraṃ kulamanādaraṇīyaṃ  cittametadamalīkaraṇīyam |
56102 rāmadhāma śaraṇīkaraṇīyaṃ  līlayā bhavajalaṃ taraṇīyam ||
56111 āse cetsvagṛhe kuṭumbabharaṇaṃ kartuṃ na śakto'smyahaṃ  seve cetsukhasādhanaṃ munivanaṃ muṣṇanti māṃ taskarāḥ |
56112 śvabhre cetsvatanuṃ tyajāmi narakādbhīrātmahatyāvaśān  no jāne karavāṇi daiva kimahaṃ martuṃ na vā jīvitum ||
56121 āsevyate mukhaṃ sarvairvidyānāṃ yoṣitāmapi |
56122 hṛdayagrāhiṇastāsāṃ dvitrāḥ santi na santi vā ||
56131 āskandan kathamapi yoṣito na yāvad bhīmatyaḥ priyakaradhāryamāṇahastāḥ |
56132 autsukyāttvaritamamūstadambu tāvat saṃkrāntapratimatayā dadhāvivāntaḥ ||
56141 āskandito bhujalatācalitāgraśākhām  āliṅgito yuvatibhiḥ kalikārthinībhiḥ |
56142 dhanyo'si campakataro kusumānurūpair āsāṃ ghanastanaphalaiḥ phalito'si yacca ||
56151 āskandhāvadhi kaṇṭhakāṇḍavipine drākcandrahāsāsinā  chettuṃ prakramite mayaiva tarasā truṭyacchirāsaṃtatau |
56152 asmeraṃ galitāśrugadgadapadaṃ bhinnabhruvā yadyabhūd vaktreṣvekamapi svayaṃ sa bhagavāṃstanme pramāṇaṃ śivaḥ ||
56161 ā stanyapānājjananī paśūnām  ā dāralābhācca narādhamānām |
56162 āgehakarmāvadhi madhyamānām  ā jīvitāttīrthamivottamānām ||
56171 āsta bhāvamadhigacchatostayoḥ  saṃmadeṣu karajakṣatārpaṇā |
56172 phāṇiteṣu maricāvacūrṇanā  sā sphuṭaṃ kaṭurapi spṛhāvahā ||
56181 āstāṃ kiṃ bahubhiḥ paropakṛtayaḥ saṃsārasāraṃ phalaṃ  siddhaṃ tatpratikūlavartini vidhau na stokamapyatra naḥ |
56182 ete smaḥ kila mānuṣā vayamapi vyarthaṃ vyapetāyuṣo  yeṣāṃ svodarapūrtireva hi kimapyaṣṭau mahāsiddhayaḥ ||
56191 āstāṃ klamāpaharaṇaṃ jaladherjalena  dūre davāgni paridīpitamānasānām |
56192 etāvadastu yadi toyakaṇairna jihvā  dandahyate dviguṇatāṃ ca na yāti tṛṣṇā ||
56201 āstāṃ gāḍhatarānuśīlanavidhiḥ saṃsparśanaṃ dūrataḥ  saṃśleṣe viṣayīkṛto'si na manāgakṣṇoḥ padaṃ prāpitaḥ |
56202 kiṃ brūmaḥ sahakāra tāvakaguṇānanyādṛśairdurlabhān  saurabhyeṇa yadadhvagānapi muhuḥ prīṇāsi dūrādapi ||
56211 āstāṃ cakṣuridaṃ tiro'ñcati kiyacceto'pi yadvaibhavair niṣpratyāśamayaṃ mune jalanidhirgaṇḍūṣitaḥ sattapaḥ |
56212 etenaiva virantumarhasi na te gaṇḍūṣapānādhikā  kācitkhyātirataḥparaṃ paramasau parjanyanīvīvyayaḥ ||
56221 āstāṃ tatkarakānipātakṛtabhīmaṇḍūkanirmajjana  kṣemaikakṣamavāri palvalaśataṃ sindhuṃ tameva stumaḥ |
56222 kupyacchakrakarasvarupraharaṇakṣuṇṇākhilāṅgakṣarat kīlālena girivrajena śaraṇaṃ yadgarbhavāsaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
56231 āstāṃ tāvatkimanyena daurātmyeneha yoṣitām |
56232 vidhṛtaṃ svodareṇāpi ghnanti putramapi svakam ||
56241 āstāṃ tāvadakīrtirme tvayā tathyaṃ tu kathyatām |
56242 cittaṃ kathamivāsītte harivaṃśīravaśrutau ||
56251 āstāṃ tāvadasīmapauruṣajuṣaḥ saṃmānitātyadbhuta  prārambhābhyadhikakriyasya sa khalu prācyaḥ pracāro hareḥ |
56252 jīrṇasyāpi ca vindhyakandaradarīdvārāvatārākṣamair aṅgairaṅgabhṛto dalanti darato gandhena gandhadvipāḥ ||
56261 āstāṃ tāvadaho samudramahimā dūre'pi karṇapriyas tīre yasya pipāsayaiva maraṇaṃ prāpnoti śīghraṃ janaḥ |
56262 tasmādambunidhervaraṃ laghusaraḥ kūpo'thavā vāpikā  yatra svātmakaradvayena salilaṃ pepīyate svecchayā ||
56271 āstāṃ tāvaddigantaprathitasuyaśasāṃ saṃgamaḥ sajjanānāṃ  taiḥ sākaṃ vairayogo'pyatiśayamahitāmunnatiṃ saṃnidhatte |
56272 loke kasyāgamiṣyacchrutipathamavapurvaktraśeṣo'pi rāhus trailokyakhyātadhāmnoryadi raviśaśinorvairitāṃ nākariṣyat ||
56281 āstāṃ tāvadvacanaracanābhājanatvaṃ vidūre  dūre cāstāṃ tava tanuparīrambhasaṃbhāvanāpi |
56282 bhūyo bhūyaḥ praṇatibhiridaṃ kiṃ tu yāce vidheyā  smāraṃ smāraṃ svajanagaṇane kāpi rekhā mamāpi ||
56291 āstāṃ te guṇinastāvadbhūṣitāśeṣabhūtalāḥ |
56292 yeṣāṃ guṇarucirbhūyaḥ sāṃprataṃ te'pi durlabhāḥ ||
56301 āstāṃ dūratayā tadīyavadanāmbhojāmṛtāsvādanaṃ  nodetyeva manoratho'pi hṛdaye tatsaṃgamāśāṃ prati |
56302 utkaṇṭhāśithilīkṛtāṅgalatikaṃ vīkṣeta māmekadā  sasnehaṃ yadi sā sarojavadanā dhanyo'smyahaṃ tāvatā ||
56311 āstāṃ dūreṇa viśleṣaḥ priyāmāliṅgato mama |
56312 svedaḥ kiṃ na sarinnātho romāñcaḥ kiṃ na parvataḥ ||
56321 āstāṃ bhavāntaravidhau suviparyayo'yam  atraiva janmani nṛṇāmadharoccabhāvaḥ |
56322 alpaḥ pṛthuḥ pṛthurapi kṣaṇato'lpa eva  svāmī bhavatyanucaraḥ sa ca tatpadārhaḥ ||
56331 āstāṃ maṇḍalamaindavaṃ varatanorvaktraśriyaścetkathā  koṇe kutracidāsatāṃ kuvalayānyakṣṇoḥ prasaṅgo yadi |
56332 dūre tiṣṭhatu vallakīkalaravaḥ prastāvanā cedgirāṃ  vārttā cedavalagnakasya yaśasāṃ vyomnaḥ prathāyai namaḥ ||
56341 āstāṃ mahābodhabalena sādhyo  mokṣo vibādhāmalasaukhyayuktaḥ |
56342 dharmārthakāmā api no bhavanti  jñānaṃ vinā tena tadarcanīyam ||
56351 āstāṃ mādya bhave śubhe sakhi latā nyastā tvayā mādhavī  kānte tanmama saṃprayaccha kusumaṃ kiṃ vāmunā me phalam |
56352 nālpaṃ nirmalayāmi mauktikamidaṃ nyastaṃ tvayā dahyatām  itthaṃ vibhramasaṃbhramo madayati preyāṃsameṇīdṛśaḥ ||
56361 āstāṃ mānaḥ kathanaṃ  sakhīṣu vā mayi nivedyadurvinaye |
56362 śithilitaratiguṇagarvā  mamāpi sā lajjitā sutanuḥ ||
56371 āstāṃ varamavakeśī  mā dohadamasya racaya pūgataroḥ |
56372 etasmātphalitādapi  kevalamudvegamadhigaccha ||
56381 āstāṃ viśvasanaṃ sakhīṣu viditābhiprāyasāre jane  tatrāpyarpayituṃ dṛśaṃ salilatāṃ śaknomi na vrīḍayā |
56382 loko hyeṣa paropahāsacaturaḥ sūkṣmeṅgitajño'pyalaṃ  mātaḥ kaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi hṛdaye jīrṇo'nurāgānalaḥ ||
56391 āstāṃ sakaṇṭakamidaṃ vasudhādhipatyaṃ  trailokyarājyamapi deva tṛṇāya manye |
56392 niḥśaṅkasuptahariṇīkulasaṃkulāsu  cetaḥ paraṃ valati śailavanasthalīṣu ||
56401 āstāmanaṅgīkaraṇādbhavena  dṛśyaḥ smaro neti purāṇavāṇī |
56402 tavaiva dehaṃ śritayā śriyeti  navastu vastu pratibhāti vādaḥ ||
56411 āstāmanyatsujanāḥ  paropakāraikakaraṇadurlalitāḥ |
56412 saṃtāpitapiśuneṣu  svaguṇeṣvapi hanta khidyante ||
56421 āstāmaparo lokaḥ  krīḍāpekṣāparo yadi prītiḥ |
56422 byasanāntare patantī  na vāritā parijanenāpi ||
56431 āstāmeva sarovareṇya bhavato dugdhodalabdhāmṛta  svādaspardhi sarojavṛndakhacitaṃ haṃsāvataṃsaṃ payaḥ |
56432 sphārollolasuśītaśīkaracayāsāraprasiktānila  sparśaireva manoharairapagatāḥ saṃtāpaśoṣaklamāḥ ||
56441 āstikyaṃ ceddhanamakhilamapyarthisātkartumarhaṃ  nāstikyaṃ cettadapi sutarāṃ bhogahetorapāsyam |
56442 aspṛṣṭvāpi svayamatirahaḥsthāpyate yattadantas tasmin hetuḥ ka iti nibhṛtaṃ tarkayāmo na vidmaḥ ||
56451 āstīkavacanaṃ smṛtvā yaḥ sarpo na nivartate |
56452 śatadhā bhidyate mūrdhni śiṃśavṛkṣaphalaṃ yathā ||
56461 āstīryantāmupānte vanavṛtinipuṇairjālikairjālabandhā  mucyantāṃ śṛṅkhalābhyaḥ śvagaṇabhiraṭavīgahvare sārameyāḥ |
56462 ākīryantāṃ sthalāni śramaśithilahayaiḥ sādibhiḥ pāśahastair vyādhūyantāṃ kṛtāntairiva mahiṣacarairdaṇḍibhiḥ kānanāni ||
56471 āstṛte'bhinavapallavapuṣpair apyanārataratābhiratābhyaḥ |
56472 dīyate sma śayituṃ śayanīye  na kṣaṇaḥ kṣaṇadayāpi vadhūbhyaḥ ||
56481 āste kaścana bhikṣuḥ  saṃgṛhṇannavyayāni daśa |
56482 na mametyavyayayugalaṃ  yācāmastaṃ kimastyanyat ||
56491 āste'traiva sarasyaho bata kiyān saṃtoṣapakṣagraho  haṃsasyāsya manāṅna dhāvati matiḥ śrīdhāmni padme kvacit |
56492 supto'dyāpi vibudhyate na taditastāvatpratīkṣāmahe  velāmityuṣasi priyā madhulihaḥ soḍhuṃ ta eva kṣamāḥ ||
56501 āste dāmodarīyāmiyamudaradarīṃ yāvalambya trilokī  saṃmātuṃ śaknuvanti prathimabharavaśādatra naitadyaśāṃsi |
56502 tāmetāṃ pūrayitvā niraguriva madhudhvaṃsinaḥ pāṇḍupadma  cchadmāpannāni tāni dvipadaśanasanābhīni nābhīpathena ||
56511 āste dvāri vadhūrvidhātṛracanāvaiduṣyavikrāntibhūr bhūretasya balādahāri bhavatā bhītā natārātinā |
56512 kiṃ nāmāparamatra kāryamadhunā sādhyaṃ samāśāsyate  tatpāṇigrahamaṅgalāya manujādhīśāstu yatno mahān ||
56521 āste no suṣamā na cāpi kusumāmodo hi no vā manāk cāturyaṃ makarandadānaviṣaye kiṃ cāturīyaṃ punaḥ |
56522 yattvaṃ citragataṃ kuśeśayadalaṃ puṣṇāsi guñjāravair māhātmyaṃ ka iva bravīmi tadaho he cañcarīkādhunā ||
56531 āste rohatkanakakamale kelipātre mṛḍānyāḥ  khelan helonmadamadhukarīmānase mānase yaḥ |
56532 bhekodrekapraṇayini valadbālajambālajāle  sa syādutkaḥ parimitajale palvale kiṃ marālaḥ ||
56541 āste vidhuḥ paramanirvṛta eva maulau  śaṃbhoriti trijagatījanacittavṛttiḥ |
56542 antarnigūḍhanayanānaladāhaduḥkhaṃ  jānāti kaḥ paramṛte bata śītaraśmeḥ ||
56551 āstrīśiśu prathitayaiṣa pipāsitebhyaḥ  saṃrakṣyate'mbudhirapeyatayaiva dūrāt |
56552 daṃṣṭrākarālamakarālikarālitābhiḥ  kiṃ bhāyayatyaparamūrmiparaṃparābhiḥ ||
56561 āsthāmālambya nīteṣu vaśaṃ kṣudreṣvarātiṣu |
56562 vyaktimāyāti mahatāṃ māhātmyamanukampayā ||
56571 āsthāya dāruṇataraṃ kamapi svabhāvam  atyantaduṣkṛtakṛtāmapi śikṣaṇāya |
56572 gṛhṇāsi sāyakapade kusumānyamūni  mātaḥ suteṣu mahatī kila rūkṣateyam ||
56581 āsthitaḥ sthagitavāridapaṅktyā  saṃdhyayā gaganapaścimabhāgaḥ |
56582 sormividrumavitānavibhāsā  rañjitasya jaladheḥ śriyamūhe ||
56591 āsphālitaṃ yatpramadākarāgrair mṛdaṅgadhīradhvanimanvagacchat |
56592 vanyairidānīṃ mahiṣaistadambhaḥ  śṛṅgāhataṃ krośati dīrghikāṇām ||
56601 āsphālitairjaladhirūrmiparaṃparāṇāṃ  dūrīkaroti yadi ratnamavastubuddhyā |
56602 ratnākaratvamapi tasya bhavedvinaṣṭaṃ  ratnaṃ tu hanta bhavitā mahadaṅgadhāryam ||
56611 āsmākī yuvatidṛśāmasau tanoti  cchāyaiva śriyamanapāyinīṃ kimebhiḥ |
56612 matvaivaṃ svaguṇapidhānasābhyasūyaiḥ  pānīyairiti vidadhāvire'ñjanāni ||
56621 āsyaṃ nirasya rasitaiḥ suciraṃ vihasya  gātrāntareṣu ghana varṣasi cātakasya |
56622 taccañcukoṭikuṭilāyatakaṃdharasya  prāṇātyayo'sya bhavataḥ parihāsamātram ||
56631 āsyaṃ pidhāya sakalaṃ  viralāṅgulinā kareṇa saghrāṇam |
56632 ayamuccaraddakāraṃ  manoharaṃ jyotkaroti śiśuḥ ||
56641 āsyaṃ yadyapi hāsyavarjitamidaṃ lāsyena vītaṃ vaco  netre śoṇasarojakānti tadapi kvāpi kṣaṇaṃ sthīyate |
56642 mālāyāḥ karaṇodyame makarikārambhaḥ kucāmbhojayor dhūpāḥ kuntaladhoraṇīṣu sudṛśaḥ sāyaṃtano dṛśyate ||
56651 āsyaṃ yasyāḥ sudhāṃśuṃ kalayati nayanābhyāṃ jitaḥ puṃsamūhaḥ  kāntyā vidyutkucābhyāṃ jalakanakadhare nirjite hanta mohaḥ |
56652 kuṣṭhaṃ durgandhiyuktaṃ laghukṛmivikṛtaṃ pūyamajjāsravāhi  vyāptaṃ tanmakṣikābhirgatiriti vapuṣaḥ kutsitā nāsti loke ||
56661 āsyaṃ sahāsyaṃ nayanaṃ salāsyaṃ  sindūrabindūdayaśobhi bhālam |
56662 navā ca veṇī hariṇīdṛśaśced anyairagaṇyairapi bhūṣaṇaiḥ kim ||
56671 āsyaproñchitapārvaṇenduyaśasaṃ netrāvadhūtotpala  śrīgarvāṃ daśanacchadavyavahitāśokapravāladyutim |

56681 āsyaśrījitajarjarendumalinaṃ kṛtvā kare kandukaṃ  krīḍākautukamiśrabhāvamanayā tāmraṃ vahantyānanam |

56691 āsyaśrīrdvijarājabādhanakarī dṛṣṭiḥ śruterlaṅghinī  mūrdhanyāvaligāminī kuṭilatā baddhāśca muktā guṇaiḥ |

56722 yathā na bhakṣayantyarthaṃ bhakṣitaṃ nirvamanti vā ||

56741 ā svarlokāduraganagaraṃ nūtanālokalakṣmīm  ātanvadbhiḥ kimiva sitatāṃ ceṣṭitaiste na nītam |

56791 āsvādito'si mohād bata viditā vadanamādhurī bhavataḥ |
56792 madhuliptakṣura rasanāc chedāya paraṃ vijānāsi ||

56802 prodghoṣyaṃ ciraviprayuktavanitāsandeśavāṇīva me  naivedyaṃ caritaṃ ca rūpamaniśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇa nāmāstu te ||
56811 āsvādya nirviśeṣaṃ  virahivadhūnāṃ mṛdūni māṃsāni |
56812 karakāmiṣeṇa manye  niḥṣṭhīvati nīrado'sthīni ||

56832 pratyāsannatame pike'pi bhavate yenārpitā tādṛśī  mādhvī tasya vivekavicyutiriyaṃ sādguṇyametanna te ||

56851 āhataṃ kucataṭena taruṇyāḥ  sādhu soḍhamamuneti papāta |

56861 āhate yatra khaḍge syāddhvaniḥ kākasvaropamaḥ |
56862 amākāradhvanirvā syātsa varjyo narapuṃgavaiḥ ||
56871 āhate yatra madhuro dhvaniḥ samupajāyate |

56881 āhatya cinumaḥ svargamapavargamanukramāt |

56892 utkarṇaṃ tarṇakasya priyatanayatayā dattahuṃkāramudrā  visraṃsatkṣīradhārālavaśabalamukhasyāṅgamātṛpti leḍhi ||
56901 āha nāthavadanasya cumbataḥ  sā sma śītakaratāmanakṣaram |
56902 sītkṛtāni sudatī vitanvatī  sattvadattapṛthuvepathustadā ||
56911 āharannapi na svastho vinidro na prabudhyati |

56921 āharejjñānamarthāṃśca pumānamaravatsadā |

56932 śrīnṛsiṃha mahīpāla svastyastu tava bāhave ||

56952 yudhyamānāḥ paraṃ śaktyā svargaṃ yāntyaparāṅmukhāḥ ||
56961 āha smaiṣā nalādanyaṃ na juṣe manaseti yat |
56962 yauvanānumitenāsyāstanmṛṣābhūnmanobhuvā ||
56971 āhāraṃ prati yatkathāpi śamitā yanmaunamudrā mukhe  yaccakṣurvinimīlanaṃ tanulatā yattānave vartate |

56981 āhāraḥ phalamūlamātmarucitaṃ śayyā mahī valkalaṃ  saṃvītāya paricchadaḥ kuśasamitpuṣpāṇi putrā mṛgāḥ |
56982 vastrānnāśrayadānabhogavibhavā niryantraṇāḥ śākhino  mitrāṇītyadhikaṃ gṛheṣu gṛhiṇāṃ kiṃ nāma duḥkhādṛte ||
56991 āhāradoṣāya ca kākadīti  syādākuṭāni dhvanitaṃ raṇāya |
56992 kekedhvaniṣṭhā kuvatī kikī ca  trayaṃ tvidaṃ syātpuradūṣaṇāya ||
57001 āhāranidrābhayamaithunāni  sāmānyametatpaśubhirnarāṇām |

57011 āhāranirhāravihārayogāḥ  susaṃvṛtā dharmavidā tu kāryāḥ |

57021 āhārapānatāmbūlagandhamālyaphalādayaḥ |
57022 bhujyante yatsa bhogaśca tanmataḥ sādhusattamaiḥ ||
57031 āhārabhojī kurute'numodaṃ  naro vadhe sthāvarajaṅgamānām |
57032 tasyāpi tasmādduritānuṣaṅgam  ityāha yastaṃ prati vacmi kiṃcit ||
57041 āhāravarge sulabhe vicitre  vimuktapāpe bhuvi vidyamāne |
57042 prārambhaduḥkhaṃ vividhaṃ prapoṣya  cedasti gṛddhirna kimatti māṃsam ||
57051 āhārājjāyate vyādhirgarbhātkrūraśca jāyate |
57052 alakṣmīkaśca śayyāyāṃ svapāṭhādāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ ||
57061 āhārārthaṃ karma kuryādanindyaṃ  kuryāttaṃ ca prāṇasaṃdhāraṇārtham |

57071 āhāre ca bhavedrogī naṣṭo garbhaśca maithune |

57082 andho vastunirīkṣaṇe'tha gamane khañjaḥ paṭuḥ krandane  bhāgyenaiva hi labhyate punarasau sarvottamaḥ sevakaḥ ||

57092 maunaṃ cedamidaṃ ca śūnyamakhilaṃ yadviśvamābhāti te  tadbrūyāḥ sakhi yoginī kimasi bhoḥ kiṃ vā viyoginyasi ||
57101 āhāre vyavahāre ca tyaktalajjaḥ sukhī bhavet |
57102 dhanaṃ maitrīkaraṃ dāne cādāne śatrukāraṇam ||
57111 āhāre śucitā dhvanau madhuratā nīḍe parādhīnatā  bandhau nirmamatā vane rasikatā vācālatā mādhave |

57121 āhāro garalaṃ tṛtīyamalike cakṣuḥ kapālaṃ kare  vāsaḥ kuñjaracarma bhasmani ratirbhūṣā bhujaṅgādhipaḥ |
57122 janmālakṣyamasākṣikaṃ kulamavijñātā ca jātiḥ kathaṃ  sevyo'smābhirasau piśācapariṣadbhartā hatāḥ smo vayam ||
57131 āhāro garalāyate pratidinaṃ hāro'pi bhārāyate  candraścaṇḍakarāyate mṛdugatirvāto'pi vajrāyate |

51741 āhāro dviguṇaḥ strīṇāṃ buddhistāsāṃ caturguṇā |
51742 ṣaḍguṇo vyavasāyaśca kāmāścāṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
57151 āhitamuktāhāryaḥ  samyaksakalaprayogasampattyā |
57152 bhāvavihīno'pi naṭaḥ  sāmājikacittarañjanaṃ kurute ||

57162 galite tatpriyānetre rājaṃścitramidaṃ mahat ||

57181 āhuḥ satyaṃ hi paramaṃ dharmaṃ dharmavido janāḥ |
57182 ... ... ... ... ... ... ||
57191 āhuḥ sūkṣmataraṃ kiṃcidamātyaparirakṣaṇam |

57262 āptābhiḥ prativeśinībhirabhitaḥ saṃtyajya kundālayaṃ  soṣyantī sahakārasaṃtatiraliśreṇībhirāveṣṭyate ||
57271 āhūto vāpyanāhūto yo rājñāṃ dvāri tiṣṭhati |
57272 sa vai rājyaśriyaṃ bhuṅkte nāvamānī kadācana ||

57291 āhṛtābhyudyatāṃ bhikṣāṃ purastādapracoditām |
57292 mene prajāpatirgrāhyāmapi duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ ||
57301 āhṛtya parityaktā  janayantyarthāḥ sukhābhāsam |

57311 āhṛtya rakṣyamāṇāpi yatnenāntarvirāgiṇī |
57312 asanmaitrī ca veśyā ca śrīśca kasya kadā sthirā ||
57321 āhnikottāpadagdhānāṃ trayāṇāṃ jagatāṃ bata |

57351 āhvānaṃ kiṃ bhavati hi taroḥ kasyacitpraśnavijñāḥ  prāyaḥ kāryaṃ kimapi na kalau kurvate ke pareṣām |

57362 tathāpi na tadākhyātuṃ sarasvatyāpi śakyate ||

57382 candanaṃ dadhi tāmbūlaṃ mardanaṃ guṇavardhanam ||

57411 ikṣurnadīpravāho  dyūtaṃ mānagrahaśca he sutanu |

5742 1 ikṣo rasaṃ yathādāya kūrcakastyajyate janaiḥ |
5742 2 dharmasāraṃ tathādāya dehaṃ tyajati paṇḍitaḥ ||
57431 ikṣorvikārā matayaḥ kavīnāṃ  gavāṃ raso bālakaceṣṭitāni |
57432 tāmbūlamagryaṃ yuvateḥ kaṭākṣā  etānyaho śakra na santi nāke ||

57451 iṅgitajñāstu magadhāḥ prekṣitajñāstu kosalāḥ |
57452 ardhoktāḥ kurupāñcālāḥ sarvoktā dakṣiṇāpathāḥ ||
