57462 āptāḥ suśīghragā dūtā vāgmino mitabhāṣiṇaḥ ||
57471 iṅgitākāratattvajña ūhāpohaviśāradaḥ |
57472 śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca na ca mānī vimatsaraḥ ||
57481 iṅgitākāratattvajño balavān priyadarśanaḥ |
57482 apramādī sadā dakṣaḥ pratīhāraḥ sa ucyate ||
57491 iṅgitena nijarāganīradhiṃ  saṃvibhāvya caṭubhirguṇajñatām |
57492 bhaktatāṃ ca paricaryayāniśaṃ  sādhikādhikavaśaṃ vyadhatta tam ||
57501 icchatāṃ saha vadhūbhirabhedaṃ  yāminīvirahiṇāṃ vihagānām |
57502 āpureva mithunāni viyogaṃ  laṅghyate na khalu kālaniyogaḥ ||
57511 icchati mānī maraṇaṃ  na ca gacchati vairiṇaḥ śaraṇam |
57512 mānakṣaraṇaṃ maraṇaṃ  mānaprāṇasya kevalaṃ kṛtinaḥ ||
57521 icchati śatī sahasraṃ  sasahasraḥ koṭimīhate kartum |
57522 koṭiyuto'pi nṛpatvaṃ  nṛpo'pi bata cakravartitvam ||
57531 icchati śatī sahasraṃ sahasrī lakṣamīhate |
57532 lakṣādhipastato rājyaṃ rājyācca svargamīhate ||
57541 icchanti kecinnarakeṣu vāsaṃ  necchanti kecinnarakeṣu vāsam |
57542 śreyo hi tasmānnarakaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ  na garbhavāsātparamaṃ hi duḥkham ||
57551 icchantyabhīkṣṇaṃ kṣayamātmano'pi  na jñātayastulyakulasya lakṣmīm |
57552 namanti śatrūnna ca bandhuvṛddhiṃ  saṃtapyamānairhṛdayaiḥ sahante ||
57561 icchāṃ sundarapāṇḍya unnatimatiṃ bibhratsvayā saṃjñayā  niṣpādyābhyavahāravārayugalaṃ niṣkampasaṃpattikam |
57562 saṃpūrṇaṃ vidadhe gabhīramudaraṃ raṅgeśituḥ śārṅgiṇo  yasyābhūdbhuvanaiścaturdaśabhirapyāpūraṇaṃ durlabham ||
57571 iccheccedvipulāṃ maitrīṃ trīṇi tatra na kārayet |
57572 vāgvādamarthasaṃbandhaṃ tatpatnīparibhāṣaṇam ||
57581 icchetparamanusartuṃ  pratimāsaṃdarśanena viśadaruciḥ |
57582 anavāpya yenayogaṃ  bhavato hṛdayeparaṃ nidhīyeta ||
57591 icchedyastu sukhaṃ nivastumavanau gacchetsa rājñaḥ sabhāṃ  kalyāṇīṃ girameva saṃsadi vadetkāryaṃ vidadhyātkṛtī |
57592 akleśāddhanamarjayedadhipaterāvarjayedvallabhān  kurvītopakṛtiṃ janasya janayetkasyāpi nāpakriyām ||
57601 ijyācāradamāhiṃsādānasvādhyāyakarmaṇām |
57602 ayaṃ tu paramo dharmo yadyogenātmadarśanam ||
57611 ijyādhyayanadānāni tapaḥ satyaṃ dhṛtiḥ kṣamā |
57612 alobha iti mārgo'yaṃ dharmasyāṣṭavidhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
57621 tatra pūrvaścaturvargo dambhārthamapi sevyate |
57622 uttarastu caturvargo mahātmanyeva tiṣṭhati ||
57631 iḍayā saṃcaran vāyuḥ saumye kārye śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ |
57632 piṅgalāyāṃ tathā dīpte dvayoḥ kvāpi na śobhanaḥ ||
57641 iḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumṇā ca sarasvatī |
57642 gāndhārī hastijihvā ca pūṣā caiva nigadyate ||
57651 alambuṣā kuhūścaiva śaṅkhinī daśamī matā |
57652 etāḥ prāṇavahā jñeyāḥ pradhānā daśa nāḍikāḥ ||
57661 iḍā nāsāpuṭe vāme piṅgalā dakṣiṇe bhavet |
57662 suṣumṇā tālu bhittvaiva brahmadvāraṃ pravartitā ||
57671 iḍāyāṃ yadi bhūmyambutattve pravahatastadā |
57672 sthirasaumyādikāryāṇāmārambhaḥ siddhikṛdbhavet ||
57681 iḍā somasya nāḍī syātpiṅgalā sūryanāḍikā |
57682 iḍā saumyā bhavetvāmā piṅgalogrā ca dakṣiṇā ||
57691 itaḥ kākānīkaṃ pratibhayamitaḥ kauśikarutād ito gṛdhravyūhaḥ kulamidamitaḥ kaṅkavayasām |
57692 śmaśānāvasthe'sminnakhilaguṇavandhye hatamarāv api dvitrāḥ kecinna khalu kalavācaḥ śakunayaḥ ||
57701 itaḥ kekī nādaistudati śatakoṭipratibhaṭair itaḥ kāmaḥ kāmaṃ kaṭhinatarabāṇaiḥ praharati |
57702 ito garjatyuccairjaladharagaṇo bhīmaninadair vinā nāthaṃ jāne na sakhi bhavitā kiṃ nanu mama ||
57711 itaḥ krodho gṛdhraḥ prakaṭayati pakṣaṃ nijamitaḥ  sṛgālī tṛṣṇeyaṃ vivṛtavadanā dhāvati puraḥ |
57712 itaḥ krūraḥ kāmo vicarati piśācaściramaho  śmaśānaṃ saṃsāraḥ ka iha patitaḥ sthāsyati sukham ||
57721 itaḥ parānarbhakahāryaśastrān  vaidarbhi paśyānumatā mayāsi |
57722 evaṃvidhenāhavaceṣṭitena  tvaṃ prārthyase hastagatā mamaibhiḥ ||
57731 itaḥ paurastyāyāṃ kakubhi vivṛṇoti kramadalat tamisrāmarmāṇaṃ kiraṇakaṇikāmambaramaṇiḥ |
57732 ito niṣkrāmantī navaratiguroḥ proñchati vadhūḥ  svakastūrīpatrāṅkuramakarikāmudritamuraḥ ||
57741 itaḥ pratyādeśātsvajanamanugantuṃ vyavasitā  muhustiṣṭhetyuccairvadati guruśiṣye gurusame |
57742 punardṛṣṭiṃ bāṣpaprasarakaluṣāmarpitavatī  mayi krūre yattatsaviṣamiva śalyaṃ dahati mām ||
57751 itaḥ prāleyāṃśuḥ pralayamakarotkairavakula  klamacchedotsekaiḥ kiraṇanikaraireṣa tamasām |
57752 ito'pyājñāvajñāṃ sakhi na sahate duḥsahatara  pratāpaḥ pañceṣustadiha śaraṇaṃ sāhasarasaḥ ||
57761 itaḥ śuklā candradyutibhiriha raktāruṇakarais tamisrairapyantaḥskhalitagatibhirmecakaruciḥ |
57762 prabhātaśrīreṣā vilasati purasthā sukṛtināṃ  mimaṅkṣūṇāṃ jahnudyumaṇividhijāsaṃgama iva ||
57771 itaḥ śociḥ prācyāṃ diśi diśati bhānoraruṇatām  ito bhṛṅgaḥ kūjannabhikamalinīṃ proccalati ca |
57772 ito niryāntyuccairvihitasurataklāntiśithila  skhalatpādanyāsakṣaṇaraṇitamañjīramabalāḥ ||
57781 itaḥ sa daityaḥ prāptaśrīrneta evārhati kṣayam |
57782 viṣavṛkṣo'pi saṃvardhya svayaṃ chettumasāṃpratam ||
57791 itaḥ svapiti keśavaḥ kulamitastadīyadviṣām  itaśca śaraṇārthinaḥ śikharipatriṇaḥ śerate |
57792 ito'pi vaḍavānalaḥ saha samastasaṃvartakair aho vitatamūrjitaṃ bharasahaṃ ca sindhorvapuḥ ||
57801 itaradeva bahirmukhamucyate  hṛdi tu yatsphuratītaradeva tat |
57802 caritametadadhīravitārakaṃ  dhuri payaḥpratibimbamivāsatām ||
57811 itarapāpaphalāni yathecchayā  vitara tāni sahe caturānana |
57812 arasikeṣu kavitvanivedanaṃ  śirasi mā likha mā likha mā likha ||
57821 itarabhajanaghanarasataḥ  phalaniṣpattirnavā bhavediti na |
57822 muktāḥ paraṃ tu loke  svātighanarasaṃ vinā na jāyeran ||
57831 itarāṇyapi rakṣāṃsi peturvānarakoṭiṣu |
57832 rajāṃsi samarotthāni tacchoṇitanadīṣviva ||
57841 itarāścārthamicchanti rūpamicchanti dārikāḥ |
57842 jñātayaḥ kulamicchanti svargamicchanti tāpasāḥ ||
57851 itaretarayantritoruyugmaṃ  kaṭhinorustanapīḍitābhirāmam |
57852 bhujamūlaśayānugaṇḍamūlaṃ  mithunaṃ syūtamivābhavanniśāyām ||
57861 itaropāyaduḥsādhye caṇḍadaṇḍo mahīpatiḥ |
57862 aduṣṭāyatyasau nīteraśnāti vipulaṃ phalam ||
57871 itaścañcaccūtacyutamadhucayā vānti caturāḥ  samīrāḥ saṃtoṣaṃ diśi diśi diśanto madhulihām |
57872 niśānte kāntānāṃ smarasamarakeliśramamuṣo  vijṛmbhante jṛmbhākalitakamalāmodasuhṛdaḥ ||
57881 itaścandraḥ sāndraḥ smaramayavayaḥsaṃdhimadhuraḥ  sphuranmugdhākelismitamiva mayūkhaiḥ sukhayati |
57882 cakorāṇāṃ cakraṃ kumudasamudāyo'pi ca śaran  niśārambhe'muṣmin samasamayamantarvikasati ||
57891 itaścetaścādbhirvighaṭitataṭaḥ seturudare  dharitrī durlaṅghyā bahulahimapaṅko girirayam |
57892 idānīṃ nirvṛtte karituraganīrājanavidhau  na jāne yātārastava ca ripavaḥ kena ca pathā ||
57901 itastataścaṅkramaṇo rajobhiḥ  krīḍanmanomattamataṅgajo'yam |
57902 yaḥ sarvadā pippalabhogatuṣṭas tacchāntaye tvaṃ harimāśrayasva ||
57911 itastato bhaṣan bhūri na patetpiśunaḥ śunaḥ |
57912 avadātatayā kiṃ ca na bhedo haṃsataḥ sataḥ ||
57921 itastato vātavidhūticañcalair nīrandhritāśāgaganairdhvajāṃśukaiḥ |
57922 lakṣaiḥ kvaṇatkāñcanakiṅkiṇīkulair amajji dhūlījaladhau nabhogate ||
57931 itastato vānti viśiṣya yasyāṃ  vātāḥ śakṛdveśmavihāravisrāḥ |
57932 sā varṇyate rauravarājadhānī  kena pratolī manasāpyagamyā ||
57941 itastato'smin vilasanti meroḥ  samānavapre maṇisānurāgāḥ |
57942 striyaśca patyau surasundarībhiḥ  samā navapremaṇi sānurāgāḥ ||
57951 itastāvannetre valaya malayādre nidhirapām  apārastvatpādapraṇayaparatantro nivasati |
57952 athātmānaṃ kiṃ na smarasi kulaśailaṃ kimayaśaḥ  patākā sarpaughaiḥ pratiśikhariśākhāsu vahasi ||
57961 itastrasadvidrutabhūbhṛdujjhitā  priyātha dṛṣṭā vanamānavījanaiḥ |
57962 śaśaṃsa pṛṣṭādbhutamātmadeśajaṃ  śaśitviṣaḥ śītalaśīlatāṃ kila ||
57971 iti kṛtavacanāyāḥ kaścidabhyetya bibhyad galitanayanavāreryāti pādāvanāmam |
57972 karuṇamapi samarthaṃ mānināṃ mānabhede  ruditamuditamastraṃ yoṣitāṃ vigraheṣu ||
57981 iti kṣitīśo navatiṃ navādhikāṃ  mahākratūnāṃ mahanīyaśāsanaḥ |
57982 samārurukṣurdivamāyuṣaḥ kṣaye  tatāna sopānaparaṃparāmiva ||
57991 iti gadantamanantaramaṅganā  bhujayugonnamanoccatarastanī |
57992 praṇayinaṃ rabhasādudaraśriyā  valibhayālibhayādiva sasvaje ||
58001 iti gaditavatī ruṣā jaghāna  sphuritamanoramapakṣmakeśareṇa |
58002 śravaṇaniyamitena kāntamanyā  samamasitāmburuheṇa cakṣuṣā ca ||
58011 iti gantumicchumabhidhāya puraḥ  kṣaṇadṛṣṭipātavikasadvadanām |
58012 svakarāvalambanavimuktagalat kalakāñci kāṃcidaruṇattaruṇaḥ ||
58021 iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayānagha |
58022 etadbuddhvā buddhimān syātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata ||
58031 iti jagati na rakṣituṃ samarthaḥ  kvacidapi kaścidapi prasahya nārīm |
58032 avati tu satataṃ viśuddha ekaḥ  kulayuvatīṃ nijasattvapāśabandhaḥ ||
58041 evaṃ cerṣyā nāma duḥkhaikahetur moghaḥ puṃsāṃ dveṣadāyī pareṣām |
58042 yo'yaṃ mā bhūdrakṣaṇāyāṅganānām  atyautsukyaṃ pratyutāsāṃ tanoti ||
58051 iti tattvadhiyaḥ paricintya budhāḥ  sakalasya janasya vinaśvaratām |
58052 na manāgapi cetasi saṃdadhate  śucamaṅgayaśaḥsukhanāśakarām ||
58061 iti deva bhavatyudārasattvo  dṛḍhabhaktaśca vilāsinījano'pi |
58062 avarodhasamo mahīpatīnāṃ  kimutānyaḥ kulajaḥ purandhrilokaḥ ||
58071 iti deva sadaiva hāsyabhāvaṃ  paribhāve ca janasya nindyatāṃ ca |
58072 vipadāspadatāṃ ca yānti mūḍhā  iha santastu bhavanti pūjanīyāḥ ||
58081 iti dvikṛtvaḥ śucimṛṣṭabhojināṃ  dināni teṣāṃ katicinmudā yayuḥ |
58082 dviraṣṭasaṃvatsaravārasundarī  parīṣṭibhistuṣṭimupeyuṣāṃ niśi ||
58091 iti dharmatarormūlamaśuddhaṃ yasya mānasam |
58092 śuddhaṃ yasya ca tadrūpaṃ phalaṃ tasya na saṃśayaḥ ||
58101 iti nikhilamudāramarthasārtha  praṇihitamekamiheva khaḍgaśāstre |
58102 giriśamatamidaṃ niṣevya cakre  kṣitipatimantrisamūhacakravartī ||
58111 iti netrādivikārair vaśamupanītaṃ pralīnadhairyāṅgam |
58112 māragrahābhibhūtaṃ  parimṛṣṭaprāṅnirākṛtismaraṇam ||
58121 prādurbhūtariraṃsaṃ  kṣaṇe kṣaṇe jaghanadeśagatadṛṣṭim |
58122 pakvāmramiva vimokṣyasi  pūrvavadācūṣya niḥśeṣam ||
58131 iti pathi viniveśitātmano  ripurapi gacchati sādhu mitratām |
58132 tadavanipatimatsarādṛte  vinayaguṇena jagadvaśaṃ nayet ||
58141 iti parigaṇitārthaḥ śāstramārgānusārī  niyamayati yatātmā yaḥ prajā daṇḍanītyā |
58142 apunarapagamāya prāptamārgapracārā  sarita iva samudraṃ saṃpadastaṃ viśanti ||
58151 iti pariṇayamitthaṃ yānamekatra yāne  daracakitakaṭākṣaprekṣaṇaṃ cānayostatat |
58152 divi diviṣadadhīśāḥ kautukenāvalokya  praṇidadhuriva gantuṃ nākamānandasāndrāḥ ||
58161 iti pūrvakarmaniyataṃ  bhavitavyaṃ jagati yasya jantoryat |
58162 tadayatnena sa purataḥ  patitaṃ prāpnotyasādhyamapi ||
58171 iti prakupitoragapramukhabhaṅgurāṃ sarvadā  nidhāya nijacetasi prabaladuḥkhadāṃ saṃsṛtim |
58172 vimuñcata parigrahagrahamanārjavaṃ sajjanā  yadīcchata sukhāmṛtaṃ rasitumastasarvāśubham ||
58181 iti pravīre subhage ca satyato  vivekinīnāmapi deva yoṣitām |
58182 calaṃ mano dhāvati yatra kutracid viśuddhasattvā viralāḥ punaḥ striyaḥ ||
58191 iti priye pṛcchati mānavihvalā  kathaṃcidantardhṛtabāṣpagadgadam |
58192 na kiṃcidityeva jagāda yadvadhūḥ  kiyanna tenaiva tayāsya varṇitam ||
58201 iti bahubhirupāyaiḥ kuṭṭanī kāmukānāṃ  kṛtasukṛtavihīnā vañcanāṃ sā kṛtaghnā (?) |
58202 vanabhuvi mṛgabandhaṃ hanta paśyanti nityaṃ  tadapi hariṇaśāvāḥ kūṭapāśaṃ viśanti ||
58211 iti madamadanābhyāṃ rāgiṇaḥ spaṣṭarāgān  anavaratarataśrīsaṅginastānavekṣya |
58212 abhajata parivṛttiṃ sātha paryastahastā  rajaniravanatendurlajjayādhomukhīva ||
58221 iti muṣitadhiyaḥ śriyā prayāntyā  rabhasavaśādavicintya dagdhabhūpāḥ |
58222 balabharabahumānataḥ pataṅga  vratamupayānti parapratāpadīpe ||
58231 iti yasmādubhau lokau dhārayatyātmavānnṛpaḥ |
58232 prajānāṃ ca tataḥ samyagdaṇḍaṃ daṇḍīva dhārayet ||
58241 iti ratisamayopadeśayuktyā  ratagurudarśitayā puraṃdhrilokaḥ |
58242 nijaparaparabhāgavṛttimaujjhīt smaraparamādvayabhūmikānilīnaḥ ||
58251 iti rājaguṇānetān yathoktān yo'nutiṣṭhati |
58252 anubhūyeha bhadrāṇi pretya svarge mahīyate ||
58261 iti rājyakalatramitraputrān  gṛhadhāmaṃ ca tṛṇāya manyamānaḥ |
58262 gurusattvarajastamaḥ kalaṅkāṃ  prakṛtiṃ hātumagādvanaṃ narendraḥ ||
58271 iti vacanaṃ bhūmipateḥ  śrutvā mantrī vihasya sāsūyaḥ |
58272 tamuvāca kasya rājan  veśyācarite'sti viśvāsaḥ ||
58281 iti vadati sakhījane nimīlad dviguṇitasāndratarākṣipakṣmamālā |
58282 apatadalibhayena bharturaṅkaṃ  bhavati hi viklavatā guṇo'ṅganānām ||
58291 iti vadati sakhījane'nurāgād dayitatamāmaparaściraṃ pratīkṣya |
58292 tadanugamavaśādanāyatāni  nyadhita mimāna ivāvanīṃ padāni ||
58301 iti viracitabandhā paddhatiryā mayeyaṃ  sakalaguṇigaṇānāṃ prītaye sāstu nityam |
58302 vipulavimaladīvyatsatkalānāṃ nidhānaṃ  taruṇataraṇiruddhā vidviṣatkauśikānām ||
58311 iti vismṛtānyakaraṇīyamātmanaḥ  sacivāvalambitadhuraṃ dharādhipam |
58312 parivṛddharāgamanubandhasevayā  mṛgayā jahāra catureva kāminī ||
58321 iti śāsati senānyāṃ gacchatastānanekadhā |
58322 niṣidhya hasatā kiṃcittasthe tatrāndhakāriṇā ||
58331 iti saṃsāraduḥkhārkatāpatāpitacetasām |
58332 vimuktipādapacchāyāmṛte kutra sukhaṃ nṛṇām ||
58341 iti saśarīrayā kṣaṇamiva kṣaṇadāḥ kṣapayan  saha viśarīrayā dayitayā virasān divasān |
58342 dinarajanīvihāraviparītamahaṃ caritai  rathacaraṇāhvayasya caritāni viḍambitavān ||
58351 iti striyo devi mahākulodgatāḥ  viśuddhadhīraiścaritairupāsate |
58352 sadaiva bhartāramananyamānasāḥ  patiḥ satīnāṃ paramaṃ hi daivatabh ||
58361 iti sphuṭaṃ tadvacasastayādarāt suraspṛhāropaviḍambanādapi |
58362 karāṅkasuptaikakapolakarṇayā  śrutaṃ ca tadbhāṣitamaśrutaṃ ca tat ||
58371 iti smaraḥ śīghramatiścakāra taṃ  vadhūṃ ca romāñcabhareṇa karkaśau |
58372 skhaliṣyati snigdhatanuḥ priyādiyaṃ  mradīyasī pīḍanabhīrudoryugāt ||
58381 iti sma rājā nayavartmanā vrajan  samudyamī maṇḍalaśuddhimācaret |
58382 virājate sādhu viśuddhamaṇḍalaḥ  śaracchaśīva pratirañjayan prajāḥ ||
58391 iti sma rājā vinayaṃ nayānvito  niṣevamāṇo naradevasevitam |
58392 padaṃ samākrāmati bhāsvaraṃ śriyaḥ  śiro mahāratnagirerivonnatam ||
58401 itihāsapurāṇāni śṛṇuyāttadanantaram |
58402 bhuktavān vihareccaiva strībhirantaḥpure saha ||
5840 1 ītihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃhayet |
5840 2 bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ pracariṣyati ||
58411 itihāsottamādasmājjāyante kavibuddhayaḥ |
58412 pañcabhya iva bhūtebhyo lokasaṃvidhayastrayaḥ ||
58421 itīrayitvā viratāṃ sa tāṃ punar girānujagrāhatarāṃ narādhipaḥ |
58422 virutya viśrāntavatīṃ tapātyaye  ghanāghanaścātakamaṇḍalīmiva ||
58431 itīṣṭamapyaniṣṭāya jāyate'vidhinā kṛtam |
58432 tasmānna vidhimutsṛjya prājñaḥ kurvīta kiṃcana |
58433 aprekṣāpūrvakārī ca nindyate'vadyakṛtkṣaṇāt ||
58441 ito gaṅgābhaṅgā ghaṭitataṭabhaṅgā punarito  davajvālā jvālājvalitatarumālā vanabhuvaḥ |
58442 saraṃhaḥ siṃho'gre dhvanati mama haṃho na hi gatir vinā daivaṃ daivaṃ hariṇaśiśurevaṃ pralapati ||
58451 ito dāvajvālaḥ sthalabhuva ito jālajaṭilā  ito vyādho dhāvatyayamanupadaṃ vakritadhanuḥ |
58452 ito'pyagre tiṣṭhatyayamajagaro vistṛtamukhaḥ  kva yāyātkiṃ kuryānmṛgaśiśurayaṃ daivavaśagaḥ ||
58461 ito na kiṃcitparato na kiṃcid yato yato yāmi tato na kiṃcit |
58462 vicāryamāṇaṃ hi jaganna kiṃcit svātmāvabodhādadhikaṃ na kiṃcit ||
58471 ito bhraṣṭastato bhraṣṭaḥ paramekāntiveṣabhāk |
58472 na samsārasukhaṃ tasya naiva muktisukhaṃ bhavet ||
58481 ito mṛtyurito vyādhirito vipadito jarā |
58482 caturaṅgā tulyabalā hanti lokamanityatā ||
58491 ito vidyutpuñjasphuritamasakṛdbhāvayatu mām  itaḥ kekānekā haratu hṛdayaṃ nirdayamidam |
58492 itaḥ kāmo vāmaḥ praharatu muhuḥ puṅkhitaśaro  gatāsi tvaṃ dūre capalanayane preyasi yataḥ ||
58501 ito vidyudvallīvilasitamitaḥ ketakataru  sphuradgandhaḥ prodyajjaladaninadasphūrjitamitaḥ |
58502 itaḥ kekikrīḍākalakalaravaḥ pakṣmaladṛśāṃ  kathaṃ yāsyantyete virahadivasāḥ saṃbhṛtarasāḥ ||
58511 ito vipinapaṅktayastilakitā rasālāṅkurair marunmalayabhūritaḥ kalamitaḥ pikīnāṃ rutam |
58512 itaśca navacampakaiḥ surabhitāḥ samantāddiśas tadadya mayi tāṃ vinā bhajatu ghasmaratvaṃ smaraḥ ||
58521 ito hāsyataraṃ loke kiṃcidanyanna vidyate |
58522 yattu durjana ityāha sajjanaṃ durjanaḥ svayam ||
58531 itthaṃ kavikuṭumbasya vacāṃsi vicinoti yaḥ |
58532 aniddhavacanasyāpi tasya vaśyā sarasvatī ||
58541 itthaṃ kelitatīrvihṛtya yamunākūle samaṃ rādhayā  tadromāvalimauktikāvaliyuge veṇībhramaṃ bibhrati |
58542 tatrāhlādikucaprayāgaphalayorlipsāvatorhastayor vyāpārāḥ puruṣottamasya dadatu sphītaṃ mudāṃ saṃpadam ||
58551 itthaṃ kriyāsu nivasantyapi yāsu tāsu  puṃsāṃ śriyaḥ prabalasattvabahiṣkṛtāsu |
58552 evaṃ ca sāhasadhaneṣvatha buddhimatsu  saṃtuṣya dānaniratāḥ kṣitipā bhavanti ||
58561 ityaihikena ca purā vihitena cāpi  svenaiva karmavibhavena śubhāśubhena |
58562 śaśvadbhavettadanurūpavicitrabhogaḥ  sarvo hi nāma sasurāsura eṣa sargaḥ ||
58571 itthaṃ copārjito yatnādguṇo'pi vidhure vidhau |
58572 saṃpattaye na na paraṃ jāyate tu vipattaye ||
58581 mūle hyavikṛte sadā sikte prajñānavāriṇā |
58582 nayālavālaḥ phalati prāyaḥ pauruṣapādapaḥ ||
58591 itthaṃ talpatalādhirohaṇamiyaṃ parṇārpaṇaprakriyā  śayyāyā vacanakramasya dayitasyaivaṃvidhārādhanā |
58592 evaṃ keligṛhopadehali balādānīyamānā muhuś cāṭūktiprakaraiściraṃ navavadhūrālībhiradhyāpyate ||
5859 1 itthaṃ tena nirīkṣitaṃ na ca mayāpyevaṃ samālokitas tenoktaṃ subhagena tatra na mayā dattaṃ vaco mandayā |
5859 2 tatsatyaṃ kathayāli kiṃ sa subhagaḥ kupyenna mahyaṃ gata  ityuktvā sudṛśā kayāpi valitagrīvaṃ dṛśau sphārite ||
58601 itthaṃ duravadhāryaiva strīcittasya gatiḥ kila |
58602 anyāsaktiṃ ca kurvanti mriyante ca patiṃ vinā ||
58611 itthaṃ dharmārjitā lakṣmīrāsaṃtatyanapāyinī |
58612 itarā tu jalāpātatuṣārakaṇanaśvarī ||
58621 ato yateta dharmeṇa dhanamarjayituṃ pumān |
58622 rājā tu sutarāṃ yena mūlaṃ rājyatarordhanam ||
58631 itthaṃ vṛḍhataravāmita  manasāṃ puṃsāmasāṃprataṃ purataḥ |
58632 veśavilāsavatīnām  aśarīraśaravyathākathanam ||
58641 itthaṃ nārīrghaṭayitumalaṃ kāmibhiḥ kāmamāsan  prāleyāṃśoḥ sapadi rucayaḥ śāntamānāntarāyāḥ |
58642 ācāryatvaṃ ratiṣu vilasanmanmamathaśrīvilāsā  hrīpratyūhapraśamakuśalāḥ śīdhavaścakrurāsām ||
58651 itthaṃ paśupatipeśala  pāśakalīlāprayuktavakrokteḥ |
58652 harṣavaśataralatārakam  ānanamavyādbhavānyā vaḥ ||
58661 itthaṃ prajñaiva nāmeha pradhānaṃ lokavartanam |
58662 jīvatyarthadaridro'pi dhīdaridro na jīvati ||
58671 itthaṃ phalati śuddhena siktaṃ saṃkalpavāriṇā |
58672 puṇyabījamapi svalpaṃ puṃsāṃ kṛṣikṛtāmiva ||
58681 tadeva dūṣitaṃ devi duṣṭasaṃkalpapāthasā |
58682 phalatyaniṣṭam ... ... ... ... ||
58691 itthaṃ madhūtthaṃ rasamudgirantī  tadoṣṭhabandūkadhanurvisṛṣṭā |
58692 karṇātprasūnāśugapañcabāṇī  vāṇīmiṣeṇāsya mano viveśa ||
58701 itthaṃ yuktimupāyānāṃ kurvāṇasya catuṣṭayīm |
58702 vrajatīnduprabhāgauraṃ parairakṣayyatāṃ yaśaḥ ||
58711 itthaṃ vihṛtya vanitābhirudasyamānaṃ  pīnastanorujaghanasthalaśālinībhiḥ |
58712 utsarpitormicayalaṅghitatīradeśam  autsukyanunnamiva vāri puraḥ pratasthe ||
58721 itthaṃ sabhāpatirbhūtvā yaḥ kāvyāni parīkṣate |
58722 yaśastasya jagadvyāpi sa sukhī tatra tatra ca ||
58731 itthaṃ samutthavirahānalatīvratāpa  saṃtāpitāṅga karipuṅgava muñca śokam |
58732 dhātrā svahastalikhitāni lalāṭapaṭṭe  ko vākṣarāṇi parimārjayituṃ samarthaḥ ||
58741 itthaṃ subuddhiralpena deva yatnena bodhyate |
58742 na kṛcchreṇāpi mahatā nirvicāramatiḥ punaḥ ||
58751 itthaṃ svadurnayavipākavaśena divyāḥ  śāpacyutā hyavataranti manuṣyaloke |
58752 bhuktvā phalaṃ taducitaṃ ca nijāṃ gatiṃ te  pūrvārjitena sukṛtena punaḥ prayānti ||
58761 itthamārādhyamāno'pi kliśnāti bhuvanatrayam |
58762 śāmyetpratyapakāreṇa nopakāreṇa durjanaḥ ||
58771 ityaguhyaṃ nigūhante guhyaṃ prakaṭayanti ca |
58772 maurkhyābhimānenādātuṃ mūrkhāḥ pratyayamātmani ||
58781 ityaṅgaiḥ saṃyutaḥ sarvairdehino bālakākṛtiḥ |
58782 māturāhārarasato dehe garbho'bhivardhate ||
58791 ityajñānatamaśchannāḥ svadoṣonmārgagāminaḥ |
58792 apuraskṛtasacchāstradīpā bhraśyanti niścitam ||
58801 ityanarthāya śabdaikaparo tātparyavijjaḍaḥ |
58802 ... ... ... ... ... ... ||
58811 ityanudvegaśīlā ye bhavyā dhairyāvalambanāḥ |
58812 dūrabhraṣṭāmapi nijāṃ bhūmiṃ saṃprāpnuvanti te ||
58821 ityanyadupacāreṇa mitramanyattu satyataḥ |
58822 tulye'pi snigdhatāyoge tailaṃ tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ ghṛtam ||
58831 ityanyaraktacittā strībhujaṅgī hantyasaṃśayam |
58832 ... ... ... ... ... ... ||
58841 ityabuddhidhanādhānanidhānairvividhodayaiḥ |
58842 kūṭapaṇyairasāmānyaistāruṇyamativāhyate ||
58851 ityarthalobhānmithyaiva vijñānakhyāpanecchavaḥ |
58852 mūrkhāḥ putramapi ghnanti na rajyetteṣu buddhimān ||
58861 ityākhyāte pavanatanayaṃ maithilīvonmukhī sā  tvāmutkaṇṭhocchvasitahṛdayā vīkṣya saṃbhāvya caiva |
58862 śroṣyatyasmātparamavahitā saumya sīmantinīnāṃ  kāntodantaḥ suhṛdupanataḥ saṃgamātkiṃcidūnaḥ ||
58871 ityādiguṇasaṃpanne lokayātrāvidi sthire |
58872 nirvṛtaḥ pitarīvāste yatra lokaḥ sa pārthivaḥ ||
58881 ityādi dūṣyān saṃdūṣya prajānāmabhivṛddhaye |
58882 vinayañśriyamutkarṣaṃ rājā śalyaṃ samuddharet ||
58891 ityuktavatyā yadalopi lajjā  sānaucitī cetasi naścakāstu |
58892 smarastu sākṣī tadadoṣatāyām  unmādya yastattadavīvadattām ||
58901 ityudgate śaśini peśalakāntadūtī  saṃlāpasaṃcalitalocanamānasābhiḥ |
58902 agrāhi maṇḍanavidhirviparītabhūṣā  vinyāsahāsitasakhījanamaṅganābhiḥ ||
58911 ityetattapaso devā mahābhāgyaṃ pracakṣate |
58912 sarvasyāsya prapaśyantastapasaḥ puṇyamudbhavam ||
58921 ityetāḥ kuṭilatarāḥ  krūrācārā gatatrapāścapalāḥ |
58922 yo nāma vetti rāmāḥ  sa strībhirṇaiva vañcyate matimān ||
58931 ityevaṃ bahuhṛdayā  bahujihvā bahukarāśca bahumāyāḥ |
58932 tattvena satyarahitāḥ  ko jānāti sphuṭaṃ veśyāḥ ||
58941 ityevaṃ yoṣito rājan bhedasya vyasanasya ca |
58942 parābhavasya ca padaṃ sevetāśaṅkito'tha tāḥ ||
58951 idaṃ kavivarairnityamākhyānamupajīvyate |
58952 udayaprepsubhirbhṛtyairabhijāta iveśvaraḥ ||
58961 idaṃ kiṃ te nyastaṃ valayini kare vaktrakamalaṃ  na yuktaḥ kopo'yaṃ praṇayini nirāgasyapi jane |
58962 bruvāṇe mayyevaṃ śvasanaviṣamotkampitakucaṃ  mṛgākṣyāstatkālaṃ nayanajalamevottaramabhūt ||
58971 idaṃ kilāvyājamanoharaṃ vapus tapaḥkṣamaṃ sādhayituṃ ya icchati |
58972 dhruvaṃ sa nīlotpalapatradhārayā  samillatāṃ chettumṛṣirvyavasyati ||
58981 idaṃ kṛtamidaṃ kāryamidamanyatkṛtākṛtam |
58982 evamīhāsukhāsaktaṃ kṛtāntaḥ kurute vaśe ||
58991 idaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ priyatama nanu śvetamatha kiṃ  gamiṣyāmo yāmo bhavatu gamanenātha bhavatu |
58992 purā yenaivaṃ me ciramanusṛtā cittapadavī  sa evānyo jātaḥ sakhi paricitāḥ kasya puruṣāḥ ||
59001 idaṃ ca tvāṃ sarvaparaṃ bravīmi  puṇyaṃ padaṃ tāta mahāviśiṣṭam |
59002 na jātu kāmānna bhayānna lobhād dharmaṃ tyajejjīvitasyāpi hetoḥ ||
59011 idaṃ jñeyamidaṃ jñeyamiti yastṛṣitaścaret |
59012 api kalpasahasreṣu naiva jñeyamavāpnuyāt ||
59021 idaṃ tatkālindītaṭamiha hi kaṃsāsurabhido  yaśaḥ śṛṇvadvaktraṃ skhalitakavalaṃ gokulamabhūt |
59022 bhramādveṇukvāṇapraṇayamasṛṇottāramadhura  svarābhirgopībhirdiśi diśi samudgīrṇamaniśam ||
59031 idaṃ tatsnehasarvasvaṃ samamāḍhyadaridrayoḥ |
59032 acandanamanauśīraṃ hṛdayasyānulepanam ||
59041 idaṃ tāvaccitraṃ yadavanitale pārvaṇaśaśī  kalaṅkādunmuktaḥ kimapi ca tadantarvilasati |
59042 pravālaṃ māṇikyaṃ kuvalayadalaṃ manmathadhanur manovīṇāvādadhvaniriti mahaccitramadharam ||
59051 idaṃ te kenoktaṃ kathaya kamalātaṅkavadane  yadetasmin hemnaḥ kaṭakamiti dhatse khalu dhiyam |
59052 idaṃ tadduḥsādhākramaṇaparamāstraṃ smṛtibhuvā  tava prītyā cakraṃ karakamalamūle vinihitam ||
59061 idaṃ tvihotpātayugaṃ prthivyāṃ  mahābhayaṃ śākunikā vadanti |
59062 yadvāyaso maithunasaṃniviṣṭo  dṛśyeta yadvā dhavalaḥ kadācit ||
59071 idaṃ dūrvākāṇḍadyutimuṣi kapole katipayaiḥ  śramāmbhobhiḥ kīrṇaṃ sahajabakulāmodasubhagam |
59072 samākāṅkṣe tāmrādharamanumanuṣva priyatame  manojñaṃ te pātuṃ mukhakamalamāghrātumathavā ||
59081 idaṃ nabhasi bhīṣaṇabhramadulūkakolāhale  niśācaravilāsinīnivahadattanetrotsave |
59082 parisphurati nirbharapracurapaṅkamagnollasad varāhakulamāṃsalaṃ prabalabandamandhaṃ tamaḥ ||
59091 idaṃ nāsīnna cotpannaṃ na cāsīnna bhaviṣyati |
59092 tattadbrahmaiva sadrūpamidamitthamavasthitam ||
59101 idaṃ nṛpaprārthibhirujjhito'rthibhir maṇipraroheṇa vivṛdhya rohaṇaḥ |
59102 kiyaddinairambaramāvariṣyate  mudhā munirvindhyamarundha bhūdharam ||
59111 idaṃ paramasundaraṃ tanupuraṃ kuraṅgīdṛśāṃ  nivārya khalu śaiśavaṃ svayamanena nītaṃ balāt |
59112 tadāgamanaśaṅkayā makaraketunā kiṃ kṛtaṃ  payodharadharādharau trivalivāhinīdustarau ||
59121 idaṃ prakṛtyā viṣayairvaśīkṛtaṃ  parasparastrīdhanalolupaṃ jagat |
59122 sanātane vartmani sādhusevite  pratiṣṭhate daṇḍabhayopapīḍitam ||
59131 idaṃ prāyo loke na paricitapūrvaṃ nayanayor na yācñā yatpuṃsaḥ suguṇaparimāṇaṃ laghayati |
59132 viśadbhirviśvātmā svavapuṣi baliprārthanakṛte  trapālīnairaṅgairyadayamabhavadvāmanatanuḥ ||
59141 idaṃ maghonaḥ kuliśaṃ dhārāsaṃnihitānalam |
59142 smaraṇaṃ yasya daityastrīgarbhapātāya kalpate ||
59151 idaṃ madaṃ candramasaḥ samantād asmatsapatnasya hariṣyatīti |
59152 yasmin purandhrīvadanasyalakṣmīṃ  nijāṃ vyadhuḥ prābhṛtamambujāni ||
59161 idaṃ yugasahasreṣu bhaviṣyadabhavaddinam |
59162 tadapyadyatvamāpannaṃ kā kathā maraṇāvadheḥ ||
59171 idaṃ labdhamidaṃ naṣṭamidaṃ lapsye manoratham |
59172 idaṃ cintayatāmeva jīrṇamāyuḥ śarīriṇām ||
59181 idaṃ vaktraṃ sākṣādvirahitakalaṅkaḥ śaśadharaḥ  sudhādhārādhāraścirapariṇataṃ bimbamadharaḥ |
59182 ime netre rātriṃdivamadhikaśobhe kuvalaye  tanurlāvaṇyānāṃ jaladhiravagāhe sukhataraḥ ||
59191 idaṃ viśvaṃ kuṭumbo na iti yeṣāṃ suniścayaḥ |
59192 te śāntāḥ paramodārāḥ keṣāṃ vandyā na sādhavaḥ ||
59201 idaṃ viśvaṃ pālyaṃ vidhivadabhiyuktena manasā  priyāśoko jīvaṃ kusumamiva gharmo glapayati |
59202 svayaṃ kṛtvā tyāgaṃ vilapanavinodo'pyasulabhas tadadyāpyucchvāso bhavati nanu lābho hi ruditam ||
59211 idaṃ vyomasaromadhye bhāti candrasitotpalam |
59212 malino'ntargato yatra kalaṅko bhramarāyate ||
59221 idaṃ śarīraṃ puruṣasya mohajaṃ  yathā pṛthagbhautikamīyate gṛham |
59222 yathaudakaiḥ pārthivataijasairjanaḥ  kālena jāto vikṛto vinaśyati ||
59231 yathānalo dāruṣu bhinna īyate  yathānilo dehagataḥ pṛthaksthitaḥ |
59232 yathā nabhaḥ sarvagataṃ na sajjate  tathā pumān sarvaguṇāśrayaḥ paraḥ ||
59241 idaṃ śarīraṃ ślathasaṃdhi jarjaraṃ  patatyavaśyaṃ pariṇāmadurvaham |
59242 kimauṣadhaṃ pṛcchasi mūḍha durmate  nirāmayaṃ kṛṣṇarasāyanaṃ piba ||
59251 idaṃ śītaṃ pāthaḥ pibata pathikā muñcata manāk pathaḥ śrāntiṃ kāntāsmṛtijanitacintādviguṇitām |
59252 iti sphītāpāṅgaṃ mṛdumadhuravāgbhaṅgihasitaṃ  prapāpālīmālā harati taruṇānāṃ pathi gatim ||
59261 idaṃ svajanadehajātanayamātṛbhāryāmayaṃ  vicitramiha kenacidracitamindrajālaṃ nanu |
59262 kva kasya kathamatra ko bhavati tattvato dehinaḥ  svakarmavaśavartinastribhuvane nijo vā paraḥ ||
59271 idaṃ svastyayanaṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ buddhivivardhanam |
59272 idaṃ yaśasyaṃ satatamidaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ param ||
59281 idaṃ hi puṃsastapasaḥ śrutasya vā  sviṣṭasya sūktasya ca buddhadattayoḥ |
59282 avicyuto'rthaḥ kavibhirnirūpito  yaduttamaślokaguṇānuvarṇanam ||
59291 idaṃ hi prāṇayaśasaṃ krayavikrayapattanam |
59292 svāmisatkāraśalyānāmatraivoddharaṇī kriyā ||
59301 idaṃ hi māhātmyaviśeṣasūcakaṃ  vadanti cihnaṃ mahatāṃ manīṣiṇaḥ |
59302 mano yadeṣāṃ sukhaduḥkhasaṃbhave  prayāti no harṣaviṣādavaśyatām ||
59311 idaṃ hi vaidagdhyarahasyamuttamaṃ  paṭhenna sūktiṃ kavimāninaḥ puraḥ |
59312 na kevalaṃ tāṃ na vibhāvayatyasau  svakāvyabandhena vināśayatyapi ||
59321 idamananyaparāyaṇamanyathā  hṛdayasaṃnihite hṛdayaṃ mama |
59322 yadi samarthayase madirekṣaṇe  madanabāṇahato'smi hataḥ punaḥ ||
59331 idamanucitamakramaśca puṃsāṃ  yadiha jarasyapi mānmatho vikāraḥ |
59332 yadapi ca na kṛtaṃ nitambinīnāṃ  stanapatanāvadhi jīvitaṃ rataṃ vā ||
59341 idamanuditahotuḥ ko'pi homāvasāna  jvaladanalamavādītkuṇḍamākhaṇḍalasya |
59342 maṇighaṭamabhiṣeke prātarasyocureke  kalitakiraṇatoyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ caṇḍabhāsaḥ ||
59351 idamantaramupakṛtaye  prakṛticalā yāvadarthisaṃpadiyam |
59352 vipadi niyatodayāyāṃ  punarupakartuṃ kuto'vasaraḥ ||
59361 idamandhaṃ tamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ jāyeta bhuvanatrayam |
59362 yadi śabdāhvayaṃ jyotirā saṃsārānna dīpyate ||
59371 idamanyacca devarṣe rahasyaṃ sarvayoṣitām |
59372 dṛṣṭvaiva puruṣaṃ hṛdyaṃ yoniḥ praklidyate striyāḥ ||
59381 idamapaṭu kapāṭaṃ jarjaraḥ pañjaro'yaṃ  viramati na gṛhe'smin krūramārjārayātrā |
59382 śuka mukulitajihvaṃ sthīyatāṃ kiṃ vacobhis tava vacanavinode nādaraḥ pāmarāṇām ||
59391 idamaparamadbhutatamaṃ  yuvatisahasrairvilupyamānasya |
59392 vṛddhirbhavati na hānir yattava saubhāgyakoṣasya ||
59401 idamapāsya virāgi parāgiṇīr alikadambakamamburuhāṃ tatīḥ |
59402 stanabhareṇa jitastabakānaman  navalate valate'bhimukhaṃ tava ||
59411 idamapratimaṃ paśya saraḥ sarasijairvṛtam |
59412 sakhe mā jalpa nārīṇāṃ nayanāni dahanti mām ||
59421 idamamṛtamameyaṃ seyamānandasindhur madhumadhuramapīdaṃ kiṃcidantardhunoti |
59422 yadayamudayalīlīlālasānāṃ vadhūnāṃ  rativinimayabhājāṃ kelibhiryāti kālaḥ ||
59431 idamamlānamānāyā lagnaṃ stanataṭe tava |
59432 chādyatāmuttarīyeṇa navaṃ nakhapadaṃ sakhi ||
59441 idamayuktamaho mahadeva yad varatanoḥ smarayatyanilo'nyadā |
59442 smṛtasayauvanasoṣmapayodharān  satuhinastu hinastu viyoginaḥ ||
59451 idamaśiśirairantastāpādvivarṇamaṇīkṛtaṃ  niśi niśi bhujanyastāpāṅgaprasāribhiraśrubhiḥ |
59452 anabhilulitajyāghātāṅkaṃ muhurmaṇibandhanāt kanakavalayaṃ srastaṃ srastaṃ mayā pratisāryate ||
59461 idamasulabhavastuprārthanādurnivāraṃ  prathamamapi mano me pañcabāṇaḥ kṣiṇoti |
59462 kimuta malayavātonmūlitāpāṇḍupatrair upavanasahakārairdarśiteṣvaṅkureṣu ||
59471 idamaskhalitaṃ dhāraya  vāraya paruṣākṣarā vācaḥ |
59472 ekaḥ sakalajanānāṃ  jagati ripuḥ paruṣavākpuruṣaḥ ||
59481 idamahaṃ karuṇāmṛtasāgaraṃ  śaśikiśoraśiromaṇimarthaye |
59482 vrajatu janmani janmani me vapur bhavadupāsanasādhanatāmiti ||
59491 idamābhāti gagane bhindānaṃ saṃtataṃ tamaḥ |
59492 amandanayanānandakaraṃ maṇḍalamaindavam ||
59501 idamidamiti bhūruhāṃ prasūnair muhuratilobhayatā puraḥpuro'nyā |
59502 anurahasamanāyi nāyakena  tvarayati rantumaho janaṃ manobhūḥ ||
59511 idamidamiti samyakkarmaṇā yojanīyaṃ  niyatamiti vicintya prāpayedīhamānaḥ |
59512 sunayapihitarandhraḥ prākṛto yasya vargaḥ  kṣitipatirupabhuṅkte sa trivargaṃ cirāya ||
59521 idamucchvasitālakaṃ mukhaṃ  tava viśrāntakathaṃ dunoti mām |
59522 niśi suptamivaikapaṅkajaṃ  viratābhyantaraṣaṭpadasvanam ||
59531 idamuddiśya vayasyāḥ  svasamīhitadaivataṃ namata |
59532 yamunaiva jānudaghnī  bhavatu na vā nāviko'stvaparaḥ ||
59541 idamupahitasūkṣmagranthinā skandhadeśe  stanayugapariṇāhācchādinā valkalena |
59542 vapurabhinavamasyāḥ puṣyati svāṃ na śobhāṃ  kusumamiva pinaddhaṃ pāṇdupatrodareṇa ||
59551 idamubhayabhittisaṃtata  hāraguṇāntargataikakucamukulam |
59552 guṭikādhanuriva bālā  vapuḥ smaraḥ śrayati kututena ||
59561 idametatkariṣyāmi tata etadbhaviṣyati |
59562 saṃkalpaḥ kriyate yo'yaṃ na taṃ mṛtyuḥ pratīkṣate ||
59571 idameva kalerasya madavisphūrjitaṃ mahat |
59572 yanme manorathāvāptiḥ na rāmabhajanādapi ||
59581 idameva narendrāṇāṃ svargadvāramanargalam |
59582 yadātmanaḥ pratijñā ca prajā ca paripālyate ||
59591 idameva paraṃ maurkhyamupāyaistribhirujjhitam |
59592 parākramante yuddheṣu samamevobhaye bhaṭāḥ ||
59601 idameva mahaddhairyaṃ dhīrāṇāṃ sutapasvinām |
59602 vighnavantyapi saṃprāpya yadvighnairna vihanyate ||
59611 idameva hi janmaphalaṃ  jīvitaphalametadeva yatpuṃsām |
59612 laṭahanitambavatījana  saṃbhogasukhena yāti tāruṇyam ||
59621 idameva hi nirṇītaṃ paiśunyādduḥkhasaṃgamaḥ |
59622 anyārthaṃ khanato gartaṃ kūpe pātaḥ suniścitaḥ ||
59631 idameva hi pāṇḍityaṃ cāturyamidameva hi |
59632 idameva subuddhitvamāyādalpataro vyayaḥ ||
59641 idameva hi pāṇḍityamiyameva kulīnatā |
59642 ayameva paro dharma āyādalpataro vyayaḥ ||
59651 idānīṃ tīvrābhirdahana iva bhābhiḥ parigato  mamāścaryaṃ sūryaḥ kimu sakhi rajanyāmudayate |
59652 ayaṃ mugdhe candraḥ kimiti mayi tāpaṃ prakaṭayaty anāthānāṃ bāle kimiha viparītaṃ na bhavati ||
59661 idānīṃ tu mayā jñātaṃ tyāgānnāsti paraṃ sukham |
59662 nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti cakṣuḥsamaṃ balam ||
59671 idānīṃ plakṣāṇāṃ jaṭharadalaviśleṣacaturaḥ  śikhānāmābandhaḥ sphurati śukacañcūpuṭanibhaḥ |
59672 tataḥ strīṇāṃ hanta kṣamamadharakāntiṃ kalayituṃ  samantānniryāti sphuṭasubhagarāgaṃ kisalayam ||
59681 idānīṃ vaṃśīnāṃ śabaramithunocchṛṅkhalarahaḥ  kriyāsakhyenālaṃ girivanasaridgrāmasuhṛdām |
59682 sphurallomaśyāmacchagalaśiśukarṇapratisama  cchadāgrābhistvagbhirvalayitakarīrāstaṭabhuvaḥ ||
59691 idānīṃ santu kāvyāni bahūni jagatītale |
59692 yadādarśamayaṃ kāvyamādyaṃ tattu tadeva hā ||
59701 idānīmaṅgamakṣāli racitaṃ cānulepanam |
59702 idānīmeva te kṛṣṇa dhūlīdhūsaritaṃ vapuḥ ||
59711 idānīmarghanti prathamakalamacchedamuditā  navāgrānnasthālīparimalamuco hālikagṛhāḥ |
59712 udañcaddorvallīraṇitavalayābhiryuvatibhir gṛhītaprotkṣiptabhramitamasṛṇodgīrṇamuśalāḥ ||
59721 inaḥ sa eva sevyo yaḥ svālokena sudhāmucā |
59722 dvijendramaṇḍalaṃ kṣīṇaṃ samagrayati saṃpadā ||
59731 indindirairnirbharagarbhamīṣad unmeṣavaccampakapuṣpamāsīt |
59732 hiraṇmayaṃ śāsanalekhahetoḥ  sajjaṃ maṣībhāṇḍamiva smarasya ||
59741 indindiro marande  vimukho yadi kiṃ nu madhuni māhātmyam |
59742 rasiko vāñchati no cet rāgādharabimbamasya ko bhūmā (?) ||
59751 indīvaraṃ locanayostulāyai  nirmāya yatnena vidhiḥ kadācit |
59752 atulyatāṃ vīkṣya tato rajāṃsi  nikṣipya cikṣepa sa paṅkamadhye ||
59761 indīvaradalaśyāmamindirānandakandalam |
59762 vandārujanamandāraṃ vande'haṃ yadunandanam ||
59771 indīvaraśyāmatanurnṛpo'sau  tvaṃ rocanāgauraśarīrayaṣṭiḥ |
59772 anyonyaśobhāparivṛddhaye vāṃ  yogastaḍittoyadayorivāstu ||
59781 indīvarasyāntarametadasyā  netrotpalasyāpi yato himāṃśoḥ |
59782 tviṣo'pi naikaṃ sahate mukhākhyam  ākramya tasthāvaparaṃ śaśāṅkam ||
59791 indīvarākṣi tava tīvrakaṭākṣabāṇa  pātavraṇe dvitayamauṣadhameva manye |
59792 ekaṃ tavādharasudhārasapānamanyad uttuṅgapīnakucakuṅkumapaṅkalepaḥ ||
59801 indīvarākṣyāḥ sphuṭavidrumoṣṭhyāḥ  saṃketamuddiśya vane carantyāḥ |
59802 cauraiḥ samastābharaṇāni hṛtvā  nāsāmaṇirno'pahṛtaḥ kimetat ||
59811 indīvareṇa nayanaṃ mukhamambujena  kundena dantamadharaṃ navapallavena |
59812 aṅgāni campakadalaiḥ sa vidhāya vedhāḥ  kānte kathaṃ ghaṭitavānupalena cetaḥ ||
59821 indīvarodarasahodarameduraśrīr vāso dravatkanakavṛndanibhaṃ dadhānaḥ |
59822 āmuktamauktikamanoharahāravakṣāḥ  ko'yaṃ yuvā jagadanaṅgamayaṃ karoti ||
59831 induṃ kairaviṇīva kokapaṭalīvāmbhojinīvallabhaṃ  meghaṃ cātakamaṇḍalīva madhupaśreṇīva puṣpavrajam |
59832 mākandaṃ pikasundarīva ramaṇīvātmeśvaraṃ proṣitaṃ  cetovṛttiriyaṃ sadā nṛpavara tvāṃ draṣṭumutkaṇṭhate ||
59841 induṃ taṇḍulakhaṇḍamaṇḍalaruciṃ nityoditaṃ jātucid darśe meghagharaṭṭaghaṭṭanagaladdehaṃ vidhatte vidhiḥ |
59842 nūnaṃ lokahitecchayā kirati yatsaṃtarpaṇaṃ sarvataḥ  śubhrādabhraviśiṣṭapiṣṭaruciraṃbhūmau tuṣāraṃ divaḥ ||
59851 induṃ nindati cakravākayugalaṃ bhāsāṃ nidhiṃ kauśikaḥ  svādukṣīramarocakī sukṛtinaṃ pāpī jaḍaḥ paṇḍitam |
59852 tyaktaṃ sarvajanaiḥ khalaḥ kaṭuvacā grāmyaḥ pumānnāgaraṃ  kaḥ paitāmahagolake'tra nikhilaiḥ saṃmānito vartate ||
59861 induṃ nindati candanaṃ na sahate mallīsrajaṃ nekṣate  hāraṃ dveṣṭi sitābjamujjhati bisastomaṃ nigṛhṇāti ca |
59862 śrībhūpāla mahīdhareṣu vipineṣvambhodhitīreṣu ca  tvatkīrtistvadaripriyā ca vilasatyuccaiḥ sphuratpāṇḍimā ||
59871 induṃ nindati candanaṃ na sahate vidveṣṭi paṅkeruhaṃ  hāraṃ bhāramavaiti naiva kurute karpūrapūre manaḥ |
59872 svargaṅgāmavagāhate himagiriṃ gāḍhaṃ samāliṅgate  yatkīrtirvirahātureva na manāgekatra viśrāmyati ||
59881 induṃ nindati taskaro gṛhapatiṃ jāro suśīlaṃ khalaḥ  sādhvīmapyasatī kulīnamakulo jahyājjarantaṃ yuvā |
59882 vidyāvantamanakṣaro dhanapatiṃ nīcaśca rūpojjvalaṃ  vairūpyeṇa hataḥ prabuddhamabudhotkṛṣṭaṃ nikṛṣṭo janaḥ ||
59891 induṃ nindati padmakhaṇḍakadalītalpaṃ na vā manyate  karpūraṃ kirati prayāti na ratiṃ prāleyadhārāgṛhe |
59892 kiṃ vānyattava viprayogaśikhinā sā dahyamānā muhus tvāmantarhṛdayasthitaṃ davabhayānnetrāmbubhiḥ siñcati ||
59901 induṃ nindatu nāma vātha nalinīṃ nindantu cakrāhvayā  naivānena sudhākarasya suṣamāhānirna vā duryaśaḥ |
59902 etenaiva kṛtārthatāsya janatā yanmodamālambate  yajjyotsnāsu ciraṃ cakorapariṣaccañcūpuṭaṃ nyasyati ||
59911 induṃ mukhādbahutṛṇaṃ tava yadgṛṇanti  nainaṃ mṛgastyajati tanmṛgatṛṣṇayaiva |
59912 atyeti mohamahimā na himāṃśubimba  lakṣmīviḍambimukhi vittiṣu pāśavīṣu ||
59921 induṃ vetti divākaraṃ malayajaṃ dāvānalaṃ manyate  jānātyambujamulmukaṃ kalayati prāleyatalpaṃ citām |
59922 hārāṅgārakadarthitena manasā sṛṣṭiṃ samastāmimāṃ  saṃpratyagnimayī na vetti subhagā tyaktā varākī tvayā ||
59931 induḥ kiṃ kva kalaṅkaḥ  sarasijametatkimambu kutra gatam |
59932 lalitasavilāsavacanair mukhamiti hariṇākṣi niścitaṃ parataḥ ||
59941 induḥ prayāsyati vinaṅkṣyati tārakaśrīḥ  sthāsyanti līḍhatimirā na maṇipradīpāḥ |
59942 andhaṃ samagramapi kīṭamaṇe bhaviṣyaty unmeṣameṣyati bhavānapi durametat ||
59951 induprabhārasavidaṃ vihagaṃ vihāya  kīrānane sphurasi bhārati kā ratiste |
59952 ādyaṃ yadi śrayasi jalpatu kaumudīnāṃ  govindarājavacasāṃ ca viśeṣameṣaḥ ||
59961 indubimbādivotkīrṇaṃ padmagarbhādivoddhṛtam |
59962 vadanaṃ tava tanvaṅgi vimṛśadbhirvibhāvyate ||
5996 1 indubhāskarayoryatra nabhaḥsaṃcārakhinnayoḥ |
5996 2 patākāḥ pavanādhūtāḥ bhajante tālavṛntatām ||
59971 indumindumukhi lokaya lokaṃ  bhānubhānubhiramuṃ paritaptam |
59972 vījituṃ rajanihastagṛhītaṃ  tālavṛntamiva nālavihīnam ||
59981 indumindradigasūta sarasvān  uttaraṅgabhujarājiranṛtyat |
59982 ujjaharṣa jhaṣaketuravāpuḥ  ṣaṭpadāḥ kumudabandhanamokṣam ||
59991 indumukhī kumudākṣī  rambhorū kamalacārukaracaraṇā |
59992 amṛtadravalāvaṇyā  hṛdayagatā devi kiṃ dahasi ||
60001 indurinduriti kiṃ durāśayā  bindureṣa payaso vilokyate |
60002 nanvidaṃ vijayate mṛgīdṛśaḥ  śyāmakomalakapolamānanam ||
60011 indurmūrdhni śivasya śailaduhiturvakro nakhāṅkaḥ stane  deyādvo'bhyudayaṃ dvayaṃ tadupamāmālambamānaṃ mithaḥ |
60012 samvādaḥ praṇavena yasya dalatā kāyaikatāyāṃ tayor ūrdhvadvāravicintitena ca hṛdi dhyātasvarūpeṇa ca ||
60021 induryatra na nindyate na madhuraṃ dūtīvacaḥ śrūyate  nālāpā nipatanti bāṣpakaluṣā nopaiti kārśyaṃ tanuḥ |
60022 svādhīnāmanukūlinīṃ svagṛhiṇīmāliṅgya yatsupyate  tatkiṃ prema gṛhāśramavratamidaṃ kaṣṭaṃ samācaryate ||
60031 induryadyudayādrimūrdhni na bhavatyadyāpi tanmā sma bhūn  nāsīre'pi tamaḥsamuccayamamūrunmūlayanti tviṣaḥ |
60032 apyakṣṇormudamudgiranti kumudairāmodayante diśaḥ  saṃpratyūrdhvamasau tu lāñchanamabhivyaṅktuṃ prakāśiṣyate ||
60041 indurlipta ivāñjanena jaḍitā dṛṣṭirmṛgīṇāmiva  pramlānāruṇimeva vidrumadalaṃ śyāmeva hemaprabhā |
60042 kārkaśyaṃ kalayā ca kokilavadhūkaṇṭheṣviva prastutaṃ  sundaryāḥ purataśca hanta śikhināṃ barhāḥ sagarhā iva ||
60051 induvratasahasraṃ tu caredyaḥ kāyaśodhanam |
60052 pibedyaścāpi gaṅgāmbhaḥ samau syātāṃ na vā samau ||
60061 industvadyaśasā jito'vanipate bhāsāṃnidhistejasā  kandarpo vapuṣā sudhājalanidhirvāco vilāsena ca |
60062 tathyaṃ te jayaśīlametadadhunā tvaddānamaddainyayor madhye kaṃ nu vijeṣyatīti viṣaye dolāyate me manaḥ ||
60071 indūdayaścandanaminduvaktraś caitrastathā yasya mahāya saṃpat |
60072 vapuśca śṛṅgāramayaṃ sa manye  saṃtāpakastvaṃ haravahniyogāt ||
60081 indoḥ kalākalāpena paṅktikramaniveśinā |
60082 sarvaduḥkhāpanodāya bālakānāṃ kṛtā bhujāḥ ||
60091 indoḥ kāntiṃ jaḍatarakarānmattanāgādgatiṃ vā  trastānnetre harasi hariṇāttatra kiṃ nāma citram |
60092 etaccitraṃ punariha jagajjaitrakandarpacāpa  śrīsarvasvaṃ yadapaharasi preyasi bhrūvilāsaiḥ ||
60101 indoḥ kiṃ druhiṇasya vā surapateḥ kiṃ vā kṛtāntasya vā  kiṃ bhūteśa diśāsthi bhūṣaṇagaṇeśvākṛṣya deyaṃ mayā |
60102 itthaṃ maṇḍanamandirodaracaravyāhārato bhīkarāt bhītā yasya surāḥ prasādhanavidhau pāyātsa vaḥ śaṃkaraḥ ||
60111 indoḥ saṃkṣayarakṣiṇākṣatasudhā kiṃ vedhasā nirmitā  kiṃ dhairyāpaharā harasya vihitā kāmena kāntā tanuḥ |
60112 kiṃ tāruṇyavasantakāntilalitā śṛṅgārasiktā latā  kiṃ lāvaṇyataraṅgiṇī punariyaṃ janmāntarāptā ratiḥ ||
60121 indoragatayaḥ padme sūryasya kumudeṃ'śavaḥ |
60122 guṇāstasya vipakṣe'pi guṇino lebhire'ntaram ||
60131 indorasya triyāmāyuvatikucataṭīcandanasthāsakasya  vyomaśrīcāmarasya tripuraharajaṭāvallarīkorakasya |
60132 kaṃdarpakṣoṇipālasphaṭikamaṇigṛhasyaitadākha ṇḍalāśā  nāsāmuktāphalasya sthagayati jagatīṃ ko'pi bhāsāṃ vilāsaḥ ||
60141 indorivāsya purato  yadvimukhī sāpavāraṇā bhramasi |
60142 tatkathaya kiṃ nu duritaṃ  sakhi tvayā chāyayeva kṛtam ||
60151 indorekakalāyā  rudreṇoddhṛtya mūrdhani dhṛtāyāḥ |
60152 sthānamiva tucchametat kalaṅkarūpeṇa pariṇamati ||
60161 indorlakṣma tripurajayinaḥ kaṇṭhamūlaṃ murārir diṅnāgānāṃ madajalamasībhāñji gaṇḍasthalāni |
60162 adyāpyurvīvalayatilaka śyāmalimnāvaliptāny ābhāsante vada dhavalitaṃ kiṃ yaśobhistvadīyaiḥ ||
60171 indoścandanabindunaiva daśanacchāyaṃ tadīyaṃ mukhaṃ  cakraṃ locanabhallamārjanavidhau śāṇasya tatkuṇḍalam |
6017 2 bhinnānāṃ kucakandarā smitasudhākulyeva muktāvalī  pādābje dhvanadindranīlavalayaṃ rolambamālaiva sā ||
6017 1 indau nindyā cakorairasamayati niśājāgaraḥ puṇḍarīkaiḥ  bhṛṅgaiḥ śīdhunyasaṅgaḥ śaradi samadhikā glānirindīvaraiśca |
60172 bhrūbhaṅge yasya vairākarayuvatidṛśāmekamevopamānaṃ  paśyāmyaśrāntabāṣpaprakaramayajharīgūḍhacārāścamaryaḥ ||
60181 indraṃ dvyakṣadharaṃ tvamanthamudadhiṃ pañcānanaṃ padmajaṃ  sindhuṃ svādujalaṃ śivaṃ sitagalaṃ kāmaṃ ca sadvigraham |
60182 śailān pakṣadharāṃstathaiva ca hayāṃllakṣmīpatiṃ piṅgalaṃ  dṛṣṭaṃ sarvamidaṃ kvacinna raghurāḍdattaṃ svayaṃ hāritam ||
60191 indraṃ vai ṣaṇḍhamāhurmalinamuḍupatiṃ mādhavaṃ gopasūnuṃ  vyāsaṃ matsītanūjaṃ gatarasamudadhiṃ pāvakaṃ sarvabhakṣam |
60192 veśyāputraṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ janapadavacanaiḥ pāṇḍavāścānyajātā  itthaṃ saṃcintya mahyaṃ kathaya narapate kasya doṣā na santi ||
60201 indraḥ prakṣubdhacitto diśi diśi sakalān dikpatīn sāvadhānān  kurvan vajrāstrapāṇiḥ suravaravalitāṃ devasenāṃ nigṛhya |
60202 svargadvāre yadīyoddhatabalinihataprauḍhaḍhakkāninādaṃ  śrutvātiṣṭhatprakampatkucakalaśataṭīkinnarīgīyamānaḥ ||
60211 indraḥ pradhānaṃ divi daivateṣu  vipro manuṣyeṣu nadīṣu gaṅgā |
60212 gāvaḥ paśuṣveṣu dhaneṣu dhānyaṃ  sarvatra gātrasya śiraḥ pradhānam ||
6021 1 indragopakaparamparā bhṛśaṃ  kānaneṣu śuśubhe visarpiṇī |
6021 2 prāvṛṣaḥ sarabhasāgamāccyutā  padmarāgaghaṭiteva karṇikā ||
60221 indragopairbabhau bhūmirnicitaiva pravāsinām |
60222 anaṅgabāṇairhṛdbhedasrutalohitabindubhiḥ ||
60231 indrajiccaṇḍavīryo'si nāmnaiva balavānasi |
60232 dhikdhikpracchannarūpeṇa yudhyase'smadbhayākulaḥ ||
60241 indranīlaśukapakṣakomalā  śaṅkhakundakumudendusaṃnibhā |
60242 taptakāñcanavikāsicampaka  spardhinī vasumatī praśasyate ||
60251 indrastvaṃ nṛpa sundarī tava śacī putro jayantopamo  gehaṃ bhāti ca vaijayantasadṛśaṃ nāgo'bhramorvallabhaḥ |
60252 itthaṃ bodhakarairasatyavacanaiḥ svairaṃ stutaḥ svaṃ hariṃ  vetti prasphuṭavikramaṃ sa mahimā jñeyo harermāyinaḥ ||
60261 indrasya vajreṇa hato vṛtrāsuramahāyaśāḥ |
60262 medasā sarvavicchinnaṃ tadarthamupalepanam ||
60271 indrasyārkasya vāyośca yamasya varuṇasya ca |
60272 candrasya ca pṛthivyāśca nṛpaḥ saptaguṇo bhavet ||
60281 indrātprabhutvaṃ jvalanātpratāpaṃ  krodho yamādvaiśravaṇācca vittam |
60282 parākramaṃ rāmajanārdanābhyām  ādāya rājñaḥ kriyate śarīram ||
60291 indrādyā lokapālā harividhutapanā nāgavidyādharādyā  dveṣyāḥ sarve'pi devāḥ priya tava varadaḥ ko'sti vandyo garīyān |
60292 śrutvā vācaṃ priyāyā iti daśamukhataḥ prāha vākyaṃ daśāsyaḥ  śūlī śaṃbhuḥ pinākī śivabhavapaśupaḥ śarva īśaśca bhargaḥ ||
60301 indrādyaiḥ kiṃ pradattaṃ pradiśasi dhavalaṃ dhāma dhanyaṃ yadebhyo  mahyaṃ yannāpi dhatse tṛṇaghaṭitakuṭīṃ kiṃ mayā te'parāddham |
60302 viśvebhyo viśvamātarvitarasi yadi vā śarma karmānusāri  prottuṅgāyāḥ kṛpāyāstava tuhinagireḥ putri kutropayogaḥ ||
60311 indrānilayamārkāṇāmagneśca varuṇasya ca |
60312 candravitteśayoścāpi mātrā nirhṛtya śāśvatīḥ ||
60321 indrābhyarthanayā pūrvaṃ bharatāya caturmukhaḥ |
60322 pramodāya mahendrasya nāṭyaṃ samupadiṣṭavān ||
60331 indrāya vīkṣamāṇas tanmukhamāsvādayannanantāya |
60332 spṛhayāmi cādya dayitām  āliṅgan kārtavīryāya ||
60341 indriyaṃ vijitaṃ yena tenaiva bhuvanaṃ jitam |
60342 yaścendriyaiḥ parābhūtaḥ sa sarvatra parājitaḥ ||
60351 indriyasyendriyasyārthe rāgadveṣau vyavasthitau |
60352 tayorna vaśamāgacchettau hyasya paripanthinau ||
60361 indriyāṇāṃ jaye yogaṃ samātiṣṭheddivāniśam |
60362 jitendriyo hi śaknoti vaśe sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ ||
60371 indriyāṇāṃ jaye śūro dharmaṃ carati paṇḍitaḥ |
60372 satyavādī bhavedvaktā dātā bhavati vā na vā ||
60381 indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yadyekaṃ kṣaratīndriyam |
60382 tato'sya kṣarati prajñā dṛteḥ pādādivodakam ||
60391 indriyāṇāṃ nirodhena rāgadveṣakṣayeṇa ca |
60392 ahiṃsayā ca bhūtānāmamṛtatvāya kalpate ||
60401 indriyāṇāṃ prasaṅgena doṣamṛcchatyasaṃśayam |
60402 saṃniyamya tu tānyeva tataḥ siddhiṃ niyacchati ||
60411 indriyāṇāṃ prasaṅgena dharmasyāsevanena ca |
60412 pāpān saṃyānti saṃsārānavidvāṃso narādhamāḥ ||
60421 indriyāṇāṃ prasṛṣṭānāṃ hayānāmiva vartmasu |
60422 dhṛtiṃ kurvīta sārathye dhṛtyā tāni jayeddhruvam ||
60431 indriyāṇāṃ vicaratāṃ viṣayeṣvapahāriṣu |
60432 saṃyame yatnamātiṣṭhedvidvān yanteva vājinām ||
60441 indriyāṇāṃ hi caratāṃ yanmano'nuvidhīyate |
60442 tadasya harati prajñāṃ vāyurnāvamivāmbhasi ||
60451 indriyāṇāmadhiṣṭhātrī bhūtānāṃ cākhileṣu yā |
60452 bhūteṣu satataṃ tasyai vyāptyai devyai namo namaḥ ||
60461 indriyāṇāmanutsargo mṛtyunā na viśiṣyate |
60462 atyarthaṃ punarutsargaḥ sādayeddaivatānyapi ||
60471 indriyāṇi ca saṃyamya rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ |
60472 samaduḥkhasukhaḥ śāntaḥ tattvajñaḥ sādhurucyate ||
60481 indriyāṇi parāṇyāhurindriyebhyaḥ paraṃ manaḥ |
60482 manasastu parā buddhiryo buddheḥ paratastu saḥ ||
60491 indriyāṇi paśūn kṛtvā vedīṃ kṛtvā tapomayīm |
60492 ahiṃsāmāhutiṃ kṛtvā ātmayajñaṃ yajāmyaham ||
60501 indriyāṇi purā jitvā jitaṃ tribhuvanaṃ tvayā |
60502 smaradbhariva taidvairamindriyaireva nirjitaḥ ||
60511 ... ... ... ... ... ... |
60512 indriyāṇi pramāthīni harantyapi yatermanaḥ ||
60521 indriyāṇi manaḥ prāṇo jñānamāyuḥ sukhaṃ dhṛtiḥ |
60522 dhāraṇā preraṇaṃ duḥkhamicchāhaṅkāra eva ca ||
60531 prayatna ākṛtirvarṇaḥ svaradveṣau bhavābhavau |
60532 tasyaitadātmajaṃ sarvamanāderādimicchataḥ ||
60541 indriyāṇi mano buddhirasyādhiṣṭhānamucyate |
60542 etairvimohayatyeṣa jñānamāvṛtya dehinam ||
60551 indriyāṇi mahatprepsurniyacchedarthadharmayoḥ |
60552 indriyairniyatairbuddhirvardhate'gnirivendhanaiḥ ||
60561 indriyāṇīndriyārthebhyaḥ prāṇādīnmana eva ca |
60562 nigṛhya samavāyena pratyāhāramupakramet ||
60571 indriyāṇyanupakleśya labhyaṃ śreyo gṛhāśrame |
60572 atasturyāśramaṃ prāhurabādhanyāyabādhitam ||
60581 indriyāṇyantaraṅgāṇi pātayanti yathā janān |
60582 abhyantarāstathā rāṣṭre bhṛtyāḥ svārthaparāyaṇāḥ ||
60591 indriyāṇyeva tatsarvaṃ yatsvarganarakāvubhau |
60592 nigṛhītavisṛṣṭāni svargāya narakāya ca ||
60601 indriyārtheṣu sarveṣu na prasajyeta kāmataḥ |
60602 atiprasaktiṃ caiteṣāṃ manasā saṃnivartayet ||
60611 indriyairindracandrādyā hrepitā yaiḥ surā api |
60612 aparimlānamānatvaṃ tairmartyasyāthavā katham ||
60621 indriyairindriyārtheṣu vartamānairanigrahaiḥ |
60622 tairayaṃ tāpyate loko nakṣatrāṇi grahairiva ||
60631 indro nindati vāhamāha dinakṛttvarvvācamevārvataś cañcūrnyañcati kiṃ na pannagariporantastrapodrekataḥ |
60632 vātaḥ khañjati paṅgupuñjati manorājirbbhavadvājiṣu  dbeṣādājiṣu vairiṇāmabhimukhaṃ dhāvatsu yāvatsukham ||
60641 indro yacchatamanyurasti dahano yatpāvako'pyantakaḥ  kīnāśo dhanado vimānanirataḥ pāśī jalānāṃ patiḥ |
60642 īśaḥ kāmaharaścalo yadanilo yannairṛto rākṣasas tannānyo'vanilokapāla bhavataḥ kaścitsamaḥ syādguṇaiḥ ||
60651 indro yamo'si varuṇo'si hutāśano'si  brahmā haro harirasītyasakṛdyaduktiḥ |
60652 bhūpālamaulimaṇirañjitapādapīṭha  tasyānṛtasya phalamindhanamudvahāmi ||
60661 ibhakumbhatuṅgakaṭhinetaretara  stanabhāradūravinivāritodarāḥ |
60662 pariphullagaṇḍaphalakāḥ parasparaṃ  parirebhire kukurakauravastriyaḥ ||
60671 ibhyā yadi nṛpadvāre saṃmanyante kimadbhutam |
60672 idānīṃ vibudhadvāre teṣāmeva puraskriyā ||
60681 imaṃ kanakavarṇābhaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam |
60682 gṛdhravākyātkathaṃ putraṃ tyajadhvaṃ pitṛpiṇḍadam ||
60691 imaṃ tilasumāyitaṃ yuvatināsikāsaṃpuṭaṃ  vibhāvya sumanojano manasi modamāpadyate |
60692 sakhe bhujagamutphaṇaṃ saviṣaphūtkṛtāhaṃkṛtaṃ  vibhāvaya na tatspṛhāṃ kuru jahīhi taddṛśyatām ||
60701 imaṃ parityajya paraṃ raṇādariḥ  svameva bhagnaḥ śaraṇaṃ budhāviśat |
60702 na vetti yattrātumitaḥ kṛtasmayo  na durgayā śailabhuvāpi śakyate ||
60711 imaṃ lokaṃ mātṛbhaktyā pitṛbhaktyā tu madhyamam |
60712 guruśuśrūṣayā tveva brahmalokaṃ samaśnute ||
60721 imāṃ ca vindyādanuraktaceṣṭāṃ  priyāṇi vakti svadhanaṃ dadāti |
60722 vilokya saṃhṛṣyati vītaroṣā  pramārṣṭi doṣān guṇakīrtanena ||
60731 imāṃ parīpsurdurjāte parābhibhavakātarām |
60732 bhartṛpriyaḥ priyairbharturānṛṇyamasubhirgataḥ ||
60741 imāṃ vidhātuṃ bhujavallimujjvalāṃ  gṛhītasāraṃ vidhinā natabhruvaḥ |
60742 kaṭhorabhāvapriyameva kevalaṃ  mṛṇālamantastaralaṃ kuto'nyathā ||
60751 imāṃ sāgaraparyantāṃ himavadvindhyakuṇḍalām |
60752 mahīmekātapatrāṅkāṃ rājasiṃhaḥ praśāstu naḥ ||
60761 imāni prāyaśastāni veśyāsvevaṃ pradāpayet |
60762 sā muñcatyacirātsarvamupabhogaṃ tadātmanaḥ ||
60771 imā yadi bhavanti no galitayauvanā nīrucas tadā kamalalocanāstaruṇamāninīrmā mucat |
60772 vilāsamadavibhramān bhramati luṇṭhayatrī jarā  yato bhuvi vadhustato bhavati niḥspṛhastanmukhe ||
60781 imā rūpasthānasvajanatanayadravyavanitā  sutālakṣmīkīrtidyutiratimatiprītidhṛtayaḥ |
60782 madāndhastrīnetraprakṛticapalāḥ sarvabhavinām  aho kaṣṭaṃ martyastadapi viṣayān sevitumanāḥ ||
60791 imāstāḥ kastūrīprakharakhuraṭaṅkakṣatataṭās taṭinyo'raṇyānīmanu kamalinīcchannasalilāḥ |
60792 jale yāsāṃ haṃsā bisakisalayagrāsarasikāḥ  salīlaṃ līyante yuvatigatividyaikaguravaḥ ||
60801 imāstā vindhyādreḥ śukaharitavaṃśīvanaghanā  bhuvaḥ krīḍāloladviradadaśanābhugnataravaḥ |
60802 latākuñje yāsāmupanadi rataklāntaśabarī  kapolasvedāmbhaḥkaṇacayanudo vānti marutaḥ ||
60811 imā hindolāsu bhramitamahasaḥ kuṅkumarucā  trapārūpākārāstaralatarahārāścaladṛśaḥ |
60812 udañcatkāñcīnāṃ bahalataraghoṣairmanasija  trilokīsamrājo dadhati jayaghaṇṭālininadam ||
60821 ime tāruṇyaśrīnavaparimalāḥ prauḍhasurata  pratāpaprārambhāḥ smaravijayadānapratibhuvaḥ |
60822 ciraṃ cetaścaurā abhinavavikāraikaguravo  vilāsavyāpārāḥ kimapi vijayante mṛgadṛśām ||
60831 ime padme nāmbhaḥ pulinataṭametanna taṭinī  khametanna vyāptiḥ stabakayugametanna latikā |
60832 pravālo'yaṃ nābdhiḥ śiśirakiraṇo'yaṃ na rajanī  ghano'yaṃ na prāvṛṭśiva śiva vidheḥ śilparacanā ||
60841 ime mama dhanāṅgajasvajanavallabhādehajā  suhṛjjanakamātulaprabhṛtayo bhṛśaṃ vallabhāḥ |
60842 mudheti hatacetano bhavavane ciraṃ khidyate  yato bhavati kasya ko jagati vālukāmuṣṭivat ||
60851 ime hi dainyena nimīlitekṣaṇā  muhuḥ skhalanto vivaśāsturaṅgamāḥ |
60852 gajāśca saptacchadadānagandhino  nivedayantīva raṇe nivartanam ||
60861 imau rambhāstambhau dviradapatikumbhadvayamidaṃ  tadetallīlābjaṃ śaradamṛtaraśmiḥ sphuṭamayam |
60862 kimaṅge tanvaṅgyāḥ kalayati jagatkāntamadhikaṃ  yadetasyāṃ śaśvatparavaśamivonmattamiva ca ||
60871 iyaṃ kalāvilāsinī kalāvatī samīpagā  dhṛtāravindalocanā manojaśokamocanā |
60872 navīnanīradacchaṭāsamānakeśabhūṣitā  na kasyacijjanasya cittavṛttitāpakhaṇḍitā ||
60881 iyaṃ kiyaccārukuceti paśyate  payaḥpradāyā hṛdayaṃ samāvṛtam |
60882 dhruvaṃ manojñā vyataradyaduttaraṃ  miṣeṇa bhṛṅgāradhṛteḥ karadvayī ||
60891 iyaṃ gehe lakṣmīriyamamṛtavartirnayanayor asāvasyāḥ sparśo vapuṣi bahulaścandanarasaḥ |
60892 ayaṃ bāhuḥ kaṇṭhe śiśiramasṛṇo mauktikasaraḥ  kimasyā na preyo yadi paramasahyastu virahaḥ ||
60901 iyaṃ gauruddāmā tava nibiḍabandhāpi hi kathaṃ  na vaidarbhādanyatspṛśati sulabhatve'pi hi katham |
60902 avandhyā ca khyātā bhuvi kathamagamyā kavivṛṣaiḥ  kathaṃ vā pīyūṣaṃ sravati bahu dugdhāpi bahubhiḥ ||
60911 iyaṃ gaurekā naḥ kvacidapi na saṃyojanavidhāv amuṣyāḥ paśyāmo rasabharamucaṃ kāṃcidaparām |
60912 gale baddhā dadhmo yadi na dhṛtiruddāmavidhṛtau  bhayaṃ gocorebhyastadiha ka upāyaḥ prabhavatu ||
60921 iyaṃ ghaṭī mattagajendragāminī  vicitrasiṃhāsanasaṃsthitā sadā |
60922 anekarāmājanalālitā paraṃ  vidhervaśātsaiva satī prajārthinī ||
60931 iyaṃ cidrūpāpi prakaṭajaḍarūpā bhagavatī  yadīyāmbhobindurvitarati hi śaṃbhorapi padam |
60932 punānā dhunvānā nikhilamapi nānāvidhamaghaṃ  jagatkṛtsnaṃ pāyādanudinamapāyātsuradhunī ||
60941 iyaṃ tāvallīlā yadadhiruruhe vṛddhavṛṣabho  yadunnehe ruṇḍaṃ yadiha citibhasmāpi lilipe |
60942 ayaṃ ko vyāpāro yadatilaki bhāle hutavaho  yadagraivi vyālo yadakavali hālāhalamapi ||
60951 iyaṃ te jananī prāptā tvadālokanatatparā |
60952 snehaprasnavanirbhinnamudvahantī stanadvayam ||
60961 iyaṃ triyāmā śatayāmadhāriṇī  sudhākarādagnirudeti sarvataḥ |
60962 tanoti tāpaṃ mṛducandanānilo  vidhau viruddhe hi vipatpade pade ||
60971 iyaṃ tvabhinnamaryādaiḥ svanuśiṣṭaiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ |
60972 sarvaṃsahairupāyajñairamūḍhaireva dhāryate ||
60981 iyaṃ dhatte dhīre malayajasamīre na ca mudaṃ  na padmānāṃ vṛnde lalitamakarande'pi ramate |
60982 na vā sā sānandā bhavati navakundāvalikule  tadetasyā bādhāharamapi samādhānamiha kim ||
60991 iyaṃ pallī bhillairanucitasamārambharasikaiḥ  samantādākīrṇā viṣaviṣamabāṇapraṇayibhiḥ |
60992 tarorasya skandhe gamaya samayaṃ kīra nibhṛtaṃ  na vāṇī kalyāṇī tadiha mukhamudraiva śaraṇam ||
61001 iyaṃ prītirvallīhṛdayabhuvi daivātsamuditā  tathā yatnādrakṣyā prakṛtimṛdulāpāyabahulā |
61002 yathā naināṃ sphītāṃ piśunajanadurvākyadahano  dahatyantaḥ śoṣaṃ vrajati na punaḥ sauhṛdanidheḥ ||
61011 iyaṃ bālā navodvāhā satyaṃ śrutvā vyathāṃ vrajet |
61012 kāmaṃ dhīrasvabhāveyaṃ strīsvabhāvastu kātaraḥ ||
61021 iyaṃ bālā māṃ pratyanavaratamindīvaradala  prabhācauraṃ cakṣuḥ kṣipati kimabhipretamanayā |
61022 gato moho'smākaṃ smarasamarabāṇavyatikara  jvarajvālā śāntā tadapi na varākī viramati ||
61031 iyaṃ bālā vallī mṛdukisalayaṃ tāpavilayaṃ  ghanacchāyaṃ śālaṃ navamativiśālaṃ parigatā |
61032 paraṃtvasyābhyantargaralalavabhasmīkṛtavanaṃ  bhujaṃgaṃ prottuṅgaṃ kathamiva varākī kalayatu ||
61041 iyaṃ bhujaginīśritā lasadanekapuṣpānvitā  dvirephatatisevitā pramadakhañjanālaṃkṛtā |
61042 phaladvayabharānatā vilasitā navaiḥ pallavair vilocanapathaṃ gatā bhavati kāpi haimī latā ||
61051 iyaṃ mayi proṣita eva saṃgatā  himatviṣābhūtkṛtamaṇḍanā satī |
61052 itīrṣyayeva drutamacchinadruṣā  vicitratārābharaṇāni bhāskaraḥ ||
61061 iyaṃ mahendraprabhṛtīnadhiśriyaś caturdigīśānavamatya māninī |
61062 arūpahāryaṃ madanasya nigrahāt pinākapāṇiṃ patimāptumicchati ||
61071 iyaṃ mukhāmbhoruhasaṃnidhāne  vilambidhammillataticchalena |
61072 samāgatāṃ sādarameva bālā  dvirephamālāmuta vā dadhāti ||
61081 iyaṃ yaśāṃsi dviṣataḥ sudhārucaḥ  kimaṅkametaddviṣataḥ kimānanam |
61082 yaśobhirasyākhilalokadhāvibhir vibhīṣitā dhāvati tāmasī masī ||
61091 iyaṃ raṅgapraveśena kalānāṃ copaśikṣayā |
61092 vañcanāpaṇḍitatvena svaranaipuṇyamāśritā ||
61101 iyaṃ vilāsadrumadohadaśrīr iyaṃ sudhā yauvanadugdhasindhoḥ |
61102 lāvaṇyamāṇikyarucicchaṭeyam  iyaṃ manaḥkārmaṇacūrṇamuṣṭiḥ ||
61111 iyaṃ vyādhāyate bālā bhrūrasyāḥ kārmukāyate |
61112 kaṭākṣāśca śarāyante mano me hariṇāyate ||
61121 iyaṃ samdhyā dūrādahamupagato hanta malayāt tadekāṃ tvadgehe karuṇavati neṣyāmi rajanīm |
61122 samīreṇaivoktā navakusumitā cūtalatikā  dhunānā murddhānaṃ nahi nahi nahītyeva kurute ||
61131 iyaṃ sā kālindī kuvalayadalasnigdhamadhurā  madāndhavyākūjattaruṇajalaraṃkupraṇayinī |
61132 purā yasyāstīre sarabhasasatṛṣṇaṃ murabhido  gatāḥ prāyo gopīnidhuvanavinodena divasāḥ ||
61141 iyaṃ sā lolākṣī tribhuvanalalāmaikavasatiḥ  sa cāyaṃ duṣṭātmā svasurapakṛtaṃ yena mama tat |
61142 itastīvraḥ kāmo gururayamitaḥ krodhadahanaḥ  kṛto veṣaścāyaṃ kathamidamiti bhrāmyati manaḥ ||
61151 iyaṃ sunayanā dāsīkṛtatāmarasaśriyā |
61152 ānanenākalaṅkena jayantīnduṃ kalaṅkitam ||
61161 iyaṃ surataraṅgiṇī na punaratra nausaṃgamo  bhavettaraṇimajjanaṃ pathika naiva pānthāgamaḥ |
61162 nidhāya hṛdaye sadā vipulacārukumbhadvayaṃ  sakhe ghanaghanāgame ghanarasasya pāraṃ vraja ||
61171 iyaṃ sustanī mastakanyastakumbhā  kusumbhāruṇaṃ cāru vāso vasānā |
61172 samastasya lokasya cetaḥpravṛttiṃ  gṛhītvā ghaṭe nyasya yātīva bhāti ||
61181 iyaṃ sṛṣṭā cañcatkanakalatikā paṅkajabhuvā  niṣiktā lāvaṇyāmṛtarasabhareṇānudivasam |
61182 akasmādromālīmadhupapaṭalīha sphurati yat tataḥ śaṅke puṣpodgamasamayamāyātamadhunā ||
61191 iyaṃ svargādhināthasya lakṣmīḥ kiṃ yakṣakanyakā |
61192 athavā vipinasyaiva devatā kimu pārvati ||
61201 iyaṃ hi nidrā nayanāvalambinī  lalāṭadeśādupasarpatīva mām |
61202 adṛśyarūpā capalā jareva yā  manuṣyasattvaṃ paribhūya vardhate ||
61211 iyaṃ hi yoniḥ prathamā yāṃ prāpya jagatīpate |
61212 ātmā vai śakyate trātuṃ karmabhiḥ śubhalakṣaṇaiḥ ||
61221 iyaṃ hi lokavyatirekavartinī  svabhāvataḥ pārthivatā samuddhatā |
61222 balāttadenāṃ vinayena yojayen  nayasya siddhau vinayaḥ puraḥsaraḥ ||
61231 iyatā vayasā na sādhitaṃ yat parataḥ kiṃ nu kariṣyatīti vedhāḥ |
61232 tilataṇḍulitāsya romarekhā  cchalataḥ kajjalacūrṇamālilimpa ||
61231 iyatīṃ subhagāvasthāṃ  gato'si yasyāḥ kṛte smarātaṅkāt |
61232 mūrcchāṃ harāmi sā tava  gatapuṇyā nayanasalilena ||
61241 iyatī jagatī kiyatī bhavitā  namitānanatāmiti yāti hayaḥ |
61242 viyadaṅgaṇariṅgaṇaraṅgavidhau  parinartitumutkramatīva nabhaḥ ||
61251 iyatpṛthvīmātraṃ tadanu ca nabhomaṇḍalamiya  diyān pātālānto jalamapi pṛthivyāmiyaditi |
61252 iti jñātvā kūpe viditaviṣayo nāyamaparaḥ  paraṃ mugdho bhekaḥ prabalatararāvaṃ prakurute ||
61261 iyatyapyetasminniravadhimahatyadhvani guṇās ta evāmī dvitrā jaraṭhajaraṭhā yānti gaṇanām |
61262 aho grāmyo lokaḥ sa na paramamībhiḥ kṛtadhṛtiḥ  smayastabdho yāvatkalayati samagraṃ tṛṇamidam ||
61271 iyatyāṃ saṃpattāvapi ca salilānāṃ tvamadhunā  na tṛṣṇāmārtānāṃ harasi yadi kāsāra sahasā |
61272 nidāghe caṇḍāṃśau kirati parito'ṅgāranikarān  kṛśībhūtaḥ keṣāmahaha parihartāsi khalu tām ||
61281 iyatyāmapi sāmagryāṃ sukṛtaṃ na kṛtaṃ tvayā |
61282 itīva kupito dantānantakaḥ pātayatyalam ||
61291 iyatyetasmin vā niravadhicamatkṛtyatiśayo  varāho vā rāhuḥ prabhavati camatkāraviṣayaḥ |
61292 mahīmeko magnāṃ yadayamavahaddantaśalalaiḥ  śiraḥśeṣaḥ śatruṃ nigilati paraṃ saṃtyajati ca ||
61301 iyamatra kayāpi diśā  nītidṛśāṃ darśitā padavī |
61302 cāṇakyādyabhidhānāj jñeyanidhānādathānyadunneyam ||
31311 iyamatra satāmalaukikī  mahatī kāpi kaṭhoracittatā |
31312 upakṛtya bhavanti dūrataḥ  parataḥ pratyupakārabhīravaḥ ||
61321 iyamapratibodhaśāyinīṃ  raśanā tvāṃ prathamā rahaḥsakhī |
61322 gativibhramasādanīravā  na śucā nānumṛteva lakṣyate ||
61331 iyamavayavaiḥ pāṇḍukṣāmairalaṃkṛtamaṇḍanā  kalitakusumā bālevāntarlatā pariśoṣiṇī |
61332 vahati ca varārohā ramyāṃ vivāhamahotsava  śriyamudayinīmudgāḍhāṃ ca vyanakti manorujam ||
61341 iyamasau taralāyatalocanā  gurusamunnatapīnapayodharā |
61342 pṛthunitambabharālasagāminī  priyatamā mama jīvitahāriṇī ||
61351 iyamānandalatikā na grīvā hariṇīdṛśaḥ |
61352 yato'syāṃ viluṭhantyete muktāḥ śuddhaguṇāntarāḥ ||
61361 iyamiyaṃ mayadānavanandinī  tridaśanāthajitaḥ prasavasthalī |
61362 kimaparaṃ daśakaṃdharagehinī  tvayi karoti karadvayayojanam ||
61371 iyamiṣṭaguṇāya rocatāṃ  rucirārthā bhavate'pi bhāratī |
61372 nanu vaktṛviśeṣaniḥspṛhā  guṇagṛhyā vacane vipaścitaḥ ||
61381 iyamudaradarī durantapūrā  yadi na bhavedabhimānabhaṅgabhūmiḥ |
61382 kṣaṇamapi na sahe bhavādṛśānāṃ  kuṭilakaṭākṣanirīkṣaṇaṃ nṛpāṇām ||
61391 iyamudgatiṃ harantī  netranikocaṃ ca vidadhatī purataḥ |
61392 na vijānīmaḥ kiṃ tava  vadati sapatnīva dinanidrā ||
61401 iyeṣa sā kartumavandhyarūpatāṃ  samādhimāsthāya tapobhirātmanaḥ |
61402 avāpyate vā kathamanyathā dvayaṃ  tathāvidhaṃ prema patiśca tādṛśaḥ ||
61411 ilātalabharākrāntagrīvaṃ mā śeṣa vakraya |
61412 tvayi duḥkhini caikasmiñjīvalokaḥ sadā sukhī ||
61421 ilikā bhramarīdhyānaṃ dhyāyantī bhramarī bhavet |
61422 vītarāgapadaṃ dhyāyan vītarāgo bhaveddhruvam ||
61431 iṣutrayeṇaiva jagattrayasya  vinirjayātpuṣpamayāśugena |
61432 śeṣā dvibāṇī saphalīkṛteyaṃ  priyādṛgambhojapade'bhiṣicya ||
61441 iṣṭaṃ dadāti gṛhṇāti kāryamākhyāti pṛcchati |
61442 bhuṅkte bhojayate caiva ṣaḍvidhaṃ mitralakṣaṇam ||
61451 iṣṭakacite samantāt puruṣanikhāte'vaṭe tarurjātaḥ |
61452 vāmana eva hi dhatte  phalakusumaṃ sarvakālamiti ||
61461 iṣṭāṃ bhāryāṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ putraṃ cāpi kanīyasam |
61462 riktapāṇirna paśyeta tathā naimittikaṃ prabhum ||
61471 iṣṭāni cāpyapatyāni dravyāṇi suhṛdaḥ priyāḥ |
61472 āpaddharmavimokṣāya bhāryā cāpi satāṃ matam ||
61481 iṣṭān bhogān hi vo devā dāsyante yajñabhāvitāḥ |
61482 tairdattānapradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ ||
61491 iṣṭāpūrtāni kalayetjagatkhyāto vaseddivi |
61492 akūpāroktavṛtto'gādindradyumno divaṃ punaḥ ||
61501 iṣṭā bālakaceṣṭā  yauvanadarpo'tha vṛddhavairāgyam |
61502 sāpi gatā so'pi gatas tadapi gataṃ svapnamāyeyam ||
61511 iṣṭā makhā dvijavarāśca mayi prasannāḥ  prajñāpitā bhayarasaṃ samadā narendrāḥ |
61512 evaṃvidhasya ca na me'sti manaḥpraharṣaḥ  kanyāpiturhi satataṃ bahu cintanīyam ||
61521 iṣṭeṣu visṛjatyarthān kubera iva kāmadaḥ |
61522 namasyeyuśca taṃ bhaktyā śiṣyā iva guruṃ sadā ||
61531 iṣṭo vā bahusukṛtopalālito vā  śliṣṭo vā vyasanaśatābhirakṣito vā |
61532 dauḥśīlyājjanayati naiva jātvasādhur visrambhaṃ bhujaga ivāṅkamadhyasuptaḥ ||
61541 iṣṭvā saṃgrāmayajñena nānāpraharaṇāmbhasā |
61542 asminnavabhṛthe snātaḥ kathaṃ patnyā mayā vinā ||
61551 iha kapaṭakutukataralita  dṛśi viśvāsaṃ kuraṅga kiṃ kuruṣe |
61552 tava rabhasataraliteyaṃ  vyādhavadhūrvāladhau valate ||
61561 iha kiṃ kuraṅgaśāvaka  kedāre kalamamañjarīṃ tyajasi |
61562 tṛṇabāṇastṛṇadhanvā  tṛṇaghaṭitaḥ kapaṭapuruṣo'yam ||
61571 iha kiṃ pratisphurati me tavāgrato  nayaśāstranīranidhipāradṛśvanaḥ |
61572 avalīḍhaviśvatamasaḥ puro raver nahi jātu dīpakaśikhā prakāśate ||
61581 iha khalu viṣamaḥ purā kṛtānāṃ  vilasati jantuṣu karmaṇāṃ vipākaḥ |
61582 haraśirasi śirāṃsi yāni rejuḥ  śiva śiva tāni luṭhanti gṛdhrapādaiḥ ||
61591 iha gamiṣyati vaidyamatiḥ śramaṃ  prathamameva purastu mahāsukham |
61592 priyatamasya mṛgākṣi samāgame  navakaragrahaṇā gṛhiṇī yathā ||
61601 iha gurujalabhārapūrṇagarbhāḥ  pradaradarībhramabhūribhīmavegāḥ |
61602 taṭakaṭakaniyudhyamānaveṇī  dviguṇamahāravabhairavāstaṭinyaḥ ||
61611 iha catvāri dānāni proktāni paramarṣibhiḥ |
61612 vicārya nānāśāstrāṇi śarmaṇe'tra paratra ca ||
61621 bhītebhyaścābhayaṃ deyaṃ vyādhitebhyastathauṣadham |
61622 deyā vidyārthināṃ vidyā deyamannaṃ kṣudhāture ||
61631 iha caiva striyo dhanyāḥ śīlasya parirakṣaṇāt |
61632 śīlabhaṅge ca nārīṇāṃ yamalokaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ||
61641 śīlaṃ rakṣyaṃ sadā strībhirduṣṭasaṃgavivarjanāt |
61642 śīlena hi paraḥ svargaḥ strīṇāṃ vaiśya na saṃśayaḥ ||
61651 iha jagati janasya kasya citte  na vasati saukhyavidhānamukhyavārtā |
61652 khalu bhavati tadeva tasya sarvaṃ  bhuvanapatistu yadīśvaraḥ karoti ||
61661 iha jagati ratīśaprakriyākauśalinyaḥ  kati kati na niśīthe subhruvaḥ saṃcaranti |
61662 mama tu vidhihatāyā jāyamānasmitāyāḥ  sahacari paripanthī hanta dantāṃśureva ||
61671 iha tava deva nipatatā  karakamalakuśodakena jāyante |
61672 tattaddūradaridra  dvāri dvipadānavāribhiḥ saritaḥ ||
61681 iha turagaśataiḥ prayāntu mūrkhā  dhanarahitā vibudhāḥ prayāntu padbhyām |
61682 giriśikharagatāpi kākapaṅktiḥ  pulinagatairna samatvameti haṃsaiḥ ||
61691 iha duḥkhaṃ nṛpādibhyaḥ paratra narakāditaḥ |
61692 prāpnoti steyatastena steyaṃ tyājyaṃ sadā budhaiḥ ||
61701 iha duḥkhaṃ layaḥ prokto duḥkhaṃ hartuṃ layaḥ kṣamaḥ |
61702 duḥkhe śubhe layo duḥkhaṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ tasya kathyate ||
61721 iha dharmārthakāmānāmavāptiphalamiṣyate |
61722 tatrārthaḥ saha kāmena nirīkṣyo dharmacakṣuṣā ||
61723 parityajya hi yo dharmamarthamarthāya paśyati |
61724 kāmaṃ vā kāmalābhāya na sa buddheṣu buddhimān ||
61731 iha nagare pratirathyaṃ  bhujaṃgasaṃbādharucirasaṃcāre |
61732 sundari mama matametan  nakulapratipālanaṃ śreyaḥ ||
61741 iha niculanikuñje madhyamadhye'sya rantur vijanamajani śayyā kasya bālapravālaiḥ |
61742 iti kathayati vṛnde yoṣitāṃ pāntu yuṣmān  smitaśabalitarādhāmādhavālokitāni ||
61751 iha niculanikuñje vaṃśasaṃbhārabhāji  svapimi yadi muhūrtaṃ paśyasi kṣetrametat |
61752 iti pathikamakasmānmārga evopaviṣṭaṃ  vadati taruṇakāntaṃ gopikā sāṅgabhaṅgam ||
61761 iha nibhṛtanipātamūkapādaṃ  valayitakārmukavallayaḥ kirātāḥ |
61762 bhavadalasavilokanānabhijñā  mṛgagṛhiṇi praharanti gaccha dūram ||
61771 iha nivasati meruḥ śekharo bhūdharāṇām  iha hi nihitabhārāḥ sāgarāḥ sapta caiva |
61772 idamatulamanantaṃ bhūtalaṃ bhūribhūtod bhavadharaṇasamarthaṃ sthānamasmadvidhānām ||
61781 iha niśi nibiḍanirantara  kucakumbhadvitayadattahṛdayabharā |
61782 ramaṇaguṇakṛṣyamāṇā  saṃtarati tamastaraṅgiṇīṃ kāpi ||
61791 iha paricitā jātyandhānāmiyaṃ na tavonnatir guṇaparicaye cakṣuṣmanto tvayātiviḍambitāḥ |
61792 kṛpaṇavaṇijāmalpīkartuṃ guṇāṃstava kevalaṃ  marakata mṛṣā doṣodgāraḥ kariṣyati duryaśaḥ ||
61801 iha parimalo yatra vyakto na tatra madhuśriyo  madhu samadhikaṃ yasmiṃstasminna gandhasamṛddhayaḥ |
61802 iti maruvakaṃ nindan kundādapetakutūhalaḥ  kamalamadhikaṃ smāraṃ smāraṃ viṣīdati ṣaṭpadaḥ ||
61811 iha puro'nilakampitavigrahā  milati kā na vanaspatinā latā |
61812 smarasi kiṃ sakhi kāntaratotsavaṃ  na hi ghanāgamarītirudāhṛtā ||
61821 iha bahalitamindordīdhitīnāṃ prabhābhir madavikalacakorīcañcumudrāṅkitābhiḥ |
61822 ratibharaparikhedasrastarārthaṃ vadhūnāṃ  karakisalayalīlābhañjanavyañjikābhiḥ ||
61831 iha bhuvi kalayati laghurapi  mahatāṃ saṅgena kamapi mahimānam |
61832 laṅghayati candralīno  nabhastalaṃ helayā hariṇaḥ ||
61841 iha bhogaṃ yaśaḥ prītiṃ sabhāsu bahumānyatām |
61842 dadyātparatra sugatiṃ vidyādhanamanuttamam ||
61851 iha madhupavadhūnāṃ pītamallīmadhūnāṃ  vilasati kamanīyaḥ kākalīsaṃpradāyaḥ |
61852 iha naṭati salīlaṃ mañjarī vañjulasya  pratipadamupadiṣṭā dakṣiṇenānilena ||
61861 iha mahiṣaviṣāṇavyastapāṣāṇapīṭha  skhalanasulabharohidgarbhiṇībhrūṇahatyāḥ |
61862 kuharaviharamāṇaprauḍhabhallūkahikkā  cayacakitakirātasrastaśastrā vanāntāḥ ||
61871 iha muhurmuditaiḥ kalabhai ravaḥ  pratidiśaṃ kriyate kalabhairavaḥ |
61872 sphurati cānuvanaṃ camarīcayaḥ  kanakaratnabhuvāṃ ca marīcayaḥ ||
61881 iha yatkriyate karma tatparatropabhujuyate |
61882 siktamūlasya vṛkṣasya phalaṃ śākhāsu dṛśyate ||
61891 iha yatkriyate karma phalaṃ tatraiva bhujyate |
61892 karmabhūmiriyaṃ rājan phalabhūmiśca sā smṛtā ||
61901 iha yādavavaṃśakṛṣṇavartmā  nugatiḥ sāṅgatayā mayānvabhāvi |
61902 adhunā tadavāpticetase me  madhurākāmadhurāpi rocate kim ||
61911 iha rūpamātrasāre  citrakṛte kamalakahlāre |
61912 na raso nāpi ca gandho  madhukara bandho mudhā bhramasi ||
61921 iha re bahalā lāse bālā rāhumalīmasā |
61922 sālakā rasalīlā sā tuṅgālāli kalārata ||
61931 ihaloke ca pitṛbhiryā strī yasya mahāmate |
61932 adbhirdattā svardharmeṇa pretyabhāve'pi tasya sā ||
61941 iha loke hi dhaninaḥ paro'pi svajanāyate |
61942 svajanastu daridrāṇāṃ jīvatāmeva naśyati ||
61951 iha loke hi dhanināṃ paro'pi svajanāyate |
61952 svajano'pi daridrāṇāṃ tatkṣaṇāddurjanāyate ||
61961 iha loko hato n ṇāṃ dāridryeṇa yathā nṛpa |
61962 manuṣyāṇāṃ tathā janma māghasnānaṃ vinā hatam ||
61971 iha vaṭavṛkṣe yakṣaḥ  prativasati divāpi yatra bhayaśaṅkā |
61972 tasminnabhinavavadhvā  nītā vītodayāḥ kṣaṇadāḥ ||
61981 iha vatsān samacārayad iha naḥ svāmī jagau vaṃśīm |
61982 iti sāsraṃ gadato me  yamunātīre dinaṃ yāyāt ||
61991 iha vahati bahumahodadhi  vibhūṣaṇā mānagarvamiyamurvī |
61992 devasya kamaṭhamūrter na pṛṣṭhamapi nikhilamāpnoti ||
62001 iha vā tārayeddurgāduta vā pretya tārayet |
62002 sarvathā tārayetputraḥ putra ityucyate budhaiḥ ||
62011 iha vikasadaśokāstokapuṣpopakārair ayamatiśayaraktaḥ saktasusnigdhabhāvaḥ |
62012 tribhuvanajayasajjaḥ prājyasā mrājyabhājaḥ  prathayati pṛthumaitrīṃ puṣpacāpasya caitraḥ ||
62021 iha vicaranti kirātās tvādṛksvacchandatānihantāraḥ |
62022 tadamīṣāṃ gānādau  mā dhāḥ śravaṇe kuraṅgaśāva tvam ||
62031 iha vijayini vaṃśe kīrtidhārākalāpa  snapitasakalalokaḥ śrīyaśovigraho'bhūt |
62032 jalaghaṭa iva yuddhottālabhūpāladarpa  jvalanaśamanalīlākovidaḥ ko'pi vīraḥ ||
62041 iha vidhiviṣamaḥ purākṛtānāṃ  bhavati hi jantuṣu karmaṇāṃ vipākaḥ |
62042 kva janakatanayā kva rāmarāmā  kva ca daśakandharamandire nivāsaḥ ||
62051 iha viracayan sādhvīṃ śiṣyaḥ kriyāṃ na nivāryate  tyajati tu yadā mārgaṃ mohāttadā gururaṅkuśaḥ |
62052 vinayarucayastasmātsantaḥ sadaiva niraṅkuśāḥ  parataramataḥ svātantryebhyo vayaṃ hi parāṅmukhāḥ ||
62061 iha viśvambharāpīḍe candanaṃ kasya na priyam |
62062 anusvāraṃ vilipyāpi okārasya prayojanāt ||
62071 iha vaikasya nāmutra amutraikasya no iha |
62072 iha cāmutra vaikasya nāmutraikasya no iha ||
62081 iha vyādhavyūhaḥ paṭughaṭitayantrapraharaṇo  mṛgendrāṇāṃ valgatprakharanakharāṇāṃ kulamiha |
62082 ihālaṅghyaḥ śailo bahalatarapaṅkā saridiha  pradīpto'gnirmadhyevanamahaha kaṣṭaṃ karipateḥ ||
62091 iha śayyāgatenāpi bandhumadhyasthitena vā |
62092 mayaivaikena soḍhavyā marmacchedādivedanā ||
62101 iha śikharakarālakṣoṇibhidgaṇḍaśaila  skhalanadalanagarjatphenilo budbudaughaḥ |
62102 pavanadhṛtaśirīṣaśreṇireṇupraṇālī  surabhisaliladṛptā dvīpavatyo vahanti ||
62111 iha śiṣṭānuśiṣṭānāṃ śiṣṭānāmapi sarvathā |
62112 vācāmeva prasādena lokayātrā pravartate ||
62121 iha saṃtamase ghanāgame  sukhitaṃ bhānavamaindavaṃ vapuḥ |
62122 taḍidujjvaladīpalekhayā  harito'mūḥ parito vicinvati ||
62131 iha samadaśakuntākrāntavānīravīrut prasavasurabhiśītasvacchatoyā vahanti |
62132 phalabharapariṇāmaśyāmajambūnikuñja  skhalanamukharabhūrisrotaso nirjhariṇyaḥ ||
62141 iha sarasi salīlaṃ cārupatre vidhunvan  darataralitatiryakcañcukaṇḍūyitāṅgaḥ |
62142 anusarati sarāgaḥ preyasīmagrayātām  anupadasamudañcatkaṇṭhanālo marālaḥ ||
62151 iha sarasi saharṣaṃ mañjuguñjābhirāmaṃ  madhukara kuru keliṃ sārdhamambhojinībhiḥ |
62152 anupamamakarandāmodadattapramodā  tyajati bata na nidrāṃ mālatī yāvadeṣā ||
62161 iha sarvasvaphalinaḥ kulaputramahādrumāḥ |
62162 niṣphalatvamalaṃ yānti veśyāvihagabhakṣitāḥ ||
62171 iha sāmānyānugamaṃ  samupadiśantaḥ sthaleṣvanekeṣu |
62172 liṅgaparāmarśaparā  navīnanaiyāyikā yānti ||
62181 iha sphuṭaṃ tiṣṭhati nātha kaṇṭakaḥ  śanaiḥ śanaiḥ karṣa nakhāgralīlayā |
62182 iti cchalātkācidalagnakaṇṭakaṃ  padaṃ tadutsaṅgatale nyaveśayat ||
62191 iha hi navavasante mañjarīpuñjareṇu  cchuraṇadhavaladehā baddhahelaṃ saranti |
62192 taralamalisamūhā hārihuṃkārakaṇṭhā  bahulaparimalālīsundaraṃ sinduvāram ||
62201 iha hi madhuragītaṃ rūpametadraso'yaṃ  sphurati parimalo'sau sparśa eṣa stanānām |
62202 iti hṛtaparamārthairidriyairbhrāmyamāṇaḥ  svahitakaraṇadhūrtaiḥ pañcabhirvañcito'smi ||
62211 ihāneke satyaṃ vṛṣamahiṣameṣāḥ suturagā  gṛhāṇi kṣudrāṇāṃ katipayatṛṇaireva sukhinaḥ |
62212 gajānāmāsthānaṃ madasalilajambālitabhuvāṃ  tadeko vindhyādrervipinamathavā bhūpasadanam ||
62221 ihāneke santaḥ satatamupakāriṇyupakṛtiṃ  kṛtajñāḥ kurvanto jagati nivasanto'pi sudhiyaḥ |
62222 kiyantaste santaḥ sukṛtaparipākapraṇayino  vinā svārthaṃ yeṣāṃ bhavati parakṛtyavyasanitā ||
62231 ihāviśadyena pathātivakraḥ  śāstraughaniṣyandasudhāpravāhaḥ |
62232 so'syāḥ śravaḥpatrayuge praṇālī  rekheva dhāvatyabhikarṇakūpam ||
62241 ihaikaścūḍālo'bhyajani kalaśādyasya sakalaiḥ  pipāsorambhobhiśculukamapi no bhartumaśakaḥ |
62242 svamāhātmyaślāghāgurugahanagarjābhiramitaḥ  kuṣitvā kliśnāsi śrutikuharamabdhe kimiti naḥ ||
62251 ihaiva narakavyādheścikitsāṃ na karoti yaḥ |
62252 gatvā nirauṣadhasthānaṃ sa rogī kiṃ kariṣyati ||
62261 ihaiva bhuvane jātaṃ sattvasaṃsthāpanaṃ kṣamam |
62262 gṛhyate kimapi svasthairanyatkimapi jihmagaiḥ ||
62271 ihodyāne sampratyahaha pariśiṣṭāḥ kramavaśād amī valmīkāste bhujagakulalīlāvasatayaḥ |
62272 gatāste vistīrṇastabakabharasaurabhyalaharī  parītavyomānaḥ prakṛtiguravaḥ ke'pi taravaḥ ||
62281 ihopapattirmama kena karmaṇā  kva vā prayātavyamito bhavediti |
62282 vicāraṇā yasya na vidyate smṛtau  kathaṃ sa dharmapravaṇo bhaviṣyati ||
62291 īkṣaṇadhyānasaṃsparśairmatsyakūrmavihaṅgamāḥ |
62292 poṣayanti svakān putrān tadvatpaṇḍitavṛttayaḥ ||
62301 īkṣitopadiśatīva nartituṃ  tatkṣaṇoditamudaṃ manobhuvam |
62302 kāntadantaparipīḍitādharā  pāṇidhūnanamiyaṃ vitanvatī ||
62311 īdṛśaṃ kārayennyāsaṃ yena śreyo bhaviṣyati |
62312 anye'pi duṣṭamantreṇa na hiṃsanti kadācana ||
62321 īdṛśaṃ nigadati priye dṛśaṃ  saṃmadātkiyadiyaṃ nyamīlayat |
62322 prātarālapati kokile kalaṃ  jāgarādiva niśaḥ kumudvatī ||
62331 īdṛśaṃ vyasanaṃ prāptaṃ bhrātaraṃ yaḥ parityajet |
62332 ko nāma sa bhavettasya yameṣa na parityajet ||
62341 īdṛśasya bhavataḥ kathametal lāghavaṃ muhuratīva rateṣu |
