64121 utkampo'pi sakampa eva hṛdaye cintāpi cintānvitā  niḥśvāsā api niḥśvasantyanibhṛtaṃ bāṣpo'pi bāṣpāyate |
64122 kāntāṃ saṃsmarato videśavasaternaktaṃ divaṃ kāminaḥ  prārohā iva niṣpatanti manaso duḥkhāni duḥkhānvitāt ||
64131 utkampo hṛdaye skhalanti vacanānyāvegalolaṃ mano  gātraṃ sīdati cakṣuraśrukaluṣaṃ cintā mukhaṃ śuṣyati |
64132 yasyaiṣā sakhi pūrvara garacanā mānaḥ sa mukto mayā  vansyāstā api yoṣitaḥ kṣititale yāsāmayaṃ saṃmataḥ ||
64141 utkarṇaṃ kariṇāṃ gaṇena vikasanmodaṃ cirādbarhibhiḥ  krīḍākeśaribhiśca pañjaragataiḥ kopasphurallocanam |
64142 kuñjotsa gabhuvi prakampataralaṃ sīmantinībhiḥ kṣaṇāt pītaḥ śrotrapuṭena deva paritaḥ prātarmṛda gadhvaniḥ ||
64151 utkarṇo'yamakāṇḍacaṇḍimapaṭuḥ sphārasphuratkesaraḥ  krūrākārakarālavakravikaṭastabdhordhvalā gūlabhṛt |
64152 citreṇāpi na śakyate'bhilikhituṃ sarvā gasaṃkocanāc cītkurvadgirikuñjakuñjaraśiraḥ kumbhasthalastho hariḥ ||
64161 utkartituṃ samartho'pi gantuṃ caiva sapakṣakaḥ |
64162 dvirepho gandhalobhena kamale yāti bandhanam ||
64171 utkarṣavānnijaguṇo  yathā yathā yāti karṇamanyasya |
64172 dhanuriva suvaṃśajanmā  tathā tathā sajjano namati ||
64181 utkarṣo naiva nityaḥ syānnāpakarṣastathaiva ca |
64182 prākkarmavaśato nityaṃ sadhano nirdhano bhavet ||
64191 utkalikābāhulyaṃ  tattatsvābhāvikaṃ dravatvaṃ ca |
64192 sa ca nirupādhisnehas teneśasya priyā ga gā ||
64201 utkallolasya lakṣmīṃ lavaṇajalanidhirlambhitaḥ kṣīrasindhoḥ  ko vindhyaḥ kaśca gaurīgururiti marutāmabhyudasto vivekaḥ |
64202 nītāḥ karkatvamarkapravahaṇaharayo hāritotsa galakṣmā  rājannuddāmagaurairajani ca rajanīvallabhastvadyaśobhiḥ ||
64211 utkāmunmanayantyete bālāṃ tadalakatviṣaḥ |
64212 ambhodharāstaḍitvanto gambhīrāḥ stanayitnavaḥ ||
64221 utkīrṇā iva vāsayaṣṭiṣu niśānidrālasā barhiṇo  dhūpairjālaviniḥsṛtairvalabhayaḥ saṃdigdhapārāvatāḥ |
64222 ācāraprayataḥ sapuṣpabaliṣu sthāneṣu cārciṣmatīḥ  saṃdhyāma galadīpikā vibhajate śuddhāntavṛddho janaḥ ||
64231 utkūjati bhramati roditi rāraṭīti  padmāni cotkṣipati cañcupuṭena dūram |
64232 toye nimajjati śaśā kamudīkṣate ca  kaṣṭaṃ priyāvirahito niśi cakravākaḥ ||
64241 utkūjati śvasiti muhyati yāti tīraṃ  tīrāttaruṃ tarutalātpunareti vāpīm |
64242 vāpyāṃ na tiṣṭhati na cāti mṛṇālakhaṇḍaṃ  cakraḥ kṣapāsu virahe khalu cakravākyāḥ ||
64251 utkūjantu vaṭe vaṭe bata bakāḥ kākā varākā api  krāṃkurvantu sadā ninādapaṭavaste pippale pippale |
64252 so'nyaḥ ko'pi rasālapallavalavagrāsollasatpāṭava  krīḍatkokilakaṇṭhakūjanakalālīlāvilāsakramaḥ ||
64261 utkṛtya jvalitātśavātkathamapi pretāśanaḥ paiśitīṃ  peśīmagnimayīṃ nigīrya sahasā dandahyamānodaraḥ |
64262 dhāvatyutplavate muhurnipatati prottiṣṭhati prekṣate  viṣvakkrośati saṃpinaṣṭi jaṭharaṃ muṣṭyā hate mastakam ||
64271 utkṛtyotkṛtya kṛttiṃ prathamamatha pṛthūcchophabhūyāṃsi māṃsānya  aṃsasphikpṛṣṭhapiṇḍādyavayavasulabhānyugrapūtīni jagdhvā |
64272 āttasnāyvantranetraḥ prakaṭitadaśanaḥ pretara kaḥ kara kād a kasthādasthisaṃsthaṃ sthapuṭagatamapi kravyamavyagramatti ||
64281 utkṛtyotkṛtya garbhānapi śakalayataḥ kṣatrasaṃtānaroṣād uddāmasyaikaviṃśatyavadhi vidhasataḥ sarvato rājavaṃśyān |
64282 pitryaṃ tadraktapūrṇahradasavanamahānandamandāyamāna  krodhāgneḥ kurvato me na khalu na viditaḥ sarvabhūtaiḥ svabhāvaḥ ||
64291 utkṛṣṭabalavīryasya vijigīṣorjayaiṣiṇaḥ |
64292 guṇānuraktaprakṛteryātrā yānamiti smṛtam ||
64301 utkṛṣṭamadhyamanikṛṣṭajaneṣu maitrī  yadvacchilāsu sikatāsu jaleṣu rekhā |
64302 vairaṃ kramādadhamamadhyamasajjaneṣu  yadvacchilāsu sikatāsu jaleṣu rekhā ||
64311 utkocaṃ prītidānaṃ ca dyūtadravyaṃ subhāṣitam |
64312 kāminīṃ prathamāvasthāṃ sadyo gṛhṇāti buddhimān ||
64321 utkocakāścaupadhikā vañcakāḥ kitavāstathā |
64322 ma galādeśavṛttāśca bhadraprekṣaṇikaiḥ saha ||
64331 asamyakkāriṇaścaiva mahāmātrāścikitsakāḥ |
64332 śilpopacārayuktāśca nipuṇāḥ puṇyayoṣitaḥ ||
64341 evamādyān vijānīyātprakāśāṃllokakaṇṭakān |
64342 vigūḍhacāriṇaścānyānanāryānāryali ginaḥ ||
64351 utkocapāritoṣaka  bhāṭasubhāṣitatarārthacauryāṃśāḥ |
64352 tatkṣaṇameva grāhyāḥ  ṣaḍanyakāle na labhyante ||
64361 utkrāntaṃ girikūṭala ghanasahaṃ te vajrasārā nakhās tattejaśca tadūrjitaṃ sa ca nagonmāthī ninādo mahān |
64362 ālasyādavimuñcatā giriguhāṃ siṃhena nidrālunā  sarvaṃ viśvajayaikasādhanamidaṃ labdhaṃ na kiṃcitkṛtam ||
64371 utkrāntānāmāmiṣāyopariṣṭād adhyākāśaṃ babhrumuḥ patravāhāḥ |
64372 mūrtāḥ prāṇā nūnamadyāpyavekṣā  māsuḥ kāyaṃ tyājitā dāruṇāstraiḥ ||
64381 utkrāmadbhiśca yaḥ prāṇaiḥ prayataḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataḥ |
64382 cintayenmanasā ga gāṃ sa gatiṃ paramāṃ labhet ||
64391 utkṣiptaṃ karaka kaṇadvayamidaṃ baddhā dṛḍhaṃ mekhalā  yatnena pratipāditā mukharayormañjīrayormūkatā |
64392 ārabdhe rabhasānmayā priyasakhi krīḍābhisārotsave  caṇḍālastimirāvaguṇṭhanapaṭakṣepaṃ vidhatte vidhuḥ ||
64401 utkṣiptaṃ sakhi vartipūritamukhaṃ mūkīkṛtaṃ nūpuraṃ  kāñcīdāma nivṛttagharghararavaṃ kṣiptaṃ dukūlāntare |
64402 suptāḥ pañjarasārikāḥ parijano'pyāghūrṇito nidrayā  śūnyo rājapathastamāṃsi niviḍānyehyehi nirgamyatām ||
64411 utkṣiptaṃ saha kauśikasya pulakaiḥ sākaṃ mukhairnāmitaṃ  bhūpānāṃ janakasya saṃśayadhiyā sārdhaṃ samāsphālitam |
64412 vaidehīmanasā samaṃ ca sahasā kṛṣṭaṃ tato bhārgava  prauḍhāhaṃkṛtikandalena ca samaṃ bhagnaṃ tadaiśaṃ dhanuḥ ||
64421 utkṣiptabāhudarśita  bhujamūlaṃ cūtamukula mama sakhyā |
64422 ākṛṣyamāṇa rājati  bhavataḥ paramuccapadalābhaḥ ||
64431 utkṣiptamucchritasitāṃśukarāvalambair uttambhitoḍubhiratīvatarāṃ śirobhiḥ |
64432 śraddheyanirjharajalavyapadeśamasya  viṣvaktaṭeṣu patati sphuṭamantarīkṣam ||
64441 utkṣiptā api dantīdraiḥ kopanaiḥ pattayaḥ param |
64442 tadasūnaharan khaḍgaghātaiḥ svasya puraḥ prabhoḥ ||
64451 utkṣipya karibhirdūrānmuktānāṃ yodhināṃ divi |
64452 prāpi jīvātmabhirdivyā gatirvā vigrahairmahī ||
64461 utkṣipya ṭiṭṭibhaḥ pādāvāste bha gabhayāddivaḥ |
64462 svacittakalpito garvaḥ kasya nātrāpi vidyate ||
64471 utkṣipyālakamālikāṃ vilulitāmāpāṇḍugaṇḍasthalād viśliṣyadvalayaprapātabhayataḥ prollāsya kiṃcitkarau |
64472 dvārastambhaniṣaṇṇagātralatikā kenāpi puṇyātmanā  mārgālokanadattadṛṣṭirabalā tatkālamāli gyate ||
64481 utkṣipyoccaiḥ prasphurantaṃ radābhyām  īṣādantaḥ kuñjaraṃ śātravīyam |
64482 śṛ gaprotaprāvṛṣeṇyāmbudasya  spaṣṭaṃ prāpatsāmyamurvīdharasya ||
64491 utkhātaṃ nidhiśa kayā kṣititalaṃ dhmātā girerdhātavo  nistīrṇaḥ saritāṃpatirnṛpatayo yatnena saṃsevitāḥ |
64492 mantrārādhanatatpareṇa manasā nītāḥ śmaśāne niśāḥ  prāptaḥ kāṇavarāṭako'pi na mayā tṛṣṇe'dhunā mā bhava ||
64501 utkhātacchinnasaṃdhyāruṇakamalavano vyomakāsāramadhyaṃ  manye matto niśīthāhvayavanamahiṣo ma kṣvavikṣanmima kṣuḥ |
64502 tatkālodbhidyamānaḥ saha tanupṛthubhistārakābudbudaughais tasmādevojjihīte kaluṣitabhuvanaṃ bhīṣaṇo dhvāntapa kaḥ ||
64511 utkhātadaivatamivāyatanaṃ purārer astācalāntaritasūryamivāntarikṣam |
64512 hammīrabhūbhuji gate suraveśma viśvaṃ  paśyāmi hāramiva nāyakaratnaśūnyam ||
64521 utkhātān pratiropayan kusumitāṃścinvaṃllaghūn vardhayan  atyuccānnamayan pṛthūn vidalayan viśleṣayan saṃhatān |
64522 tīkṣnān kaṇṭakino bahirniyamayan svāropitān pālayan  mālākāra iva prayogakuśalo rājye ciraṃ tiṣṭhati ||
64531 utkhāya cittopavanātsumedho  mālā kṛtā pustakaniṣkuṭeṣu |
64532 kāvyadrumāṇāmadhiropitānāṃ  phalaṃ parāṃ nirvṛtimunnayāmaḥ ||
64541 utkhelattrivalītara gataralā romāvalīśaivala  stragvalliryuvatī dhruvaṃ janamanonirvāṇavārāṇasī |
64542 etasyā yadurastaṭīparisare yadbālyacāpalyayoḥ  sthāne yauvanaśilpikalpitacitācaityadvayaṃ dṛśyate ||
64551 uttaṃsaḥ kekipicchairmarakatavalayaśyāmale doḥprakāṇḍe  hāraḥ sāndrendranīlairmṛgamadaracito vaktrapatraprapañcaḥ |
64552 nīlābjaiḥ śekharaśrīrasitavasanatā cetyabhīkābhisāre  saṃpratyeṇekṣaṇānāṃ timirabharasakhī vartate veṣalīlā ||
64561 uttaṃsakautukarasena vilāsinīnāṃ  lūnāni yasya na nakhairapi pallavāni |
64562 udyānamaṇḍanataro sahakāra sa tvam  a gārakārakaragocaratāṃ gato'si ||
64571 uttaṃsitaṃ bhāti mukhaprabhābhir na kiṃcidabjaṃ yadaho tadasyāḥ |
64572 yuktaṃ dṛśāveva vidhirvidhijñaḥ  karṇadvayālaṃkaraṇaṃ cakāra ||
64581 uttaṃsīkṛtacandramāḥ sabhujagān vīcīn parāvartayan  jyotsnābhasmavilepane niravadhisphīte mahimni sthitaḥ |
64582 pre kaccha karoṭikoṭihananaiḥ svaḥsindhumudghoṣayann  atyantaṃ pathi garjitāṭṭahasito rudraṃ hasatyarṇavaḥ ||
64591 uttaṃseṣu nanarta na kṣitibhujāṃ na prekṣakairlakṣitaḥ  sākā kṣaṃ luṭhito na ca stanataṭe līlāvatīnāṃ kvacit |
64592 kaṣṭaṃ bhościramantareva jaladherdaivādviśīrṇo'bhavat kheladvyālakulā gagharṣaṇaparikṣīṇapramāṇo maṇiḥ ||
64601 uttapto'yamuraṃgamaḥ śikhitalacchāyāṃ samālambate  vairaṃ sāhajikaṃ vihāya ca śikhī mūlaṃ tarorgacchati |
64602 yācante ca jalaṃ nikuñjabhavane tṛṣṇāturāḥ sārikās tapte vāriṇi pa kajāni madhupāstyaktvā śrayante latāḥ ||
64611 uttamaṃ puṣkarakṣetraṃ tārākṣetraṃ na madhyamam |
64612 adhamaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ tvadhamādhamam ||
64621 uttamaṃ praṇipātena śūraṃ bhedena yojayet | nīcamalpapradānena samaśaktiṃ parākramaiḥ ||
64631 uttamaṃ suciraṃ naiva vipado'bhibhavantyalam |
64632 rāhugrasanasaṃbhūtiḥ kṣaṇaṃ vicchāyayedvidhum ||
64641 uttamaṃ svārjitaṃ vittaṃ madhyamaṃ piturarjitam |
64642 adhamaṃ bhrātṛvittaṃ ca strīvittamadhamādhamam ||
64651 uttamaḥ kleśavikṣobhaṃ kṣamaḥ soḍhuṃ na hītaraḥ |
64652 maṇireva mahāśāṇagharṣaṇaṃ na tu mṛtkaṇaḥ ||
64661 uttamaḥ ṣaṭpadaḥ prokto madhyamaḥ pañcabhistathā |
64662 kaniṣṭhastu caturbhiḥ syādevaṃ syurdhruvakāstridhā ||
64671 uttamakule'pi jātaḥ  sevāṃ vidadhāti nīcalokasya |
64672 vadati ca vācaṃ nīcām  udareśvarapīḍito martyaḥ ||
64681 uttamataruṇaprakṛtiḥ  pulakādikasūcitānyatanusaktiḥ |
64682 sphuṭasaṃnihitavibhāvo  nivāryate kena śṛ gāraḥ ||
64691 uttamapadārtharasikāḥ  sulabhā loke bhavanti sarve'pi |
64692 dūṣitapadārtharasikas tvamiva matastvaṃ punaḥ karaṭa ||
64701 uttamabhujaṃgasaṃgama  nispandanitambacāpalastasyāḥ |
64702 mandaragiririva vibudhair itastataḥ kṛṣyate kāyaḥ ||
64711 uttamarṇadhanadānaśa kayā  pāvakotthaśikhayā hṛdisthayā |
64712 deva dagdhavasanā sarasvatī  nāsyato bahirupaiti lajjayā ||
64721 uttamarṇamukhaṃ paśyannadhamarṇo hriyā naman |
64722 mṛtyujīvitayoryuddhasaṃbhramaṃ parilokate ||
64731 uttamavanitaikagatiḥ  karīva sarasīpayaḥ sakhīdhairyam |
64732 āskanditoruṇā tvaṃ  hastenaiva spṛśan harasi ||
64741 uttamaścintitaṃ kuryātproktakārī tu madhyamaḥ |
64742 adhamo'śraddhayā kuryādakartoccaritaṃ pituḥ ||
64751 uttamastoṣamāyāti tada gaṃ poṣyate yadi |
64752 vṛkṣaḥ prasīdati prāyaḥ pādābhya gena na svayam ||
64761 uttamasya kṣaṇaṃ kopo madhyasya praharadvayam |
64762 adhamasya tvahorātraṃ pāpiṣṭho naiva mucyate ||
64771 uttamasyāpi varṇasya nīco'pi gṛhamāgataḥ |
64772 pūjanīyo yathāyogyaṃ sarvadevamayo'tithiḥ ||
64781 uttamasyāpi varṇasya nīco'pi gṛhamāgataḥ |
64782 bālo vā yadi vā vṛddhaḥ sarvasyābhyāgato guruḥ ||
64791 uttamāḥ svaguṇaiḥ khyātā madhyamāśca piturguṇaiḥ |
64792 adhamā mātulasyāpi śvaśurasyādhamādhamāḥ ||
64801 uttamāḥ svārjitairdravyaiḥ piturvittena madhyamāḥ |
64802 adhamā mātṛvittena strīvittenādhamādhamāḥ ||
64811 uttamā ātmanaḥ khyātāḥ pituḥ khyātāśca madhyamāḥ |
64812 adhamā mātulātkhyātāḥ śvaśurāccādhamādhamaḥ ||
64821 uttamā godbhavājjyaiṣṭhyādbrahmaṇaścaiva dhāraṇāt |
64822 sarvasyaivāsya sargasya dharmato brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||
64831 uttamādhamamadhyānāṃ śrotavyaṃ vacanaṃ budhaiḥ |
64832 tatra cātmahitaṃ grāhyaṃ vastavākyaṃ yathā nṛpaḥ ||
64841 uttamādhamamadhyāni buddhvā kāryāṇi pārthivaḥ |
64842 uttamādhamamadhyeṣu puruṣeṣu niyojayet ||
64851 uttamādhamasaṃsaktau jānan sadṛśavṛttitām |
64852 nārīṇāṃ śucibāhyānāma ganākhyāṃ vyadhādvidhiḥ ||
64861 uttamānāṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ paraduḥkhāsahiṣṇutā |
64862 svayaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ manyate'nyasya vāryate ||
64871 uttamānāmapi strīṇāṃ viśvāso naiva vidyate |
64872 rājapriyāḥ kairaviṇyo ramante madhupaiḥ saha ||
64881 uttamānuttamāneva gacchan hīnāṃśca varjayan |
64882 brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhatāmeti pratyavāyena śūdratām ||
64891 uttamāneva seveta prāpte kāle tu madhyamān |
64892 adhamāṃstu na seveta ya icchecśreya ātmanaḥ ||
64901 uttamābhijanopetānna nīcaiḥ saha vardhayet |
64902 kṛśo'pi hi vivekajño yāti saṃśrayaṇīyatām ||
64911 uttamāścātmanā khyātāḥ pitrā khyātāśca madhyamāḥ |
64912 adhamā mātulaiḥ khyātāḥ śvaśuraiścādhamādhamāḥ ||
64921 uttamāstājikāḥ proktāḥ pārasīkāḥ samudrajāḥ |
64922 kokkāṇākhatalāṇāśca tathā saurāṣṭrajā hayāḥ ||
64931 uttame tu kṣaṇaṃ kopo madhyame ghaṭikādvayam |
64932 adhame syādahorātraṃ cāṇḍāle maraṇāntikaḥ ||
64941 uttamenottamaṃ sarvaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ prayatnataḥ |
64942 adṛṣṭamīkṣya sarveṣāṃ vaktavyaṃ suvicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
64951 uttame vighnavattāsti adhamo duḥkhabhājanam |
64952 tasmātsarvatra yogyatvācśreṣṭho vai madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
64961 uttamaiḥ saha sa gena ko na yāti samunnatim |
64962 mūrdhnā tṛṇāni dhāryante grathitaiḥ kusumaiḥ saha ||
64971 uttamaiḥ saha sāṃgatyaṃ paṇḍitaiḥ saha saṃkathām |
64972 alubdhaiḥ saha mitratvaṃ kurvāṇo nāvasīdati ||
64981 uttamaiḥ saha sāṃgatyaṃ yatprājñaiḥ satyavādibhiḥ |
64982 bandhanastho'pi tiṣṭheta na tu rājye narādhamaiḥ ||
64991 uttamaiḥ svīkṛto nīco nīca eva na cottamaḥ |
64992 bhairavādhiṣṭhitaḥ śvā tu kadācinnaiva kesarī ||
65001 uttamairananujñātaṃ kāryaṃ necchecca taiḥ saha |
65002 devaiḥ sākaṃ sudhāpānādrāhośchinnaṃ śiro yataḥ ||
65011 uttamairuttamairnityaṃ saṃbandhānācaretsaha |
65012 ninīṣuḥ kulamutkarṣamadhamānadhamāṃstyajet ||
65021 uttamo nātivaktā syādadhamo bahubhāṣakaḥ |
65022 na hi svarṇe dhvanistādṛgyādṛkkāṃsye prajāyate ||
65031 uttamo'pi kulajo'pi manuṣyaḥ  sarvalokamahito'pi budho'pi |
65032 dāsatāṃ bhajati yāṃ bhajamānas tāṃ bhajanti gaṇikāṃ kimu santaḥ ||
65041 uttamo'pyadhamasya syādyācñānamrakaraḥ kvacit |
65042 kaustubhādīni ratnāni yayāce harirambudhim ||
65051 uttamo'prārthito datte madhyamaḥ prārthitaḥ punaḥ |
65052 yācakairyācyamāno'pi datte na tvadhamādhamaḥ ||
65061 uttamo madhyamo nīco'dhamo bhrātṛguṇairnaraḥ |
65062 kanyāstrībhaginībhāgyo naro'dhamatamo mataḥ ||
65071 uttamo rasavādaśca dhātuvādaśca madhyamaḥ |
65072 adhamo mantravādaśca mithyāvādo'dhamādhamaḥ ||
65081 uttara gaya kura galocane  locane kamalagarvamocane |
65082 astu sundari kalindanandinī  vīciḍambaragabhīramambaram ||

67311 udayasthaḥ sahasrāṃśurdṛṣṭerāyāti gamyatām |

67321 udayādreruḍḍīno  dinaṃ bhramitvā pata go'yam |

67391 udaradvayabharaṇabhayādardhā gāhitadāraḥ |

67702 prerayedropaṇāyāpi candraloke sa modate ||

67751 udeti savitā tāmrastāmra evāstameti ca |
67752 saṃpattau ca vipattau ca mahatāmekarūpatā ||
67761 udetumatyajannīhāṃ rājasu dvādaśasvapi |
67762 jigīṣureko dinakṛdādityeṣviva kalpate ||

67772 cakorairuḍḍīnairjhaṭiti kṛtaśa kāḥ pratipadaṃ  parāñcaḥ saṃcārānavinayavatīnāṃ vivṛṇute ||

67861 udgrāhaścānyadhātuḥ syāddhruvakaścānyadhātukaḥ |
67862 melāpako'nyadhātuḥ syādābhogaścānyadhātukaḥ |
67863 caturdhātukametaddhi rūpakaṃ kīrtyate budhaiḥ ||

67872 evaṃ hi ṣaṭpadaḥ prokta uttamo dhruvako budhaiḥ ||

67882 niyamastrividho jñeyo maṇṭhakasya vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||

67892 he prāṇā viraheṇa yāta kimidaṃ nairghṛṇyamālambitaṃ  tatsmṛtvā yadi yuktamāsitumaho yūyaṃ pramāṇaṃ mama ||
67901 udgrīvastimitekṣanastata itaḥ paśyannilīya sthitaṃ  pādodghṛṣṭiparasparapratibhayabhrāntaṃ calatpakṣatiḥ |
67902 drāktroṭīpurakoṭikuṇṭhitarayaṃ prāktiryagūrdhvīkṛtaṃ  garbhāntaḥpraṇayīcakāra śapharaṃ kāsāracārī bakaḥ ||
67911 udgrīvā vivṛtāruṇāsyakuharāstṛṣṇācalattālavaḥ  pakṣāsaṃbhavavepamānatanavaḥ proḍḍīya kiṃcidbhuvaḥ |
67912 anyonyākramiṇaḥ śarāriśiśavaḥ prātarnadīrodhasi  prāleyāmbu pibanti vīraṇadaladroṇīpraṇālasrutam ||
67921 udghātayeddakṣiṇamakṣi yakṣo  hastena mṛdnātyatha dakṣiṇena |
67922 yasyābhiṣeke sa bhavetsvaśaktyā  kṣitīśalakṣekṣitapādapadmaḥ ||
67931 udghāṭitanavadvāre pañjare vihago'nilaḥ |
67932 yattiṣṭhati tadāścāryaṃ prayāṇe vismayaḥ kutaḥ ||
67941 udghāṭya ceddakṣiṇamakṣi līḍhe  nābhiṃ svakīyāmathavādhirūḍhaḥ |
67942 śete gṛhasyopari jāgarūkas tadāmbudo'mbu kṣipati prabhūtam ||
67951 udghāṭya yogakalayā hṛdayābjakośaṃ  dhanyaiścirādapi yathāruci gṛhyamāṇaḥ |
67952 yaḥ prasphuratyavirataṃ paripūrṇarūpaḥ  śreyaḥ sa me diśatu śāśvatikaṃ mukundaḥ ||
67961 uddaṇḍakokanadakomalakośakāntiḥ  kāntākacagrahaṇakaṇṭakitaprakoṣṭhaḥ |
67962 mitradvijātiripuvargavilāsinīnāṃ  saṃmānadānabhayabhogakaraḥ karaste ||
67971 uddaṇḍe bhujadaṇḍe  tava kodaṇḍe parisphurati |
67972 arimaṇḍalaravimaṇḍala  rambhākucamaṇḍalāni vepante ||
67981 uddāmajvaladaṃśumālikiraṇavyarthātirekādiva  cchāyāḥ saṃprati yānti piṇḍapadavīṃ mūleṣu bhūmīruhām |
67982 kiṃ caitaddanujādhirājayuvatīvargāvagāhotsarat kṣobhoḍḍīnavihaṃgamaṇḍalakṛtālīkātapatraṃ saraḥ ||
67991 uddāmadakṣiṇamarudbharacālitābhiḥ  śākhābhirākulataraṃ rutavāraṇāya |
67992 mā meti kokilakulaṃ vadatīva vṛkṣaḥ  straiṇaṃ viyogavidhuraṃ kṛpayā vilokya ||
68001 uddāmadantarucipallavitārdhacandra  jyotsnānipītatimiraprasaroparodhaḥ |
68002 śreyāṃsi vo diśatu tāṇḍavitasya śambhor ambhodharāvalighanadhvaniraṭṭahāsaḥ ||
68011 uddāmadānadvipavṛndabṛṃhitair nitāntamuttu gaturaṃgaheṣitaiḥ |
68012 caladghanasyandananeminiḥsvanair abhūnnirucchvāsamivākulaṃ jagat ||
68021 uddāmadigdviradacañcalakarṇapūra  gaṇḍasthaloccaladalistabakākṛtīni |
68022 mīlannabhāṃsi mṛganābhisamānabhāṃsi  dikkandareṣu vilasantitamāṃ tamāṃsi ||
68031 uddāmadyumaṇidyutivyatikaraprakrīḍadarkopala  jvālājālajaṭālajā galataṭīniṣkūjakoyaṣṭayaḥ |
68032 bhaumoṣmaplavamānasūrakiraṇakrūraprakāśā dṛśor āyuḥkarma samāpayanti dhigamūrmadhye'hni śūnyā diśaḥ ||
68041 uddāmadrumabha gabhīmadaśano yenābhyaghāni dvipaḥ  so'yaṃ vañcakaceṣṭitaistyajati kiṃ pañcānanaḥ kānanam |
68042 tatprītirnna kṛtiḥ samaṃ na samaraṃ kṣāntirmanoglānaye  śreyānityayamasya mānanidhino yatkānanopakramaḥ ||
68051 uddāmadviradāvalūnabisinīsaurabhyasaṃbhāvita  vyomānaḥ kalahaṃsakampitagarutpālīmarunmāṃsalāḥ |
68052 dūrottānatara gala ghanakalāja ghālagarvaspṛśaḥ  karpūradravaśīkarairiva diśo limpanti pampānilāḥ ||
68061 uddāmabhramivegavistṛtajaṭāvallīpraṇālīpatat svarga gājaladaṇḍikāvalayitaṃ nirmāya tatpañjaram |
68062 saṃbhrāmyadbhujadaṇḍapakṣapaṭaladvandvena haṃsāyitas trailokyavyayanāṭikānayanaṭaḥ svāmī jagattrāyatām ||
68071 uddāmāmbudagarhitāndhatamasapradhvastadi maṇḍale  kāle yāmikajāgradugrasubhaṭavyākīrṇakolāhale |
68072 karṇasyāsuhṛdarṇavāmbuvaḍavāvahneryadantaḥpurād āyātāsi tadambujākṣi kṛtakaṃ manye bhayaṃ yoṣitām ||
68081 uddāmāmbudavardha mānaśikhinīkekātirekākule  saṃprāpyaṃ salilaṃ sthaleṣvapi sadā nistarṣavarṣāgame |
68082 bhīṣmagrīṣmabhaṭe parasparabhayādālocyamānaṃ muhur dīnaṃ mīnakulaṃ na pālayasi cetkāsāra kā sāratā ||
68091 uddāmārkamarīcimūrchitadṛśāṃ yenādhvagānāmayaṃ  velālambanajāgarūkamanasāmārambhi karṇajvaraḥ |
68092 kleśocchṛ khalacetasaḥ praviśato gaṇḍūṣagarbhaṃ muner līnaḥ kutra mahārṇavasya sa punaḥ kallolakolāhalaḥ ||
68101 uddāmārkāṃśudīpyaddinamaṇimaṇibhirbhasmitānte samantād vāyuvyādhūyamānajvalanakaṇagaṇākīrṇadhūliprakīrṇe |
68102 kāntāre'sminnṛpārte pathi pathika bhave kvāpi pāthodasenā  sūcyagre kūpaṣaṭkaṃ tadupari nagarī tatra ga gāpravāhaḥ ||
68111 uddāmotkalikāṃ vipāṇḍurarucaṃ prārabdhajṛmbhāṃ kṣaṇād āyāsaṃ śvasanodgamairaviratairātanvatīmātmanaḥ |
68112 adyodyānalatāmimāṃ samadanāṃ nārīmivānyāṃ dhruvaṃ  paśyan kopavipāṭaladyuti mukhaṃ devyāḥ kariṣyāmyaham ||
68121 uddiśya niḥsarantīṃ  sakhīmiyaṃ kapaṭakopakuṭilabhrūḥ |
68122 evamavataṃsamākṣipad āhatadīpo yathā patati ||
68131 uddiṣṭaṃ vastu rāgādau kiṃcidādhikyacintitam |
68132 taddhātumātuniṣpannaṃ pratyantaramitīritam ||
68141 uddīpito'pi kanakadyutimañjulo'pi  snehānvito'pi sudṛśo'pi suvartito'pi |
68142 kāntākarāntarakucacchavimaṇḍito'pi  svābhāvikīṃ malinatāṃ na jahāti dīpaḥ ||
68151 uddīptāgnirasau munirvijayate yasyodare jīryataḥ  pāthodheravaśiṣṭamambu kathamapyudgīrṇamanyārṇavam |
68152 kiṃ cāsmājjaṭharānalādiva navastatkālavāntikramān  niryātaḥ sa punaryamāya payasāmantargato vāḍavaḥ ||
68161 uddeśo'yaṃ kanakasikatākomalaikāntakāntā  līlāvāsīkṛtatarutalaḥ kāmibhirnarmadāyāḥ |
68162 kiṃcaitasmin suratasacivāstanvi te vānti vātā  yeṣāmagre sarati kalitākaṇṭhakopo manobhūḥ ||
68171 uddeśo'yaṃ sarasakadalīśreṇiśobhātiśāyī  kuñjotkarṣā kuritaramaṇīvibhramo narmadāyāḥ |
68172 kiṃ caitasmin suratasuhṛdastanvi te vānti vātā  yeṣāmagre sarati kalitākāṇḍakopo manobhūḥ ||
68181 uddhatā alamuddhartumauddhatyaṃ duritātmanām |
68182 kṣārāṇāmeva sāmarthyaṃ malanāśāya vāsasām ||
68191 uddhatairiva parasparasa gād īritānyubhayataḥ kucakumbhaiḥ |
68192 yoṣitāmatimadena jughūrṇur vibhramātiśayapuṃṣi vapūṃṣi ||
68201 uddhatairnibhṛtamekamanekaiś chedavanmṛgadṛśāmavirāmaiḥ |
68202 śrūyate sma maṇitaṃ kalakāñcī  nūpuradhvanibhirakṣatameva ||
68211 uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet |
68212 ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ ||
68221 uddhartuṃ kila śailakelirabhasasrastāni pāthonidher antarbhūṣaṇamauktikāni divijastrībhiḥ samutkaṇṭhayā |
68222 gāḍhaṃ tatra nimajjitena raviṇā baddhvā dṛḍhaṃ raśmibhiḥ  protkṣiptāni nipatya tāni gagane tārāpadeśaṃ dadhuḥ ||
68231 uddhartuṃ dharaṇīṃ niśākararavī kṣeptuṃ marunmārgato  vātaṃ stambhayituṃ payonidhijalaṃ pātuṃ giriṃ cūrṇitum |
68232 śaktā yatra viśanti mṛtyuvadane kānyasya tatra sthitir yasmin yāti girirbile saha vanaiḥ kātra vyavasthā hyaṇoḥ ||
68241 uddhava mādhavasavidhe  vinivedyaṃ sarvathā bhavatā |
68242 api bahumūlyaṃ bhavanaṃ  yamunākuñjopamaṃ na syāt ||
68251 uddhūtakāmānalatāpataptā  vihāya doṣādhikajāṃ tu cintām |
68252 vanādirāgāvayavaprabhedaṃ  nareti matvā vanitā ramante ||
6825 1 uddhūtapāṃsupaṭalānumitaprabandha  dhāvatkhurāgracayacumbitabhūmibhāgāḥ |
6825 2 nirmathyamānajaladhidhvanighoraghoṣam  ete rathaṃ gaganasīmni vahanti vāhāḥ ||
68261 uddhūtā dhūmadhārā virahijanamanomāthino manmathāgneḥ  kastūrīpatramālā timiratatiraho dikpurandhrīmukhānām |
68262 nirvāṇā gāralekhā divasahutabhujaḥ saṃcaraccañcarīka  śreṇīyaṃ bhāti bhāsvatkaralulitanabhaḥkandarendīvarasya ||
68271 uddhūya dhūlīrdhavalā rasātalād vātyā lagantī gagane vyavartata |
68272 phūtkārayantyeva bhuvoddhṛtā bhujā  nidāghatāpākulayā tapātyaye ||
68281 uddhūyeta tanūlateti nalinīpatreṇa no vījyate  sphoṭaḥ syāditi nā gakaṃ malayajakṣodāmbhasā sicyate |
68282 syādasyātibharātparābhava iti prāyo na vā pallavā  ropo vakṣasi tatkathaṃ kṛśatanorādhiḥ samādhīyatām ||
68291 uddhūyeta natabhrūḥ  pakṣmanipātodbhavaiḥ pavanaiḥ |
68292 iti nirnimeṣamasyā  virahavayasyā vilokate vadanam ||
68301 uddhṛteṣvapi śastreṣu dūto vadati nānyathā |
68302 te vai yathoktavaktāro na vadhyāḥ pṛthivībhujā ||
68311 uddhṛteṣvapi śastreṣu bandhuvargavadheṣvapi |
68312 paruṣāṇyapi jalpanto vadhyā dūtā na bhūbhujā ||
68321 uddhriyamānendukarair unmajjatyandhakāravārinidheḥ |
68322 kvāpi kvāpi vilagna  cchāyājambāladhoraṇī dharaṇī ||
68331 udbaddhebhyaḥ sudūraṃ ghanarajanitamaḥpūriteṣu drumeṣu  prodgrīvaṃ paśya pādadvitayadhṛtabhuvaḥ śreṇayaḥ pheravāṇām |
68332 ulkālokaiḥ sphuradbhirnijavadanaguhotsarpibhirvīkṣitebhyaś cyotatsāndraṃ vasāmbhaḥ kvathitaśavavapurmaṇḍalebhyaḥ pibanti ||
68341 udbandhanaṃ dṛḍhaṃ gāḍhaṃ siṃho'pi sahate yadi |
68342 kathaṃ karaṭinastarhi nṛpacihnāni bibhrati ||
68351 udbhartṛgāminī puruṣa  bhāṣiṇī kāmacihnakṛtaveśā |
68352 yā nātimāṃsayuktā  surāpriyā sarvataścapalā ||
68361 udbhāvyamāno nalinīpalāśaiḥ  samīraṇastaddhṛdayāspadasya |
68362 karoti dāhasya nivāraṇaṃ nu  saṃdhukṣaṇaṃ vā smarapāvakasya ||
68371 udbhāsitākhilakhalasya viśṛ khalasya  prāgjātavismṛtanijādhamakarmavṛtteḥ |
68372 daivādavāptavibhavasya guṇadviṣo'sya  nīcasya gocaragataiḥ sukhamāsyate kaiḥ ||
68381 udbhāsite'ndhatamasavraja eti nāśaṃ  sūne prayāntyubhayato'timarandamugdhāḥ |
68382 siṃhā nihatya rudhiraṃ bahu bhakṣitaṃ yad dīpā kure madhukarāḥ kariṇaṃ vamanti ||
68391 udbhiduraṃ stanavadanaṃ  locanamaligarvamocanaṃ sudṛśaḥ |
68392 dṛṣṭvā vigatavicāraṃ  dhātāraṃ nindati sthaviraḥ ||
68401 udbhinnaṃ kimidaṃ manobhavanṛpakrīḍāravindadvayaṃ  sūte tatkathamekataḥ kila lasadromāvalīnālataḥ |
68402 cakradvandvamidaṃ kṣamaṃ tadapi na sthātuṃ mukhendoḥ puro  lāvaṇyāmbunimagnayauvanagajasyāvaimi kumbhadvayam ||
68411 udbhinnayauvanamanohararūpaśobhā  saṃbhāvitābhinavabhogamanobhavānām |
68412 eṇīdṛśāṃ tvadupadeśavivarjitānāṃ  mātarbhavanti nahi nāma samīhitārthāḥ ||
68421 udbhinnasāttvikavikārapariplavāni  sadyastiraskṛtamanobhavavedanāni |
68422 tanvi tvada gaparirambhasukhāmṛtāni  prādurbhavantu punarāgatajīvitāni ||
68431 udbhinnastanakuḍmaladvayamuraḥ kiṃcitkapolasthalīṃ  limpatyeva madhūkakāntiradharaḥ saṃmugdhalakṣmīmayaḥ |
68432 pratyāsīdati yauvane mṛgadṛśaḥ kiṃ cānyadāvirbhaval lāvaṇyāmṛtapa kalepalaḍahacchāyaṃ vapurvartate ||
68441 udbhinnastabakāvataṃsasubhagāḥ pre khanmarunnartitāḥ  puṣpodgīrṇaparāgapāṃśulalasatpatraprakāṇḍa tviṣaḥ |
68442 gambhīrakramapañcamonmadapikadhvānocchaladgītayaḥ  pratyujjīvitamanmathotsava iva krīḍantyamū bhūruhaḥ ||
68451 udbhinnā kalakaṇṭhakaṇṭhakuharātkarṇāmṛtasyandinī  hṛdyā yadyapi mārdavaikavasatiḥ sā kākalīhuṃkṛtiḥ |
68452 anyastanvi tathāpi te triṇayanapluṣṭasya jīvārpaṇaḥ  pañceṣorucitaprapañcitarasaḥ pākāñcitaḥ pañcamaḥ ||
68471 udbhedaṃ pratipadya pakvabadarībhāvaṃ sametya kramāt puṃnāgākṛtimāpya pūgapadavīmāruhya bilvaśriyam |
68472 labdhvā tālaphalopamāṃ ca lalitāmāsādya bhūyo'dhunā  cañcatkāñcanakumbhajṛmbhaṇamibhāvasyāḥ stanau bibhrataḥ ||
68481 udbhrāntabhekakulakīrṇajale taḍāge  ko'pyasti nāma yadi nānyagatirbakoṭaḥ |
68482 utphullapadmasurabhīṇi sarāṃsi hitvā  na sthātumarhati bhavāniha rājahaṃsa ||
68491 udyacchatā dhuramakāpuruṣānurūpāṃ  gantavyamājinidhanena pituḥ pathā vā |
68492 ācchidya vā svajananījanalocanebhyo  neyo mayā ripuvadhūnayanāni bāṣpaḥ ||
68501 udyajjvālāvalībhirvaramiha bhuvanaploṣake havyavāhe  ra gadvīcau praviṣṭaṃ jalanidhipayasi grāhanakrākule vā |
68502 saṃgrāme vāriraudre vividhaśarahatānekayodhapradhāne  no nārīsaukhyamadhye bhavaśatajanitānantaduḥkhapravīṇe ||
68511 udyañchaśī taruṇabhāskarakānticauraḥ  sparśena śītakaralālitayā pradoṣe |
68512 jñāto'rdhasuptanalinīpriyayā salajjaḥ  pāṇḍutvamāpa rabhasādiva manmathārtaḥ ||
68521 udyataṃ śastramālokya viṣādaṃ yāti vihvalaḥ |
68522 jīvanaṃ prati saṃtrāsto nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ bhayam ||
68531 udyatamekahastacaraṇaṃ dvitīyakararecitaṃ suvinataṃ  vaṃśamṛda gavādyamadhuraṃ vicitrakaraṇānvitaṃ bahu vidham |
68532 madrakametadadya subhagairvidagdhagaticeṣṭitaiḥ sulalitair nṛtyasi vibhramākulapadaṃ viviktarasabhāvitaṃ śaśimukhi ||
68541 udyatasya paraṃ hantuṃ stabdhasya vivaraiṣiṇaḥ |
68542 patanaṃ jāyate'vaśyaṃ kṛcchreṇa punarunnatiḥ ||
68551 udyatasya hi kāmasya prativādo na śasyate |
68552 api nirmuktasa gasya kāmaraktasya kiṃ punaḥ ||
68561 udyatāsirnṛpo yatra tatraiva dhanarakṣaṇam |
68562 kaṇṭakākulaśākhyāyāṃ lagnaṃ gṛhṇāti no phalam ||
68571 udyateta yathāśakti na prasajyeta jātucit |
68572 sādhyānāṃ siddhyasiddhī yanniyatyā niyate kṛte ||
68581 udyateṣvapi śastreṣu dūto vadati nānyathā |
68582 sadaivāvadhyabhāvena yathārthasya hi vācakaḥ ||
68591 udyateṣvapi śastreṣu yathoktaṃ śāsanaṃ vadet |
68592 rāgāparāgau jānīyāddṛṣṭivaktraviceṣṭitaiḥ ||
68601 udyatkarakaravālaḥ  śakatimiradhvaṃsane mahānipuṇaḥ |
68602 kalkiharirvaḥ pāyād apāyataḥ kaliniśāntotthaḥ ||
68611 udyattārādhināthadyutihṛtipaṭavaḥ sāndrasindūraśoṇāḥ  śrīmadvetaṇḍatuṇḍapratibhaṭabaṭavaḥ padmarāgātirāgāḥ |
68612 dūrādānamrakamracchaviravikiraṇaśreṇikirmīritāntā  guñjāpuñjānurāgadviguṇitamahasaḥ pāntu kṛṣṇā ghribhāsaḥ ||
68621 udyattāruṇyavāruṇyatiśayitamadocchvāsacāruṇyatī va  prodañcatpañcabāṇapracuraruciradṛkcañcarīkaprapañce |
68622 mandaśrīścandramāste sati sutanu mukhe procchvasattandramāste  hīnaṃ śobhābhirambhoruhamapi rajanau naiti rambhoru hāsam ||
68631 udyatsaurabhagarbhanirbharamiladvālā kuraśrīmṛto  mākandānavalokya yaḥ pratidiśaṃ sānandamutkūjitaḥ |
68632 tānevādya phalāśayā pariraṭalluṇṭhākakākāvalī  vācālānupalabhya kokilayuvā jātaḥ sa vācaṃyamaḥ ||
68641 udyadgandhaprabandhāṃ paramasukharasāṃ kokilālāpajalpāṃ  puṣpasraksaukumāryāṃ kusumaśaravadhūṃ rūpato nirjayantīm |
68642 saukhyaṃ sarvendriyāṇāmabhimatamabhitaḥ kurvatīṃ mānaseṣṭāṃ  satsaubhāgyāllabhante kṛtasukṛtavaśāḥ kāminīṃ martyamukhyāḥ ||
68651 udyadduḥsahavittatānavatayā baddhāvadhāne manasy unmārgabhramaṇe'vaśasya rabhasācchvabhre paribhrāmyataḥ |
68652 anyo'pāhitakośapṛṣṭhaluṭhanātsaṃdarśitā gakṣater jantorhanta tanoti durgatiśamaṃ ramyānulomyo vidhiḥ ||
68661 udyadbarhiṣi dardurāravapuṣi prkṣīṇapānthāyuṣi  ścyotadvipruṣi candraru muṣi sakhe haṃsadviṣi prāvṛṣi |
68662 mā muñcoccakucāgrasantatapatadbāṣpākulāṃ bālikāṃ  kāle kālakarālanīlajaladavyāluptabhāsvattviṣi ||
68671 udyadbālā kuraśrīrdiśi diśi daśanairebhirāśāgajānāṃ  rohanmūlā sugaurairuragapatiphaṇairatra pātālakukṣau |
68672 asminnākāśadeśe vikasitakusumā rāśibhistārakāṇāṃ  nātha tvatkīrtivallī phalati phalamidaṃ bimbamindoḥ sudhārdram ||
68681 udyadvidrumakāntibhiḥ kisalayaistāmrāṃ tviṣaṃ bibhrato  bhṛ gālīvirutaiḥ kalairaviśadavyāhāralīlābhṛtaḥ |
68682 ghūrṇanto malayānilāhaticalaiḥ śākhāsamūhairmuhur bhrāntiṃ prāpya madhuprasa gamadhunā mattā ivāmī drumāḥ ||
68691 udyadvilocanahutāśataḍidvikāśa  vyāsaṃginī suradhunīpayasā sagarbhā |
68692 bhrājatkalānidhibalākaviśobhamānā  pāyājjaṭāghanaghaṭā vṛṣabhadhvajasya ||
68701 udyadvivekatapanapraphulle hṛdayāmbuja |
68702 viśate bhagavadbhaktiraravinda ivendirā ||
68711 udyantu nāma subahūni mahāmahāṃsi  candro'pyalaṃ bhuvanamaṇḍalamaṇḍanāya |
68712 sūryādṛte na tadudeti na cāstameti  yenoditena dinamastamitena rātriḥ ||
68721 udyantu śatamādityā udyantu śatamindavaḥ |

69031 udyogaḥ kṣayameti hanta sahasā jāḍyaṃ samujjṛmbhate  mitrasyāpi ca darśanaṃ bhavati no kiṃ vānyadācakṣmahe |

69061 udyogamedhādhṛtisattvasatya  tyāgānurāgasthitigauravāṇi |

69141 udvartitamapi bahudhā  nuliptamapi candanāgururasādyaiḥ |

69151 udvāsayituṃ veśmani  saraghāḥ kurvanti yanmadhucchattram |

69161 udvāhāropitārdrakṣatanijapadayoḥ saṃgatāmindumaulā  vānamre yāṃ sudhāṃśorvyadhita kila kalāṃ tūrṇamevānnapūrṇām |
69162 saktānāmakṣatānāmamṛtadṛganalopādhitaḥ pakvabhāvān  nānārthairannapūrṇā praṇatajanatateḥ pūrṇatāmātanotu ||
69171 udvijante yathā sarpānnarādanṛtavādinaḥ |
69172 dharmaḥ satyaṃ paro loke mūlaṃ svargasya cocyate ||
69181 udvīkṣya priyakarakuḍmalāpaviddhair vakṣojadvayamabhiṣiktamanyanāryāḥ |
69182 ambhobhirmuhurasicadvadhūramarṣād ātmīyaṃ pṛthutaranetrayugmamuktaiḥ ||
69191 udvṛttadaityapṛtanāpatikaṇṭhapīṭha  cchedocchaladbahalaśoṇitaśoṇadhāram |

69361 unnataghanamadhyagataṃ  nirguṇamapi suradhanuḥ śobhām |

69422 prāṇān prāṇitumeva muñcati raṇe kliśnāti bhogecchayā  sarvaṃ tadviparītameva kurute tṛṣṇāndhadṛksevakaḥ ||

69441 unnamitaikabhrūlatam  ānanamasyāḥ padāni racayantyāḥ |

69481 unnayati nābhinimnān  muktāvalipāśi romarājinalam |

69531 unnidreṇa mayādya cintitamabhūdyatrāvatārā harer ākhyātā daśa kīrtito'si na kathaṃ tatra tvamekādaśaḥ |
69532 tviccāritramagocaraṃ kavigirāṃ jānannapi kṣmāpate  na prastaumi bhayena bhāratakaveḥ kastādṛśaṃ vakṣyati ||
69541 unnīto bhavabhūtinā pratidinaṃ bāṇe gate yaḥ purā  yaścīrṇaḥ kamalāyudhena suciraṃ yenāgamatkeśaṭaḥ |
69542 yaḥ śrīvākpatirājapādarajasāṃ saṃparkapūtaściraṃ  diṣṭyā ślāghyaguṇasya kasyacidasau mārgaḥ samunmīlati ||
69551 unmagnacañcalavanāni vanāpagānām  āśyānasaikatatara gaparaṃparāṇi |

69581 unmatta dhūrta taruṇendunivāsayogye  sthāne piśācapatinā viniveśito'si |

69591 unmattapremasaṃrambhādārabhante yada ganāḥ |
69592 tatra pratyūhamādhātuṃ brahmāpi khalu kātaraḥ ||
69601 unmattamāsādya haraḥ smaraśca  dvāvapyasīmāṃ mudamudvahete |
69602 pūrvaṃ paraspardhitayā prasūnaṃ  nūnaṃ dvitīyo virahādhidūnam ||
69611 unmattānāṃ ca yā gāthāḥ śiśūnāṃ yacca bhāṣitam |
69612 striyo yacca prabhāṣante tasya nāsti vyatikramaḥ ||
69621 unmattānāṃ bhuja gānāṃ madyapānāṃ ca dantinām |
69622 strīṇāṃ rājakulānāṃ ca viśvasanti gatāyuṣaḥ ||
69631 unmattānāṃ bhuja gānāṃ śṛ giṇāṃ śastrapāṇinām |
69632 viśvāso naiva kartavyaḥ strīṣu rājakuleṣu ca ||
69641 unmadatayā kayācit kadācidapathapravṛttamapi puruṣam |
69642 sadyaḥ suhṛdupadeśaḥ  sṛṇiriva kariṇaṃ nivarttayati ||
69651 unmādagadgadagiro madavihvalākṣā  bhraśyannijaprakṛtayaḥ kṛtamasmarantaḥ |
69652 aiśvaryasīdhurasapānavighūrṇamānāḥ  ke nāma na pratipadaṃ puruṣāḥ skhalanti ||
69661 unmādameke puṣyanti yāntyanye dviṣatāṃ vaśam |
69662 dāsyameke ca gacchanti pareṣāmarthahetunā ||
69671 unmīlattrivalītara gavalayā prottu gapīnastana  dvandvenodyatacakravākamithunā vaktrāmbujodbhāsinī |
69672 kāntākāradharā nadīyamabhitaḥ krūrāśayā neṣyate  saṃsārārṇavamajjanaṃ yadi tato dūreṇa saṃtyajyatām ||
69681 unmīlatpulakaṃ viloladalakaṃ svidyatkapolasthalaṃ  bhrāmyatkuṇḍalamākulākulalasatsītkāramudyatkaram |

72722 gatakalpakundatalpāḥ  sarasīsalilāni jighranti ||
72731 uṣasi malayavāsī jālamārgapraviṣṭo  vikacakamalareṇuṃ vyākiranmohacūrṇam |

72741 uṣasyeva bhrāntaṃ hatajaṭharahetostata itaḥ  svayaṃ ca svaṃ bibhradvicarati kuṭumbaṃ diśi diśi |
72742 batāsmābhiḥ kākairiva kavalamātraikamuditair na cāyurdurgatyoravadhiriha labdhaḥ kathamapi ||
72751 uṣāpatimukhāmbhoje narīnarti sarasvatī |
72752 ṛturājakavereva gāyantī guṇagauravam ||
72761 uṣṭrāṇāṃ ca vivāheṣu gītaṃ gāyanti gardabhāḥ |
72762 parasparaṃ praśaṃsanti aho rūpamaho aho dhvaniḥ ||
72771 uṣṇaṃ jalaṃ kṣipettatra mātrā nāstīha kasyacit |
72772 pakṣaikaṃ sthāpite bhāṇḍe koṣṇasthāne manīṣiṇā |
72773 kuṇapastu bhavedeva tarūṇāṃ puṣṭikārakaḥ ||
72781 uṣṇakāle jalaṃ dadyācśītakāle hutāśanam |
72782 prāvṛṭkāle gṛhaṃ deyaṃ sarvakāle ca bhojanam ||
72791 uṣṇamannaṃ ghṛtaṃ madyaṃ taruṇī kṣīrabhojanam |
72792 vāpīkapavaṭacchāyā ṣaḍkaṃ tatbalavardhanam ||
72801 uṣṇāluḥ śiśire niṣīdati tarormūlālavāle śikhī  nirbhidyopari karṇikāramukulānyālīyate ṣaṭpadaḥ |
72802 taptaṃ vāri vihāya tīranalinīṃ kāraṇḍavaḥ sevate  krīḍāveśmani caiṣa pañjaraśukaḥ klānto jalaṃ yācate ||
72811 uṣṇālu kvacidarkadhāmani manāṅnidrālu śītānile  hālānāṃ gṛhayālu cumbadasakṛllajjālu jāyāmukham |

72821 uṣṇīṣavān yathā vastraistribhirbhavati saṃvṛtaḥ |
72822 saṃvṛto'yaṃ tathā dehī sattvarājasatāmasaiḥ ||
72831 uṣmāyamāṇastanamaṇḍalībhir vārāṅganābhiḥ sphuṭavibhramābhiḥ |

72841 ūcivānucitamakṣaramenaṃ  pāśapāṇirapi pāṇimudasya |

7284 1 ūḍhā khaḍgalatā śyāmā tvayā mātaṅgadārikā |
7284 2 ata eva bhavānmanye dūraṃ parihṛtaḥ paraiḥ ||
72851 ūḍhāpi dyutaraṅgiṇi trijagatīvandyena tenāpyaho  maulau bālakuraṅgaketanakalālīlāvataṃsāṅkite |

72861 ūḍhāmunātivāhaya  pṛṣṭhe lagnāpi kālamacalāpi |

72871 ūḍhā yena mahādhurāḥ suviṣame mārge sadaikākinā  soḍho yena kadācideva na nije goṣṭhe'nyaśauṇḍadhvaniḥ |
72872 āsīdyastu gavāṃ gaṇasya tilakastasyaida saṃpratyaho  dhikkaṣṭaṃ dhavalasya jātajaraso goḥ paṇyamudghoṣyate ||
72881 ūdhaśchindyāddhi yo dhenvāḥ kṣīrārthī na labhetpayaḥ |
72882 evaṃ rāṣṭramayogena pīḍitaṃ na vivardhate ||
72891 ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣāyāmaprāptaḥ pañcaviṃśatim |
72892 yadyādhatte pumān garbhaḥ kukṣisthaḥ sa vipadyate ||
72901 ūne dadyādgurūneva yāvatsarvalaghurbhavet |
72902 prastāro'yaṃ samākhyātaśchandovicitivedibhiḥ ||
72911 ūnenāpi hi tucchena vairiṇāpi kathaṃcana |
72912 maitrī buddhimatā kāryā āpadyapi nivartate ||
72921 ūrīkartuṃ tuhinakiraṇaprītidhārāmudārāṃ  dūrīkartuṃ dinakarakarakleśabādhāmagādhām |
72922 yasyāḥ puṇye payasi viśati snātukāmā triyāmā  prāyastasyāstimiratatibhiḥ śyāmalaṃ nīramasyāḥ ||
72931 ūruḥ kuraṅgadṛśaś cañcalacelāñcalo bhāti |
72932 sapatākaḥ kanakamayo  vijayastambhaḥ smarasyeva ||
72941 ūrudvandvamaninditaṃ prathayatā śroṇīṃ samātanvatā  romālīṃ sṛjatā samāgamayatā nābhiṃ gabhīraśriyā |
72942 madhyaṃ kṣāmayatā stanau ghanayatā kāntyā mukhaṃ limpatā  tanvaṅgyā navayauvanena kimapi pratyaṅgamunmīlitam ||
72951 ūrudvayaṃ kadalakandalayoḥ savaṃśaṃ  śroṇiḥ śilāphalakasodarasanniveśā |
72952 vakṣaḥ stanadvitayatāḍitakumbhaśobhaṃ  sabrahmacāri śaśinaśca mukhaṃ mṛgākṣyāḥ ||
72961 ūrudvayaṃ mṛgadṛśaḥ kadalasya kāṇḍau  madhyaṃ ca vediratulaṃ stanayugmamasyāḥ |
72962 lāvaṇyavāriparipūritaśātakumbha  kumbhau manojanṛpaterabhiṣecanāya ||
72971 ūruprakāṇḍadvitayena tanvyāḥ  karaḥ parājīyata vāraṇīyaḥ |
72972 yuktaṃ hriyā kuṇḍalanacchalena  gopāyati svaṃ mukhapuṣkaraṃ saḥ ||
72981 ūrumūlagatanetrayugasya  preyaso rabhasavellitakeśī |
72982 cumbati sma ratikelividagdhā  hāvahāri vadanaṃ dayitasya ||
72991 ūrumūlacapalekṣaṇamaghnan  yairvataṃsakumumaiḥ priyametāḥ |
72992 cakrire sapadi tāni yathārthaṃ  manmathasya kusumāyudhanāma ||
73001 ūrū rambhā dṛgapi kamalaṃ śevalaṃ keśapāśo  vaktraṃ candro lapitamamṛtaṃ madhyadeśo mṛṇālam |
73002 nābhiḥ kūpo valirapi saritpallavaḥ kiṃ ca pāṇir yasyāḥ sā cedurasi na kathaṃ hanta tāpasya śāntiḥ ||
73011 ūrū rambhe bāhū  late vidhātrā kucau punaḥ kamale |
73012 yauvanamupavanamasyāṃ  madanavilāsāya kiṃ racitam ||
73021 ūrau śirastava niveśya dayāvitīrṇa  saṃyānapallavasamīravinītakhedam |
73022 atraiva janmani vibhoḥ paramopadeśam  ākarṇayeyamapi kiṃ maṇikarṇikāyām ||
73031 ūrjitaṃ sajjanaṃ dṛṣṭvā dveṣṭi nīcaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
73032 kavalīkurute svasthaṃ vidhuṃ divi vidhuṃtudaḥ ||
73041 ūrṇāṃ naiva dadāti naiva viṣayo vāhasya dohasya vā  tṛptirnāsti mahodarasya bahubhirghāsaiḥ palāśairapi |
73042 hā kaṣṭaṃ kathamasya pṛṣṭhaśikhare goṇī samāropyate  ko gṛhṇāti kapardakairalamiti grāmyairgajo hasyate ||
73051 ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti yaṃ tyaktvā yaṃ gṛhītvā patantyadhaḥ |
73052 tasya gauravamarthasya tāvataivānumīyatām ||
73061 ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ |
73062 jaghanyaguṇavṛttasthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ ||
73071 ūrdhvaṃ na kṣīravicchedātpayo dhenoravāpyate |
73072 evaṃ rāṣṭrādayogena pīḍitānnāpyate baliḥ ||
73081 ūrdhvaṃ nīradavṛndamaindavamidaṃ bimbaṃ tvadho nirmitaṃ  vyomnaḥ palvalacitritasya nihitau śailāvuparyunnatau |
73082 kiṃ cādhaḥ pulinoccayasya kadalīkāṇḍāvavāropitau  tanmanye caturasya puṣpadhanuṣaḥ sargo'yamanyādṛśaḥ ||
73091 ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati |
73092 pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punastān pratipadyate ||
73101 ūrdhvaṃ yāti cāpamuṣṭirguṇamuṣṭiradho bhavet |
73102 sa mukto mārgaṇo lakṣyāddūraṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ||
73111 ūrdhvaṃvrīhitrayaṃ mānamaṅgulasya nigadyate |
73112 hasto'pi hi samākhyātaścaturviśadbhiraṅgulaiḥ ||
73121 ūrdhvaṃ śvasaṃstataḥ prāṇo yātyalabdhasthitistanoḥ |
73122 taṃ yāntamanuyātyeva jīvaḥ kālapraṇoditaḥ ||
73131 ūrdhvagaṃ kapilābhāsamaṅgaṃ yasmin pratīyate |
73132 nakulāṅgaṃ tu taṃ vidyātsparśastasyāhināśanaḥ ||
73141 ūrdhvabāhurviraumyeṣa na ca kaścicśrṇoti me |
73142 dharmādarthaśca kāmaśca sa kimarthaṃ na sevyate ||
73151 ūrdhvavedhī bhavejjyeṣṭho nābhivedī ca madhyamaḥ |
73152 yaḥ pādavedhī lakṣyasya sa kaniṣṭho mato mayā ||
73161 ūrdhvaśaktinipātena adhaḥśakternikuñcanāt |
73162 madhyaśaktiprabodhena jāyate paramaṃ sukham ||
73171 ūrdhvānanā bhāskarasaṃmukhīnāḥ  śvāno ruvanto mahate bhayāya |
73172 evaṃ hi saṃdhyāsamaye'nyadā tu  nirvāsakāḥ syurnagarasya tasya ||
73181 ūrdhvārohe ya ālambaheturbhūbhṛcchinatti tam |
73182 kuṭhārikastaruskandhamivādhogamanonmukhaḥ ||
73191 ūrdhvārdhe lakṣaṇaṃ yasya nādho'rdhe lakṣaṇaṃ bhavet |
73192 taṃ khaḍgaṃ madhyamaṃ prāhuḥ pravīṇamatayo budhāḥ ||
73201 ūrdhvīkṛtagrīvamaho mudhaiva  kiṃ yācase cātakapota megham |
73202 atyūrjitaṃ garjitamātramasminn  ambhodhare bindulavastu dūram ||
73211 ūrdhvīkṛtāsyā ravidattadṛṣṭayaḥ  sametya sarve suravidviṣaḥ puraḥ |
73212 śvānaḥ svareṇa śravaṇāntaśātinā  mitho rudantaḥ karuṇena niryayuḥ ||
73221 ūṣaraṃ karmasasyānāṃ kṣetraṃ vārāṇasī purī |
73222 yatra saṃlabhyate mokṣaḥ samaṃ caṇḍālapaṇḍitaiḥ ||
73231 ūṣareṣu ca kṣetreṣu yathā bījaṃ hi niṣphalam |
73232 upakāro'pi nīcānāṃ kṛto bhavati tādṛśaḥ ||
73241 ūṣareṣu vivareṣu cāmbhasāṃ  vīcayo'pi bhavatā vinirmitāḥ |
73242 kṣetrasīmni nihitāstu bindavo  vārivāha bhavato navo nayaḥ ||
73251 ūṣare sariti śālmalīvane  dāvapāvakacite'pi candane |
73252 tulyamarpayati vāri vāride  kīrtirastu guṇagauravairgatam ||
73261 ūṣmavyapetā rahitāśca vṛddhyā  saṃyogahīnā laghavo'pi cāntaḥ |

73271 ūṣmā yasyāṃ dhātryāṃ  dhūmo vā tatra vāri narayugale |
73272 nirdeṣṭavyā ca śirā  mahatā vāripravāheṇa ||
73281 ūṣmā hi vittajo vṛddhiṃ tejo nayati dehinām |

73291 ṛkṣasya kroḍasaṃdhiprahitamukhatayā maṇḍalībhūtamūrter ārātsuptasya vīra tvadarivarapuradvāri nīhārakāle |
73292 prātarnidrāvinodakramajanitasukhonmīlitaṃ cakṣurekaṃ  vyādhāḥ pālālabhasmasthitadahanakaṇākāramālokayanti ||
73301 ṛkṣāṇāṃ bhūridhāmnāṃ śritamadhipatinā prasphuradbhīmatāraṃ  sphāraṃ netrānalena prasabhaniyamitoccāpamīnadhvajena |
73302 rāmāyattaṃ purāreḥ kumudaśuci lasannīlasugrīvamaṅgaṃ  plāvaṅgaṃ sainyamanyaddaśavadanaśiracchedahetu śriyai vaḥ ||
73311 ṛkṣairvṛto haripade nivasan samīra  saṃtānaśaityajanakaḥ kumudapramodī |
73312 nighnanniśācaratamaḥ pṛthunīlalakṣmā  tārāpatiḥ sphurati citramanaṅgado'yam ||
73321 ṛgyajuḥsāmanāmānastrayo vedāstrayī smṛtā |
73322 ubhau lokāvavāpnoti trayyāṃ tiṣṭhan yathāvidhi ||
73331 ṛjutāṃ nayataḥ smarāmi te  śaramutsaṅganiṣaṇṇadhanvanaḥ |
73332 madhunā saha sasmitāṃ kathāṃ  nayanopāntavilokitaṃ ca yat ||
7333 1 ṛjutā dhanvaguṇayorastu vastusvarūpataḥ |
7333 2 kāryasiddhau praśasyeta vakrataiva tayoḥ punaḥ ||
73341 ṛjutvaṃ ca parityajya kalāṃ darśayato'rcanā |
73342 dvijarājo'nṛjutvena maheśenāpi mahyate ||
73351 ṛjutvaṃ tyāgitā śauryaṃ sāmānyaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ |
73352 dākṣiṇyaṃ cānuriktaśca satyatā ca suhṛdguṇāḥ ||
73361 ṛjutvamaunaśrutipāragāmitā  yadīyametatparameva hiṃsitum |
73362 atīva viśvāsavidhāyi ceṣṭitaṃ  bahurmahānasya sa dāmbhikaḥ śaraḥ ||
73371 ṛjudṛśaḥ kathayanti purāvido  madhubhidaṃ kila rāhuśiraśchidam |
73372 virahimūrdhabhidaṃ nigadanti na  kva nu śaśī yadi tajjaṭharānalaḥ ||
73381 ṛjunayananipātaḥ kāmatantrābhighātas tanurapi taralākṣyāḥ kasya na syātkaṭākṣaḥ |
73382 iti namitamukhenduṃ paśyati prāṇanāthaṃ  janasadasi vidagdhā pakṣmaṇāmantareṇa ||
73391 ṛjunā nidhehi caraṇau  parihara sakhi nikhilanāgarācāram |
73392 iha ḍākinīti pallī  patiḥ kaṭākṣe'pi daṇḍayati ||
73401 ṛju paśyati yaḥ sarvaṃ cakṣuṣānupibanniva |
73402 āsīnamapi tūṣṇīkamanurajyanti taṃ prajāḥ ||
73411 ṛjureṣa pakṣavāniti  kāṇḍe prītiṃ khale ca mā kārṣīḥ |
73412 prāyeṇa tyaktaguṇaḥ  phalena hṛdayaṃ vidārayati ||
73421 ṛjvāyatāṃ ca viralāṃ ca natonnatāṃ ca  saptarṣivaṃśakuṭilāṃ ca nivartaneṣu |
73422 nirmucyamānabhujagodaranirmalasya  sīmāmivāmbaratalasya vibhajyamānām ||
73431 ṛjvāyatāṃ hi mukhatoraṇalolamālāṃ  bhraṣṭāṃ kṣitau tvamavagacchasi mūrkha sarpam |
73432 mandānilena niśi yā parivartamānā  kiṃcitkaroti bhujagasya viceṣṭitāni ||
73441 ṛjvī dṛṣṭiranulbaṇaṃ vihasitaṃ mandaṃ parispanditaṃ  dveṣo narmaṇi dūratīrthagamane yatno ratirliṅgiṣu |
73442 yasyāstyaktasukhaspṛhaṃ kila vapuḥ pīnālpalambastanī  sakṣīrā viṭaceṭakaikamahiṣī raṇḍā śivāyāstu vaḥ ||
73451 ṛjvī sthirā suvṛttā  pāṇigrahaṇojjvalā suvaṃśotthā |
73452 saṃdhārayati patantaṃ  saṃprati gṛhaṇīva yaṣṭirmām ||
73461 ṛṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tvadattaṃ cedbādhate'tra paratra ca |
73462 na naśyedduṣkṛtaṃ tadvadbhuktiṃ vā niṣkṛtiṃ vinā ||
73471 ṛṇaṃ mitrānna kartavyaṃ na deyaṃ cāpi mitrake |
73472 prīticchedakarī jñeyā yasmādvai ṛṇakartarī ||
73481 ṛṇaṃ yācñā ca vṛddhatvaṃ jāracoradaridratāḥ |
73482 rogaśca bhuktaśeṣaścāpyaṣṭa kaṣṭāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
73491 ṛṇakartā pitā śatrurmātā ca vyabhicāriṇī |
73492 bhāryā rūpavatī śatruḥ putraḥ śatrurapaṇḍitaḥ ||
73501 ṛṇatrayaṃ dvijātīnāṃ janmanaḥ prabhṛti sthitam |
73502 ṛṇāntarabhṛtāṃ puṃsāṃ jīvanaṃ jīvanaṃ vinā ||
73511 ṛṇatrayaṃ nirākāri nūtnaṃ cākāri yena no |
73512 sa ekaḥ sukṛtī lokaḥ sarvatra sukhamedhate ||
73521 ṛṇatrayamapākartuṃ śāstrājñābhaṅgabhīḥ puraḥ |
73522 caturtharṇanirākāre pratyakṣaṃ nṛpaterbhayam ||
73531 ṛṇadātā ca daivajñaḥ śrotriyaḥ sujalā nadī |
73532 yatra hyete na vidyante na tatra divasaṃ vaset ||
73541 ṛṇadaiḥ svajanaiḥ putrairlabdhakṣāmapratigrahaḥ |
73542 nityamāyāsyate yena kalidānena tena kim ||
73551 ṛṇapāpasamuddhārādṛṇoddhāro varaḥ smṛtaḥ |
73552 paraloke dahetpāpamṛṇāgniriha tatra ca ||
73561 ṛṇapradātā vaidyastu śrotriyaḥ sajalā nadī |
73562 rājā yatra na vidyante na kuryāttatra saṃsthitim ||
73571 ṛṇamādyaṃ nirākṛtya nirākartumṛṇāntaram |
73572 pratiṣṭhā rājate yasya gṛhasthāśrama eva saḥ ||
73581 ṛṇavaccirasaṃśodhyaṃ vacasā pratipāditam |
73582 yannityayācanadveṣaṃ yācyadānena tena kim ||
73591 ṛṇaśeṣaṃ rogaśeṣaṃ śatruśeṣaṃ na rakṣayet |
73592 yācakādyaiḥ prārthitaḥ sanna tīkṣṇaṃ cottaraṃ vadet |
73593 tatkāryaṃ tu samarthaścetkuryādvā kārayīta ca ||
73601 ṛṇaśeṣo'gniśeṣaśca vyādhiśeṣastathaiva ca |
73602 punaśca vardhate yasmāttasmāccheṣaṃ ca kārayet ||
73611 ṛṇaśeṣo'gniśeṣaśca śatruśeṣastathaiva ca |
73612 punaḥ punarvivardheta svalpo'pyanivāritaḥ ||
73621 ṛṇasaṃbandhinaḥ sarve putradāraṃ paśustathā |
73622 ṛṇakṣaye kṣayaṃ yānti kā tatra paridevanā ||
73631 ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet |
73632 anapākṛtya mokṣaṃ tu sevamāno vrajatyadhaḥ ||
73641 ṛṇānubandharūpeṇa paśupatnīsutālayāḥ |
73642 ṛṇakṣaye kṣayaṃ yānti kā tatra paridevanā ||
73651 ṛṇikaiḥ kalahairnityamacchinnagaṇanāgateḥ |
73652 dānadviṣo'napatyasya mandāgneśca dhanena kim ||
73661 ṛṇīkṛtā kiṃ hariṇībhirāsīd asyāḥ sakāśānnayanadvayaśrīḥ |
73662 bhūyoguṇeyaṃ sakalā balādyat tābhyo'nayālabhyata bibhyatībhyaḥ ||
73671 ṛtumatyāṃ tu tiṣṭhantyāṃ svecchādānaṃ vidhīyate |
73672 tasmādudvāhayennagnāṃ manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bravīt ||
73681 ṛturmāsadvayenaiva ṣaṇmāsairayanaṃ smṛtam |
73682 ayanadvitayaṃ varṣo devānāṃ vāsaro niśā ||
73691 ṛturvyatītaḥ parivartate punaḥ  kṣayaṃ prayātaḥ punareti candramāḥ |
73692 gataṃ gataṃ naiva tu saṃnivartate  jalaṃ nadīnāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ ca yauvanam ||
73701 ṛtusnātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ naiva gacchati mūḍhadhīḥ |
73702 ghorāyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
73711 ṛtusnātā pibennārī śvetakaṇṭārikājaṭām |
73712 payasā putrasaṃbhūtistasyāḥ saṃjāyate dhruvam ||
73721 ṛtena jīvedanṛtena jīven  mitena jīvetpramitena jīvet |
73722 satyānṛtābhyāmathavāpi jīvet śvavṛttimekāṃ parivarjayettu ||
73731 ṛte niyogātsāmarthyamavaboddhuṃ na śakyate |
73732 sahasā viniyogo hi doṣavān pratibhāti me ||
73741 ṛte yadarthaṃ praṇayādrakṣyate yacca rakṣati |
73742 pūrvopacitasaṃbandhaṃ tanmitraṃ nityamucyate ||
73751 ṛte senāpraṇetāraṃ pṛtanā sumahatyapi |
73752 dīryate yuddhamāsādya pipīlikapuṭaṃ yathā ||
73761 ṛtvikpurohitācāryāḥ śiṣyāḥ saṃbandhibāndhavāḥ |
73762 sarve pūjyāśca mānyāśca śrutavṛttopasaṃhitāḥ ||
73771 ṛddhimān rākṣaso mūḍhaścitraṃ nāsau yaduddhataḥ |
73772 ko vā heturanāryāṇāṃ dharmye vartmani vartitum ||
73781 ... ... ... ... ... ... |
73782 ṛddhiyuktā hi puruṣā na sahante parastavam ||
73791 ṛṣabho'tra gīyata iti  śrutvā svarapāragā vayaṃ prāptāḥ |
73792 ko veda goṣṭhametad gośāntau vihitabahumānam ||
73801 ṛṣayaścaiva devāśca satyameva hi menire |
73802 satyavādī hi loke'smin paramaṃ gacchati kṣayam ||
73811 ṛṣayo'pyugratapaso daivenābhiprapīḍitāḥ |
73812 utsṛjya niyamāṃstīvrān bhraśyante kāmamanyubhiḥ ||
73821 ṛṣayo manavo devā manuputrā mahaujasaḥ |
73822 kalāḥ sarve harereva saprajāpatayastathā ||
73831 ṛṣayo rākṣasīmāhurvācamunmattadṛptayoḥ |
73832 sā yoniḥ sarvavairāṇāṃ sā hi lokasya nirṛtiḥ ||
73841 ṛṣirayamatithiścedviṣṭaraḥ pādyamarghyaṃ  tadanu ca madhuparkaḥ kalpyatāṃ śrotriyāya |
73842 atha tu ripurakasmāddveṣṭi naḥ putrabhāṇḍaṃ  tadiha nayavihīne kārmukasyādhikāraḥ ||
73851 ṛṣisenā vinā vedamapriyā sahagāminī |
73852 devasenā vinā dātnaviṣṇuḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ||
73861 ṛṣīṃśca devāṃśca mahāsurāṃśca  traividyavṛddhāṃśca vane munīṃśca |
73862 kānāpado nopanamanti loke  parāvarajñāstu na saṃbhramanti ||
73871 ṛṣīṇāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca kulānāṃ ca mahātmanām |
73872 prabhavo nādhigantavyaḥ strīṇāṃ duścaritasya ca ||
73881 ṛṣīṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyamidaṃ bharatasattama |
73882 tīrthābhigamanaṃ puṇyaṃ yajñairapi viśiṣyate ||
73891 ṛṣerasyāśrame puṇye śāpasaṃtrastamānasaḥ |
73892 mudbodhato'pi prāyo'yaṃ mṛgātsiṃhaḥ palāyate ||
73901 ekaṃ kāñcanabhūdharaṃ suvalayaṃ vāsaḥ sudhāvāridhiṃ  tāraṃ tārakarājamaṇḍalamidaṃ saṃprāpya satkuṇḍalam |
73902 dūrasthāpi ca tena tena sadṛśaṃ tvāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cāparaṃ  strī mānagrahileva yācatitarāṃ śrīrāma kīrtistava ||
73911 ekaṃ cakṣurviveko hi dvitīyaṃ satsamāgamaḥ |
73912 tau na sto yasya sa kṣipraṃ mohakūpe pateddhruvam ||
73921 ekaṃ citramatīva dṛṣṭamiha yannālokitaṃ na śrutaṃ  kiṃ kasmai kathayāmi kasya manasi syādvā mama pratyayaḥ |
73922 ekasmin kanakasya dāmni sarasīmailindamattadvipa  jyotsnācandracakoracakracamarīvālāścamatkurvate ||
73931 ekaṃ jīvanamūlaṃ  cañcalamapi tāpayantamapi satatam |
73932 antarvahati varākī  sā tvāṃ nāseva niḥśvāsam ||
73941 ekaṃ dantacchadasya sphurati japavaśādardhamanyatprakopād ekaḥ pāṇiḥ praṇantuṃ śirasi kṛtapadaḥ kṣeptumanyastameva |
73942 ekaṃ dhyānānnimīlatyaparamaviṣahaṃ vīkṣituṃ cakṣuritthaṃ  tulyānicchāpi vāmā tanuravatu sa vo yasya saṃdhyāvasāne ||
73951 ekaṃ dṛṣṭvā śataṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā pañcaśatānyapi |
73952 atilobho na kartavyaścakraṃ bhramati mastake ||
7395 1 ekaṃ dvijaṃ ca spṛhaṇīyavācaṃ   mattadvirephaṃ ca madhuḥ pupoṣa |
7395 2 sato guṇānapyasato'pi doṣān  jātyā vihīno na vivektumīṣṭe ||
73961 ekaṃ dhāma śamīṣu līnamaparaṃ sūryopalajyotiṣāṃ  vyājādadriṣu gūḍhamanyadudadhau saṃguptamaurvāyate |
73962 tvattejastapanāṃśumāṃsalasamuttāpena durgaṃ bhayād vārkṣaṃ pārvatamaudakaṃ yadi yayustejāṃsi kiṃ pārthivāḥ ||
73971 ekaṃ dhyānanimīlanānmukulitaprāyaṃ dvitīyaṃ punaḥ  pārvatyā vadanāmbujastanabhare śṛṅgārabhāvālasam |
73972 anyaddūravikṛṣṭacāpamadanakrodhānaloddīpitaṃ  śaṃbhorbhinnarasaṃ samādhisamaye netratrayaṃ pātu vaḥ ||
73981 ekaṃ nāma jaḍātmakasya muṣitaṃ lāvaṇyamindostayā  netrābhyāmasitotpalasya ca ruciḥ prāyeṇa tanno mṛṣā |
73982 no jānāti hṛtāmasau padagatiṃ matto varākaḥ karī  tanvaṅgyā vidato'pi yanmama hṛtaṃ cetastadatyadbhutam ||
73991 ekaṃ bhūmipatiḥ karoti sacivaṃ rājye pramāṇaṃ yadā  taṃ mohācśrayate madaḥ sa ca madālasyena nirvidyate |
73992 nirviṇṇasya padaṃ karoti hṛdaye tasya svatantraspṛhā  svātantryaspṛhayā tataḥ sa nṛpateḥ prāṇānabhidruhyati ||
74001 ekaṃ mahiṣaśiraḥsthitam  aparaṃ sānandasuragaṇapraṇatam |
74002 giriduhituḥ padayugalaṃ  śoṇitamaṇirāgarañjitaṃ jayati ||
74011 ekaṃ mitraṃ bhajate  māsenenduḥ svayaṃ kṣayaṃ gacchan |
74012 mitraśatāni bhajaṃstvaṃ  pratikṣaṇaṃ vṛddhimupayāsi ||
74021 ekaṃ mitraṃ bhūpatirvā yatirvā  ekā bhāryā sundarī vā darī vā |
74022 ekaṃ śāstraṃ vedamadhyātmakaṃ vā  eko devaḥ keśavo vā jino vā ||
74031 ekaṃ liṅgaṃ pramadā  hṛdayaṃ vidadhāti jarjaraṃ sahasā |
74032 teṣāṃ ṣaṭkaṃ yeṣāṃ  antargūḍhaṃ na te kathaṃ paśavaḥ ||
74041 ekaṃ vadati mano mama  yāmi na yāmīti hṛdayamaparaṃ me |
74042 hṛdayadvayamucitaṃ tava  sundari hṛtakāntacittāyāḥ ||
74051 ekaṃ vastu dvidhā kartuṃ bahavaḥ santi dhanvinaḥ |
74052 dhanvī sa māra evaiko dvayoraikyaṃ karoti yaḥ ||
74061 ekaṃ vastu yadasti viśvajanatānandapramodātmakaṃ  satyaṃ tattvamasīti vākyamakhilaṃ tvayyeva viśrāmyati |
74062 tvāmākarṇya na kiṃcidanyadavanīśṛṅgāra bho manyate  tvayyāpte janakādikīrtijanake kiṃ jñānamīmāṃsayā ||
74071 ekaṃ vā kupitapriyāpraṇayinīṃ kṛtvā manonirvṛtiṃ  tiṣṭhāmo nijacārupīvarakucakrīḍārasāsvādane |
74072 anyadvā surasindhusaikatataṭīdarbhāṣṭakasrastara  sthāne brahmapadaṃ samāhitadhiyo dhyāyanta evāsmahe ||
74081 ekaṃ viṣaraso hanti śastreṇaikaśca vadhyate |
74082 sarāṣṭraṃ saprajaṃ hanti rājānaṃ mantravisravaḥ ||
74091 ekaṃ vai sevate nityamanyaṃ cetasi rocate |
74092 puruṣāṇāmalābhena nārī caiva pativratā ||
74101 ekaṃ saṃdigdhayostāvadbhāvi tatreṣṭajanmani |
74102 hetumāhuḥ svamantrādīnasaṅgānanyathā viṭāḥ ||
74111 ekaṃ sāgaratīranīranikarasphārāñjalikṣālitaiḥ  puṣpairacyutapūjanaṃ nijakaravyāpārasaṃpāditaiḥ |
74112 no cenmañjulamālatīdalalasatkhaṭvārcite mandire  kāntātuṅganitambabimbasuratakrīḍārasaiḥ sthīyate ||
74121 ekaṃ sute mṛgāriṇī bahūn sūte vṛkī sutān |
74122 uttāraḥ pralayaṃ yānti nādyamānāḥ kathaṃcana ||
74131 ekaṃ hanyānna vā hanyādiṣuḥ kṣipto dhanuṣmatā |
74132 prājñena tu matiḥ kṣiptā hanyādgarbhagatānapi ||
74141 ekaṃ hanyānna vā hanyādiṣurmukto dhanuṣmatā |
74142 buddhirbuddhimatotsṛṣṭā hanyādrāṣṭraṃ sarājakam ||
74151 ekaṃ hanyānna vā hanyādiṣurmukto dhanuṣmatā |
74152 sarāṣṭraṃ saprajaṃ hanti rājānaṃ mantriniścayaḥ ||
74161 ekaṃ hi cakṣuramalaṃ sahajo viveko  vidvadbhireva saha saṃvasatirdvitīyam |
74162 etaddvayaṃ bhuvi na yasya sa tattvato'ndhas tasyāpamārgacalane vada ko'parādhaḥ ||
74171 ekaḥ karṇamahīpatiḥ pratidinaṃ lakṣādhikā yācakāḥ  kasmai kiṃ vitariṣyatīti manasā cintāṃ vṛthā mā kṛthāḥ |
74172 āste kiṃ pratiyācakaṃ surataruḥ pratyambujaṃ kiṃ raviś candraḥ kiṃ pratikairavaṃ pratilatāgulmaṃ kimambhodharaḥ ||
74181 ekaḥ kāpuruṣo dīrṇo dārayenmahatīṃ camūm |
74182 taṃ dīrṇamanu dīryante yodhāḥ śūratamā api ||
74191 ekaḥ ko'pi mahīdharo laghutaro dorbhyāṃ dhṛto līlayā  tena tvaṃ divi bhūtale ca vidito govarddhanoddhārakaḥ |
74192 tvāṃ trailokyavahaṃ vahāmi kucayoragre sadā puṣpavat tatkiṃ keśava jalpitena bahunā puṇyairyaśo labhyate ||
74201 ekaḥ kṣamāvataṃ doṣo dvitīyo nopalabhyate |
74202 yadenaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ ||
74211 so'sya doṣo na mantavyaḥ kṣamā hi paramaṃ balam |
74212 kṣamā guṇo hyaśaktānāṃ śaktānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ kṣamā ||
74221 ekaḥ khalo'pi yadi nāma bhavetsabhāyāṃ  vyarthīkaroti viduṣāmakhilaṃ prayāsam |
74222 ekāpi pūrṇamudaraṃ madhuraiḥ padārthair āloḍya recayati hanta na makṣikā kim ||
74231 ekaḥ pañcatvamāsādya jāyate punaraṣṭadhā |
74232 aho vāṇijyasaṃpattiḥ kāśīpuranivāsinām ||
74241 ekaḥ pathā na gantavyaṃ na suptiṃ bāhyamandire |
74242 janavākyaṃ na kartavyaṃ strīṇāmālocanaṃ vinā ||
74251 ekaḥ pāpāni kurute phalaṃ bhuṅkte mahājanaḥ |
74252 bhoktāro vipramucyante kartā doṣeṇa lipyate ||
74261 ekaḥ pālayate lokamekaḥ pālayate kulam |
74262 majjatyeko hi niraya ekaḥ svarge mahīyate ||
74271 ekaḥ putro varaṃ vidvān bahubhirnirguṇaistu kim |
74272 ekastārayate vaṃśamanye saṃtāpakārakāḥ ||
74281 ekaḥ prajāyate jantureka eva pralīyate |
74282 eko'nubhuṅkte sukṛtameka eva ca duṣkṛtam ||
74291 ekaḥ prayātyuparamaṃ draviṇaṃ tadīyaṃ  hṛtvāparaḥ prasabhamudvahati pramodam |
74292 no vetti tatsvanidhane parakośagāmi  dhigvāsanāmasamamohakṛtāndhakārām ||
74301 ekaḥ śataṃ yodhayati prākārastho dhanurdharaḥ |
74302 śataṃ daśasahasrāṇi tasmāddurgaṃ vidhīyate ||
74311 ekaḥ śatrurna dvitīyo'sti śatrur ajñānatulyaḥ puruṣasya rājan |
74312 yenāvṛtaḥ kurute saṃprayukto  ghorāṇi karmāṇi sudāruṇāni ||
74321 ekaḥ saṃgrāmariṅgatturagakhurarajorājibhirnaṣṭadṛṣṭir digyātrājaitramattadviradabharanamadbhūmibhagnastathānyaḥ |
74322 vīrāḥ ke nāma tasmāttrijagati na yayuḥ kṣīṇatāṃ kāṇakubja  nyāyādetena muktāvabhayamabhajatāṃ vāsavo vāsukiśca ||
74331 ekaḥ saṃpannamaśnāti vaste vāsaśca śobhanam |
74332 yo'saṃvibhajya bhṛtyebhyaḥ ko nṛśaṃsatarastataḥ ||
74341 ekaḥ saṃprati pākaśāsanapurīpīyūṣasattrī puraḥ  pārakyaṃ tamasāmasau kumudinīcaitanyacintāmaṇiḥ |
74342 mānoccāṭanakārmaṇaṃ mṛgadṛśāṃ devo nabho'mbhonidhau  paśyodañcati pañcabāṇavaṇijo yātrāvahitraṃ śaśī ||
74351 ekaḥ sa eva jīvati  svahṛdayaśūnyo'pi sahṛdayo rāhuḥ |
74352 yaḥ sakalalaghimakāraṇam  udaraṃ na bibharti duṣpūram ||
74361 ekaḥ sa eva tejasvī saihikeyaḥ suradviṣām |
74362 śiromātrāvaśeṣeṇa jīyante yena śatravaḥ ||
74371 ekaḥ sa eva paripālayatājjaganti  gaurīgirīśacaritānukṛtiṃ dadhānaḥ |
74372 ābhāti yo daśanaśūnyamukhaikadeśa  dehārdhahāritavadhūka ivaikadantaḥ ||
74381 ekaḥ sakalajanānāṃ  hṛdayeṣu kṛtāspado madaḥ śatruḥ |
74382 yenāviṣṭaśarīro  na śṛṇoti na paśyati stabdhaḥ ||
74391 ekaḥ sakhā priyo bhūya upakārī guṇānvitaḥ |
74392 hantavyaḥ strīnimittena kaṣṭamāpatitaṃ mama ||
74401 ekaḥ sa vyasanī pumānacaramairniḥśvāsavātaiḥ samaṃ  hā me sā dayiteti yasya vadataḥ prāṇāḥ samaṃ nirgatāḥ |
74402 anye tu vyasanaṃ kṣipanti paśavaḥ kāntāviyogodbhavaiś cintāglāniviṣādadainyajanitairbāṣpairanāhāriṇaḥ ||
74411 ekaḥ sudhāṃśurna kathaṃcana syāt tṛptikṣamastvannayanadvayasya |
74412 tvallocanāsecanakastadastu  nalāsyaśītadyutisadvitīyaḥ ||
74421 ekaḥ stanastuṅgataraḥ parasya  vārtāmiva praṣṭumagānmukhāgram |
74422 yasyāḥ priyārdhasthitimudvahantyāḥ  sā pātu vaḥ parvatarājaputrī ||
74431 ekaḥ sthito'ntaḥ prāpto'nyaḥ parasyādyaiva durgrahaḥ |
74432 kiṃ karomīti jananīṃ pṛcchantīṣvaparāsu ca ||
74441 ekaḥ svādu na bhuñjīta ekaścārthānna cintayet |
74442 eko na gacchedadhvānaṃ naikaḥ supteṣu jāgṛyāt ||
74451 eka eva khago mānī vane vasati cātakaḥ |
74452 pipāsito vā mriyate yācate vā puraṃdaram ||
74461 eka eva khago mānī sukhaṃ jīvati cātakaḥ |
74462 arthitvaṃ yāti śakrasya na nīcamupasarpati ||
74471 eka eva careddharmaṃ nāsti dharme sahāyatā |
74472 kevalaṃ vidhimāsādya sahāyaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ||
74481 eka eva dame doṣo dvitīyo nopapadyate |
74482 yadenaṃ kṣamayā yuktamaśaktaṃ manyate janaḥ ||
74491 etasya tu mahāprājña doṣasya sumahān guṇaḥ |
74492 kṣamāyāṃ vipulā lokāḥ sulabhā hi sahiṣṇunā ||
74501 eka eva na bhuñjīyādyadicchecśubhamātmanaḥ |
74502 dvitribhirbandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhojanaṃ kārayennaraḥ ||
74511 eka eva padārthastu tridhā bhavati vīkṣitaḥ |
74512 kuṇapaṃ kaminī māṃsaṃ yogibhiḥ kāmibhiḥ śvabhiḥ ||
74521 eka eva paro hyātmā sarveṣāmapi dehinām |
74522 nāneva gṛhyate mūḍhairyathā jyotiryathā nabhaḥ ||
74531 eka eva mahān doṣo bhavatāṃ vimale kule |
74532 lumpanti pūrvajāṃ kīrtiṃ jātā jātā guṇādhikāḥ ||
74541 eka eva laghuryatra āditālaḥ sa kathyate |
74542 vinode rāsakastena śrotṇāṃ ca sukhāvahaḥ ||
74551 eka eva suhṛddharmo nidhane'pyanuyāti yaḥ |
74552 śarīreṇa samaṃ nāśaṃ sarvamanyadhi gacchati ||
74561 eka eva hitārthāya tejasvī pārthivo bhuvaḥ |
74562 yugānta iva bhāsvanto bahavo'tra vipattaye ||
74571 eka eva hi bhūtātmā bhūte bhūte vyavasthitaḥ |
74572 ekadhā bahudhā caiva dṛśyate jalacandravat ||
74581 eka eva hi vandhyāyāḥ śoko bhavati mānasaḥ |
74582 aprajāsmīti saṃtāpo na hyanyaḥ putra vidyate ||
74591 eka evopahārastu saṃdhiretanmataṃ hi naḥ |
74592 upahārasya bhedāstu sarve'nye maitravarjitāḥ ||
74601 ekakāryaniyoge'pi nānayostulyaśīlatā |
74602 vivāhe ca citāyāṃ ca yathā hutabhujordvayoḥ ||
74611 ekakṣitibhṛdutpannāḥ sacchidrāḥ kaṇṭakolbaṇāḥ |
74612 mithaḥ saṃgharṣaṇādvaṃśā dahyante sādhuśākhibhiḥ ||
74621 ekagarbhoṣitāḥ snigdhā mūrdhnā satkṛtya dhāritāḥ |
74622 keśā api virajyante jarayā kimutāṅganāḥ ||
74631 ekaguṇā bhavati tithiś caturguṇaṃ bhavati nakṣatram |
74632 catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ lagnam  eṣa jyotiṣatantrasiddhāntaḥ ||
74641 ekacakro ratho yantā vikalo viṣamā hayāḥ |
74642 ākrāmatyeva tejasvī tathāpyarko nabhastalam ||
74651 ekacakṣurna kāko'yaṃ bilamicchanna pannagaḥ |
74652 kṣīyate vardhate caiva na samudro na candramāḥ ||
74661 ekacitto labhetsiddhiṃ dvidhācitto vinaśyati |
74662 skandhāvāraṃ hi gacchantamiṣukāro na paśyati ||
74671 ekacchattraṃ kṣititalamidaṃ bhuñjate yannarendrāḥ  svargāsthāne muditamanaso yadramante munīndrāḥ |
74672 yannirvāṇe nirupamasukhaṃ martyamukhyā labhante  dānasyāyaṃ sphurati mahimā kevalasyāmalasya ||
74681 ekacchāgaṃ dvirāveyaṃ trigavaṃ pañcamāhiṣam |
74682 ṣaḍaśvaṃ saptamātaṅgaṃ śakrasyāpi śriyaṃ haret ||
74691 ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ |
74692 ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam ||
74701 ekataḥ praṇayapīḍanaṃ mudhā  mānadhāraṇarasādaro'nyataḥ |
74702 rakṣatī dvayamidaṃ manasvinī  nirvṛṇotu kathamatra janmani ||
74711 ekataḥ sakalā vidyā cāturyaṃ punarekataḥ |
74712 cāturyeṇa vinākṛtya sakalā vikalā kalā ||
74721 ekataḥ sarvapāpāni madyapānaṃ tathaikataḥ |
74722 ekataḥ sarvadānāni brahmacaryaṃ tathaikataḥ ||
74731 ekataścaturo vedāḥ sāṅgopāṅgāḥ savistarāḥ |
74732 svādhīnāste naraśreṣṭha satyamekaṃ kilaikataḥ ||
