83982 dadāmītyakṣarairdātuḥ punaḥ śrotrādviśanti te ||
83991 kaṇṭhādraktaṃ pibati guṇināṃ madyamāṃsaṃ na bhuṅkte  viṣṇudravyaṃ harati kurute dvādaśīṣūpavāsam |
83992 sāṃkhyaṃ śrutvāpaharati gavāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vṛttiṃ  pāpo dambhaḥ kaliyugasakhaḥ kasya mitraṃ niyogī ||
84001 kaṇṭhāntaḥ kvaṇitaṃ divākarakaraklāntyā rajoviplavais tannetrāñcalakuñcanaṃ śitakuśaprāntakṣataiḥ sītkṛtiḥ |
84002 śvāsormiprabhavo vanecarabhiyā tvadvairivāmabhruvām  evaṃ deva marostaṭe'pi suratakrīḍānurūpaḥ kramaḥ ||
84011 kaṇṭhālaṃkāraghaṇṭāghaṇaghaṇaraṇitādhmātarodaḥkaṭāhaḥ  kaṇṭhekālādhirohocitaghanasubhagaṃ bhāvukasnindhapṛṣṭhaḥ |
84012 sākṣāddharmo vapuṣmān dhavalakakudanirdhūtakailāsakūṭaḥ  kūṭastho vaḥ kakudmānnibiḍataratamaḥstomatṛṇyāṃ vitṛṇyāt ||
84021 kaṇṭhāliṅganamaṅgalaṃ ghanakucābhogopabhogotsavaṃ  śroṇīsaṃgamasaubhagaṃ ca satataṃ matpreyasīnāṃ puraḥ |
84022 prāptuṃ ko'yamitīrṣyayeva yamunākūle balādyaḥ svayaṃ  gopīnāmaharaddukūlanicayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sa puṣṇātu naḥ ||
84031 kaṇṭhāvasaktamṛdubāhulatāsturaṅgād rājāvarodhanavadhūravatārayantaḥ |
84032 āliṅganānyadhikṛtāḥ sphuṭamāpureva  gaṇḍasthalīḥ śucitayā na cucumburāsām ||
84041 kaṇṭhāśleṣiṇamunnatastanabharaśroṇītaṭagrāhiṇaṃ  saṃsaktoruyugaṃ gṛhītajaghanaprākāramapyantataḥ |
84042 drāgeva ślathabandhaminduvadanā gāḍhāvamardāsahaṃ  vijñāyātyajadāśu kāñcanapaṭaṃ vrīḍākulāpi kṣaṇam ||
84051 kaṇṭhe ka eṣa tava vallabha nūpuro'yaṃ  tatpādabhūṣaṇamayaṃ valayastadānīm |
84052 ityādivācyamavibhāvya vaco mṛgākṣyā  jñāne'pi tadvihṛtamutsukatāṃ tanoti ||
8405 1 kaṇṭhe kṛttāvaśeṣaṃ kanakamayamadhaḥ śṛṅkhalādāma karṣan  krāntvā dvārāṇi helācalacaraṇaraṇatkiṅkaṇīcakravālaḥ |
8405 2 dattātaṅko'ṅganānāmanusṛtasaraṇiḥ saṃbhramādaśvapālaiḥ  prabhraṣṭo'yaṃ plavaṅgaḥ praviśati nṛpatermandiraṃ mandurāyāḥ ||
84061 kaṇṭhe gadgadatā svedo mukhe vaivarṇyavepathū |
84062 mriyamāṇasya cihnāni yāni tānyeva yācataḥ ||
84071 kaṇṭhe cintāmaṇirjñeyaścintitārthapradaḥ sadā |
84072 āvartaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśe yaḥ sa sūryākhyaḥ śubhaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
84081 kaṇṭhe jīvitamānane tava guṇāḥ pāṇau kapolastanau  saṃtāpastvayi mānasaṃ nayanayoracchinnadhāraṃ payaḥ |
84082 sarvaṃ niṣkaruṇa tvadīyavirahe sālambanaṃ kiṃ punas tasyāḥ saṃprati jīvite bata sakhīvargo nirālambanaḥ ||
84091 kaṇṭhe madaḥ kodravajo hṛdi tāmbūlajo madaḥ |
84092 lakṣmīmadastu sarvāṅge putradāramukheṣvapi ||
84101 kaṇṭhe mauktikamālikāḥ stanataṭe kārpūramacchaṃ rajaḥ  sāndraṃ candanamaṅgake valayitāḥ pāṇau mṛṇālīlatāḥ |
84102 tanvī naktamiyaṃ cakāsti śucinī cīnāṃśuke bibhratī  śītāṃśoradhidevateva galitā vyomāgramārohataḥ ||
84111 kaṇṭhe rajjuṃ baddhvā  mṛtasya puṃsastu rajjumādāya |
84112 tasyāḥ khaṇḍaṃ kaṇṭhe  baddhaṃ gaṇḍasrajaṃ harati ||
84121 kaṇṭhe vasantī caturā yadasyāḥ  sarasvatī vādayate vipañcīm |
84122 tadeva vāgbhūya mukhe mṛgākṣyāḥ  śrotuḥ śrutau yāti sudhārasatvam ||
84131 kaṇṭhocito'pi huṃkṛti  mātranirastaḥ padāntike patitaḥ |
84132 yasyāścandraśikhaḥ smara  bhallanibho jayati sā caṇḍī ||
84141 kaṇḍūyate dakṣiṇapāṇinā cet sa sārameyo vadanaṃ tadānīm |
84142 bhaktaiḥ prabhūtaiḥ saha bhūmipālair bhojyāni bhakṣyāṇi ciraṃ bhavanti ||
84151 kaṇḍūladvipagaṇḍapiṇḍakaṣaṇākampena sampātibhir dharmasraṃsitabandhanaiḥ svakusumairarcanti godāvarīm |
84152 chāyāpaskiramāṇaviṣkiramukhavyākṛṣṭakīṭatvacaḥ  kūjatklāntakapītakukkuṭakulāḥ kūle kulāyadrumāḥ ||
84161 kaṇḍūyamānaḥ khalu dakṣiṇena  hastena bhālaṃ bhaṣaṇo dadāti |
84162 prabhāvinamrīkṛtarājacakraṃ  rājyābhiṣeke varapaṭṭabandham ||
84171 kataratpurahara paruṣaṃ  hālāhalakavalayācanāvacasoḥ |
84172 ekaiva tava rasajñā  tadubhayarasatāratamyajñā ||
84181 kati kati na punaścaranti hanti  pratiśikharaṃ pratikānanaṃ kuraṅgāḥ |
84182 tadapi janamanovinodahetur vilasati keṣvapi ko'pi nābhigandhaḥ ||
84191 kati kati na madoddhatāścaranti  pratiśikhari pratikānanaṃ kuraṅgāḥ |
84192 kvacidapi punaruttamā mṛgāste  madayati yanmada eva medinīśān ||
84201 kati kati na latāḥ kalitāḥ  saṃcaratā cañcarīkarasikena |
84202 nalini bhavanmadhu madhuraṃ  yatpītaṃ tattadeva paripītam ||
84211 kati kati na vasante vallayaḥ śākhino vā  surabhitasumanobhirbhūṣitāṅgā babhūvuḥ |
84212 tadapi yuvajanānāṃ prītaye kevalo'bhūd abhinavakalikālībhāraśālī rasālaḥ ||
84221 katiciduddhatanirbharamatsarāḥ  katicidātmavacaḥstutiśālinaḥ |
84222 ahaha ke'pi nirakṣarakukṣayas tadiha saṃprati kaṃ prati me śramaḥ ||
8422 1 katiciddivasāni kāṇḍaśeṣāḥ  patitāśeṣapurāṇajīrṇaparṇāḥ |
8422 2 taravastvaci garhitapravālāḥ  samavāpyanta na nāmato vivektum ||
84231 katiciddivasāni tayā gamitā  ni gṛhe tava saṅgamarocanayā |
84232 katicidvipine nalinīśayane  vacanena pikīmadamocanayā ||
84241 na vane'pi ratirbhavane'pi na yaṃ  pratirūpavinirjjitarocanayā |
84242 karuṇāvaruṇālaya kiṃ kriyatām  aruṇāyatapaṅkajalocanayā ||
84251 kati te kabarībhāraḥ  sumanaḥsaṅgātpriye'tinīlatvāt |
84252 bhavati ca kalāpavattvān  nijairasevyaḥ kathaṃ na syāt ||
84261 kati na santi janā jagatītale  tadapi tadvirahākulitaṃ manaḥ |
84262 kati na santi niśākaratārakāḥ  kamalinī malinī raviṇā vinā ||
84271 kati na santi mahīṣu mahīruhaḥ  surabhipuṣparasālaphalālayaḥ |
84272 surabhayanti na ke'pi ca bhūruhān  iti yaśo'sti paraṃ tava candana ||
84281 kati no viṣayā nibhālitāḥ  kati vā bhūmibhujo na śīlitāḥ |
84282 dharaṇīdhara tāvakān guṇān  avadhāryājagaṇaṃ guruṃ laghum ||
84291 katipayadivasasthāyini  madakāriṇi yauvane durātmānaḥ |
84292 vidadhati tathāparādhaṃ  janmaiva yathā vṛthā bhavati ||
84301 kattipayadivasasthāyī  pūro dūronnato'pi bhavitā te |
84302 taṭini taṭadrumapātana  pātakamekaṃ cirasthāyi ||
84311 katipayadivasaiḥ kṣayaṃ prayāyāt kanakagiriḥ kṛtavāsarāvasānaḥ |
84312 iti mudamupayāti cakravākī  vitaraṇaśālini vīrarudradeve ||
84321 katipayanimeṣavartini  janmajarāmaraṇavihvale jagati |
84322 kalpāntakoṭibandhuḥ  sphurati kavīnāṃ yaśaḥprasaraḥ ||
84331 katipayapurasvāmī kāyavyayairapi durgraho  mitavitaritā mohenāho mayānusṛtaḥ purā |
84332 tribhuvanapatirbuddhyārādhyo'dhunā svapadapradaḥ  punaradhigatastatprācīno dunoti dinavyayaḥ ||
84341 katipayasahakārapuṣparamyas tanutuhino'lpavinidrasinduvāraḥ |
84342 surabhimukhahimāgamāntaśaṃsī  samupayayau śiśiraḥ smaraikabandhuḥ ||
84351 kati pallavitā na puṣpitā vā  taravaḥ santi samantato vasante |
84352 jagato vijaye tu puṣpaketoḥ  sahakārī sahakāra eka eva ||
84361 katiṣu na kṛtā sevā ke vā na vāgvibhavaiḥ stutās tṛṇamapi guṇaprītaḥ prādānna ko'pi vipaścitām |
84362 ayamiha paraṃ duḥkhajvālākalāpamakhaṇḍayat kanakapayasāṃ dhārādaṇḍairakāṇḍaghanāghanaḥ ||
84371 kati santi nonnatibhṛtastaravas tadapi tvameva gurukīrtivaraḥ |
84372 nibiḍādaraṃ navamarandaharaḥ  sahakāra kāraṇamiha bhramaraḥ ||
84381 kati santi latā vipine kusuma  stavakānamitāḥ khalu pallavitāḥ |
84382 praticampakacandananīpavanī  navapaṅkajinīmadhusaṃvalitāḥ ||
84391 suciraṃ kusumeṣu paribhramatā  na ca mālati kāpi tathā militā |
84392 madhupena punarmadhupānavidhau  hṛdaye na yathā bhavatī kalitā ||
84401 kati santi lavaṅgalatā lalitā  navakorakitā dharaṇīsutale |
84402 kati bandhuragandhabhṛtastaravo  guravo nivasanti girau malaye ||
84411 katyakṣīṇi karoṭayaḥ kati kati dvīpidvipānāṃ tvacaḥ  kākolāḥ kati pannagāḥ kati sudhādhāmnaśca khaṇḍāḥ kati |
84412 kiṃ ca tvaṃ ca kati trilokajanani tvadvāripūrodare  majjajjantukadambakaṃ samudayatyekaikamādāya yat ||
84421 katyaśvāḥ kati dhenavaḥ kati gajāḥ katyadbhutāḥ pādapāḥ  sundaryaḥ kati susruvaḥ kati mahāratnānyanardhyāṇyapi |
84422 jātaikā kila kanyakā jalanidherdātuṃ prasaktā yadā  sarvaṃ tadvyayitaṃ tadā pariṇatau nāmaikamuccheṣitam ||
84431 kathaṃcitkālidāsasya kālena bahunā mayā |
84432 avagāḍheva gambhīramasṛṇaudhā sarasvatī ||
84441 kathaṃcidahni hṛdaye kuśalairviniveśitā |
84442 śikṣā gaurakhareṇeva rājñā vismāryate niśi ||
84451 kathaṃcinnaidāghe divasa iva kope vigalite  prasattau prāptāyāṃ tadanu ca niśāyāmiva śanaiḥ |
84452 smitajyotsnārambhakṣapitavirahadhvāntanivaho  mukhendurmāninyāḥ sphurati kṛtapuṇyasya surate ||
84461 kathaṃ te tyaktasadvṛttāḥ sukhaṃ rātriṣu śerate |
84462 maraṇāntaritā yeṣāṃ narakeṣūpapattayaḥ ||
84471 kathaṃ tvadupalambhāśāvihatāviha tādṛśī |
84472 avasthā nālamāroḍhumaṅganāmaṅganāśinī ||
8447 1 kathaṃ na ramate cittaṃ dharme'nekasukhaprade |
8447 2 jīvānāṃ duḥkhabhīrūṇāṃ prāyo mithyādṛśo yataḥ ||
84481 kathaṃ na lajjitastādṛksavitā tejasāṃ nidhiḥ |
84482 brahmāṇḍakhaṇḍikāṃ prāpya kurvan pādaprasārikām ||
84491 kathaṃ nāma na sevyante yatnataḥ parameśvarāḥ |
84492 acireṇaiva ye tuṣṭāḥ pūrayanti manorathān ||
84501 kathaṃ nu taṃ bandhurakomalāṅguliṃ  karaṃ vihāyāsi nimagnamambhasi |
84502 acetanaṃ nāma guṇaṃ na lakṣayen  mayaiva kasmādavadhīritā priyā ||
84511 kathaṃ nu putrāḥ pitaraṃ hanyuḥ kasyāṃcidāpadi |
84512 bhrātā vā bhrātaraṃ hanyātsaumitre prāṇamātmānaḥ ||
84521 kathaṃ nyāyyamanuṣṭhānaṃ mādṛśaḥ pratiṣedhatu |
84522 kathaṃ vābhyanujānātu sāhasaikarasāṃ kriyām ||
84531 kathaṃ nvidaṃ kamalaviśālalocane  gṛhaṃ ghanaiḥ pihitakare niśākare |
84532 acintayantyabhinavavarṣavidyutas tvamāgatā sutanu yathā prabhāvatī ||
84541 kathaṃ caiṣā tanvī prakṛtisukumārāṅgalatikā  pragalbhavyāpāraṃ ratikalahakhedaṃ viṣahate |
84542 nalinyāstigmo'pi prabhavati sukhāyaiva savitā  prakṛṣṭe premṇyevaṃ kimiva na sahante yuvatayaḥ ||
84551 kathaṃ priyāyā anukampitāyāḥ  saṅgaṃ rahasyaṃ rucirāṃśca mantrān |
84552 suhṛtsu ca snehasitaḥ śiśūnāṃ  kalākṣarāṇāmanuraktacittaḥ ||
84561 putrān smaraṃstā duhitrhṛdasyā  bhrātn svasrvā pitarau ca dīnau |
84562 gṛhānmanojñoruparicchadāṃśca  vṛttīśca kulyāḥ paśubhṛtyavargān ||
84571 kathaṃ bhāryāmṛte dharmamarthaṃ vā puruṣaḥ prabho |
84572 prāpnoti kāmamatha vā tasyāṃ tritayamāhitam ||
84581 tathaiva bhartāramṛte bhāryā dharmādisādhane |
84582 na samarthā trivargo'yaṃ dāmpatyaṃ samupāśritaḥ ||
84591 kathaṃ mamorasi kṛtapakṣaniḥsvanaḥ  śilīmukho'pahitaditi (?) jalpati priye |
84592 nivṛtya kiṃ kimiti bruvāṇayānayā  sasādhvasaṃ kupitamamoci kāntayā ||
84601 kathaṃ mugdhe kathaṃ vakre kāntāyāste vilocane |
84602 kathaṃ janānurāgāya kathaṃ janavipattaye ||
84611 kathaṃ yateta manujau bhinnaiva prakṛtiryataḥ |
84612 ekasthānasamutpanna sudhākṣveḍabhidā smṛtā ||
84621 kathaṃ rājā sthito dharme paradārān parāmṛśet |
84622 rakṣaṇīyā viśeṣeṇa rājadārā mahābala ||
84631 kathaṃ vilokeyamamuṃ yuvānaṃ  kumudvatībandhumivojjihānam |
84632 bhartuḥ svasā bhādracaturthikeva  kalaṅkayatyardhavilokane'pi ||
84641 kathaṃ vīthīmasmānupadiśasi dharmapraṇayinīṃ  prasīda svāṃ śiṣyāmatikhalamukhīṃ śādhi muralīm |
84642 harantī maryādāṃ śiva śiva pare puṃsi hṛdayaṃ  nayantī dhṛṣṭeyaṃ yaduvara yathā nāhvayati naḥ ||
84651 kathaṃ saṃbodhyate rājā sugrīvasya ca kā priyā |
84652 nirdhanāḥ kiṃ ca vāñchanti kiṃ kurvanti manīṣiṇaḥ ||
84661 kathaṃ sa dantarahitaḥ sūryaḥ sūribhirucyate |
84662 yo mīnarāśiṃ muktaiva meṣaṃ bhoktuṃ samudyataḥ ||
84671 kathanena vināpyāśāṃ pūrayanti hi sādhavaḥ |
84672 pratigehaṃ bhāsate hi vivasvān kathanaṃ vinā ||
84681 kathamagaṇitapūrvaṃ drakṣyate taṃ narendraḥ  kathamapuruṣavākyaṃ śroṣyate siddhavākyaḥ |
84682 kathamaviṣayavanghyaṃ dhārayiṣyatyamarṣaṃ  praṇipatati niruddhaḥ satkṛto dharṣito vā ||
84691 kathamadya kathaṃ ca śva iti jīvanacintayā |
84692 yā kṛthā hā vṛthā dainyamāyurantaṃ prayacchati ||
84701 kathamapi kṛtapratyāpattau priye skhalitottare  virahakṛśayā kṛtvā vyājaṃ prakalpitamaśrutam |
84702 asahanasakhīśrotraprāptiṃ viśaṅkya sasaṃbhramaṃ  vivalitadṛśā śūnye gehe samucchvasitaṃ punaḥ ||
84711 kathamapi tava vṛndāraṇyamāhātmyavṛndaṃ  na hi kathayitumuccairīśvaro'pyīśvaraḥ syāt |
84712 api ca tṛṇaphalānāṃ yasya lubdho rasāya  prabhuramṛtabhujāmapyāśrayadvatsabhāvam ||
84721 kathamapi na niṣiddho duḥkhinā bhīruṇā vā  drupadatanayapāṇistena pitrā mamādya |
84722 tava bhujabaladarpādhyāyamānasya vāmaḥ  śirasi caraṇa eṣa nyasyate vārayainam ||
84731 kathamapi paricitamudrā  bhujabhudrāsaṅgataṃ svapne |
84732 uṣasi nimīlatanayanā  śayanāntaḥ kāntamāmṛṣati ||
84741 kathamapi sakhi krīḍākopādvrajeti mayodite  kaṭhinahṛdayastyaktvā śayyāṃ balādgata eva saḥ |
84742 iti sarabhasadhvastapremṇi vyapetaghṛṇe spṛhāṃ  punarapi hatavrīḍaṃ cetaḥ karoti karomi kim ||
84751 kathamapi hi bhavanti kṣetrasadbījayogāj jagadupakṛtihetornātmavṛttyai phalanti |
84752 dadhati phalasamṛddhyā dūramānamrabhāvaṃ  nanu jagati suśūkāḥ sādhavaḥ śālayaśca ||
84761 kathamapyadhigatarandhrair adhyuṣitā yadi guhākhubhiḥ kṣudraiḥ |
84762 iyataiva kiṃ mṛgādhipa  nijavikramanirvidaṃ vahasi ||
84771 kathamarthaṃ niṣedhantu śrutayaḥ smṛtayo'pi vā |
84772 yāsāmekaṃ padamapi na calatyarthato vinā ||
84781 kathamavanipa darpo yanniśātāsidhārā  dalanagalitamūrdhnā vidviṣāṃ svīkṛtā śrīḥ |
84782 nanu tava nihatārerapyasau kiṃ na nītā  tridivamapagatāṅgairvallabhā kīrtirebhiḥ ||
84791 kathamasau na bhajatyaśarīratāṃ  hatavivekapado hatamanmathaḥ |
84792 praharataḥ kadalīdalakomale  bhavati yasya dayā na vadhūjane ||
84801 kathamasau madano na namasyatāṃ  sthitavivekapado makaradhvajaḥ |
84802 mṛgadṛśaṃ kadalīlalitaṃ vapur yadabhi hanti śaraiḥ kusumodbhavaiḥ ||
84811 kathamiyati vanānte kaścideko na tādṛg varavanataruruccaiḥ puṣpavallīphalāḍhyaḥ |
84812 jagadasukhavidhāturdagdhadhāturniyogā  ddhavakhadirapalāśāḥ kevalaṃ vṛddhibhājaḥ ||
84821 kathamiva tava saṃmatirbhavitrī  samamṛtubhirmunināvadhīritasya |
84822 iti viracitamallikāvikāsaḥ  smayata iva sma madhuṃ nidāghakālaḥ ||
84831 kathamiha manuṣyajanmā  saṃpraviśati sadasi vibudhagamitāyām |
84832 yena na subhāṣitāmṛtam  āhlādi nipītamā tṛpteḥ ||
84841 kathamutpadyate dharmaḥ kathaṃ dharmaḥ pravardhate |
84842 kathaṃ ca sthāpyate dharmaḥ kathaṃ dharmo vinaśyati ||
84851 satyenotpadyate dharmo dayādānairvivardhate |
84852 kṣamayā sthāpyate dharmaḥ krodhalobhairvinaśyati ||
84861 kathamupari kalāpinaḥ kalāpo  vilasati tasya tale'ṣṭamīndukhaṇḍam |
84862 kuvalayayugalaṃ tato vilolaṃ  tilakusumaṃ tadadhaḥ pravālamasmāt ||
84871 kathametatkucadvandvaṃ patitaṃ tava sundari |
84872 paśyādhaḥ khanane mūḍha patanti girayo'pi ca ||
84881 kathaya kathamivāśā jāyatāṃ jīvite me  malayabhujagavāntā vānti vātāḥ kṛtāntāḥ |
84882 ayamapi khalu guñjanmañju mākandamaulau  culukayati madīyāṃ cetanāṃ cañcarīkaḥ ||
8488 1 kathaya kathamurojadāmahetor yadupatireṣa cinoti campakāni |
8488 2 bhavati karatale yadasya kampaḥ  priyasakhi matsmṛtireva matsapatnī ||

86831 kampitaḥ patasi pādakayugme  netrakoṇanihato'pi bhayārtaḥ |

87432 pāṣāṇaistāḍitaḥ svapne sadyo mṛtyuṃ labhennaraḥ ||

8773 1 karairupāttān kamalotkarebhyo  nijairvivasvān vikacodarebhyaḥ |

87801 karoti pāpaṃ yo'jñānānnātmano vetti ca kṣamam |

88261 karṇāhativyatikaraṃ kariṇāmupekṣya  dānaṃ vyavasyati madhruvrata eṣa tiktam |

90881 kavayaḥ kavayantu tailabhuktāḥ  sarasā eva parantu dākṣiṇātyāḥ |

9177 1 kastūrikādikrayavikrayāṅgāṃ  yadṛcchayā yadvipaṇiṃ gatānām |
9177 2 saurabhyamaṅgeṣu samagralagnam  na hīyate pañcaṣamapyahāni ||
91781 kastūrikāmṛgāṇām  aṇḍādgandhaguṇamakhilamādāya |
91782 yadi punarahaṃ vidhiḥ syāṃ  khalajihvāyāṃ niveśayiṣyāmi ||
91791 kastūrī jāyate kasmātko hanti kariṇāṃ śatam |
91792 kiṃ kuryātkātaro yuddhe mṛgātsiṃhaḥ palāyanam ||
91801 kastūrīti, kimaṅga, sāṃparimaladravyaṃ kimapyāmaraṃ  peyā kiṃ, na hi, kīdṛśī, mṛgadṛśāṃ śṛṅgāralīlāspadam |
91802 dhāryā kutra, kucasthalīṣu, kucayoḥ sthaulyaṃ tato hīyate  kliṣṭaḥ kliśyati pakvaṇaiśca bahuśaḥ kastūrikāvikrayī ||
91811 kastūrītilakaṃ tasyā  janayati śobhāṃ bhruvorantaḥ |
91812 kodaṇḍamadhyalagnaṃ  phalamiva pañceṣubāṇasya ||
91821 kastūrītilakaṃ bāle bhāle mā kuru mā kuru |
91822 adya sāmyaṃ bhajāmīti jṛmbhate śaśalāñchanaḥ ||
91831 kastūrītilakaṃ bāle bhāle mā kuru mā kuru |
91832 kalaṅkaśaṅkayā rāhurgrasiṣyati tavānanam ||
91841 kastūrītilakaṃ lalāṭaphalake vakṣaḥsthale kaustubhaṃ  nāsāgre navamauktikaṃ karatale veṇuṃ kare kaṅkaṇam |
91842 sarvāṅge haricandanaṃ ca kalayan kaṇṭhe ca muktāvaliṃ  gopastrīpariveṣṭato vijayate gopālacūḍāmaṇiḥ ||
91851 kastūrītilakaṃ lalāṭaracitaṃ nāsāmaṇiṃ nistalaṃ  vaktraṃ kuñcitakeśapāśamaniśaṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nisṛṣṭāṃ puraḥ |
91852 puṃsāṃ mānasamatsyabandhanavidhau dhatse'tra vatse svayaṃ  jambūvajjalabinduvajjalajavajjambālavajjālavat ||
91861 kastūrītilakanti bhālaphalake devyā mukhāmbhoruhe  rolambanti tamālabālamukulottaṃsanti mauliṃ prati |
91862 yāḥ karṇe vikacotpalanti kucayoraṅke ca kālāguru  sthāsanti prathayantu tāstava śivaṃ śrīkaṇṭhakaṇṭhatviṣaḥ ||
91871 kastūrīyanti bhāle tadanu nayanayoḥ kajjalīyanti karṇa  prānte nīlotpalīyantyurasi marakatālaṃkṛtīyanti devyāḥ |
91872 romālīyanti nābherupari harimaṇīmekhalīyanti madhye  kalyāṇaṃ kuryurete trijagati purajitkaṇṭhabhāsāṃ vilāsāḥ ||
91881 kastūrīvarapatrabhaṅganikaro bhraṣṭo na gaṇḍasthale  no luptaṃ sakhi candanaṃ stanataṭe dhautaṃ na netrāñjanam |
91882 rāgo na skhalitastavādharapuṭe tāmbūlasaṃvardhitaḥ  kiṃ ruṣṭāsi gajendramattagamane kiṃ vā śiśuste patiḥ ||
91891 kastūrī sitimānamāgatavatī śauklyaṃ gatāḥ kuntalā  nīlaṃ colamabhūtsitaṃ dhavalimā jāto maṇīnāṃ gaṇe |
91892 dhvāntaṃ śāntamabhūtsamaṃ narapate tvatkīrticandrodaye  trailokyeṅpyabhisārasāhasarasaḥ śāntaḥ kuraṅgīdṛśām ||
9189 1 kastūryā tatkapoladvayabhuvi makarīnirmitau prastutāyāṃ  nirmitsūnāṃ svavakṣasyatiparicayanāttvatpraśastīrupāṃśu |
9189 2 vīra śrīsiṃhabhūpa tvadahitakubhujāṃ rājyalakṣmīsapatnī  mānavyājena lajjāṃ sapadi vidadhate svāvarodhe pragalbhāḥ ||
91901 kaste śaśāṅka mohaḥ  sudhākaro'haṃ na ko'pi madbhinnaḥ |
91902 kiṃ nanu paśyasi nijabhā  jayi vanitāyā mukhaṃ mūḍha ||
91911 kaste śauryamado yoddhuṃ tvayyekaṃ saptimāsthite |
91912 saptasaptisamāruḍhā bhavanti paripanthinaḥ ||
91921 kastvaṃ, kṛṣṇamavehi māṃ kimiha te, manmandirāśaṅkayā  yuktaṃ tannavanītabhājanapuṭe nyastaḥ kimarthaṃ karaḥ |
91922 kartuṃ tatra pipīlikāpanayanaṃ, suptāḥ kimudbodhitā  bālā, vatsagatiṃ vivektumiti saṃjalpan hariḥ pātu vaḥ ||
91931 kastvaṃ, ko'pi, kuto'si, ratnavasatestīrādahaṃ nīradher,  labdhaṃ kiṃcana, garjitairbadhiratā dṛgvyāhatiḥ saikataiḥ |
91932 mā khedaṃ kuru tādṛgaurvadahanajvālāvalīduḥsahaṃ  kṣārodaṃ yadupāsya jīvasi sakhe ślāghyaṃ na tanmanyase ||
91941 kastvaṃ ko'haṃ kuta āyātaḥ  kā me jananī ko me tātaḥ |
91942 iti paribhāvaya sarvamasāraṃ  sarvaṃ tyakvā svapnavicāram ||
91951 kastvaṃ, tāsu yadṛcchayā, kitava yāstiṣṭhanti gopāṅganāḥ  premāṇaṃ na vidanti yās, tava hare kiṃ tāsu te kaitavam |
91952 eṣā hanta hatāśayā yadabhavaṃ tvayyekatānā paraṃ  tenāsyāḥ praṇayo'dhunā khalu mama prāṇaiḥ samaṃ yāsyati ||
91961 kastvaṃ, pītāṃbaro'haṃ, kimu vadasi mṛṣā cāṃbaraṃ kena pītaṃ  mugdhe kaṃsasya śatruḥ, śiva śiva sālilaṃ sasyavairi kva dṛṣṭam|
91962 mallāsyadhvaṃsano'haṃ kimiti nijamaho lāsyamadhvaṃsi ceti  vyāhārairvallavīnāṃ niśi bhavatu mude'nuttaraḥ śrīpatirvaḥ ||
91971 kastvaṃ brahma, nnapūrvaḥ, kva ca tava vasati, ryākhilā brahmasṛṣṭiḥ  kaste nātho, hyanāthaḥ, kva ca tava janako, naiva tātaṃ smarāmi
91972 kiṃ te'bhīṣṭaṃ dadāmi, tripadaparimitā bhūmi, ralpaṃ kimetat trailokyaṃ, bhāvagarbhaṃ balimidamavadadvāmano vaḥ sa pāyāt ||
91981 kastvaṃ brahmann, apūrvas, tvadanucarajano, nāstyanātho'hamekaḥ,  kiṃ dadyāmīpsitaṃ te, tripadaviharaṇasthānametat, kiyatte |
91982 trailokyaṃ taddvijātermama śamaniratasyeti sammūḍhabhāvā  viṣṇorvācaḥ surārau kṛtakapaṭapadanyāsamugdhāḥ punantu ||
91991 kastvaṃ bhadra, khaleśvaro'ham, iha kiṃ ghore vane sthīyate,  śārdūlādibhireva hiṃsrapaśubhiḥ bhojyo'hamityāśayā |
91992 kasmātkaṣṭamidaṃ tvayā vyavasitaṃ, maddehamāmsāśinaḥ  pratyutpannanṛmāṃsabhakṣaṇadhiyaste ghnantu sarvānnarān ||
92001 kastvaṃ bhoḥ, kathayāmi daivahatakaṃ māṃ viddhi śākhoṭakaṃ  vairāgyādiva vakṣi, sādhu viditaṃ, kasmādidaṃ, kathyate |
92002 vāmenātra vaṭastamadhvagajanaḥ sarvātmanā sevate  na cchāyāpi paropakārakaraṇe mārgasthitasyāpi me ||
92011 kastvaṃ bhoḥ, kavirasmi, tatkimu sakhe kṣīṇo'sya, nāhārato  dhigdeśaṃ guṇino'pi, durmatiriyaṃ deśaṃ na māmeva dhik |
92012 pākārthī kṣudhito yadaiva vidadhe pākāya duddhiṃ tadā  vindhye nendhanamambudhau na salilaṃ nānnaṃ dharitrītale ||
92021 kastvaṃ bho niśi, keśavaḥ, śirasijaiḥ kiṃ nāma garvāyase  bhadre śaurirahaṃ, guṇaiḥ rpitṛgataiḥ putrasya kiṃ syādiha |
92022 cakrī candramukhi, prayacchasi na me kuṇḍīṃ ghaṭīṃ dehinīm  itthaṃ gopavadhūhṛtottaratayā duḥstho hariḥ pātu vaḥ ||
92031 kastvaṃ lohitalocanāsyacaraṇo, haṃsaḥ, kuto mānasāt kiṃ tatrāsti, suvarṇapaṅkajavanānyambhaḥ sudhāsannibham |
92032 ratnānāṃ nicayāḥ pravālamaṇayo vaiḍūryarohāḥ kvacic,  ambūkā api santi, neti ca bakairākarṇya hīhīkṛtam ||
92041 kastvaṃ vānara, rāmarājabhavane lekhārthasaṃvāhako,  yātaḥ kutra purāgataḥ sa hanumānnirdagdhalaṅkāpuraḥ |
92042 vaddho rākṣasasūnuneti kapibhiḥ saṃtāḍitastarjitaḥ  sa vrīḍāttaparābhavo vanamṛgaḥ kutreti na jñāyate ||
9204 1 kastvaṃ, śūlī, praviśa bhiṣajāṃ veśma, vaidyaṃ na jāne,  sthāṇurbāle, na vadati tarurnīlakaṇṭhaḥ pramugdhe |
9204 2 kekāmekāṃ vada tvaṃ, paśupatirabale, naiva dṛṣṭe viṣāṇe  ityevaṃ śailakanyāprativacanajaḍaḥ pātu vaḥ pārvatīśaḥ ||
92051 kastvaṃ śūlī, mṛgaya bhiṣajaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ priye'haṃ  kekāmekāṃ vada, paśupati,rnaivadṛśye viṣāṇe |
92052 mugdheṃ sthāṇuḥ, sa carati kathaṃ, jīviteśaḥ śivāyā  gacchāṭavyāmiti hatavacāḥ pātu vaścandracūḍaḥ ||
92061 kasmātkasmin samutpanne sarāgaṃ bhuvanatrayam |
92062 atrādau kathitaṃ śloke yo jānāti sa paṇḍitaḥ ||
92071 kasmātko'haṃ kimapi ca bhavān ko'yamatra prapañcaḥ  svaṃ svaṃ vedyaṃ gaganasadṛśaṃ pūrṇatattvaprakāśam |
92072 ānandākhyaṃ samarasaghane bāhyamantarvihīne  nistraiguṇye pathi vicarataḥ ko vidhiḥ ko niṣedhaḥ ||
92081 kasmāttanvi tanūni samprati samānyaṅgāni jātāni te  kasmātkokanadaprabhaṃ mukhamidaṃ jātaṃ hi candropamam |
92082 evaṃ pṛcchati vallabhe'mbujamukhi proṣyasvabhāvāditi  vyāvṛtyātha tayā sagadgadaravaṃ muktaśca bāṣpotkaraḥ ||
92091 kasmāttvaṃ kva nu dṛśyate sukhamukhaṃ kvāste'ndhakāraḥ paraṃ  kva strīṣu smaradhūmaketuruditeo dṛṣṭā yuvānaḥ kva te |
92092 gantā kva kva ca pañcamaḥ kva ṇasakṛtkvātsaṃkuro nidgataḥ  kvānandaikarasodayaḥ kva nu satī kaivādhvagastatkathā ||
92101 kasmāttvaṃ, tātagehād, aparamabhinavā brūhi kā tatra vārtā,  devyā devo jitaḥ, kiṃ vṛṣaḍamarucitābhasmabhogīndracandrān |
92102 ityevaṃ barhināthe kathayati sahasā bhartūbhikṣāvibhūṣā  vaiguṇyodvegajanmā jagadavatu ciraṃ hāravo bhṛṅgarīṭeḥ ||
92111 kasmāttvaṃ durbalāsīti sakhyastāṃ paripṛcchati |
92112 tvayi saṃnihite tāsu dadyātkathaya sottaram ||
92121 kasmāttvaṃ, bhavadālayād, vada sakhe kṣemaṃ, tavānugrahād,  dṛṣṭā me subhagā, na te'sti subhagā dṛṣṭā bhavadgehinī |
92122 svarbhānuṃ viṣamekṣaṇaṃ viṣadharaṃ kākaṃ varākī gṛhe  candrānaṅgasamīrakokilabhayādvyagrā likhantī muhuḥ ||
92131 kasmāttvaṃ hi vikhidyase katipayaireva priye vāsarair āyātā vayamehi dhehi purataḥ prāsthānikaṃ maṅgalam |
92132 evaṃ vādini vallabhe dayitayā niḥśvasya pāṇau kṛtī  maṅgalyaḥ kalaśo vilocanapayodhārābhirāpūritaḥ ||
92141 kasmātpārvati niṣṭhurāsi, sahajaḥ śailodbhavānāmayaṃ  niḥsnehāsi kathaṃ, na bhasmapuruṣaḥ snehaṃ vibharti kvacit |
92142 kopaste mayi niṣphalaḥ priyatame, sthāṇau phalaṃ kiṃ bhaved itthaṃ nirvacanīkṛto girijayā śaṃbhuściraṃ pātu vaḥ ||
92151 kasmātsaṃlkiśyate vidvān vyarthayārthehayāsakṛt |
92152 kasyacinmāyayā nūnaṃ loko'yaṃ suvimohitaḥ ||
92161 kasmātsatyavatīsutena muninā noktaṃ bhaviṣyatkathā  madhye rūpamanādimadhyanidhanasyehaṃ harermānuṣam |
92162 itthaṃ vyutthitaviśvakaṇṭakacamūnirmūlanavyāpṛtaṃ  saṃgrāmāmbarasūryamambaracarāstvāṃ vīkṣya saṃśerate ||
92171 kasmādadya na bhūṣitaṃ vapuridaṃ sadbhūṣaṇaiḥ kāñcanaiḥ  kasmādacchatarāṇi nādya vasanānyaṅgīkṛtāni tvayā |
92172 uktā seti mayā manojña vijane bālā viśālākṣa mā  kṣipraṃ rodanamekameva vidadhe pratyuttaraṃ no dadau ||
92181 kasmādidaṃ nayanamastamitāñjanaśri  viśrāntapatraracanau ca kutaḥ kapolau |
92182 śṛṅgāravāriruhakānanarājahaṃsi  kasmātkṛśāsi virasāsi malīmasāsi ||
92191 kasmādindurasau dhinoti jagatīṃ pīyūṣagarbhaiḥ karaiḥ  kasmādvā jaladhārayaiva dharaṇiṃ dhārādharaḥ siñcati |
92192 bhrāmaṃ bhrāmamayaṃ ca nandayati vā kasmāttrilokīṃ raviḥ  sādhūnāṃ hi paropakārakaraṇe nopādhyapekṣaṃ manaḥ ||
92201 kasmāddūti śvasiṣi nibhṛtaṃ, satvarāvartanena  bhraṣṭo rāgaḥ kimadharadale, prārthanābhistvadartham |
92202 srastā ceyaṃ kimalakatatis, tatpadāluṇṭhanena  vāsastasya tvayi vada kathaṃ, pratyayārthaṃ tavaiva ||
92211 kasmādbhagnāḥ sumukhi valayā, mārgapātānniśāyāṃ  kiṃ te vaktraṃ vigataracanaṃ, kṣālitaṃ dhūlipūrṇam |
92212 oṣṭhe rāgaḥ kimapi galita, stvadvyathocchvāsavātais tadvāsaḥ kiṃ, hṛtamiti mayā vastralobhātkileti ||
92221 kasmādbhayamiha maraṇād andhādapi ko viśiṣyate rāgī |
92222 kaḥ śūro yo lalanā  locanabāṇairna vivyathitaḥ ||
92231 kasmiñchete murāriḥ kva na khalu vasatirvāyasī ko niṣedhaḥ  strīṇāṃ rāgastu kasmin kva nu khalu sitimā śairisaṃbodhanaṃ kim |
92232 saṃbuddhiḥ kā'himāṃśorvidhiharavayasāṃ cāpi saṃbuddhayaḥ kā  brūte lubdhaḥ kathaṃ vā kurukulahananaṃ kena tatkeśavena ||
92241 kasmānmlāyasi mālatīva mṛditetyālījane pṛcchati  vyaktaṃ noditamārtayāpi virahe śālīnayā bālayā |
92242 akṣṇorbāṣpacayaṃ nigṛhya kathamapyālokitaḥ kevalaṃ  kiṃcitkuḍmalakoṭibhinnaśikharaścūtadrumaḥ prāṅgaṇe ||
92251 kasmin karmaṇi sāmarthyamasya nottapatetarām |
92252 ayaṃ sādhucarastasmādañjalirbadhyatāmiha ||
92261 kasminnapi mate satye hatāḥ sarvamatatyajaḥ |
92262 taddṛṣṭyā vyarthatāmātramanarthastu na dharmajaḥ ||
92271 kasmin vasanti vada mīnagaṇā vikalpaṃ  kiṃ vāpadaṃ vadati kiṃ kurute vivasvān |
92272 vidyullatāvalayavān pathikāṅganānām  udvejako bhavati kaḥ khalu vārivāhaḥ ||
92281 kasmin svapiti kaṃsāriḥ kāvṛttiradhamā nṛṇām |
92282 kiṃ brūte pitaraṃ bālaḥ kiṃ dṛṣṭvā ramate manaḥ ||
92291 kasmai kiṃ kathanīyaṃ  kasya manaḥpratyayo bhavati |
92292 ramayati gopavadhūṭī  kuñjakuṭīre paraṃ brahma ||
92301 kasmaicitkapaṭāya kaiṭabharipūraḥpīṭhadīrghālayāṃ  devi tvāmabhivādya kupyasi na cettatkiṃcidācakṣmahe |
92302 yatte mandiramambujanma kimidaṃ vidyāgṛhaṃ yacca te  nīcānnīcataropasarpaṇamapāmetatkimācāryakam ||
9230 1 kasmaicitpratipādya vikramajitāṃ viprāya viśvaṃbharām  abdhau vaibhavalabdhavāsarasikaḥ kṣemāya rāmo'stu vaḥ |
9230 2 ślāghante raṇasīmni yasya caritaṃ kālāgnikūlaṃkaṣa  jvālodgārikuṭhārakukṣinihitakṣmāpālacakrā n janān ||
92311 kasmaiciddvijabandhave kiyadapi kṣīraṃ purā nāthate  datto yena dayārasaikavapuṣā dugdhoda evārṇavaḥ |
92312 śrīśrīvallabhakalpapādapasudhācintāmaṇībhiḥ samaṃ  sa svāmī mama daivataṃ taditaro nāmnāpi nāmnāyate ||
92321 kasmai namaḥ surairapi  sutarāṃ kriyate dayāpradhānāya |
92322 kasmādudvijitavyaṃ  saṃsārāraṇyataḥ sudhiyā ||
92331 kasmai yacchati sajjano bahudhanaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ kṣagatkena vā  śambhorbhāni ca ko gale yuvatibhirveṇyāṃ ca kā dhāryate |
92332 gaurīśaḥ kamatāḍayaccaraṇataḥ kā rakṣitā rākṣasair ārohādavarohataḥ kalayatāmekaṃ dvayoruttaram ||
92341 kasmai hanta phalāya sajjana guṇagrāmārjane sajjasi  svātmopaskaraṇāya cenmama vacaḥ pathyaṃ samākarṇaya |
92342 ye bhāvā hṛdayaṃ haranti nitarāṃ śobhābharaiḥ saṃbhṛtās tairevāsya kaleḥ kalevarapuṣo dainaṃdinaṃ vartanam ||
92351 kasya karānna skhalitā  nīranidhikledapicchilā lakṣmīḥ |
92352 bhṛgucaraṇadhūliparuṣe  hṛdi paribaddhā hareḥ sthireyamabhūt ||
92361 kasyacijjāyate jantoḥ pādāghātastavādhvani |
92362 padabhaṅgavyathā śambho jṛmbhate jambhavairiṇaḥ ||
92371 kasyacitkimapi no haraṇīyaṃ  marmavākyamapi noccaraṇīyam |
92372 śrīpateḥ padayugaṃ smaraṇīyaṃ  līlayā bhavajalaṃ taraṇīyam ||
92381 kasyacitsamadanaṃ madanīya  preyasīvadanapānaparasya |
92382 svāditaḥ sakṛdivāsava eva  pratyuta kṣaṇavidaṃśapade'bhūt ||
92391 kasyacinna hi durbuddheśchandato jāyate matiḥ |
92392 yādṛśaṃ kurute karma tādṛśaṃ phalamaśnute ||
92401 kasya tṛṣaṃ na kṣapayasi  pibati na kastava payaḥ praviśyāntaḥ |
92402 yadi sanmārgasarovara  nakrī na kroḍamadhivasati ||
92411 kasya doṣaḥ kule nāsti vyādhinā ko na pīḍitaḥ |
92412 vyasanaṃ kena na prāptaṃ kasya saukhyaṃ nirantaram ||
92421 kasya na dayitaṃ vittaṃ  cittaṃ hriyate na kasya vittena |
92422 kiṃ tu yaśodhanalubdhā  vāñchanti na duṣkṛtairarthān ||
92431 kasya na pratihataṃ bata cakṣur dhvāntasantatibhiraḍḍamarābhiḥ |
92432 kevalaṃ manasijapratihatānāṃ  nāvadhūtamabhisāravadhūnām ||
92441 kasya na vāhanayogyā  mugdhadhiyastucchasādhane lagnāḥ |
92442 prītatayā praśamarucaś capalāsu strīṣu ye'dāntāḥ ||
92451 kasya no kurute mugdhe pipāsākulitaṃ manaḥ |
92452 ayaṃ te vidrumacchāyo marumārga ivādharaḥ ||
92461 kasya marau duradhigamaḥ  kamale kaḥ kathaya viracitāvāsaḥ |
92462 kaistuṣyati cāmuṇḍā  ripavaste vada kuto bhraṣṭāḥ ||
92471 kasya mātā kasya pitā kasya bandhurmahāmune |
92472 vibhramaśca smṛtibhraṃśāttena muhyanti jantavaḥ ||
92481 kasya mātā pitā kasya kasya bhāryā suto'pi vā |
92482 jātau jātau hi jīvānāṃ bhaviṣyantyapare'pare ||
9248 1 kasya vaktavyatā nāsti sopāyaṃ ko na jīvati |
9248 2 vyasanaṃ kena na prāptaṃ kasya saukhyaṃ nirantaram ||
92491 kasya vaśe prāṇigaṇaḥ  satyapriyabhāṣiṇo vinītasya |
92492 kva sthātavyaṃ nyāyye  pathi dṛṣṭādṛṣṭalābhāya ||

93312 kālindī kaṣapaṭṭikā karighaṭā kāmārikaṇṭhasthalī  yasyaite karadā bhavanti sakhi tadvande vinidraṃ tamaḥ ||
93321 kā khalena saha spardhā sajjanasyābhimāninaḥ |
93322 bhāṣaṇaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ sādhu dūṣaṇaṃ yasya bhūṣaṇam ||
93331 kā gaṇanā viṣayavaśe  puṃsi varāke varāṅganā spṛhayā |
93332 vyājena vīkṣamāṇā  dhyānadhiyāṃ spṛśati sajjñānam ||
93341 kāṅkṣitenāpyalabdhena bhogārhe navayauvane |
93342 jarājīrṇaśarīrasya bhāreṇeva dhanena kim ||
93351 kācaṃ maṇiṃ kāñcanamekasūtre  mugdhā nibadhnanti kimatra citram |
93352 vicāravān paṇinirekasūtre  śvānaṃ yuvānaṃ maghavānamāha ||
93361 kācaḥ kāñcanasaṃsargāddhatte mārakatīṃ dyutim |
93362 aśmāpi yāti devatvaṃ mahadbhiḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
93371 kācaḥ kāñcanasaṃsargāddhatte mārakatīṃ dyutim |
93372 tathā satsaṃnidhānena mūrkho yāti pravīṇatām ||
9337 1 kācakāmaladoṣeṇa paśyennetre viparyayam |
9337 2 abhyākhyānaṃ vadejjihvā tatra rāgaka ucyate ||
93381 kā cakre hariṇā, dhane kṛpaṇadhīḥ kīdṛg, bhujaṃge'sti kiṃ,  kīdṛk, kumbhasamudbhavasya jaṭharaṃ, kīdṛgyiyāsurvadhūḥ |
93382 ślokaḥ kīdṛgabhīpsitaḥ sukṛtināṃ, kīdṛṅnabho nirmalaṃ,  kṣoṇīmāhvaya sarvagaṃ kimuditaṃ rātrau saraḥ kīdṛśam ||
93391 kācāḥ kāñcanabhūṣitāḥ kati na vā puṣṇanti ratnaśriyaṃ  maulau vā kati nodvahantyapadhiyastāneva ratnabhramāt |
93392 akṣṇāṃ ye punarunmṛjanti timiraṃ yairnāma ratnākaraḥ  sindhuste pṛthageva hanta maṇayasteṣvapyabhijñāḥ pṛthak ||
93401 kācitkarābhyāṃ kusumāni nītvā  dadhāra śaṃbhoḥ padayoḥ samīpe |
93402 vivakṣayā manmathaduṣpravṛtteḥ  samutsṛjantī viśikhānivāgre ||
93411 kācitkīrṇā rajobhirdivamanuvidadhe bhinnavakrendulakṣmīr aśrīkāḥ kāścidantardiśa iva dadhire dāhamudbhrāntasattvāḥ |
93412 mremurvātyā ivānyāḥ pratipadamaparā bhūmivatkampamāpuḥ  prasthāne pārthivānāmaśivamiti purobhāvi nāryaḥ śaśaṃsuḥ ||
93421 kācitkṛtā kṛtiriti tvayi sārpiteti  kāpi pramodakaṇikā mama nāntaraṅge |
93422 mauḍhyaṃ madīyamiha yadviditaṃ mamaiva  kiṃ tvamba viśvasimi dīnaśaraṇyatāṃ te ||
93431 kācittṛṣārtā vanitā nidāghe  gaṅgāṃ samabhyetya sudhāsavarṇām |
93432 ādāya tadvāri karadvayena  vilokayantī na papau kimetat ||
93435 (karakisalayakāntikāntyā śoṇitaśaṅkayeti |)
93441 kācitpadairaskhalitaiḥ sakhelaṃ  vāntīṣu śuddhāntakareṇukāsu |
93442 rājāṅganānāmakarodavajñāṃ  śroṇībhare ca stanagaurave ca ||
93451 kācitpurā virahiṇī parivṛddhihetor yasyai dideśa salilaṃ navamālikāyai |
93452 sā puṣpitaiva jalamaśruvaśādviyoge  tasyai pradāya kathamapyanṛṇī babhūva ||
93461 kācitsvarṇalatā tadūrdhvamamalaścandrastadabhyantare  padme tannikaṭaṃ tilasya kusumaṃ tatsannidhau pallave |
93462 hemnaḥ kiṃcidadhastayośca kalaśau kāntau jaganmohanau  svastyetatprakarotu vastrijagatāṃ kiṃ brahmakṛṣṇādibhiḥ ||
93471 kācidbalinā krāntā  kācinna jahāti kāminaṃ ruciram |
93472 anyā pānakagoṣṭhyāṃ  nayati dinaṃ prītakaiḥ sārdham ||
93481 kācidbālakavanmahītalagatā mūlacchidākāraṇaṃ  dravyeṇārjanapuṣpitāpi viphalī kācicca jātiprabhā |
93482 kācicchrīḥ kadalīva bhogasubhagā satpuṇyabījacyutā  sarvāṅge subhagā rasālalatikāvatpuṇyabījāṅkitā ||
93491 kācidbālā ramaṇavasatiṃ preṣayantī karaṇḍaṃ  dāsīhastātsabhayamalikhadvyālamasyopariṣṭāt |
93492 gaurīkāntaṃ pavanatanayaṃ campakaṃ cātra bhāvaṃ  pṛcchatyāryo nipuṇatilako mallināthaḥ kavīndraḥ ||
93501 kācidvibhūṣayati darpaṇasaktahastā  bālātapeṣu vanitā vadanāravindam |
93502 dantacchadaṃ priyatamena nipītasāraṃ  dantāgrabhinnamavakṛṣya nirīkṣate ca ||
93511 kācidviyogānalataptagātrī  prāṇān samādhārayituṃ lilekha |
93512 bāhvorbhujaṅgaṃ hṛdi rāhubimbaṃ  nābhau ca karpūramayaṃ maheśam ||
93521 kācidvilolanayanā ramaṇe svakīye  dūraṃ gate sati manobhavabāṇakhinnā |
93522 tyaktaṃ śarīramacirānmalayādrivāyuṃ  saurabhyaśālinamaho pibati sma citram ||
93531 kācidvihṛtya kila kantukakeliraṅgād bhūreṇurūṣitatanurniragānmṛgākṣī |
93532 utphullapaṅkajavane suciraṃ caritvā  kiñjalkareṇuparidhūsariteva lakṣmīḥ ||
93541 kā cintā mama jīvane yadi harirviśvaṃbharo gīyate  no cedarbhakajīvanāya jananīstanyaṃ kathaṃ nirmame |
93542 ityālocya muhurmuhuryadupate lakṣmīpate kevalaṃ  tvatpādāmbujasevanena satataṃ kālo mayā nīyate ||
93551 kācinnitambārpitavāmahastā  dorlekhayā kuñcitayā natāṅgī |
93552 kṣamāpatau mārgaṇamokṣadakṣam  akalpayaccāpamiva smarasya ||
93561 kācinnideśājjaratījanānāṃ  kulocitaṃ kiṃcidihālapantī |
93562 kuñjadrumālekhanamācarantī  saṃjñāpitālībhirabhūtsalajjā ||
93571 kācinnivāritabahirgamanā jananyā  draṣṭuṃ haraṃ bhavanajālakamāsasāda |
93572 tasyā vilocanamadṛśyata dāśayantra  yatroparuddhaśapharopamitaṃ kṣaṇena ||
93581 kācinmṛgākṣī priyaviprayoge  gantuṃ niśāpāramapārayantī |
93582 udgātumādāya kareṇa vīṇām  eṇāṅkamālokya śanairahāsīt ||
93591 kāce maṇirmaṇau kāco yeṣāṃ buddhiḥ pravartate |
93592 na teṣāṃ saṃnidhau bhṛtyo nāmamātro'pi tiṣṭhati ||
93601 kāco maṇirmaṇiḥ kāco yeṣāṃ te'nye hi dehinaḥ |
93602 santi te sudhiyo yeṣāṃ kācaḥ kāco maṇirmaṇiḥ ||
9360 1 kāñcanāṅgi kamanīyakalāpau  kañculīkavacitau likucau te |
9360 2 pāṇinā nanu vahāmi muhūrtaṃ  dehi me'dharamaṇiṃ tava dāsyam ||
93611 kāñcikena samāloḍya bhakṣayetprātaranvaham |
93612 ṣaṇmāsayogato hanti palitaṃ valibhiḥ saha |
93613 dugdhānnabhojanāsaktaściraṃjīvī bhavennaraḥ ||
93621 kāñcīṃ kāñcī na dhatte kalayati na dṛśā keralī kelitalpaṃ  sindūraṃ dūra eva kṣipati karatalanyastamāndhrī purandhrī |
93622 saurāṣṭrī mārṣṭi bhūyaḥ sapadi nayanayo raktayo raktimānaṃ  kārṇāṭī karṇikāyāṃ malinayati mano mānasiṃhaprayāṇe ||
9362 1 kāñcīkalakvaṇitakomalanābhikānti  pārāvatadhvanitacitritakaṇṭhapālim |
9362 2 udbhrāntalocanacakoramanaṅgaraṅgam  āśāsmahe kamapi vāravilāsavatyāḥ ||
93631 kāñcī kāṃcidiyaṃ cakāra jaghananyastā gatermandatāṃ  gāḍhaṃ baddhamidaṃ ca kañcukamadāducchrūnatāṃ vakṣasaḥ |
93632 netraprāntamathākulaṃ kalayati śrotrāvataṃsadvayaṃ  tatko'yaṃ bata matprasādhanavidhau sakhyaiṣamastvatkramaḥ ||
93641 kāncīguṇagrathitakāñcanaceladṛśya  caṇḍātapāṃśukavibhāparabhāgaśobhi |
93642 paryaṅkamaṇḍalapariṣkaraṇaṃ purārer dhyāyāmi te nikhilamamba nitambabibhbam ||
93651 kāñcīguṇaiḥ kāñcanaratnacitrair no bhūṣayanti pramadā nitambam |
93652 na nūpuraihaṃsarutaṃ bhajadbhiḥ  pādāmbujānyambujakāntibhāñji ||
93661 kāñcīguṇairviracitā jaghaneṣu lakṣmīr labdhā sthitiḥ stanataṭeṣu ca ratnahāraiḥ |
93662 no bhūṣitā vayamitīva nitambinīnāṃ  kārśya nirargalamadhāryata madhyabhāgaiḥ ||
93671 kāñcīdāmakabandhanaṃ salalitā karṇotpalaistāḍanā  helāliṅnavighnamāhitaruṣā maunena nirbhartsanam |
93672 kiṃ pūrvocitametadatra sahasā vismṛtya manyorbharān  mayyutkaṇṭhamanasyadarśanapathaṃ yātāsyaho kopane ||
93681 kāñcīdāma dṛḍhaṃ vidhāya kavarīmābadhya gāḍhaṃ guṇair vakṣojādapasārya hāramasakṛdvyādhūya karṇotpalam |
93682 dūrotsāritakaṅkaṇā vidhumukhī sotprāsahāsaṃ haṭhāt kaṇṭhe kasya karoti hanta dayitāśleṣāya dorbandhanam ||
93691 kāñcīdāma niveśayan vitanute vāsaḥ ślathaṃ subhruvo  hāraṃ vakṣasi yojayan karatalaṃ dhatte kucāmbhoruhe |
93692 jalpaṃścāṭuvaco'dharaṃ dhayati yatpreyān kuto vismayaḥ  pāṃsuṃ cakṣuṣi vikṣipan yadi dhanaṃ gṛhṇāsi pāṭaccaraḥ ||
9369 1 kāñcīsīmani kāpi kāñcanamayī niśreṇikā rājate  tāmāsādya raṇotsavena mahatā kenāpi dhīra tvayā |
9369 2 sadyaḥ kaṇṭakaśālinā karayugenākramya śailadvayaṃ  tasyopāntanivāsinaśca śaśinaḥ sphītā sudhā lapsyate ||
93701 kāñcyā gāḍhatarāvabaddhavasanaprāntā kimarthaṃ punar mugdhākṣī svapitīti tatparijanaṃ svairaṃ priye pṛcchati |
93702 mātaḥ suptimapīha lumpati mametyāropitakrodhayā  paryasya svapanacchalena śayane datto'vakāśastayā ||
93711 kāṭhinyaṃ kucayoḥ sraṣṭuṃ vāñchantyaḥ pādapadmayoḥ |
93712 nindanti ca vidhātāraṃ tvadghāṭīṣvariyoṣitaḥ ||
93721 kāṭhinyaṃ kucakumbhayornayanayoścāñcalyametaddvayaṃ  bho brahman bhavatā kathaṃ na padayorasmākamāsāditam |
93722 itthaṃ śrīnarasiṃha te tribhuvanādhīśasya ghāṭībhiyā  kāntāreṣu mithaḥ palāyanaparā jalpanti vairistriyaḥ ||
93731 kāṭhinyaṃ giriṣu sadā  mṛdutā salile dhruvā prabhā sūrye |
93732 vairamasajjanahṛdaye  sajjanahṛdaye punaḥ kṣāntiḥ ||
93741 kāṭhinyamaṅgairnikhilairnirastaṃ  stanau kṛśāṅgyāḥ śaraṇaṃ jagāma |
93742 adhaḥ patiṣyāva itīva bhītyā  na śaknutastāvapi hātumetat ||
93751 kāṇaḥ kubjo'tha khañjaḥ śrutibalavikalo vāmanaḥ paṅgurandhaḥ  ṣaṇḍo'pi cchinnanāsaḥ parijanarahito durbhago rogadehī |
93752 duṣputro duṣkalatraḥ svajanaparijanairnindino hīnamānaḥ  satyaṃ yajjāyate tatsvakṛtamidamaho ceṣṭate jīvaloke ||
93761 kāṇāḥ kamalapatrākṣāḥ kadaryāḥ kalpaśākhinaḥ |
93762 kātarā vikramādityāḥ kavidṛggocaraṃ gatāḥ ||
93771 kāṇāḥ kubjāśca ṣaṇḍāśca tathā vṛddhāśca paṅgavaḥ |
93772 ete cāntaḥpure nityaṃ niyoktavyāḥ kṣamābhṛtā ||
93781 kāṇāḥ khañjāśca kubjāśca atividdhāśca paṅgulāḥ |
93782 eteṣvantaḥ purarakṣāyāṃ niyojyāḥ pārthivena tu ||
9378 1 kāṇāśchaṭāśca raṃḍāśca tathā vṛddhāśca paṅgavaḥ |
9378 2 ete cāntaḥpure nityaṃ niyoktavyāḥ kṣamābhṛtā ||
9378 1 kāṇo nimagnaviṣamonnatadṛṣṭirekaḥ  śakto virāgajanane jananāturāṇām |
9378 2 yo naiva kasyacidupaiti manaḥpriyatvam  ālekhyakarma likhito'pi kimu svarūpaḥ ||
93791 kātaratākekarita  smaralajjāroṣamasṛṇamadhurākṣī |
93792 yoktuṃ na moktumathavā  valate'sāvarthalabdharatiḥ ||
93801 kātaryaṃ kevalā nītiḥ śauryaṃ śvāpadaceṣṭitam |
93802 ataḥ siddhiṃ sametābhyāmubhābhyāmanviyeṣa saḥ ||
93811 kātaryaṃ tu na kārmaṇaṃ na na paraṃ dambho na kiṃ yoṣitāṃ  yaccittā tanucāpalaṃ madhuvidhudbeṣastanutvaṃ tanoḥ |
93812 asmākaṃ sakhi paśya saṃprati tanū romāpi vakrāyate  sadyaḥ proṣita nāthayābhinavayā pānthastriyo hāsitāḥ ||
93821 kātaryaṃ durvinītatvaṃ kārpaṇyamavivekatā |
93822 sarvaṃ mārjanti kavayaḥ śālīnāṃ muṣṭikiṃkarāḥ ||
93831 kā tava kāgtā kaste putraḥ  saṃsāro'yamatīva vicitraḥ |
93832 kasya tvaṃ vā kuta āyātas tattvaṃ cintaya tadidaṃ bhrātaḥ ||
93841 kā tārairmama garjitairuparatā dhārāmbubhiḥ kā hatā  kā mohaṃ gamitā viyogavidhurā kā vā kadambānilaiḥ |
93842 nītā kā ca vilolatāṃ madakalaiḥ kekārabairbarhiṇām  itthaṃ pānthagṛheṣu paśyati ghano vidyutpradīpairiva ||
93851 kātyāyanīkusumakāmanayā kimarthaṃ  kāntārakukṣikuharaṃ kutukādgatāsi |
93852 paśya stanastabakayostava kaṇṭakāṅkaṃ  gopaḥ sukaṇṭhi bata paśyati jātakopaḥ ||
93861 kātra śrīḥ śroṇibimbe sravadudarapurāvastikhadvāravācye  lakṣmīḥ kā kāminīnāṃ kucakalaśayuge māṃsapiṇḍasvarūpe |
93862 kā kāntirnetrayugme jalakaluṣajuṣi śleṣmaraktādipūrṇe  kā śobhāvartagarte nigadata yadaho mohinastāḥ stuvanti ||
9386 1 kā tvaṃ kāmini jāhnavī, kimiha te, bhartā haro nanvasāv ambhastvaṃ kila vetsi manmathakalāṃ, jānātyayaṃ te patiḥ |
9386 2 svāmin satyamidaṃ, nahi priyatame satyaḥ kutaḥ kāmināṃ  ityevaṃ harajāhnavīgirisutāsaṃjalpitaṃ pātu vaḥ ||
93871 kā tvaṃ, kuntalamallakīrtir, ahaha kvāsi sthitā, na kvacit sakhyastāstava kutra kutra vada vāglakṣmīstathā kāntayaḥ |
93872 vāgyātā caturānanasya vadanaṃ lakṣmīrmurāreruraḥ  kāntirmaṇḍalamaindavaṃ mama punarnādyāpi viśrāmabhūḥ ||
93881 kā tvaṃ padmapalāśākṣi pītakauśeyavāsini |
93882 drumasya śākhāmālambya tiṣṭhasi tvamanindate ||
93891 kā tvaṃ putri, narendra lubdhakavadhūr, haste kimetat, palaṃ  kṣāmaṃ kiṃ, sahajaṃ bravīmi nṛpate yadyādarācchrūyate |
93892 gāyanti tvadaripriyāśrutaṭinītīreṣu siddhāṅganā  gītāndhā na tṛṇaṃ caranti hariṇāstenāmiṣaṃ durbalam ||
93901 kā tvaṃ, mādhavadūtikā, vadasi kiṃ, mānaṃ jahīhi priye  dhūrtaḥ so'nyamanā, manāgapi sakhi tvayyādaraṃ nojjhati |
93902 ityanyonyakathārasaiḥ pramuditāṃ rādhāṃ sakhīveṣavān  nītvā kuñjagṛhaṃ prakāśitatanuḥ smero hariḥ pātu vaḥ ||
93911 kā tvaṃ, mukti, rupāgatāsmi bhavatī kasmādakasmādiha  śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇena deva bhavato dāsīpadaṃ prāpitā |
93912 dūre tiṣṭha manāganāgasi kathaṃ kuryādanāryaṃ mayi  tvadgandhānnijanāmacandanarasālepasya lopo bhavet ||
93921 kā tvaṃ śubhe kasya parigraho vā  kiṃ vā madabhyāgamakāraṇaṃ te |
93922 ācakṣva matvā vaśināṃ raghūṇāṃ  manaḥ parastrīvimukhapravṛtti ||
93931 kādambinī kambalikā kadamba  kedārakāntākucakuṭṭimaṃ ca |
93932 kastūrikā ketakapuṣpagamdhaḥ  kekāravaḥ prāvṛṣi harṣamūlam ||
93941 kādambinī kimiyamāli kadambamūle  kiṃ vā tamālatarureva kimandhakāraḥ |
93942 jānāsi naiva sakhi gopakulāṅganānāṃ  kaulavratavratatibhaṅgakaraḥ karīndraḥ ||
9394 1 kā dīyatāṃ tava raghūdvaha samyagāśīr niṣkaṇṭakāni vihitāni jaganti yena |
9394 2 āśāsmahe nanu tathāpi saha svavīrair bhūkāśyapopamasutadvitayā vadhūḥ syāt ||
93951 kā durdaśā kupitanirdayacitragupta  vitrāsitasya jagato yadi devi na syāḥ |
93952 tvaṃ karmabandhanavimocanadharmarāja  lekhādhikārapariśodhanajātapatrī ||
93961 kā dyauḥ, kiṃ balasadma, kā vasumatī, syātsarvametadyadi  pratyakṣaṃ na bhavetkadācidapi kiṃ te sarvasandarśinaḥ |
93962 bhrāmyantaḥ pralapantu nāma viditaṃ maṇḍūka samyaktvayā  muktvemaṃ paramaṃ kukūpamitaratkiṃ nāma saṃbhāvyate ||
93971 kānane sariduddeśe girīṇāmapi kandare |
93972 paśyantyantakasaṃkāśaṃ tvāmekaṃ ripavaḥ puraḥ ||
93981 kā nāma buddhihīnasya vidheravidagdhatā |
9398 2 kūṣmāṇḍānāṃ na yaścakre tailamūrṇāṃ ca dantinām
93991 kāni sthānāni dagdhānyatiśayagahanāḥ santi ke vā pradeśāḥ  kiṃ vā śeṣaṃ vanasya sthitamiti pavanāsaṅgavispaṣṭatejāḥ |
93992 caṇḍajvālāvalīḍhasphuṭitatarulatāgranthimuktāṭṭahāso  dāvāgniḥ śuṣkavṛkṣe śikhariṇi gahane'dhiṣṭhitaḥ paśyatīva ||
94001 kānīnastu pitāmahaḥ samabhavatpitrādayo golakās tatputrāśca yudhiṣṭhiraprabhṛtayaḥ kuṇḍā hyamī pāṇḍavāḥ |
94002 pañcānāṃ drupadātmajā sahacarī yuddhe hatā bāndhavā  śrīkṛṣṇena kulaṃ kalaṅkanicitaṃ nītaṃ jagadvanditam ||
94011 kānīnasya muneḥ svabāndhavavadhūvaidhavyavidhvaṃsino  naptāraḥ khalu golakasya tanayāḥ kuṇḍāḥ svayaṃ pāṇḍavāḥ |
94012 te'mī pañca samānayoniratayasteṣāṃ guṇotkīrtanād akṣayyaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavedavikalaṃ, dharmasya sūkṣmā gatiḥ ||
9401 1 kāntaṃ kandarpapuṣpaṃ stanataṭaśaśinaṃ rāgavṛkṣapravālaṃ  śayyāyuddhābhighātaṃ surataratharaṇaśrāntadhuryapratomad |
9401 2 unmeṣaṃ vimramāṇāṃ karajapadamayaṃ guhyasambhogacihnaṃ  rāgākrāntā vahantāṃ jaghananipatitaṃ karkaśāḥ strīkiśoryaḥ ||
94021 kāntaṃ khalagirā kāvyaṃ labhate bhūyasīṃ rucam |
94022 spṛṣṭaṃ ca daṃṣṭtrayā hṛdyaṃ yathā hemavibhūṣaṇam ||
94031 kāntaṃ nirīkṣya valayāṅkitakaṇṭhadeśaṃ  muktāstayā parabhiyā paruṣā na vācaḥ |
94032 dūtīmukhe mṛgadṛśā skhaladambupūrā  dūrātparaṃ nidadhire nayanāntapātāḥ ||
9403 1 kāntaṃ rūpaṃ yauvanaṃ cārulīlaṃ  dānaṃ dākṣipyaṃ vākca sāmopapannā |
9403 2 yaṃ prāpyaite sadguṇāḥ bhānti sarve  loke kāminyaḥ kā na tasya prasādyāḥ ||
94041 kāntaṃ vakti kapotikākulatayā nāthāntakālo'dhunā  vyādho'dho dhṛtacāpasajjitaśaraḥ śvenaḥ paribhrāmati |
94042 itthaṃ satyahinā sa daṣṭa iṣuṇā śyeno'pi tenāhatas tūrṇaṃ tau tu yamālayaṃ prati gatau daivī vicitrā gatiḥ ||
94051 kāntaṃ vicintya sulabhetarasaṃprayogāṃ  śrutvā vidarbhapatimānamitaṃ balaiśca |
94052 dhārābhirātapa ivābhihataṃ sarojaṃ  duḥkhāyate ca hṛdayaṃ sukhamaśnute ca ||
94061 kāntaṃ vinā nadītīraṃ madamālokya kekinī |
94062 atra kriyāpadaṃ guptaṃ yo jānāti sa paṇḍitaḥ ||
94071 kāntaṃ vīkṣya vipakṣapakṣmaladṛśaḥ pādāmbujālaktakair āliptānanamānatīkṛtamukhī citrārpitevābhavat |
94072 rūkṣaṃ noktavatī na vā kṛtavatī niḥśvāsakoṣṇe dṛśau  prātarmaṅgalamaṅganā karatalādādarśamādarśayat ||
94081 kāntaḥ kaṭākṣapātena bhrāmayannayanadvayam |
94082 sugandhimāruto tāta śṛṅgārarasasevitaḥ ||
94091 kāntaḥ karaṃ spṛśati jalpati cāṭuvācam  ālokate mukhamapākurute dukūlam |
94092 ityeva kevalamanaṅga vilāsabhītā  svapne'pi paśyati navoḍhasaroruhākṣī ||
94101 kāntaḥ kucādekakareṇa veṇīm  eṇīdṛśaḥ karṣati kautukena |
94102 anyāṅganāsaṅgamaśuddhihetoḥ  śyāmāṃ bhujaṅgīmiva hemakumbhāt ||
94111 kāntaḥ kṛtāntacaritaḥ kuṭilā tadambā  vajropamāni vacanāni ca durjanānām |
94112 pratyaṅgamantaratanoḥ praharanti bāṇāḥ  prāṇāḥ punaḥ sakhi bahirna khalu prayānti ||
94121 kāntaḥ padena hata iti  saralāmaparādhya kiṃ prasādayatha |
94122 so'pyevameva sulabhaḥ  padaprahāraḥ prasādaḥ kim ||
94131 kāntaḥ putri haṭhādgataścaraṇayorna tvaṃ nipatya sthitā  baddho mekhalayānayā ratirahaḥ sakhyā na vā phūtkṛtam |
94132 kā lajjā muṣitāsi kiṃ prakaṭitairebhirvilakṣasmitair āḥ pāpe virahānalasya na śikhā jānāsi marmacchidaḥ ||
94141 kāntadūtya iva kuṅkumatāmrāḥ  sāyamaṇḍalamabhitvarayantyaḥ |
94142 sādaraṃ dadṛśire vanitābhiḥ  saudhajālapatitā ravibhāsaḥ ||
94151 kāntaprakarṣaṃ daśanacchadena  sandhyāghane baddhapadaṃ harantyāḥ |
94152 tasyā gṛhodyānasarogatasya  hastasya evāmburuhasya rāgaḥ ||
94161 kāntarmūrdhni dadhatī vidhitsayā  tanmaṇeḥ śravaṇapūramutpalam |
94162 rantumarcanamivācaratpuraḥ  sā svavallabhatano manobhuvaḥ ||
94171 kāntayā kāntasaṃyoge kimakāri navoḍhayā |
94172 atrāpi cottaraṃ vaktumavadhirbrahmaṇo vayaḥ ||
94181 kāntayānugataḥ ko'yaṃ pīnaskandho madoddhataḥ |
94182 mṛgāṇāṃ pṛṣṭhato yāti śambaro rūḍhayauvanaḥ ||
94191 kāntayā sapadi ko'pyupagūḍhaḥ  prauḍhapāṇirapanetumiyeṣa |
94192 saṃhatastanatiraskṛtadṛṣṭir bhraṣṭameva na dukūlamapaśyat ||
94201 kāntaveśma bahu saṃdiśatībhir yātameva rataye ramaṇībhiḥ |
94202 manmathena pariluptamatīnāṃ  prāyaśaḥ skhalitamapyupakāri ||
94211 kāntasaṃgamaparājitamanyau  vāruṇīrasanaśāntavivāde |
94212 māninījana upāhitasaṃdhau  saṃdadhe dhanuṣi neṣumanaṅgaḥ ||
94221 kāntaste kamalābhirāmanayane kalpe hi deśāntaraṃ  ganteti śrutamadya lokavacanāttathyaṃ kimetadvacaḥ |
94222 pṛṣṭā seti mayā dayādhananidhe provāca dīnānanā  yattadvaktumapi kṣamā na rasanā me jāyate sāmpratam ||
94231 kāntāṃ kāmapi kāmayatyanudinaṃ dhyānāpadeśādayaṃ  yenāmuṃ munayo'pyanādinidhanaṃ dhyāyanti dhautaspṛhāḥ |
94232 ityaṅkātsvakare hṛte girijayā pāde ca padmāsanād viśvaṃ pātu purandhrinaddhavapuṣaḥ śambhoḥ samādhivyayaḥ ||
94241 kāntāṃ kvāpi vilambinīṃ kalarutairāhūya bhūyastato  digbhāgānavalokya raṅgavasudhāmutsṛjya padbhyāṃ tataḥ |
94242 eṣa sphāramṛdaṅganādamadhurairambhomucāmāravair barhaśreṇikṛtātapatraracano hṛṣṭaḥ śikhī nṛtyati ||
94251 kāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā caraṇayugalakṣālanāya pravṛttām  asmin rāṣṭre śriyamiti vacaḥ pāpaṭhīti prayatnāt |
94252 devasya tveti ca punarasau vīṭikāyāḥ pradāne  jāmātā te jaḍamatirayaṃ chāndasaḥ kiṃ karomi ||
94261 kāntāṃ hitvā virahavidhurārambhakhedālasāṅgīṃ  māmullaṅghya vrajatu pathikaḥ ko'pi yadyasti śaktiḥ |
94262 ityāśokī jagati sakale vallarī corikeva  prāptāramme kusumasamaye kāmadevena dattā ||
94271 kāntāḥ kiṃ na śaśāṅkakāntidhavalāḥ saudhālayāḥ kasyacit kāñcīdāmavirājitorujaghanā sevyā na kiṃ kāminī |
94272 kiṃ vā śrotrarasāyanaṃ sukhakaraṃ śravyaṃ na gītādikaṃ  viśvaṃ kintu vilokya mārutacalaṃ santastapaḥ kurvate ||
9427 1 kāntākaṭākṣavapuṣe namaḥ kusumadhanvane |
9427 2 jāyate yena sacchāyo viraso'pi bhavadrumaḥ ||
94281 kāntākaṭākṣaviśikhā na khananti yasya  cittaṃ na nirdahati kopakṛśānutāpaḥ |
94282 karṣanti bhūriviṣayāśca na lobhapāśā  lokatrayaṃ jayati kṛtsnamidaṃ sa dhīraḥ ||
94291 kāntā karṣaṇalolakeralavadhūdhammillamallīrajaś caurāścoḍanitambinīstanataṭe niṣpandatāmāgatāḥ |
94292 revāśīkaradhāriṇo'ndhramuralastrīmānamudrābhi do  vātā vānti navīnakokilavaghūhūṃkāravācālitāḥ ||
94301 kāntākeliṃ kalayatu taruḥ ko'pi kaścitprabhūṇām  atyānandaṃ janayatu phalaiḥ ko'pi lokān dhinotu |
94302 dhanyaṃ manye malayajamaho yaḥ prabhūtopatāpaṃ  saṃsārasya drutamapanayatyātmadehavyayena ||
94311 kāntākelimayopi bhūtakaruṇāśānto'pyasau saṃyamī  krīḍārūḍhasamādhibhaṅgavikaṭabhrūbhaṅgabhīmānanaḥ |
94312 dṛṣṭvākṛṣṭaśarāsanaṃ yadakarotkruddhaḥ pinākī smaraṃ  tvāmapyadya dṛśā tadeva kurute krodhādayaṃ kauśikaḥ ||
94321 kāntā candrodayo vīṇāpañcamadhvanirityamī |
94322 ye nandayanti sukhitān duḥkhitān vyathayanti te ||
94331 kāntājanaṃ suratakhedanimīlitākṣaṃ  saṃvāhituṃ samupayāniva mandamandam |
94332 harmyeṣu mālyamadirāparibhogagandhān  āviścakāra rajanīparivṛttivāyuḥ ||
94341 kāntājanena rahasi prasabhaṃ gṛhīta  keśe rate smarasahāsavatoṣitena |
94342 premṇā manassu rajanīṣvapi haimanīṣu  ke śerate sma rasahāsavatoṣitena ||
94351 kāntā dadāti madanaṃ  madanaḥ saṃtāpamasamamanupaśayam |
94352 saṃtāpo maraṇamaho  tathāpi śaraṇaṃ nṛṇāṃ saiva ||
9435 1 kāntādharasudhāsvādādyūnaṃ yajjāyate sukham |
9435 2 binduḥ pārśve tadadhyātmaśāstrāsvādasukhodadheḥ ||
94361 kāntādharāsavanipānamupāsya dhīmān  pīyūṣapānakṛtaye na ruciṃ prayāti |
94362 tatrāsti cenmadhurimā bata ko'pi satyaṃ  kiṃ nāma tāta tṛṣiṭāḥ kṣudhitāḥ punaḥ syuḥ ||
94371 kāntānavādhararasāmṛtatṛṣṇayeva  bimbaṃ papāta śaśino madhubhājane yat |
94372 niḥśeṣite madhuni lajjitacittavṛtti  tattanmukhābjajitakāntitayā vinaṣṭam ||
94381 kāntānāṃ kuvalayamapyapāstamakṣṇoḥ  śobhābhirna mukharucāhamekameva |
94382 saṃharṣādalivirutairitīva gāyaṃl lolormau payasi mahotpalaṃ nanarta ||
94391 kāntānāṃ kṛtapulakaḥ stanāṅgarāge  vaktreṣu cyutatilakeṣu mauktikāmbhaḥ |
94392 saṃpede śramasalilodgamo vibhūṣāṃ  ramyāṇāṃ vikṛtirapi śriyaṃ tanoti ||
94401 kāntānāṃ vadanendukāntimadhunā dhatte sudhādīdhitiḥ  khelatkhañjanapaṅktayo mṛgadṛśāṃ tanvanti netraśriyam |
94402 padmāni śvasitasya saurabhamabhidruhyanti vāmabhruvām  abhyasyanti ca rājahaṃsavanitāḥ pīnastanīnāṃ gatim ||
94411 kāntānurāgacaturo'si manoharo'si  nātho'si kiṃ ca navayauvanabhūṣito'si |
94412 itthaṃ nigadya sudṛśā vadane priyasya  niśvasya bāṣpalulitā nihitā dṛgantāḥ ||
9441 1 kāntānetrārdhapātā vadanarucikarāḥ sasmitā bhrūvilāsāḥ  sākārā vākyaleśāḥ sahatalaninadā dṛṣṭanaṣṭāśca hāsāḥ |
9441 2 nābhīkakṣastanānāṃ vivaraṇamasakṛtsparśanaṃ mekhalānāṃ  śvāsāyāsāśca dīrghāṃ madanaśarahatāṃ kāminīṃ sūcayanti ||
9441 1 kāntānyardhanirīkṣitāni madhurā hāsopadaṃśāḥ kathāḥ  pīnaśroṇiniruddhaśeṣamatulasparśaṃ tadardhāṃsanam |
9441 2 snehavyaktikarān karavyatikarāṃstāṃstāṃśca ramyān guṇān  veśyābhyaḥ praṇayādṛte'pi labhate jñātopacāro janaḥ ||
9441 1 kāntāprītiparānujo vinayavān hṛnnandano nandano  bhāgyaṃ svarlalanopabhogyamamalā lakṣmīḥ sukhaṃ nistuṣam |
9441 2 pūjā rājakule yaśo'tiviśadaṃ goṣṭhī samaṃ kovidair dāne'tivyasanaṃ ratirjinamate syātkasyacitpuṇyataḥ ||
94421 kāntāmukhaṃ suratakelivimardakheda  saṃjātagharmakaṇavicchuritaṃ ratānte |
94422 āpāṇḍuraṃ taralatāranimīlitākṣaṃ  saṃsmṛtya he hṛdaya kiṃ śatadhā na yāsi ||
94431 kāntāmukhadyutijuṣāmapi codgatānāṃ  śobhāṃ parāṃ kuravakadrumamañjarīṇām |
94432 dṛṣṭvā priye sahṛdayasya bhavenna kasya  kandarpabāṇapatanavyathitaṃ hi cetaḥ ||
94441 kāntāmukhāsvādaparāṅmukhā yat pānthāḥ śaśāṅkasya karairvimṛṣṭāḥ |
94442 suduḥsahaṃ tāpamime prayānti  manye tatau naiva sudhetaratra ||
94451 kāntāyāḥ karajaiḥ kapolaphalake patrāvalī kalpitā  kelidyūtapaṇīkṛto viharatā pītaḥ sa bimbādharaḥ |
94452 svedārdrīkṛtacandanastanataṭī sānandamāliṅgitā  nirviṣṭā viṣayāḥ śivātmamahasi nyastaṃ manaḥ saṃprati ||
94461 kāntāyā vikasadvilāsahasitasvacchāṃśavaścāmaraṃ  saṃsaktāvabhiṣekahemakalaśau yaccandanāṅkau stanau |
94462 yatkārtasvarakānti cāru jaghanaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ bhūbhujāṃ  sāmrājyaṃ tadidaṃ jayājayamayaḥ śeṣastu cintāmayḥ ||
94471 kāntāraṃ na yathetaro jvalayituṃ dakṣo davāgniṃ vinā  dāvāgniṃ na yathā paraḥ śamayituṃ śakto vināmbhodharam |
94472 niṣṇātaḥ pavanaṃ vinā nirasituṃ nānyo yathāmbhodharaṃ  karmaughaṃ sukṛtaṃ vinā kimaparaṃ hantuṃ samarthaṃ tathā ||
94481 kāntāraṃ parito jvalatyatibale dāvānale daivato  gomāyorgahanāṃ guhāṃ paripatan darpoddhuraḥ kesarī |
94482 yadvyāpādayati sma taṃ na kṛpayā tenaiṣa tasmin vane  siṃhānāmabhayaprado'hamadhunetyutpucchamuddhāvati ||
94491 kāntāraḥ samarākhyaśca vaikuṇṭho vāñchitastathā |
94492 viśālaśca tathā nandaḥ ṣoḍhāḥ niḥsāruko bhavet ||
94501 kāntārapādapānāṃ  yathā phalaṃ mānuṣairananubhogyam |
94502 evamanāryeṣvarthāḥ  manasā'pyāryairananubhogyāḥ ||
94511 kāntārabhūmiruhamaulinivāsaśīlāḥ  prāyaḥ palāyanaparā janavīkṣaṇena |
94512 kūjanti te'pi hi śukāḥ khalu rāmanāma  saṅgaḥ svabhāvaparivartavidhau nidānam ||
94521 kāntāravanadurgeṣu kṛcchrāsvāpatsu saṃbhrame |
94522 udyateṣu ca śastreṣu nāsti sattvavatāṃ bhayam ||
94531 kāntā ruciṃ munijanastaruṇo'viyogī  kāmaśca ratnamaṇirujjvalakaṅkaṇena |
94532 dhatte payodharayuge kucabhūṣaṇena  hāre hare himakare makare kare ca ||
94541 kāntāre ghanatimire bhujaṃgamebhyo  no bhītā na ca gaṇitā mahāpagāpi |
94542 kiṃ bāle vahasi bhayaṃ madaṅgasaṃgāt vikrīte kariṇi kimaṅkuśe vivādaḥ ||
94551 kāntāre jalavṛkṣavairiṇi muhustvadvairivāmabhruvo  bālairākulalocanaiḥ pratipadaṃ ruddhakramāścaṅkrame |
94552 pṛthvīcaṇḍaruce paṭaccaradaśāsaṃghaṭṭadīptaprabhaṃ  siñcantyañjalisañcitāśrubhiralaṃ yuṣmatpratāpānalam ||
94561 kāntāre daivagatyā kathamapi galitānyantarālokya bhakṣyāṇy uḍḍīyoḍḍīya bhūyastaruśikharaśikhāmeva tebhyaḥ śrayante |
94562 itthaṃ tvadvairinārī giriṣu narapate jambulambīkadamba  bhrāntyā bharturbubhukṣoḥ kathayati purataśceṣṭitaṃ ṣaṭpadānām ||
94571 kāntāreṣu karāvalambiśiśavaḥ pādaiḥ sravallohitair arcantyaḥ padavīṃ vilocanajalairāvedayantyaḥ śucam |
94572 dṛṣṭāḥ pānthajanairvivṛtya sakṛpaṃ hāśabdagarbhairmukhair yantyahnā sakalena yojanaturīyāṃśaṃ tavāristriyaḥ ||
94581 kāntāreṣu ca kānaneṣu ca sarittīreṣu ca kṣmābhṛtām  utsaṅgeṣu ca pattaneṣu ca saridbhartustaṭānteṣu ca |
94582 bhrāntāḥ ketakagarbhapallavarucaḥ śrāntā iva kṣmāpate  kānte nandanakandalīparisare rohanti te kīrtayaḥ ||
94591 kāntāreṣvapi viśrāmo narasyādhvanikasya vai |
94592 yaḥ sadāraḥ sa viśvāsyastasmāddārāḥ parā gatiḥ ||
94601 kāntāviyogaḥ svajanāpamānaṃ  ṛṇasya śeṣaṃ kunṛpasya sevā |
94602 dāridryabhāvādvimukhaṃ ca mitraṃ  vināgninā pañca dahanti kāyam ||
94611 kāntāśleṣaparāṅmukhaṃ yadi daheddoṣākaraḥ kaṃcana  sthāne tarhi yataḥ sa hanta vidhinā hantuṃ vyadhāyīdṛśān |
94612 kaṣṭaṃ yatpunareṣa candanabhuvo labdhaprabhāvo'bhitaḥ  svarṇadyādyavagāhako marudayaṃ dagdhaṃ pracaṇḍojvalam ||
94621 kāntāsuhṛdguṇakathāśravaṇotsukasya  ramyā vinidranayanasya gatā mamāsau |
94622 sarvendriyārthajanitāni hi sevyamānā  dīrghā svavṛttiriva hanti sukhāni nidrā ||
94631 kāntiṃ kuṅkumakeśarānmadhuratāṃ drākṣārasasyāsavād vaidarbhīparipākapūtavacasaḥ kāvyātkavermārdavam |
94632 pārśvādeva jarātureṇa vidhinā taṃ taṃ gṛhītvā guṇaṃ  sṛṣṭā hanta haranti kasya na manaḥ kaśmīravāmabhruvaḥ ||
94641 kāntiṃ ketakakorakadyutisakhīṃ rākāmṛgāṅkasya yac cañcaccañcu culumpati pratidinaṃ premṇā cakorārbhakaḥ |
94642 tanmanye nayanāmṛtaṃ ratipatermṛtyuñjayenārthinā  tenedaṃ ramaṇīkapolaphalake lāvaṇyamālokitam ||
94651 kāntikallolavalitāṃ nayanāmṛtavāhinīm |
94652 bhajamānaṃ svayaṃ subhru kastvāṃ na bahu manyate ||
9465 1 kāntiprakarṣaṃ daśanacchadena  sandhyāghane baddhapadaṃ harantyāḥ |
9465 2 tasyā gṛhodyānasarogatasya  hastasya evāmburuhasya rāgaḥ ||
94661 kāntimayādativimalād avirataviśvopakāragatakālāt |
94662 sudaśānmahatotimahān  prasarati dīpān pradīpa iva ||
94671 kāntiryasya vinidranīlanalinacchāyāsakhī subhruvāṃ  yatpaṅke'pi mudo'sti yasya surabhiḥ kāsāṃ raso'gocaraḥ |
94672 aṅgārārthitayā janeratijaḍairuḍḍāmaraiḥ pāmaraiḥ  paśyaiṣa praguṇairguṇairapi gururdagdhaḥ sa kālāguruḥ ||
94681 kāntiryasya śaranniśākarakalālāvaṇyasaṃvādinī  taṃ vikretumihāsi yāsi kimaho hāraṃ vihāraṃ śriyaḥ |
94682 etāṃ paśya puraḥ pulindanagarīṃ bhūpāḥ kuraṅgīdṛśāṃ  yatraitā galakandale ca kucayoraṅke ca guñjāsrajaḥ ||
94691 kāntirlocanavartiradbhutamayī mūrtirmahatsaurabhaṃ  niḥṣyando'tha sudhākarādapi sudhāsyandādapi hlādakaḥ |
94692 sarvo'yaṃ viralo jagatyapi guṇagrāmo'bhirāmo hahā  paśyottaṃsabhujaṃgasaṃgamajuṣaḥ śrīkhaṇḍa te khaṇḍitaḥ ||
9469 1 kāntiścandramaso mṛgasya nayane bāhū mṛṇālasya te  haṃsānāṃ gamanaṃ sarojavadane hemno ghaṭau te kucau |
9469 2 etatte parakīyavastu sakalaṃ namaikamātraṃ tava  mānaṃ mā kuru mānini priyatame rūpābhimānaṃ prati ||
94701 kāntiśriyā nirjitapadmarāgaṃ  manojñagandhaṃ dvayameva śastam |
94702 navaprabuddhaṃ jalajaṃ jaleṣu  sthaleṣu tasyā vadanāravindam ||
9470 1 kāntiste kanakācalapratinidhiḥ kāntākucaspardhi te  saubhāgyaṃ kṣitipāladarśanavidhau tvatpūrvakaṃ darśanam |
9470 2 saurabhyaṃ sakalātiśāyi bhavato jambira kiṃ brūmahe  karpūrapratikūlatā yadi na te tvayyeva sarve guṇāḥ ||
94711 kāntiste yadi nirmalā yadi guṇā lakṣmīryadi sthāyinī  mā gāḥ padma madaṃ tathāpi galitā hyete śaradvāsarāḥ |
94712 saṃsparśena tuṣāravāripṛṣatāmālūnamūrteḥ saro  madhye'traiva varāṭakena bhavataḥ stheyaṃ punaḥ kevalam ||
94721 kānte katyapi vāsarāṇi gamaya tvaṃ mīlayitvā dṛśau  svasti svasti nimīlayāmi nayane yāvanna śūnyā diśaḥ |
94722 āyātā vayamāgamiṣyati suhṛdvargasya bhāgyodayaiḥ  sandeśo vada kastavābhilaṣitastīrtheṣu toyāñjaliḥ ||
94731 kānte kathaṃcitkathitaprayāṇe  kṣaṇaṃ vinamrā virahārditāṅgī |
94732 tatastamālokya kadāgato'sīty āliṅgya mugdhā mudamāsasāda ||
94741 kānte kanakajambīraṃ kare kimapi kurvati |
94742 āgāralikhite bhānau bindumindumukhī dadau ||
94751 kānte kalitacolānte dīpe vairiṇi dīpyati |
94752 āsīdasitapadmākṣyāḥ pakṣo nayanamudraṇam ||
94761 kānte kāñculikāvalokini kalāvatyā namantyā sthitaṃ  tasmin komalakākubhāṣiṇi tayā spandī niruddho'dharaḥ |
94762 utthāyātha karaspṛśi priyatame yūnornave saṃgame  kāñcīkūjitakaitavena madano dyauḥśāntimabhyasyati ||
9476 1 kānte kathaya kathaṃ vā  gacchasi pānīyaśālikāmekā |
9476 2 aṅgamanaṅgaṃ nitarām  aṅkurayati paṅkajākṣi vayo'pi tava ||
94771 kānte kiṃ kupitāsi, kaḥ parajane prāṇeśa kopo bhavet ko'yaṃ subhru para, stvameva, dayite dāso'smi kiṃ te paraḥ |
94772 ityuktvā praṇataḥ priyaḥ kṣititalādutthāpya sānandayā  netrāmbhaḥkaṇikāṅkite stanataṭe tanvyā samāropitaḥ ||
94781 kānte kuṭilamālokya karṇakaṇḍūyanena kim |
94782 kāmaṃ kathaya kalyāṇi kiṅkaraḥ karavāṇi yat ||
94791 kānte gṛhāṇa tvamimāṃ svamālām  akāraṇaṃ kiṃ kalahaṃ karoṣi |
94792 yatpūrvapādaṃ manuṣe'tra śuddhaṃ  tattathyamevāsti na cedidaṃ syāt ||
94801 kānte ghorakṛtāntavakrakuharāttvaṃ puṇyapuñjena me  muktā kṛnta tadarjanaśramabharaṃ pratyaṅgamāliṅgya mām |
94802 ityākarṇya nimīlitārdhanayanaṃ smeraṃ śanairānataṃ  sollāsaṃ vadanāmbujaṃ mṛgadṛśaḥ svairaṃ cucumba priyaḥ ||
94811 kānte jagmuṣi tāmracūḍaraṭitaṃ śrutvā prabuddhā javāt kiṃcidvāsavadiṅmukhaṃ pravikasaddṛṣṭvā gavākṣādhvanā |
94812 saṃtrāsena samīritā priyatamapremṇāvaruddhā śanair utthānopaniveśanāni kurute talpe muhuḥ pāṃsulā ||
94821 kānte tathā kathamapi prathitaṃ mṛgākṣyā  cāturyamuddhatamanobhavayā rateṣu |
94822 tatkūjitānyanuvadadbhiranekavāraṃ  śiṣyāyitaṃ gṛhakapotaśatairyathā syāt ||
94831 kānte talpamupāgate vigalitā nīvī svayaṃ tatkṣaṇāt tadvāsaḥ ślathamekhalāguṇadhṛtaṃ kiṃcinnitambe sthitam |
94832 etāvatsakhi vedmi kevalamahaṃ tasyāṅgasaṅge punaḥ  ko'sau kāsmi rataṃ tu kiṃ kathamiti svalpāpi me na smṛtiḥ ||
94841 kāntetyutpalalocaneti vipulaśroṇībharetyunnamat pīnottuṅgapayodhareti sumukhāmbhojeti subhrūriti |
94842 dṛṣṭvā mādyati modate'bhiramate prastauti vidvānapi  pratyakṣāśuciputrikāṃ striyamaho mohasya duśceṣṭitam ||
9484 1 kānte tvatkucacūcukau tadupari smerā ca hārāvalī  tadvaktraṃ taruṇāṅgi bimbitamanucchāyālatāśyāmatām |
9484 2 tvaṃ sarvāṅgamanorame trijagatāṃ badhnāsi dṛṣṭyā mano  jambūvajjalabinduvajjalajavajjambālavajjālavat ||
94851 kānte tvannetrakāntaṃ puru kamalavanaṃ tvanmukhasyopameyaś candraḥ pratyakṣasiddhaḥ pikakulamapi ca tvatsvarasyānukāri |
94852 rambhākāṇḍastvadūrucchavirapi sulabhaḥ kambavaśca tvadīyāḥ  kaṇṭhākārā śikhaṇḍāstava kacasadṛśāstatkathaṃ te'samatvam ||
94861 kānte dhāvaya me pādāviti bhartrā niveditā |
94862 na tayā dhāvitau pādau bharturājñā na laṅghitā ||
94871 kāntena prahito navaḥ priyasakhīvargeṇa baddhaspṛhaś cittenopahṛtaḥ smarāya na samutsraṣṭuṃ gataḥ pāṇinā |
94872 āmṛṣṭo muhurīkṣito muharabhighrāto muhurloṭhitaḥ  pratyaṅgaṃ ca muhuḥ kṛto mṛgadṛśā kiṃ kiṃ na cūtāṅkuraḥ ||
94881 kānte nitāntaṃ dayitākucānta  colāñcalaṃ karṣati harṣamugdhe |
94882 babhāra bālā namitāsyahāsya  leśāpadeśādaparaṃ nicolam ||
94891 kānte nitāntametair vacanai ruṣiteva lakṣyate bhavatī |
94892 ka ivoṣyate na vacanair uktairāgāṃsyapahnotum ||
9489 1 kānte kṛtāgasi puraḥ parivartamāne  sakhyaṃ sarojaśaśinoḥ sahasā babhūva |
9489 2 roṣākṣaraṃ sudṛśi vaktumapārayantyām  indīvaradvayamavāpa tuṣāradhārām ||
9489 1 kānte paśyati sānurāgamabalā sācīkarotyānanaṃ  tasmin kāmakalākalāpakuśale vyāvṛttavaktre kila |
9489 2 paśyantī muhurantaraṅgamadanā dolāyamānekṣaṇā  lajjāmanmathamadhyagāpi nitarāṃ tasyābhavatprītaye ||
94901 kānte yāmi, kva, deśāntara, mapi śayanā, nneti, kiṃ sadmano'pi  kvaitāvanmātra, māḥ kiṃ kathayasi nagarā, nna priye nirvṛto'pi |
94902 ityākarṇyoktavastukramaghanaghanahṛdvedanā veda nāhaṃ  kāhaṃ kutrāsmi ko'yaṃ bata hatasamayo'pyasmi vā nāsmi veti ||
94911 kānte vicitrasuratakramabaddharāge  saṅketake'pi mṛgaśābadṛśā rasena |
94912 tatkūjitaṃ kimapi yena tadīyatalpaṃ  nālpaiḥ parītamanukūjitalāvakaughaiḥ ||
94921 kānte vilāsini kalāvati padmanetre  nityaṃ tvayi priyatame ramate mano me |
94922 itthaṃ bhavantamurubhāvanayā vadantaṃ  śrīkṛṣṇa māṃ budhajanā api hā hasanti ||
94931 kānte sāgasi kañcukaspṛśi tayā sācīkṛtagrīvayā  muktāḥ kopakaṣāyamanmathaśaratkrūrāḥ kaṭākṣāṅkurāḥ |
94932 sākūtaṃ darahāsakesaravacomādhvīkadhārālasā  prītiḥ kalpalateva kācana mahādānīkṛtā subhruvā ||
9493 1 kānte sāgasi kācidantikagate nirbhartsya roṣāruṇair bhrūbhaṅgīkṛṭilairapāṅgavalanairālokamānā muhuḥ |
9493 2 badhvā mekhalayā sapatnaramaṇīpādābjalākṣāṅkitaṃ  līlānīlasaroruheṇa niṭilaṃ hanti sma roṣākulā ||
94941 kānte sāgasi yāpite priyasakhīveṣaṃ vidhāyāgate  bhrāntyāliṅgya mayā rahasyamuditaṃ tatsaṃgamākāṅkṣayā |
94942 mugdhe duṣkarametadityatitarāmuktvā sahāsaṃ balād āliṅgya cchalitāsmi tena kitavenādya pradoṣāgame ||
94951 kānte snehanidhau samīyuṣi madhau jitvā śriyaṃ śaiśirīṃ  viśleṣādiva tasya pāṇḍimabhṛtāmālīlatānāmiyam |
94952 kartuṃ nūtanacitrapatraracanāṃ kiṃ kānanaśrīrimāṃ  prācīnāṃ pavanāñcalena paritaḥ patrāvalīṃ lumpati ||
94961 kānte hanta sukomalā bata matā prāgvyarthameva bhramāt kiṃtu tvaṃ bhuvi niṣṭhurā nirupamā paśyasyapīmaṃ na mām |
94962 tasmādvakṣasi te payodharamiṣāddhātrā nikhāyārpitau  śailendrāviti sāṃprataṃ na hi ciraṃ saukhyaṃ parakleśituḥ ||
94971 kānto narmaṇi naipuṇena viditastvaṃ śaiśavadveṣiṇī  krīḍāśailaśiromaṇirgṛhamidaṃ ramyo vasantotsavaḥ |
94972 sakhyaḥ kāmakathopacāracaturāḥ saṃbhogakāle'dhunā  māno vā kalaho'thavā yadi kadā taccetaso nirvṛtiḥ ||
94981 kānto yāsyati dūradeśamiti me cintā paraṃ jāyate  lokānandakaro hi candravadane vairāyate candramāḥ |
94982 kiṃ cāyaṃ vitanoti kokilakalālāpo vilāpodayaṃ  prāṇāneva haranti hanta nitarāmārāmamandānilāḥ ||
94991 kānto'si nityamadhuro'si rasākulo'si  kiṃ cāsi pañcaśarakārmukamadvitīyam |
94992 ikṣo tavāsti sakalaṃ paramekamūnaṃ  yatsevito bhajasi nīrasatāṃ krameṇa ||
95001 kāntyā kāñcanakāntayā parimalairbhāgyaikabhogyaistathā  saundaryeṇa ca sādhunaiva kusumaṃ hā hanta na tvatsamam |
95002 akrodhaṃ śṛṇu kintu dūṣaṇamiva tvayyasti kiñcitpunas tattvajñairyadacumbitaṃ tvamasi re cāmpeya puṣpandhayaiḥ ||
95011 kāntyā daridratvamupaiti candraḥ  kimasti tattvaṃ vikacotpaleṣu |
95012 na vedyi viśvāsya kathaṃ mṛgākṣyā  saundaryasṛṣṭirmuṣitā vidhātuḥ ||
95021 kāntyā viluptāni vilocanānām  āpāṭalānāmatirodanena |
95022 sakuṅkumānīva punarbhaṃvanti  yasyārinārīkucamaṇḍalāni ||
95031 kāntyā suvarṇavarayā parayā ca śuddhyā  nityaṃ svikāḥ khalu śikhāḥ paritaḥ kṣipantīm |
95032 cetoharāmapi kṛśeśayalocane tvāṃ  jānāmi kopakaluṣo dahano dadāha ||
95041 kānyakubjā dvijāḥ sarve māgadhaṃ mādhuraṃ vinā |
95042 gauḍadrāviḍavikhyātāḥ kānyakubjāḥ mahodbhavāḥ ||
95051 kā pāṇḍupatnī gṛhabhūṣaṇaṃ kiṃ  ko rāmaśatruḥ kimagastyajanma |
95052 kaḥ sūryaputro viparītapṛcchā  kuntīsuto rāvaṇakumbhakarṇāḥ ||
95061 kāpi kāntamidamāha mahelā  sādhu sādhaya tathā yudhi kāryam |
95062 vartate tava yathā ca jayaśrīr lokanāthalalanā ca sapatnī ||
95071 kāpi kuḍyalikhitāvadhirekhāḥ  proṣitapriyatamā gaṇayantī |
95072 veśmani prabalavahniparīte  sāsrayā bahiranīyata sakhyā ||
95081 kāpi mukhyapadavīmadhiropya  svāṃ sakhīṃ svakaradhāritadīpā |
95082 prāṇanātharatigehamayāsīd adbhuto ratipaterupadeśaḥ ||
95091 kāpiśāyanasugandhi vighūrṇann  unmado'dhiśayituṃ samaśeta |
95092 phulladṛṣṭivadanaṃ pramadānām  abjacāru caṣakaṃ ca śaḍaṅghriḥ ||
95101 kāpi śīghramavadhīritamānā  mānino vicalitā priyadhāmni |
95102 āgatena marutāpi purastāl lāghavasya parihāramamaṃsta ||
95111 kāpuruṣaḥ kukkuraśca bhojanaikaparāyaṇaḥ |
95112 lālitaḥ pārśvamāyāti vārito naiva gacchati ||
95121 kāpyaṅghrī raṅgapatryāruṇayati ramaṇī bhūṣaṇairbhāti kācid gāyatyanyā parāpi pralasati laharīlakṣma vāso vasānā |
95122 yatrānyā snehapūrān vitarati ca mudaṃ yāti dolābhiranyā  sā śṛṅgāradvitīyā racayati na manaḥ kasya śṛṅgāramagnam ||
95131 kāpyanyā mukulādhikāramilitā lakṣmīraśokadrume  mākandaḥ samayocitena vidhinā dhatte'bhijātaṃ vapuḥ |
95132 kiṃ cāṣāḍhagireranaṅgavijayaprastāvanāpaṇḍita ḥ  svairaṃ sarpati bālacandanalatālīlāsakho mārutaḥ ||
95141 kāpyabhikhyā tayorāsīdvrajato śuddhaveṣayoḥ |
95142 himanirmuktayoryoge citrācandramasoriva ||
95151 kāpyāgataṃ vīkṣya manodhināthaṃ  samutthitā sādaramāsanāya |
95152 kareṇa śiñjadvalayena talpam  āsphālayantī kalamājuhāva ||
95161 kā prastutābhiṣekād āryaṃ pracyāvayedguṇajyeṣṭham |
95162 manye mamaiva puṇyaiḥ  sevāvasaraḥ kṛto vidhinā ||
95171 kā priyeṇa rahitā varāṅganā  dhāmni kena tanayena nanditā |
95172 kīdṛśena puruṣeṇa pakṣiṇāṃ  bandhanaṃ samabhilaṣyate sadā ||
95181 kā prītiḥ saha mārjāraiḥ kā prītiravanīpatau |
95182 gaṇikābhiśca kā prītiḥ kā prītirbhikṣukaiḥ saha ||
95191 kābhirna tatrābhinavasmarājñā  viśvāsanikṣepavaṇikkriye'ham |
95192 jihneti yannaiva kuto'pi tiryak kaścittiraścastrapate na tena ||
95201 kā bhūṣā balināṃ, kṣamā, paribhavaḥ, kopaḥ svakulyaiḥ kṛtaḥ  kiṃ duḥkhaṃ, parasaṃśrayo, jagati kaḥ ślāghyo, ya āśrīyate |
95202 ko mṛtyu, rvyasanaṃ, śucaṃ jahati ke, yairnirjitā śatravaḥ  kairvijñātamidaṃ virāṭanagaracchannasthitaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ ||
95211 kāmaṃ karīṣāgnimadho nidhāyā  bhrameṇa tāpātiśayaṃ bhajadhvam |
95212 yuṣmākamadyāvadhi nādhikāro  dugdhātimugdhādharamādhurīṣu ||
95221 kāmaṃ karṇakaṭuḥ kṛto'timadhuraḥ kekāravaḥ kekināṃ  meghāścāmṛtadhāriṇo'pi vihitāḥ prāyo viṣasyandinaḥ |
95222 unmīlannavakandalāvalirasau śayyāpi sarpāyate  tatkiṃ yadviparītamatra na kṛtaṃ tasyā viyogena me ||
95231 kāmaṃ kāmadughaṃ dhuṅkṣva mitrāya varuṇāya ca |
95232 vayaṃ dhīreṇa dānena sarvān kāmānaśīmahi ||
95241 kāmaṃ kāmayate na kelinalinīṃ nāmodate kaumudī  nisyandairna samīhate mṛgadṛśāmālāpalīlāmapi |
95242 sīdanneṣa niśāsu duḥsahatanurbhogābhilāṣālasair aṅgaistāmyati cetasi vrajavadhūmādhāya mugdho hariḥ ||
95251 kāmaṃ kāmayamānasya yadā kāmaḥ samṛddhyate |
95252 athainamaparaḥ kāmastṛṣṇā vidhyati bāṇavat ||
95261 kāmaṃ kāmasamastvamatra jagati khyāto'si yatsarvadā  rūpeṇaiva mahīpate tava dhanuḥpāṇḍityamanyādṛśam |
95262 tvaṃ yasmin viśikhaṃ vimuñcasi tamevoddiśya muktatrapaṃ  truṭyatkaṃcukamudgataspṛhamaho dhāvanti devāṅganāḥ ||
95271 kāmaṃ kumīnasadṛśaṃ  rājyamapi prājyakaṇṭakaṃ kuśalaḥ |
95272 pākānvitamatisurasaṃ  bhuṅkte bahudhāvadhānena ||
95281 kāmaṃ kūle nadīnāmanugiri mahiṣīyūthanīḍopakaṇṭhe  gāhante śaṣparājīrabhinavaśalabhagrāsalolā balākāḥ |
95282 antarvinyastavīruttṛṇamayapuruṣatrāsavighnaṃ kathaṃcit kāpotaṃ kodravāṇāṃ kavalayati kaṇān kṣetrakoṇaikadeśe ||
95291 kāmaṃ kopakaṣāyitākṣiyugalaṃ kṛtvā karotphālanaiḥ  kṣudrān vanyamṛgātkarīndra sahasā vidrāvaya tvaṃ mudā |
95292 helākhaṇḍitakumbhikumbhavigaladraktāruṇāṅge harau  jāte locanagocare yadi bhavān sthātā tadā manmahe ||
95301 kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca dambhaṃ darpaṃ ca bhūmipaḥ |
95302 samyagvijetuṃ yo veda sa mahīmabhijāyate ||
9530 1 kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ lobhaṃ dambhaṃ mohaṃ madaṃ tathā |
9530 2 nidrāṃ matsaramālasyaṃ nāstikyaṃ ca parityaja ||
95311 kāmaṃ krodhaṃ lobhaṃ mohaṃ  tyaktvātmānaṃ paśya hi ko'ham
95312 ātmajñānavihīnā mūḍhās te pacyante narake mūḍhāḥ ||
95321 kāmaṃ guṇairmahāneṣa prakṛtyā punarāsuraḥ |
95322 utkarṣātsarvato vṛtteḥ sarvākāraṃ hi dṛpyati ||
95331 kāmaṃ janāḥ smayante  kailāsavilāsavarṇanāvasare |
95332 sādhanakathanāvasare  sācīkurvanti vaktrāṇi ||
95341 kāmaṃ tu kṣapayeddehaṃ puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
95342 na tu nāmāpi gṛhṇīyātpatyau prete parasya tu ||
95351 kāmaṃ dahantu maruto malayācalasya  candro'pi pātayatu vā nitarāṃ sphuliṅgān |
95352 dūre priyo vimalavaṃśamaṇiḥ patirme  tatsāmprataṃ tvaritamānaya taṃ kathaṃcit ||
95361 kāmaṃ dīrghā bhavedyātrā kāmaṃ panthā mahān bhavet |
95362 so'pi prabhoḥ kṛpāmeva nityamāśrayate'ntataḥ ||
95371 kāmaṃ dugdhe viprakarṣatyalakṣmīṃ  kīrtiṃ sūte duṣkṛtaṃ yā hinasti |
95372 tāṃ cāpyetāṃ mātaraṃ maṅgalānāṃ  dhenuṃ dhīrāḥ sūnṛtāṃ vācamāhuḥ ||
95381 kāmaṃ durviṣahajvaraṃ janayati vyāghūrṇayatpakṣiṇī  gātrāṇyūrunitambagaṇḍahṛdayānyucchūnayatyulbaṇam |
95382 tāṃ tāṃ durvikṛtaṃ karoti suhṛdo gāḍhaṃ vyathante yayā  vyādhiyauvanamātmanāśaniyataḥ ke te grahaṇyādayaḥ ||
95391 kāmaṃ dṛṣṭā mayā sarvā vivastrā rāvaṇastriyaḥ |
95392 na tu me manasaḥ kiṃcidvaikṛtyamupapadyate ||
95401 mano hi hetuḥ sarveṣāmindriyāṇāṃ pravartane |
95402 śubhāśubhāsvavasthāsu tacca me suvyavasthitam ||
95411 kāmaṃ na paśyati didṛkṣata eva bhūmnā  noktāpi jalpati vivakṣati cādareṇa |
95412 lajjāsmaravyatikareṇa mano'dhināthe  bālā rasāntaramidaṃ lalitaṃ bibharti ||
95421 kāmaṃ niṣkaruṇaṃ vetsi vetsi taṃ bahuvallabham |
95422 dūti cūtāṅkurakharā diśo vetsi na vetsi kim ||
95431 kāmaṃ nṛpāḥ santu sahasraśo'nye  rājanvatīmāhuranena bhūmim |
95432 nakṣatratārāgrahasaṃkulāpi  jyotiṣmatī cāndramasaiva rātriḥ ||
9543 1 kāmaṃ paramiti jñātvā devo'pi hi purandaraḥ |
9543 2 gautamasya muneḥ patnīmahalyāṃ cakame purā ||
95441 kāmaṃ pratyādiṣṭāṃ  smarāmi na parigrahaṃ munestanayān |
95442 balavattu dūyamānaṃ  pratyāyayatīva me hṛdayam ||
95451 kāmaṃ pradīpayati rūpamabhivyanakti  saubhāgyamāvahati vaktrasugandhitāṃ ca |

95481 kāmaṃ pradoṣatimireṇa na dṛśyase tvaṃ  saudāminīva jaladodarasaṃdhilīnā |

95501 kāmaṃ priyā na sulabhā  manastu tadbhāvadarśanāśvāsi |

95601 kāmaṃ śīrṇapalāśapatraracitāṃ kanthāṃ vasāno vane  kuryāmambubhirapyayācitasukhaiḥ prāṇānubandhasthitim |

95611 kāmaṃ śunako nṛpati  prasādataḥ syādgajendramaulisthaḥ |

95631 kāmaṃ santu sahasraśaḥ katipaye sārasyadhaureyakāḥ  kāmaṃ vā kamanīyatāparimalasvārājyabaddhavratāḥ |

95651 kāmaṃ striyo niṣeveta pānaṃ vā sādhu mātrayā |

9569 1 kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca dehe tiṣṭhanti taskarāḥ |

96121 kāmayante virajyante rañjayanti tyajanti ca |

96401 kāmārtāṃ svayamāyātāṃ yo na bhuṅkte nitambinīm |
96402 so'vaśyaṃ narakaṃ yāti tanniḥśvāsahato naraḥ ||
96411 kāmārtāṃ svastriyaṃ dīnāṃ prārthayantīṃ punaḥ punaḥ |
96412 na bhajedbhajamānāṃ yaḥ sa vai cāṇḍāladarśanaḥ ||
9641 1 kāmārtā gharmataptā vetyaniścayakaraṃ vacaḥ |
9641 2 yuvānamākulīkartumiti dūtyāha narmaṇā ||
9641 1 kāmārthamajñaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ karoti  prāpnoti duḥkhaṃ vadhabandhanādi |
9641 2 kāmārthamāśākṛpaṇastapasvī  mṛrtyu śramaṃ cācchati jīvalokaḥ ||
96421 kāmārthau lipsamānastu dharmamevāditaścaret |
96422 na hi dharmādapaityarthaḥ kāmo vāpi kadācana ||
9642 1 kāmāllobhādbhayātkrodhātsākṣivādāttathaiva ca |
9642 2 mithyā vadati yatpāpaṃ tadasatyaṃ prakīrtitam ||
9642 1 kāmāveśaḥ kaitavasyopadeśaḥ  māyākośo vañcanāsanniveśaḥ |
